summary_zh: 缓解胸闷气短，帮助你深呼吸更顺畅。
summary_en: Eases chest tightness and helps you breathe more deeply.
location_zh: 锁骨外端下方有个三角形凹窝，从凹窝正中往下摸一根肋骨的距离就到了。按下去会有明显酸胀感，位置大约在乳头正上方偏外两横指处。
location_en: Find the hollow below the outer end of your collarbone. Drop straight down about one thumb-width. It sits roughly two finger-widths above and outside your nipple line. Press in and you'll feel a distinct deep ache.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的中指指腹，按住穴位向肋骨方向用力，做小幅度揉圈。力度中等偏重，以酸胀为度，不要用力到疼痛。
massage_en: Use the middle finger of your opposite hand. Press firmly inward toward the ribs and make small circular motions. Aim for a deep, achy pressure — not sharp pain.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天2-3次，早晚各一次效果更好。
routine_en: Press for 1-2 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Morning and evening work best.
when_zh: 感觉胸口发闷、叹气才舒服的时候；久坐含胸驼背后；感冒初期咳嗽时。
when_en: When your chest feels stuffy and you keep sighing for relief. After long hours hunched over a desk. At the start of a cold with coughing.
tips_zh: 按揉时配合深呼吸，吸气时轻按，呼气时加力。可以先按中府再按云门（上方一寸），效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with deep breathing — press lighter on inhale, deeper on exhale. Follow up by pressing LU2 (Yunmen), just above, for a stronger effect.
caution_zh: 此处下方是肺脏，只能平着按揉，不要用手指或硬物垂直深压。孕妇慎用。
caution_en: The lungs sit directly beneath this point. Press at an angle, never straight down with hard force. Avoid during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 打开胸腔、缓解肩前部紧张，让呼吸更自在。
summary_en: Opens up the chest and releases tension in the front of your shoulder.
location_zh: 双手叉腰站直，锁骨外端正下方有一个明显的三角形凹窝，窝的正中就是。按下去会有酸胀感，同时可能觉得肩膀有放松的感觉。
location_en: Stand with hands on hips. Feel for the hollow directly below the outer tip of your collarbone — there's a clear triangular dip. Press the center of that dip. You'll feel soreness and your shoulder may start to relax.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的食指和中指并拢，指腹按住凹窝，缓慢画圈揉动。力度中等，感觉酸胀即可。也可以用指腹按住不动，持续按压。
massage_en: Place two fingertips (index and middle) of the opposite hand into the hollow. Rub in slow circles with moderate pressure, or simply hold steady pressure until you feel the tension release.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天2次，久坐工作时随时可按。
routine_en: Press 1-2 minutes each time, twice daily. Also useful anytime during desk work.
when_zh: 肩膀前侧酸紧时；长时间打字后胸口发紧时；呼吸浅短觉得吸不到底时。
when_en: When the front of your shoulders feel tight. After long typing sessions when your chest feels constricted. When your breathing feels shallow.
tips_zh: 按揉的同时慢慢扩胸，把肩膀向后打开，效果更明显。配合中府（下方一寸）一起按更好。
tips_en: While pressing, slowly roll your shoulders back and open your chest for a deeper release. Pair with LU1 (Zhongfu) just below for best results.
caution_zh: 此处靠近肺尖，只适合轻到中等力度按揉，不可用力深压。
caution_en: This point sits near the top of the lung. Use only light to moderate pressure — never press deeply inward.

summary_zh: 缓解上臂酸痛，也对鼻塞流涕有帮助。
summary_en: Relieves upper arm soreness and helps with nasal congestion.
location_zh: 手臂自然下垂，从腋窝前面的横纹往下量四横指（约3寸），摸到上臂内侧有一条肌肉的外缘就是。按下去会有明显酸痛感。
location_en: Let your arm hang naturally. Measure four finger-widths down from the front crease of your armpit. Find the outer edge of the muscle on the inner side of your upper arm. Press in — you'll feel a clear sore spot.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指按住穴位，其余四指环抱上臂固定，拇指做按压-松开的节奏性动作。力度中等，酸胀为度。
massage_en: Grip your upper arm with the opposite hand, thumb on the point. Press rhythmically — squeeze for 3 seconds, release for 2 seconds. Use moderate pressure until you feel a deep ache.
routine_zh: 每次按压1-2分钟，每天1-2次，鼻塞时可随时按。
routine_en: Press 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime when congested.
when_zh: 上臂酸痛无力时；感冒鼻塞、流鼻涕时；季节性过敏打喷嚏时。
when_en: When your upper arm feels sore or weak. During colds with a stuffy or runny nose. During seasonal allergy sneezing fits.
tips_zh: 鼻塞时可以配合按迎香穴（鼻翼两旁），通鼻效果更快。按揉时保持均匀呼吸。
tips_en: For nasal congestion, combine with pressing beside your nostrils (LI20 Yingxiang) for faster relief. Keep breathing steadily while pressing.
caution_zh: 力度不要过大，此处肌肉较薄，按到骨头就减轻力度。
caution_en: The muscle here is thin. Ease up if you feel bone beneath your finger. Avoid heavy pressure.

summary_zh: 缓解上臂内侧疼痛，也能帮助减轻胸闷和干呕。
summary_en: Eases inner upper arm pain and helps relieve chest discomfort and nausea.
location_zh: 从腋窝前面的横纹往下量五横指（约4寸），在上臂内侧那条肌肉的外缘，天府穴再往下一横指就是。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: From the front armpit crease, measure five finger-widths down along the inner arm. It's one finger-width below LU3 (Tianfu), on the outer edge of the muscle. You'll feel a tender, achy spot when you press.
massage_zh: 用对侧手拇指按住穴位，做缓慢的按揉，顺时针和逆时针各揉半分钟交替。力度适中，感觉酸胀但不刺痛。
massage_en: Use the opposite thumb. Press and rub slowly, alternating clockwise and counterclockwise circles every 30 seconds. Keep the pressure moderate — achy but not sharp.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，感觉不适时随时可按。
routine_en: Press 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily, or whenever discomfort arises.
when_zh: 上臂内侧酸痛时；胸口闷得想干呕时；心慌气短不舒服时。
when_en: When the inside of your upper arm aches. When chest tightness triggers an urge to gag. When you feel short of breath or uneasy.
tips_zh: 可以和天府穴一起按揉，沿着上臂内侧从上往下依次按效果更好。按前先搓热双手。
tips_en: Press together with LU3 (Tianfu) — work down the inner arm in sequence. Warm your hands by rubbing them together before you start.
caution_zh: 避免在上臂有淤青或红肿时按压此处。
caution_en: Skip this point if you have bruises or swelling on your upper arm.

summary_zh: 缓解咳嗽咽痛，也是肘部不适的要穴。
summary_en: Relieves coughs, sore throat, and elbow discomfort.
location_zh: 手臂微微弯曲，掌心朝上，在肘弯横纹上摸到一条大筋（手肘中间那根紧绷的筋），筋的外侧（靠拇指那侧）凹陷处就是。按下去酸胀感很明显。
location_en: Bend your elbow slightly, palm facing up. Feel the thick tendon in the center of your elbow crease. The point is in the hollow just to the thumb-side of that tendon. Press and you'll feel a strong, deep ache.
massage_zh: 用对侧手拇指顶住凹陷处，做垂直按压并小幅度揉动。力度可以稍重，以明显酸胀为度。也可以用拇指做弹拨，横向拨动肌腱旁的肌肉。
massage_en: Press your opposite thumb firmly into the hollow. Apply direct downward pressure with small circular rubs. You can also strum across the tendon area with your thumb. The pressure can be moderately firm — a strong ache is normal here.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天2次，咳嗽发作时可随时按。
routine_en: Press 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily. Press anytime during a coughing episode.
when_zh: 感冒咳嗽、喉咙痛时；肘关节酸痛、手臂用力后不适时；夏天中暑头晕时。
when_en: When you have a cough or sore throat from a cold. When your elbow aches after overuse. When you feel dizzy from heat or summer sun.
tips_zh: 咳嗽时配合按合谷穴（虎口处）效果更好。按揉前后多喝温水，帮助缓解咽喉不适。
tips_en: For coughs, combine with pressing Hegu (LI4, in the web between thumb and index finger). Drink warm water before and after to soothe your throat.
caution_zh: 肘部有损伤或关节炎急性发作时不要用力按压。按揉时避开中间的肌腱。
caution_en: Avoid firm pressure if your elbow is injured or inflamed. Press beside the tendon, not directly on it.

summary_zh: 急性咳嗽、咽喉痛时的应急穴位，也能缓解前臂酸痛。
summary_en: A go-to point for sudden coughs and sore throats, also eases forearm soreness.
location_zh: 掌心朝上，先找到手腕横纹和肘横纹的正中点，从中点再往肘方向量一横指。在前臂外侧骨头（靠拇指那侧的骨头）的内缘就是。按下去比较酸痛。
location_en: Palm up, find the midpoint between your wrist crease and elbow crease. Go one thumb-width toward the elbow from that midpoint. Feel along the inner edge of the forearm bone on the thumb side. Press and you'll feel a notably sharp ache.
massage_zh: 用对侧手拇指用力按住穴位，做持续按压或小幅度揉动。力度可以偏重，此穴按起来通常比较酸。急性咳嗽时可以用指尖重按。
massage_en: Press firmly with the opposite thumb, holding steady or making small circles. This point often feels quite intense. During an acute coughing fit, use your fingertip to press hard for quick relief.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天2-3次。急性咳嗽时可随时重按30秒。
routine_en: Press 1-2 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. For sudden coughs, press hard for 30 seconds as needed.
when_zh: 突然咳嗽停不下来时；嗓子突然痛起来时；前臂酸痛、写字打字太久时。
when_en: When a cough won't stop. When your throat suddenly flares up. When your forearm aches from too much writing or typing.
tips_zh: 急性咳嗽时可以左右两侧同时按压。配合多喝温水、含润喉糖效果更好。
tips_en: For acute coughs, press both forearms simultaneously. Follow up with warm water or a throat lozenge for added relief.
caution_zh: 此穴按起来会比较痛，可以接受就好，不要过度用力以免淤青。
caution_en: This point can be quite tender. Accept a strong ache but don't press so hard that you bruise.

summary_zh: 头痛和脖子僵硬的特效穴，也能缓解咳嗽。
summary_en: A key point for headaches and stiff neck, also calms coughs.
location_zh: 两手虎口交叉（右手在上握左手腕，或反过来），食指尖自然搭到手腕上方骨头突起旁边，指尖所到的凹陷处就是。按下去有酸胀并可能向手指方向窜。
location_en: Cross your hands, one gripping the other wrist with the thumb-web interlocked. Your index fingertip lands on a bony bump on the wrist — the point is in the dip right where your fingertip rests. Press and you may feel the ache radiate toward your thumb.
massage_zh: 用对侧手拇指指尖掐按凹陷处，做按压加小幅度揉动。力度中等偏重，酸胀感明显即可。也可以用指甲尖稍加刺激。
massage_en: Use the opposite thumbnail or thumb tip to press firmly into the hollow. Combine steady pressure with small circular rubs. Moderate-to-firm pressure works best — you should feel a clear, spreading ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天2-3次。头痛时立即按，不限次数。
routine_en: Press 2-3 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. During headaches, press immediately — no limit on frequency.
when_zh: 头痛、偏头痛发作时；脖子僵硬转不动时；感冒初起怕冷打喷嚏时；咳嗽时。
when_en: When a headache or migraine hits. When your neck is so stiff you can't turn. At the first sign of a cold with chills and sneezing. When coughing.
tips_zh: 头痛时配合按合谷穴（虎口）效果翻倍。脖子僵硬时可以边按列缺边慢慢转动脖子。
tips_en: For headaches, pair with Hegu (LI4, in the thumb web) for a much stronger effect. For stiff neck, slowly rotate your head while pressing this point.
caution_zh: 孕妇不宜刺激此穴。按揉时不要过度扭转手腕。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Don't twist your wrist into an awkward position while pressing.

summary_zh: 缓解手腕不适和咳嗽胸闷的辅助穴位。
summary_en: Helps relieve wrist discomfort, coughs, and chest tightness.
location_zh: 掌心朝上，手腕横纹上方一横指处，靠拇指那侧摸到一个骨头突起，突起内侧能感觉到脉搏跳动，脉搏和骨头之间的凹陷就是。
location_en: Palm up, one thumb-width above your wrist crease on the thumb side. Feel for the bony bump — then find the groove between that bump and the pulse you can feel beating. The point is in that groove.
massage_zh: 用对侧手拇指轻轻按住凹陷，做小幅度揉圈。这里靠近动脉，力度一定要轻柔，感觉微微酸胀即可，千万不要重按。
massage_en: Gently press the opposite thumb into the groove and rub in small circles. Keep the pressure light — this is near an artery. A mild ache is enough; never press hard here.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1分钟，每天1-2次，咳嗽期间可增加次数。
routine_en: Gently rub for 1 minute, 1-2 times daily. Increase frequency during cough episodes.
when_zh: 手腕酸痛、活动不利时；咳嗽伴有胸口闷痛时；嗓子痛说话费力时。
when_en: When your wrist is sore or stiff. When coughing comes with chest tightness. When your throat hurts and talking feels effortful.
tips_zh: 配合太渊穴（手腕横纹处）一起按，沿手臂内侧从上往下顺序按效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with LU9 (Taiyuan) at the wrist crease. Press in sequence down the inner forearm for the best effect.
caution_zh: 此处有桡动脉经过，按揉力度必须轻柔，绝对不要重按。
caution_en: A major artery runs here. Always use gentle pressure — never press hard on this point.

summary_zh: 手腕疼痛和慢性咳嗽的常用穴，也能帮助改善循环。
summary_en: A go-to point for wrist pain and lingering coughs, also supports circulation.
location_zh: 掌心朝上，手腕最靠近手掌的那条横纹上，靠拇指那侧能摸到脉搏跳动的地方。脉搏跳动点的拇指侧凹陷就是。按下去有轻微酸胀。
location_en: Palm up, find the wrist crease closest to your palm. On the thumb side, feel your pulse beating. The point is in the small hollow just to the thumb-side of that pulse. You'll feel a mild, deep ache when you press.
massage_zh: 用对侧手拇指轻轻按在穴位上，做非常轻柔的揉圈或持续按压。注意避开脉搏跳动最强的地方，稍微偏向拇指侧。力度要轻。
massage_en: Press gently with the opposite thumb, making very soft circles or holding steady pressure. Stay slightly to the thumb-side of the strongest pulse beat. Keep the touch light and steady.
routine_zh: 每次轻按1-2分钟，每天2次，早晨和睡前各一次。
routine_en: Press gently for 1-2 minutes, twice daily — once in the morning, once before bed.
when_zh: 手腕痛、活动受限时；久咳不愈、嗓子总是不舒服时；手脚发凉、循环不好时。
when_en: When your wrist hurts or feels restricted. When a cough lingers for weeks. When your hands and feet are always cold.
tips_zh: 配合列缺穴一起按，先列缺后太渊。手脚凉的人可以先搓热双手再按，同时配合深呼吸。
tips_en: Pair with LU7 (Lieque) — press Lieque first, then Taiyuan. If your hands are cold, warm them by rubbing together before you start. Add deep breathing.
caution_zh: 此处有动脉，只能轻按，不可重压。正在服用抗凝血药物者慎用。
caution_en: An artery runs beneath this point — light pressure only. Use caution if you take blood-thinning medication.

summary_zh: 嗓子痛、声音嘶哑时最好用的穴位之一。
summary_en: One of the best points for a sore throat and hoarse voice.
location_zh: 把手掌摊开，拇指根部有一块鼓起来的肌肉（像鱼肚子一样），在这块肌肉的中间靠外侧边缘，手掌颜色深浅交界的地方就是。按下去酸痛很明显。
location_en: Open your palm. The fleshy mound at the base of your thumb looks like a fish belly. Find the midpoint along its outer edge, right where the skin color changes from palm-pink to back-of-hand. Press in firmly — it will feel distinctly sore.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指尖用力按住穴位，做垂直按压或带揉动的按压。此穴适合稍重的力度，酸痛感比较强是正常的。也可以两手鱼际互相对搓发热。
massage_en: Press hard with the opposite thumb tip straight into the point, or press and rub. Strong soreness is normal here. You can also rub both fish-belly mounds against each other until they feel warm.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天2-3次。嗓子痛时可以随时按。
routine_en: Press 2-3 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime when your throat hurts.
when_zh: 嗓子痛、声音哑时；发烧、手心发烫时；喉咙干痒想咳嗽时；讲话太多嗓子累时。
when_en: When your throat is sore or your voice goes hoarse. When your palms feel hot during a fever. When your throat itches and triggers coughing. After talking too much.
tips_zh: 嗓子痛时配合少商穴（拇指指甲旁）一起按效果更好。平时可以经常对搓两手鱼际来预防感冒。
tips_en: For sore throats, combine with LU11 (Shaoshang) near the thumbnail for stronger relief. Regularly rubbing both fish-belly mounds together can help prevent colds.
caution_zh: 此穴按压会比较痛，根据自己的承受力调节力度即可。
caution_en: This point can be quite painful. Adjust pressure to your own comfort level.

summary_zh: 嗓子肿痛和高烧的急救穴，日常按压能预防咽喉不适。
summary_en: An emergency point for severe sore throat and high fever; daily pressing prevents throat problems.
location_zh: 拇指指甲靠外侧（远离其他手指的一侧），指甲根部角落旁约一粒米的距离就是。按的时候用指甲掐这个点，会有尖锐的刺痛感。
location_en: On your thumb, find the corner of the nail base on the outer side (away from the other fingers). The point is about a grain of rice away from that corner. Pinch it with your opposite thumbnail — you'll feel a sharp, stinging sensation.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指和食指捏住拇指指甲两侧，用拇指指甲对准穴位做掐按。力度可以稍重，有刺痛感是正常的。每次掐按5-10秒，松开，重复。
massage_en: Pinch the sides of your thumbnail between the opposite thumb and index finger. Dig your thumbnail into the point for 5-10 seconds, release, and repeat. A sharp sting is normal. Use firm pressure.
routine_zh: 每次掐按1-2分钟（反复掐放），每天1-2次。嗓子痛时加按。
routine_en: Pinch on and off for 1-2 minutes total, 1-2 times daily. Add extra sessions when your throat is sore.
when_zh: 嗓子突然肿痛、吞口水都痛时；发高烧时；感觉快要感冒的第一时间；流鼻血时。
when_en: When your throat suddenly swells and even swallowing hurts. During a high fever. At the very first hint of a cold coming on. When you have a nosebleed.
tips_zh: 嗓子痛时配合鱼际穴一起按，双管齐下效果明显。可以左右手拇指都按，不限于一侧。
tips_en: For sore throats, combine with LU10 (Yuji) for a noticeably stronger effect. Press both thumbs, not just one side.
caution_zh: 此穴刺激较强，每次掐按时间不要过长。孕妇慎用。
caution_en: This point produces strong stimulation — keep each pinch brief. Avoid during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解咽喉痛、牙痛，帮助退热提神。
summary_en: Relieves sore throat, toothache, and helps clear a foggy head.
location_zh: 食指指甲根部靠拇指那一侧，指甲角旁约2毫米处。按下去会有明显的刺痛感。
location_en: On your index finger, about 2mm from the base corner of the nail on the thumb side. Press and you'll feel a sharp, distinct tenderness.
massage_zh: 用另一手的拇指指甲尖掐按此穴，力度中等偏强，有明显酸胀感即可。也可用指甲反复快速掐按。
massage_en: Pinch this point firmly with the thumbnail of your other hand. Use a press-and-release rhythm, applying moderate to strong pressure. You should feel a clear ache.
routine_zh: 每次掐按30～50下，每天2～3次，感到不适时随时可按。
routine_en: Pinch 30-50 times per session, 2-3 times daily. Use anytime you feel discomfort.
when_zh: 嗓子突然痛、发烧觉得昏沉、牙疼难忍时。
when_en: When a sore throat comes on suddenly, you feel feverish and groggy, or a toothache flares up.
tips_zh: 配合掐按少商穴（拇指指甲旁）效果更好。掐按时慢慢深呼吸，有助放松。
tips_en: Pair with Shaoshang (LU11, at the thumbnail base) for stronger relief. Breathe slowly and deeply while pressing.
caution_zh: 此处皮肤薄，掐按力度不宜过猛，避免掐破皮肤。
caution_en: The skin here is thin. Don't press so hard that you break the skin.

summary_zh: 缓解牙痛、喉咙痛和眼睛不适。
summary_en: Eases toothache, sore throat, and eye discomfort.
location_zh: 微握拳，食指根部关节前方靠拇指一侧，手背皮肤和手掌皮肤交界处的凹陷中。按下去会有酸胀感。
location_en: Make a loose fist. Find the crease in front of your index finger knuckle on the thumb side, where the lighter palm skin meets the darker back-of-hand skin. Press into the dip — you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按揉，力度中等，做小圆圈旋转按摩。感到酸胀为宜。
massage_en: Press with your thumb pad and massage in small circles using moderate pressure. You should feel a satisfying deep ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1～2分钟，每天2～3次。
routine_en: Massage 1-2 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily.
when_zh: 牙痛、嗓子不舒服、眼睛干涩发红、流鼻血时。
when_en: When you have a toothache, scratchy throat, dry or red eyes, or a nosebleed.
tips_zh: 牙痛时配合按压合谷穴效果更佳。按摩前可搓热双手。
tips_en: For toothache, combine with Hegu (LI4) for better results. Warm your hands by rubbing them together before pressing.
caution_zh: 按压力度适中，不要用力过猛导致手指关节不适。
caution_en: Use moderate pressure. Don't press so hard that your finger joint becomes sore.

summary_zh: 缓解眼痛、牙痛、咽喉肿痛和手背胀痛。
summary_en: Relieves eye pain, toothache, sore throat, and swollen hands.
location_zh: 微握拳，食指根部关节后方靠拇指一侧，手背与手掌皮肤交界处的凹陷中。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Make a loose fist. Behind the index finger knuckle on the thumb side, where palm skin meets back-of-hand skin, find the small dip. Press in — you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指尖按压凹陷处，力度中等偏强，持续按压后做小幅度揉动。
massage_en: Press your thumb tip firmly into the dip. Hold steady pressure for a few seconds, then massage in tiny circles. Moderate to firm pressure.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1～3分钟，每天2次，早晚各一次。
routine_en: Massage 1-3 minutes per session, twice daily — morning and evening.
when_zh: 眼睛酸痛、牙疼、嗓子肿痛、手背肿胀、消化不好胃胀时。
when_en: When your eyes ache, teeth hurt, throat is swollen, hands feel puffy, or you have bloating after eating.
tips_zh: 配合按压合谷穴，对缓解头面部疼痛效果更好。按压时配合缓慢呼气。
tips_en: Combine with Hegu (LI4) for head and face pain. Exhale slowly as you press for deeper relief.
caution_zh: 力度不宜过大，手指关节有损伤时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid pressing if your finger joint is injured. Keep pressure firm but not painful.

summary_zh: 头痛、牙痛、感冒的万能穴，全身最常用的保健穴之一。
summary_en: The go-to point for headaches, toothaches, and colds — incredibly versatile.
location_zh: 把拇指和食指并拢，手背上隆起的肌肉最高点就是。张开手再按，会摸到一个明显的酸痛点。
location_en: Squeeze your thumb and index finger together — see the muscle that bulges on the back of your hand? The highest point of that bulge is it. Now spread your fingers and press there. You'll feel a deep, unmistakable ache.
massage_zh: 用另一手的拇指按在穴位上，食指垫在掌心，拇指用力向食指方向按揉。力度要有明显酸胀感，做圆圈按揉。
massage_en: Place your other thumb on the point with your index finger supporting underneath your palm. Press the thumb firmly toward the index finger in a circular massage. You should feel a strong, spreading ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2～3分钟，每天2～3次。头痛时可随时按。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime a headache strikes.
when_zh: 头痛、偏头痛、牙痛、感冒鼻塞、面部疼痛、便秘、压力大精神紧张时。
when_en: Headaches, migraines, toothaches, stuffy nose from a cold, facial pain, constipation, or when you feel tense and stressed.
tips_zh: 头痛时同时按太冲穴（脚背上）效果翻倍。便秘时顺时针揉腹部后再按合谷。
tips_en: For headaches, press Taichong (LR3, on top of the foot) at the same time for doubled effect. For constipation, rub your belly clockwise first, then press Hegu.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁按此穴。月经期间不宜重按。
caution_en: Do NOT press this point during pregnancy. Avoid strong pressure during menstruation.

summary_zh: 缓解手腕疼痛，也能帮助减轻头痛和牙痛。
summary_en: Relieves wrist pain, and also helps with headaches and toothaches.
location_zh: 把拇指向上翘起，手腕背面会露出两条筋，两条筋之间、手腕横纹上的凹陷就是。按下去有酸痛感。
location_en: Cock your thumb upward. Two tendons pop up on the back of your wrist. The point is in the dip between those two tendons, right at the wrist crease. Press and you'll feel a distinct ache.
massage_zh: 用另一手的拇指按入两筋之间的凹陷中，向下适度用力按揉，做缓慢的圆圈运动。
massage_en: Press your other thumb into the dip between the two tendons. Apply moderate downward pressure and massage in slow circles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1～2分钟，每天2～3次。手腕累了随时可按。
routine_en: Massage 1-2 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Press whenever your wrist feels tired.
when_zh: 长时间用电脑或手机后手腕酸痛、头痛、牙痛、眼睛红肿时。
when_en: After long hours typing or scrolling on your phone, when your wrist aches, or during headaches, toothaches, or red swollen eyes.
tips_zh: 手腕痛时配合缓慢转动手腕，边转边按效果更好。可配合阳池穴一起按。
tips_en: Slowly rotate your wrist while pressing for better wrist relief. Pair with Yangchi (TE4) on the back of the wrist.
caution_zh: 手腕有急性扭伤时不要揉按，先冷敷。
caution_en: If your wrist is freshly sprained, ice it first — don't massage.

summary_zh: 缓解耳鸣、牙痛和咽喉不适，也有助于消除水肿。
summary_en: Eases ringing ears, toothache, and sore throat. Also helps with puffiness and water retention.
location_zh: 两手虎口交叉握住，中指尖自然落在前臂上的位置就是。大约在手腕背面横纹上方四横指处、前臂外侧。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Cross your hands so your thumb-index web grips the other wrist. Where your middle fingertip lands on the forearm is the spot — roughly four finger-widths above the wrist crease on the outer forearm. Press and you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按压穴位，力度中等，做上下方向的推揉。酸胀感明显时保持按压。
massage_en: Press with your thumb pad using moderate force. Slide up and down along the forearm while pressing. When you feel a strong ache, hold the pressure steady.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2～3分钟，每天2次，早晚各一次。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily — morning and evening.
when_zh: 耳朵嗡嗡响、嗓子不舒服、脸部或四肢浮肿、小便不畅时。
when_en: When your ears ring, throat feels off, face or limbs look puffy, or urination feels sluggish.
tips_zh: 水肿时配合按压阴陵泉穴（小腿内侧），效果更好。按摩时多喝温水。
tips_en: For puffiness, combine with Yinlingquan (SP9, inner shin). Drink warm water after massage to help your body flush.
caution_zh: 前臂有伤口或皮肤病时避免按压此处。
caution_en: Avoid if you have wounds or skin conditions on your forearm.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛、面部肿胀、咽喉痛和肚子不舒服。
summary_en: Eases headaches, facial swelling, sore throat, and stomach discomfort.
location_zh: 前臂外侧，手腕背面横纹上方约五寸（大约一个手掌宽）处。在偏历穴上方约两横指。按下去会有酸胀感。
location_en: On the outer forearm, about one palm-width above the wrist crease on the back side. It's roughly two finger-widths above Pianli (LI6). Press and you'll feel a deep soreness.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹深按穴位，力度偏强，持续按压几秒后做小圆圈揉动。可配合前臂上下推揉。
massage_en: Press deeply with your thumb pad. Hold firm pressure for a few seconds, then massage in small circles. You can also slide your thumb up and down along the forearm.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2～3分钟，每天1～2次。不舒服时随时按。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Press whenever discomfort arises.
when_zh: 头痛、脸肿、嗓子痛、肚子咕咕叫或腹痛、肩背酸痛时。
when_en: During headaches, facial swelling, sore throat, rumbling stomach or belly pain, and shoulder-back soreness.
tips_zh: 嗓子痛时配合按压合谷穴和少商穴。按摩后喝杯温水帮助身体恢复。
tips_en: For sore throat, pair with Hegu (LI4) and Shaoshang (LU11). Drink warm water after massage.
caution_zh: 按压力度适中即可，前臂有外伤时避免按揉。
caution_en: Use moderate pressure. Avoid if your forearm has an injury.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛头晕、腹胀腹痛和手肘手臂疼痛。
summary_en: Relieves headaches, dizziness, bloating, belly pain, and elbow-arm soreness.
location_zh: 弯曲手肘，肘横纹下方约四横指处，前臂外侧那条线上。也就是手三里穴下方两横指处。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Bend your elbow. Four finger-widths below the elbow crease on the outer forearm — or two finger-widths below Shousanli (LI10). Press and you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按压穴位，力度中等偏强，做缓慢的圆圈揉按。也可以用拇指沿前臂上下推揉。
massage_en: Press with your thumb pad using moderate to firm pressure. Massage in slow circles, or slide your thumb up and down along the outer forearm.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2～3分钟，每天1～2次。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 头晕目眩、吃完东西肚子胀、腹痛、手肘和前臂酸痛时。
when_en: When you feel dizzy, bloated after eating, have belly pain, or your elbow and forearm ache.
tips_zh: 腹胀时配合按揉足三里穴（膝下四横指）效果更好。按摩时保持平稳呼吸。
tips_en: For bloating, combine with Zusanli (ST36, four finger-widths below the knee). Keep your breathing slow and steady while pressing.
caution_zh: 前臂有炎症或骨折时禁止按揉。
caution_en: Do not massage if your forearm is inflamed or fractured.

summary_zh: 缓解肩臂酸痛、手臂麻木和头痛。
summary_en: Relieves shoulder-arm soreness, arm numbness, and headaches.
location_zh: 弯曲手肘，肘横纹下方约三横指处，前臂外侧。在手三里穴下方一横指处。按下去有明显的酸胀感。
location_en: Bend your elbow. Three finger-widths below the elbow crease on the outer forearm — one finger-width below Shousanli (LI10). Press and you'll feel a clear, deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹深按穴位，力度中等，做圆圈揉按。也可以用掌根沿前臂推揉。
massage_en: Press deeply with your thumb pad and massage in circles using moderate pressure. You can also use the heel of your palm to rub along the forearm.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2～3分钟，每天1～2次。手臂累了就按。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Press whenever your arm feels tired.
when_zh: 肩膀和手臂酸痛、手臂发麻、头痛、肚子不舒服肠鸣时。
when_en: When your shoulder and arm ache, your arm goes numb, you have a headache, or your stomach is gurgling and uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 手臂酸痛时配合按压曲池穴和手三里穴，沿着前臂依次按下来效果更好。
tips_en: For arm soreness, press Quchi (LI11) and Shousanli (LI10) too — work your way down the forearm for the best effect.
caution_zh: 前臂有皮肤破损或严重肿胀时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid if your forearm has broken skin or severe swelling.

summary_zh: 缓解手臂疼痛麻木，也有助于缓解牙痛和肩背痛。
summary_en: Relieves arm pain and numbness, and also helps with toothache and shoulder-back pain.
location_zh: 弯曲手肘，肘横纹外侧端下方两横指处，前臂外侧。按下去有明显的酸胀和放射感。
location_en: Bend your elbow. Two finger-widths below the outer end of the elbow crease, on the fleshy outer forearm. Press and you'll feel a strong ache that may radiate down your arm.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹用力按压，力度偏强，先持续按压5秒，然后做圆圈揉按。酸胀感越明显效果越好。
massage_en: Press firmly with your thumb pad. Hold steady pressure for 5 seconds, then switch to circular massage. A strong, spreading ache means you've found the right spot.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2～3分钟，每天2～3次。提重物后适合按。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Great after carrying heavy things.
when_zh: 手臂酸痛无力、手麻、牙痛、脸颊肿痛、腰背酸痛时。
when_en: When your arm is sore and weak, hands go numb, a toothache hits, your cheek swells, or your lower back aches.
tips_zh: 配合按压曲池穴效果更佳。经常用电脑的人可以每天按来预防手臂疲劳。
tips_en: Pair with Quchi (LI11) for stronger relief. If you work at a computer daily, press this point preventively to ward off arm fatigue.
caution_zh: 按揉力度虽强但不要引起疼痛难忍，循序渐进。
caution_en: Firm pressure is good, but don't push to the point of sharp pain. Build up gradually.

summary_zh: 大肠经最重要的穴位之一，清热、止痛、增强抵抗力的要穴。
summary_en: A key wellness point that cools the body, relieves pain, and boosts immunity.
location_zh: 弯曲手肘成直角，肘横纹外侧端的凹陷处。用手一摸就能摸到一个明显的窝，按下去很酸。
location_en: Bend your elbow to 90 degrees. The point is at the outer end of the elbow crease, in the dip you can easily feel there. Press and you'll notice a strong, deep ache.
massage_zh: 用另一手的拇指按入肘窝凹陷处，力度中等偏强，做圆圈按揉。酸胀感会比较强烈，这是正常的。
massage_en: Press your other thumb into the elbow crease dip. Use moderate to firm pressure and massage in circles. The ache will be quite strong — that's normal.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2～3分钟，每天2～3次。长期坚持有保健效果。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Regular long-term use provides wellness benefits.
when_zh: 感冒发烧、嗓子痛牙痛、皮肤过敏长疹子、手臂痛抬不起来、便秘腹泻时。
when_en: During colds and fevers, sore throat or toothache, skin rashes and allergies, when you can't lift your arm, or with constipation or diarrhea.
tips_zh: 配合合谷穴同时按效果更强。想增强抵抗力的话，每天坚持按揉曲池加足三里。
tips_en: Press together with Hegu (LI4) for a stronger effect. For long-term immune support, make a daily habit of massaging Quchi plus Zusanli (ST36).
caution_zh: 肘关节有急性损伤或严重炎症时不要按揉。
caution_en: Don't massage if your elbow joint has an acute injury or severe inflammation.

summary_zh: 专门缓解肘关节和手臂的疼痛、麻木和僵硬。
summary_en: Targets elbow and arm pain, numbness, and stiffness.
location_zh: 弯曲手肘，曲池穴再往上约一横指，肘关节外侧骨头上缘的前方。按下去有酸痛感。
location_en: Bend your elbow. About one finger-width above Quchi (LI11), in front of the bony bump on the outer elbow. Press and you'll feel a tender ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按在骨头前方的软组织上，力度中等，做缓慢的小圆圈揉按。
massage_en: Place your thumb pad on the soft tissue in front of the bone. Apply moderate pressure and massage in slow, small circles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1～2分钟，每天2次，手肘不舒服时随时按。
routine_en: Massage 1-2 minutes per session, twice daily. Press anytime your elbow feels off.
when_zh: 肘关节酸痛、手臂麻木僵硬、网球肘不适、提东西肘部疼痛时。
when_en: When your elbow aches, your arm feels numb or stiff, tennis elbow flares up, or lifting things hurts your elbow.
tips_zh: 配合按压曲池穴和手三里穴，三个穴位一起按对手肘问题效果最好。
tips_en: Press together with Quchi (LI11) and Shousanli (LI10) — the trio works best for elbow problems.
caution_zh: 肘关节有骨折或严重肿胀时禁止按揉。
caution_en: Do not massage if your elbow is fractured or severely swollen.

summary_zh: 缓解上臂和肘部的疼痛、紧张和不适。
summary_en: Relieves upper arm and elbow pain, tension, and discomfort.
location_zh: 弯曲手肘，肘横纹上方约三横指处，上臂外侧。在曲池穴和肩膀连线上。按下去有深层的酸胀感。
location_en: Bend your elbow. About three finger-widths above the elbow crease, on the outer upper arm along the line from Quchi (LI11) toward your shoulder. Press and you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指或食指、中指并拢按压穴位，力度中等，做上下方向的推揉或圆圈按揉。
massage_en: Press with your thumb or two fingers together. Use moderate pressure and massage up and down or in circles along the upper arm.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1～2分钟，每天1～2次。
routine_en: Massage 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 上臂外侧疼痛、肘部弯伸困难、手臂活动受限时。
when_en: When the outer upper arm hurts, bending or straightening your elbow is difficult, or arm movement feels restricted.
tips_zh: 配合按压曲池穴和臂臑穴，沿上臂外侧依次按揉效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Quchi (LI11) and Binao (LI14). Work your way along the outer upper arm for better results.
caution_zh: 此处靠近血管，按压力度不宜过大，感到明显酸胀即可。
caution_en: This area is near blood vessels. Use moderate pressure — a clear ache is enough.

summary_zh: 缓解肩臂疼痛和眼睛不适。
summary_en: Relieves shoulder-arm pain and eye discomfort.
location_zh: 弯曲手肘握拳用力，上臂外侧三角肌（肩膀上那块鼓起来的肌肉）下端偏内侧处。按下去有酸痛感。
location_en: Bend your elbow, make a fist, and flex your arm. Find the lower inside edge of the deltoid — that rounded shoulder muscle. The point is where the muscle ends, on its inner side. Press and you'll feel a sore ache.
massage_zh: 用另一手的拇指或中指按压穴位，力度中等，做圆圈揉按。也可以用手掌搓揉整个区域。
massage_en: Press with your other thumb or middle finger using moderate pressure. Massage in circles, or rub the whole area with your palm to warm it up.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2～3分钟，每天1～2次。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 肩膀和上臂酸痛、手臂抬举困难、眼睛疲劳不适时。
when_en: When your shoulder and upper arm ache, it's hard to raise your arm, or your eyes feel strained and tired.
tips_zh: 肩臂痛时配合按压肩髃穴和曲池穴，从上往下依次按效果最佳。
tips_en: For shoulder-arm pain, also press Jianyu (LI15) and Quchi (LI11). Work top to bottom for the best results.
caution_zh: 按揉力度适中，此处肌肉较厚可适当加力但不要过猛。
caution_en: The muscle here is thick, so you can press a bit harder — but still avoid excessive force.

summary_zh: 肩关节疼痛的首选穴位，缓解肩膀活动困难。
summary_en: The top choice for shoulder joint pain and restricted shoulder movement.
location_zh: 手臂平举向外展开，肩膀最高处（肩峰）前方会出现一个凹陷，按下去就是。凹陷处按压有明显酸胀感。
location_en: Raise your arm out to the side. Two dips appear on top of your shoulder — the front one is the point. It's just in front of the bony tip of your shoulder. Press into the dip and you'll feel a strong ache.
massage_zh: 用另一手的中指或拇指按入凹陷中，力度中等偏强，做圆圈揉按。可以边按边缓慢活动肩膀。
massage_en: Press your other middle finger or thumb into the dip. Use moderate to firm pressure and massage in circles. Slowly rotate your shoulder while pressing for added benefit.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2～3分钟，每天2～3次。肩膀不舒服时多按。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Press more often when your shoulder bothers you.
when_zh: 肩膀疼痛、手臂抬不起来、肩周炎发作、长期伏案肩膀僵硬时。
when_en: When your shoulder hurts, you can't raise your arm, frozen shoulder acts up, or long desk work leaves your shoulders stiff.
tips_zh: 配合按压肩井穴（肩膀最高处）和臂臑穴，同时缓慢做肩部旋转运动。
tips_en: Combine with Jianjing (GB21, top of the shoulder) and Binao (LI14). Gently rotate your shoulder while pressing all three.
caution_zh: 肩关节有急性损伤或脱臼时不要按揉，应就医。
caution_en: Don't massage with an acute shoulder injury or dislocation. See a doctor instead.

summary_zh: 缓解肩背部疼痛和上肢活动不便。
summary_en: Eases shoulder-back pain and restricted upper limb movement.
location_zh: 肩膀最高处往后摸，锁骨外端和肩胛骨上方那条骨脊之间的凹陷中。按下去有深层的酸胀感。
location_en: Feel behind the tip of your shoulder. Between the outer end of your collarbone and the bony ridge of your shoulder blade, there's a dip. Press in and you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用中指或食指按入凹陷中，力度中等，做缓慢的圆圈揉按。也可以用手掌搓揉整个肩部。
massage_en: Press your middle or index finger into the dip with moderate pressure. Massage in slow circles. You can also rub the whole shoulder area with your palm.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1～2分钟，每天1～2次。
routine_en: Massage 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 肩背部僵硬疼痛、手臂活动受限、长时间坐着导致上背部不适时。
when_en: When your shoulder-back area is stiff and sore, arm movement is restricted, or prolonged sitting makes your upper back uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 配合按压肩髃穴和肩井穴，三穴联用对肩部问题效果最好。按摩后做肩部拉伸。
tips_en: Combine with Jianyu (LI15) and Jianjing (GB21) for the best shoulder relief. Stretch your shoulders after massage.
caution_zh: 此处较深，不宜用力过猛，尤其是体型偏瘦的人。
caution_en: This point is deep. Don't press too hard, especially if you're thin.

summary_zh: 缓解咽喉疼痛、声音嘶哑和脖子不适。
summary_en: Relieves sore throat, hoarse voice, and neck discomfort.
location_zh: 脖子侧面，喉结向两侧平移，摸到一条粗的肌肉（转头时会鼓起来的那条），在这条肌肉后缘，与喉结等高的位置。轻按有酸胀感。
location_en: On the side of your neck, level with the Adam's apple. Find the thick muscle that pops out when you turn your head — the point is along its back edge. Gentle pressure will produce a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢，轻柔地按压穴位，做小幅度的圆圈揉按。颈部穴位力度一定要轻。
massage_en: Place your index and middle fingers together on the point. Use gentle pressure and massage in small, slow circles. Always use light pressure on neck points.
routine_zh: 每次轻柔按揉1分钟，每天1～2次。
routine_en: Gently massage for 1 minute per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 嗓子痛、突然说不出话或声音嘶哑、打嗝不止、脖子侧面酸痛时。
when_en: When your throat hurts, you suddenly lose your voice or go hoarse, hiccups won't stop, or the side of your neck aches.
tips_zh: 嗓子不舒服时配合按压合谷穴和少商穴。按摩后可以喝温蜂蜜水润喉。
tips_en: For throat issues, pair with Hegu (LI4) and Shaoshang (LU11). Sip warm honey water after massage to soothe your throat.
caution_zh: 颈部穴位必须轻柔按压，禁止用力按揉。有颈动脉疾病者禁按。
caution_en: Always use gentle pressure on the neck. Do NOT press hard. Avoid entirely if you have carotid artery disease.

summary_zh: 缓解咽喉不适、声音嘶哑和咳嗽气喘。
summary_en: Eases throat discomfort, hoarseness, coughing, and wheezing.
location_zh: 脖子侧面，与喉结等高处，那条粗的颈部肌肉（转头时凸起的）的中间位置。轻按有酸胀感。
location_en: On the side of your neck, level with the Adam's apple, in the middle of the thick neck muscle that pops out when you turn your head. Gentle pressure produces a clear ache.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指轻柔地按压，做非常小幅度的圆圈揉按。颈部穴位操作必须温和。
massage_en: Press gently with your index and middle fingers. Massage in very small, slow circles. Be especially gentle — this is a sensitive neck area.
routine_zh: 每次轻柔按揉1分钟，每天1～2次。
routine_en: Gently massage for 1 minute per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 嗓子不舒服、声音沙哑说话费力、咳嗽、气喘、甲状腺区域不适时。
when_en: When your throat is uncomfortable, your voice is hoarse, speaking is effortful, you're coughing or wheezing, or you feel discomfort around the thyroid area.
tips_zh: 配合天鼎穴一起轻柔按揉效果更好。按完后做几次深呼吸放松喉部。
tips_en: Pair with Tianding (LI17) for stronger effect. Take several deep breaths after massage to relax the throat area.
caution_zh: 颈部穴位力度必须轻，不能用力。孕妇、颈部血管疾病者禁按。
caution_en: Neck points require gentle touch only. Avoid during pregnancy or if you have vascular conditions in the neck.

summary_zh: 缓解鼻塞和口鼻周围的不适。
summary_en: Relieves nasal congestion and discomfort around the nose and mouth.
location_zh: 鼻孔正下方，人中沟（鼻子和嘴唇之间的竖沟）上三分之一处旁边。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Directly below the nostril, beside the upper third of the groove between your nose and upper lip. Press and you'll feel a distinct tenderness.
massage_zh: 用食指指腹轻柔按压穴位，力度要轻，做小圆圈揉按。面部穴位只需轻柔刺激。
massage_en: Press gently with your index fingertip and massage in small circles. Facial points need only light pressure — no need to push hard.
routine_zh: 每次轻按1分钟，每天2～3次。鼻塞时可多按几次。
routine_en: Gently press for 1 minute per session, 2-3 times daily. Press more often during nasal congestion.
when_zh: 鼻塞不通气、流鼻血、嘴角歪斜不适、口鼻周围麻木时。
when_en: When your nose is blocked, you have a nosebleed, the area around your mouth feels numb, or you have discomfort near the nose and lips.
tips_zh: 鼻塞时配合按压迎香穴（鼻翼旁）效果更好。按摩前搓热手指，温热刺激更舒适。
tips_en: For stuffy nose, combine with Yingxiang (LI20, beside the nostril). Warm your fingers by rubbing them together before pressing.
caution_zh: 面部皮肤薄嫩，力度一定要轻。面部有伤口或痘痘时避开。
caution_en: Facial skin is delicate — use light pressure only. Avoid if there are wounds or breakouts in the area.

summary_zh: 鼻塞的特效穴，按一按就能让鼻子通气。
summary_en: The star point for stuffy noses — press it and breathe clearly again.
location_zh: 鼻翼（鼻子两侧最宽的地方）外缘旁边，鼻唇沟（法令纹）中。用手指一按就能摸到一个小凹陷，按下去鼻子会有通畅感。
location_en: Right beside the widest part of your nostril, in the smile line (nasolabial fold). Press into the small dip there and you'll feel your nasal passage start to open up.
massage_zh: 用两手食指或中指指腹同时按压两侧迎香穴，力度中等偏轻，上下搓揉或做小圆圈按揉。
massage_en: Place both index or middle fingers on each side of the nose. Press with light to moderate pressure and rub up and down, or massage in small circles on both sides simultaneously.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1～2分钟，每天3～5次。鼻塞时随时按。
routine_en: Massage 1-2 minutes per session, 3-5 times daily. Press anytime your nose feels blocked.
when_zh: 感冒鼻塞、过敏性鼻炎、闻不到味道、面部浮肿、脸部皮肤发痒时。
when_en: When you have a cold with a stuffy nose, allergy-related nasal congestion, you can't smell anything, your face feels puffy, or facial skin itches.
tips_zh: 搓热双手后再按效果更好。配合按印堂穴（两眉之间）和合谷穴，鼻塞缓解更快。
tips_en: Warm your hands first by rubbing them together. Combine with Yintang (between the eyebrows) and Hegu (LI4) for faster nasal relief.
caution_zh: 力度要轻柔，面部皮肤娇嫩。鼻部有外伤或手术后避免按压。
caution_en: Use gentle pressure — facial skin is sensitive. Avoid if you've had recent nasal injury or surgery.

summary_zh: 缓解眼睛疲劳、干涩和黑眼圈。
summary_en: Relieves eye fatigue, dryness, and dark circles.
location_zh: 眼睛正下方，眼眶骨下缘的中点处。闭眼轻轻往下摸，摸到骨头边缘的凹陷就是。按压时会有轻微酸胀感。
location_en: Directly below the center of your eye, right on the lower edge of the eye socket bone. Close your eyes, gently feel downward until you find the bony rim. Press and you'll feel a mild ache.
massage_zh: 用食指指腹轻轻按压，力度要非常轻柔（像触碰豆腐一样），做小圆圈揉动。切勿用力按压眼球。
massage_en: Use your index fingertip to press very gently on the bone edge — never press the eyeball. Make tiny circles with feather-light pressure, like touching a soap bubble.
routine_zh: 每次1分钟，每天2-3次，用眼疲劳时随时可做。
routine_en: 1 minute per session, 2-3 times daily. Use anytime your eyes feel tired.
when_zh: 长时间看屏幕后、眼睛干涩酸胀时、早起眼睛浮肿时。
when_en: After long screen time, when eyes feel dry or puffy, or when you wake up with swollen eyes.
tips_zh: 闭眼配合深呼吸效果更好。可以和四白穴（ST2）一起按，从上到下依次做。
tips_en: Close your eyes and breathe deeply while pressing. Pair with Sibai (ST2) below it for a mini eye-care routine.
caution_zh: 力度一定要轻，不要按压眼球。眼部有炎症或刚做过眼部手术时不要按。
caution_en: Use extremely light pressure — never press on the eyeball. Avoid if you have eye inflammation or recent eye surgery.

summary_zh: 改善眼部疲劳，缓解面部紧张和鼻塞。
summary_en: Eases eye strain, facial tension, and sinus congestion.
location_zh: 眼睛正下方约一拇指宽处，颧骨上方有个小凹陷。用指尖从眼眶下缘往下滑，会摸到一个小窝，按下去有明显酸胀感。
location_en: About one thumb-width below the center of your eye, in a small dip on the cheekbone. Slide your fingertip down from the eye socket rim — you'll find a small notch. Press and you'll feel a distinct ache.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹按住穴位，以适中力度做小圆圈揉动，先顺时针再逆时针各揉。
massage_en: Place your index or middle fingertip on the point. Press with moderate pressure and make small circles — clockwise then counterclockwise.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天2-3次，做眼保健操时重点按揉。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Great during eye exercise breaks.
when_zh: 眼睛酸涩、面部僵硬、鼻子不通气、长时间阅读或看屏幕后。
when_en: When your eyes ache, face feels stiff, nose is stuffy, or after prolonged reading or screen work.
tips_zh: 双手同时按压两侧效果更好。配合承泣（ST1）和迎香（LI20）一起按，可以做一套面部放松操。
tips_en: Press both sides simultaneously. Combine with Chengqi (ST1) above and Yingxiang (LI20) beside your nose for a full facial refresh.
caution_zh: 面部皮肤娇嫩，力度适中即可，不要过度用力。面部有伤口时避开。
caution_en: Use moderate pressure — facial skin is delicate. Avoid if there are wounds or skin irritation on the area.

summary_zh: 缓解牙痛、面部疼痛和鼻塞。
summary_en: Relieves toothache, facial pain, and nasal congestion.
location_zh: 鼻翼下缘水平线与瞳孔正下方垂直线的交叉点，大约在鼻子旁边、颧骨下方。按压会有酸胀感向牙齿方向扩散。
location_en: Level with the bottom of your nostril, directly below your pupil — roughly where the cheekbone dips beside your nose. Press and you'll feel an ache that may spread toward your teeth.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按压，力度中等偏重，持续按压5秒后松开，反复进行。也可以做小幅度的揉动。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip using firm pressure. Hold 5 seconds, release, repeat. You can also add small circular kneading motions.
routine_zh: 每次2分钟，牙痛时可随时按，每天不超过4次。
routine_en: 2 minutes per session, up to 4 times daily. Press anytime tooth or face pain flares.
when_zh: 牙疼、鼻塞、面部浮肿、三叉神经痛发作时。
when_en: During toothaches, nasal congestion, facial swelling, or when facial nerve pain strikes.
tips_zh: 牙痛时配合颊车穴（ST6）和合谷穴（LI4）一起按，效果更明显。
tips_en: For toothaches, combine with Jiache (ST6) on your jaw and Hegu (LI4) on your hand for stronger relief.
caution_zh: 面部有皮肤感染或严重痤疮时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid pressing if the area has skin infections or severe acne.

summary_zh: 缓解嘴角周围不适，改善面部肌肉紧张。
summary_en: Eases discomfort around the mouth and relieves facial muscle tension.
location_zh: 嘴角正外侧约半指宽处。微笑时嘴角尽头的位置，按下去会有酸胀感。
location_en: Just outside the corner of your mouth, about half a finger-width out. Find the endpoint of your smile line. Press and you'll feel a tender ache.
massage_zh: 用食指指腹轻柔按压，做小圆圈揉动，力度轻到中等。两侧同时做。
massage_en: Use your index fingertips on both sides simultaneously. Apply light to moderate pressure with small circular motions.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天2次，早晚各一次。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, twice daily — morning and evening.
when_zh: 嘴角紧绷、说话过多后面部疲劳、口水多、面部表情僵硬时。
when_en: When your mouth feels tight, after talking a lot, when your face feels stiff, or if you drool during sleep.
tips_zh: 配合颊车穴（ST6）一起按摩，可以放松整个下半面部。做完后轻轻活动嘴巴。
tips_en: Pair with Jiache (ST6) on your jaw for full lower-face relaxation. Gently open and close your mouth afterward.
caution_zh: 嘴角有疱疹或破损时不要按。力度宜轻柔。
caution_en: Do not press if you have cold sores or broken skin near the mouth. Keep pressure gentle.

summary_zh: 缓解下颌疼痛和面部肿胀。
summary_en: Relieves jaw pain and facial swelling.
location_zh: 下巴骨（下颌骨）转角前方，咬紧牙时鼓起来的肌肉前缘有个凹陷，能摸到脉搏跳动。
location_en: In front of the jaw angle. Clench your teeth and feel for the front edge of the bulging muscle — there's a dip where you can feel a pulse.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住凹陷处，避开脉搏跳动点，轻柔揉动，力度适中。
massage_en: Press your middle fingertip into the dip, avoiding the pulse point. Knead gently with moderate pressure in small circles.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天2次，牙痛时可加做一次。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, twice daily. Add an extra session during toothaches.
when_zh: 下巴疼痛、牙痛、面部浮肿、咬合不舒服时。
when_en: When your jaw aches, teeth hurt, face is swollen, or your bite feels uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 配合颊车穴（ST6）按摩效果更好。按完后轻轻张合嘴巴放松下颌。
tips_en: Combine with Jiache (ST6) for better results. Gently open and close your jaw after massaging to release tension.
caution_zh: 避免按压到动脉搏动处，力度不要过大。
caution_en: Avoid pressing directly on the pulsing artery. Do not use excessive force.

summary_zh: 缓解牙痛、下颌紧张和磨牙问题。
summary_en: Relieves toothache, jaw tension, and teeth grinding.
location_zh: 咬紧牙齿时，下颌角上方鼓起的肌肉最高处。放松后那里会有个凹陷，按下去酸胀感很明显。
location_en: Clench your teeth — feel the muscle that bulges on your jaw angle. Relax and press the center of that area. You'll feel a strong, satisfying ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指或中指指腹用力按压，做深层揉动。可以一边按一边慢慢张合嘴巴，帮助放松。
massage_en: Press firmly with your thumb or middle finger and knead deeply. Slowly open and close your mouth while pressing for a deeper release.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。磨牙严重时睡前加做一次。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily. Add an evening session if you grind your teeth at night.
when_zh: 牙痛、下巴酸痛、夜间磨牙、嚼东西后下巴累、紧张咬牙时。
when_en: During toothaches, jaw soreness, after heavy chewing, or when you catch yourself clenching from stress.
tips_zh: 配合合谷穴（LI4）一起按，缓解牙痛效果显著。按完用温毛巾敷一下效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with Hegu (LI4) on your hand for stronger toothache relief. Follow up with a warm towel on your jaw.
caution_zh: 下颌骨骨折或脱臼时禁止按压。力度根据自己承受能力调节。
caution_en: Do not press if you have a jaw fracture or dislocation. Adjust pressure to your comfort level.

summary_zh: 缓解耳鸣、耳痛和颞下颌关节不适。
summary_en: Relieves ear ringing, ear pain, and jaw joint discomfort.
location_zh: 耳朵前方约一横指处，颧骨下方有个凹陷。闭嘴时是凹的，张嘴时会鼓起来。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: About one finger-width in front of your ear, in a dip below the cheekbone. It's hollow when your mouth is closed and pops up when you open wide. Press and feel the ache.
massage_zh: 闭嘴，用中指指腹按入凹陷处，力度中等，做小圆圈揉动。按压时可配合缓慢张合嘴。
massage_en: Close your mouth. Press your middle fingertip into the dip with moderate force and make small circles. Slowly open and close your jaw while pressing.
routine_zh: 每次2分钟，每天2次，耳鸣时可随时加按。
routine_en: 2 minutes per session, twice daily. Press anytime ear ringing flares up.
when_zh: 耳鸣、耳朵闷堵、张嘴时下巴咔咔响、颞下颌关节不适时。
when_en: When you hear ringing, ears feel blocked, jaw clicks when opening, or your jaw joint feels off.
tips_zh: 配合听宫穴（SI19）和翳风穴（SJ17）一起按摩，对耳部不适效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Tinggong (SI19) and Yifeng (SJ17) near your ear for stronger ear relief.
caution_zh: 颞下颌关节严重问题请就医，不要强力按压。
caution_en: See a doctor for serious jaw joint issues. Do not press forcefully on this area.

summary_zh: 缓解偏头痛、前额疼痛和眼睛疲劳。
summary_en: Relieves migraines, forehead pain, and eye fatigue.
location_zh: 额角发际线上方约半横指处，大约在额头两侧发际转角的位置。按压时有胀痛感。
location_en: About half a finger-width above your hairline at the temple corner of your forehead. Press and you'll feel a deep, spreading ache.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢，指腹按住穴位做环形揉动，力度中等。两侧同时按效果更好。
massage_en: Place your index and middle fingers together on the point. Rub in circles with moderate pressure. Press both sides at the same time.
routine_zh: 每次2分钟，每天2次，头痛时随时可做。
routine_en: 2 minutes per session, twice daily. Use anytime a headache starts.
when_zh: 偏头痛、前额胀痛、看东西模糊、眼睛酸痛时。
when_en: During migraines, forehead pressure, blurry vision, or aching eyes.
tips_zh: 配合太阳穴一起按揉，缓解头痛效果更好。按摩时闭眼放松。
tips_en: Combine with your temples for stronger headache relief. Close your eyes and relax while pressing.
caution_zh: 头部有外伤时不要按。孕妇慎用。
caution_en: Avoid if you have a head injury. Pregnant women should use caution.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解咽喉不适和头晕。
summary_en: Helps ease sore throat and dizziness.
location_zh: 喉结旁边，颈部大动脉跳动处的内侧缘。能明显摸到脉搏跳动。
location_en: Beside your Adam's apple, on the inner edge of the large neck artery where you can feel a clear pulse.
massage_zh: 此穴位于颈动脉旁，仅适合非常轻柔的触碰式按压。用食指指腹极轻地按住，不做揉动，持续轻触即可。
massage_en: This point is beside a major artery — use only feather-light touch. Place your index fingertip gently on the spot and hold without rubbing. No circular motions.
routine_zh: 每次30秒到1分钟，每天1次即可，不宜多做。
routine_en: 30 seconds to 1 minute, once daily at most. Less is more here.
when_zh: 咽喉肿痛、头晕头胀、血压偏高感觉不适时。
when_en: When your throat is sore, you feel dizzy, or experience head pressure.
tips_zh: 配合天突穴（CV22）轻按，对咽喉不适有帮助。
tips_en: Pair with a gentle touch on Tiantu (CV22) at the throat notch for sore throat support.
caution_zh: 此穴靠近颈动脉，绝对不能用力按压。有颈动脉疾病、高血压者禁用。
caution_en: NEVER press hard — this is next to the carotid artery. Do not use if you have carotid artery disease or uncontrolled high blood pressure.

summary_zh: 缓解咽喉疼痛和咳嗽不适。
summary_en: Eases sore throat and cough discomfort.
location_zh: 颈部前侧，喉结下方与锁骨之间的中点附近，颈部大肌肉的前缘。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On the front of your neck, roughly halfway between your Adam's apple and collarbone, at the front edge of the large neck muscle. Press and feel a mild ache.
massage_zh: 用食指指腹轻轻按压，力度一定要轻柔，做轻微的上下推揉。
massage_en: Press gently with your index fingertip using light pressure. Use slight up-and-down strokes — no deep kneading.
routine_zh: 每次1分钟，每天1-2次，喉咙不适时轻按。
routine_en: 1 minute per session, 1-2 times daily when throat feels uncomfortable.
when_zh: 咽喉疼痛、咳嗽、吞咽不舒服时。
when_en: When your throat hurts, you're coughing, or swallowing feels uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 配合天突穴（CV22）一起轻按，对咽喉不适帮助更大。多喝温水。
tips_en: Combine with gentle pressure on Tiantu (CV22) and drink warm water for better throat relief.
caution_zh: 颈部穴位一律轻按，不可用力。甲状腺疾病患者慎用。
caution_en: Always use light pressure on neck points. Avoid if you have thyroid conditions.

summary_zh: 缓解咽喉不适和颈部僵硬。
summary_en: Eases throat discomfort and neck stiffness.
location_zh: 锁骨上方，颈根部内侧的凹陷处，锁骨与颈部大肌肉交汇的窝里。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: In the hollow just above your collarbone, on the inner side of the large neck muscle where it meets the bone. Press and feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用食指指腹轻轻按入凹陷，力度轻柔，做小幅度的按揉。
massage_en: Gently press your index fingertip into the hollow. Use light pressure and small kneading motions.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 喉咙痛、脖子僵硬、咳嗽频繁时。
when_en: When your throat is sore, neck feels stiff, or you're coughing frequently.
tips_zh: 配合水突穴（ST10）一起按，可沿颈部从上往下依次轻按。
tips_en: Combine with Shuitu (ST10) — work gently down from upper neck to collarbone in sequence.
caution_zh: 颈部穴位力度要轻。不要按压过深。
caution_en: Keep pressure light on all neck points. Do not press too deeply.

summary_zh: 缓解肩颈紧张、咳嗽和胸闷。
summary_en: Relieves shoulder-neck tension, cough, and chest tightness.
location_zh: 锁骨上方的大凹窝正中处。低头时锁骨上方那个明显的窝，按下去会有酸胀感向肩膀方向扩散。
location_en: In the center of the large hollow above your collarbone. Look down — find the obvious dip above the bone. Press and feel an ache spreading toward your shoulder.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻按入凹陷，力度轻到中等，不要往下深按。做轻柔的揉动。
massage_en: Press your middle fingertip gently into the hollow with light to moderate pressure. Do not press downward deeply. Use gentle circular kneading.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 肩膀酸痛、胸闷气短、咳嗽不止时。
when_en: When shoulders ache, chest feels tight, breathing feels shallow, or you can't stop coughing.
tips_zh: 配合肩井穴（GB21）一起按，对肩颈不适效果好。按完活动一下肩膀。
tips_en: Pair with Jianjing (GB21) on your shoulder for neck-shoulder relief. Roll your shoulders gently afterward.
caution_zh: 此穴下方是肺，绝对不能向下深按。孕妇慎用。
caution_en: The lung is directly beneath this point — NEVER press deeply downward. Pregnant women should avoid.

summary_zh: 缓解胸闷和呼吸不畅。
summary_en: Relieves chest tightness and labored breathing.
location_zh: 锁骨正下方，距离胸口正中线约四横指处。锁骨下缘能摸到一个浅凹陷，按下有胀感。
location_en: Just below the collarbone, about four finger-widths from the center of your chest. Feel for a shallow dip under the bone. Press and sense a spreading fullness.
massage_zh: 用中指或食指指腹按住，力度中等，向锁骨方向轻推按揉。
massage_en: Press with your middle or index fingertip using moderate pressure. Knead gently, pushing slightly upward toward the collarbone.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天2次，呼吸不畅时做。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, twice daily. Use when breathing feels constricted.
when_zh: 胸闷、深呼吸困难、咳嗽、情绪压抑感觉胸口堵时。
when_en: When your chest feels tight, deep breaths are difficult, you're coughing, or stress makes your chest feel blocked.
tips_zh: 配合深呼吸一起做：按压时吸气，松开时呼气。搭配膻中穴（CV17）效果更好。
tips_en: Breathe deeply while pressing — inhale as you press, exhale as you release. Combine with Danzhong (CV17) at your chest center.
caution_zh: 力度不宜过重，胸部按摩要温和。
caution_en: Use moderate pressure only. Be gentle with all chest-area massage.

summary_zh: 缓解胸部胀闷和咳嗽。
summary_en: Eases chest congestion and persistent cough.
location_zh: 锁骨下方第一个肋骨间隙处，距离胸口正中约四横指。按压有轻微胀痛感。
location_en: In the first rib space below your collarbone, about four finger-widths from chest center. Press and feel a mild ache.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹轻按揉动，力度轻到中等，做小圆圈按摩。
massage_en: Press with your index or middle fingertip, using light to moderate pressure in small circular motions.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 咳嗽不止、胸口发闷、呼吸不畅时。
when_en: When coughing persists, your chest feels stuffy, or breathing seems labored.
tips_zh: 配合气户穴（ST13）从上往下依次按摩胸部几个穴位。
tips_en: Work downward from Qihu (ST13) through the chest points in sequence for broader relief.
caution_zh: 胸部按摩力度要轻柔，不要用力叩击。
caution_en: Keep chest massage gentle. Do not tap or pound the area.

summary_zh: 缓解胸闷、咳嗽和乳房胀痛。
summary_en: Eases chest tightness, cough, and breast tenderness.
location_zh: 第二根肋骨间隙处，距胸口正中约四横指。在锁骨下方两个肋间隙的位置，按压有胀感。
location_en: In the second rib space, about four finger-widths from chest center. Two rib spaces below the collarbone. Press and feel a dull ache.
massage_zh: 用食指指腹轻柔按揉，做小圆圈运动，力度轻柔。
massage_en: Gently press with your index fingertip and make small circular motions. Keep pressure light.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 胸闷、咳嗽、经期乳房胀痛时。
when_en: When your chest feels congested, you're coughing, or breasts are sore before your period.
tips_zh: 经期乳房胀痛时配合膻中穴（CV17）一起按，边按边深呼吸。
tips_en: For menstrual breast soreness, combine with Danzhong (CV17) while breathing deeply.
caution_zh: 乳房有肿块时请先就医，不要自行按摩。怀孕期间避免。
caution_en: See a doctor first if you have breast lumps. Avoid during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解胸闷气短和乳房不适。
summary_en: Relieves chest tightness and breast discomfort.
location_zh: 第三根肋骨间隙处，距胸口正中约四横指。大约在乳头上方两个肋间隙的位置。
location_en: In the third rib space, about four finger-widths from chest center — roughly two rib spaces above the nipple level.
massage_zh: 用食指指腹轻按揉动，力度轻柔，做小圆圈按摩。
massage_en: Use your index fingertip with light pressure in small circular motions.
routine_zh: 每次1分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 1 minute per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 胸闷气短、深呼吸不畅、乳房胀痛时。
when_en: When breathing feels shallow, chest is tight, or breasts feel sore.
tips_zh: 配合深呼吸，可以从气户穴（ST13）依次往下按到膺窗。
tips_en: Combine with deep breathing. Work down from Qihu (ST13) through each chest point in sequence.
caution_zh: 乳房有肿块时请就医。胸部按摩力度要温和。
caution_en: See a doctor if you have breast lumps. Always use gentle pressure on the chest.

summary_zh: 此穴仅作为体表定位参考点，不用于按摩。
summary_en: This point is a body landmark only — not used for massage.
location_zh: 乳头正中央。此穴仅用于定位其他穴位，不进行任何按摩操作。
location_en: The center of the nipple. This point is used only as a reference landmark for locating other points. No massage is performed here.
massage_zh: 此穴不进行按摩。
massage_en: No massage is performed on this point.
routine_zh: 不适用。
routine_en: Not applicable.
when_zh: 不适用，此穴仅为定位标志。
when_en: Not applicable — this point is a positioning landmark only.
tips_zh: 可以用此穴位置来帮助找到乳根穴（ST18）等周围穴位。
tips_en: Use this landmark to help locate nearby points like Rugen (ST18) below it.
caution_zh: 此穴不可按摩、不可针灸。
caution_en: Do not massage or apply any pressure to this point.

summary_zh: 缓解胸闷和乳房胀痛。
summary_en: Eases chest congestion and breast tenderness.
location_zh: 乳头正下方一个肋间隙处，大约在乳房下缘的位置。按压有胀痛感。
location_en: One rib space directly below the nipple, roughly at the lower edge of the breast. Press and feel a distinct ache.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹轻按揉动，力度轻柔，做小圆圈运动。
massage_en: Use your index or middle fingertip with light pressure in small circular motions.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 胸闷、经期乳房胀痛、哺乳期乳汁不畅时。
when_en: When your chest feels tight, breasts are sore before your period, or milk flow is sluggish while nursing.
tips_zh: 哺乳期乳汁不畅时配合膻中穴（CV17）一起按揉，按完后热敷胸部。
tips_en: For nursing flow issues, combine with Danzhong (CV17) and follow with a warm compress on the chest.
caution_zh: 乳房有硬块请先就医。怀孕期间慎用。
caution_en: See a doctor first if you feel breast lumps. Use caution during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解上腹部胀满和食欲不振。
summary_en: Relieves upper belly bloating and poor appetite.
location_zh: 肚脐正上方约六横指（一手掌宽），再往旁边两横指处。大约在肋骨下缘内侧，按压有胀痛感。
location_en: About one palm-width above your navel, then two finger-widths to the side — near the inner edge of your lower ribs. Press and feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢，指腹按住穴位做轻柔的揉动，力度中等。
massage_en: Place your index and middle fingers together on the point. Knead gently with moderate pressure in circular motions.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次，饭后1小时做。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily, about 1 hour after meals.
when_zh: 吃多了胃胀、没食欲、感觉食物堵在上腹时。
when_en: When you've overeaten, lost your appetite, or feel food sitting heavy in your upper belly.
tips_zh: 饭后散步10分钟后再按效果更好。配合中脘穴（CV12）一起按。
tips_en: Take a 10-minute walk after eating before pressing. Combine with Zhongwan (CV12) at your upper belly center.
caution_zh: 饭后不要立即按压，至少等1小时。腹部有急性疼痛时请就医。
caution_en: Wait at least 1 hour after eating. Seek medical help for sudden, severe abdominal pain.

summary_zh: 缓解胃胀、胃痛和消化不良。
summary_en: Relieves stomach bloating, stomach pain, and indigestion.
location_zh: 肚脐正上方约五横指，再往旁边两横指处。在上腹部中段位置，按压有酸胀感。
location_en: About five finger-widths above your navel, then two finger-widths to the side — in the mid-upper belly area. Press and feel a deep, achy sensation.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指指腹按住穴位，以中等力度做顺时针圆圈揉动。
massage_en: Press with your index and middle fingertips and make clockwise circular motions with moderate pressure.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次，饭后1小时做最佳。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily, ideally 1 hour after meals.
when_zh: 胃胀气、胃痛、吃完东西不消化、打嗝不止时。
when_en: When your stomach is bloated, hurting, food won't digest, or you can't stop burping.
tips_zh: 配合中脘穴（CV12）一起按揉。按摩时配合腹式深呼吸效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with Zhongwan (CV12) and practice belly breathing while pressing for better results.
caution_zh: 饭后至少等1小时再按。剧烈腹痛请就医。
caution_en: Wait at least 1 hour after eating. See a doctor for intense abdominal pain.

summary_zh: 缓解胃痛、腹胀和消化不良。
summary_en: Relieves stomach pain, bloating, and poor digestion.
location_zh: 肚脐正上方约四横指，再往旁边两横指处。在胃区中部，按压有酸胀感。
location_en: About four finger-widths above your navel, then two finger-widths to the side — in the middle of the stomach area. Press and feel a satisfying ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，以中等力度做顺时针揉动。可以两侧同时按。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip using moderate pressure in clockwise circles. Work both sides simultaneously.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次，两餐之间做最好。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily — best between meals.
when_zh: 胃痛、吃不下饭、腹胀、拉肚子时。
when_en: When your stomach aches, you have no appetite, belly is bloated, or you have diarrhea.
tips_zh: 配合足三里（ST36）一起按，上下呼应，消化效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Zusanli (ST36) on your leg — working upper and lower body together boosts digestive relief.
caution_zh: 饭后不要立即按。有胃溃疡者力度要轻。
caution_en: Don't press right after eating. Use lighter pressure if you have stomach ulcers.

summary_zh: 缓解腹胀、腹痛和水肿。
summary_en: Relieves belly bloating, abdominal pain, and water retention.
location_zh: 肚脐正上方约三横指，再往旁边两横指处。按压时有酸胀感向腹部深处扩散。
location_en: About three finger-widths above your navel, then two finger-widths to the side. Press and feel an ache spreading deep into your belly.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，以中等力度做顺时针揉动。配合呼吸，呼气时加力。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip in clockwise circles using moderate pressure. Press deeper as you exhale, lighter as you inhale.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily.
when_zh: 腹胀肠鸣、拉肚子、小便不畅、身体浮肿时。
when_en: When your belly is bloated and gurgling, you have diarrhea, urination is difficult, or you notice puffiness.
tips_zh: 配合天枢穴（ST25）一起按揉，沿腹部从上往下做效果好。
tips_en: Pair with Tianshu (ST25) at navel level. Work downward through the belly points in sequence.
caution_zh: 饭后1小时再按。急性腹痛请就医。
caution_en: Wait 1 hour after eating. See a doctor for sudden, severe belly pain.

summary_zh: 缓解腹胀、腹痛和情绪烦躁。
summary_en: Eases belly bloating, abdominal pain, and restlessness.
location_zh: 肚脐正上方约两横指，再往旁边两横指处。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: About two finger-widths above your navel, then two finger-widths to the side. Press and feel a mild ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位揉动，力度中等，做顺时针小圆圈。
massage_en: Press your middle fingertip on the point and make small clockwise circles with moderate pressure.
routine_zh: 每次2分钟，每天2次。
routine_en: 2 minutes per session, twice daily.
when_zh: 腹胀、恶心想吐、心烦意乱、精神不安时。
when_en: When your belly is bloated, you feel nauseous, restless, or emotionally uneasy.
tips_zh: 配合中脘穴（CV12）一起按可缓解恶心。情绪烦躁时配合深呼吸。
tips_en: Combine with Zhongwan (CV12) to ease nausea. Add deep breathing when feeling emotionally restless.
caution_zh: 饭后1小时再按。怀孕期间避免按压腹部穴位。
caution_en: Wait 1 hour after eating. Avoid all belly points during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解腹胀、恶心和呕吐。
summary_en: Eases belly bloating, nausea, and vomiting.
location_zh: 肚脐正上方约一横指，再往旁边两横指处。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: About one finger-width above your navel, then two finger-widths to the side. Press and feel a mild ache.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指指腹按住穴位，以适中力度做小圆圈揉动。
massage_en: Press with your index and middle fingertips and make small circular motions with moderate pressure.
routine_zh: 每次2分钟，每天2次。
routine_en: 2 minutes per session, twice daily.
when_zh: 肚子胀气、恶心想吐、消化不良时。
when_en: When you have gas, feel nauseous, or your digestion is sluggish.
tips_zh: 配合天枢穴（ST25）一起按，可以从上往下顺序按压肚脐周围的穴位。
tips_en: Combine with Tianshu (ST25). Work through the points around your navel from top to bottom.
caution_zh: 饭后不要立即按。怀孕期间不要按腹部穴位。
caution_en: Don't press right after eating. Avoid all belly points during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 调理肠胃的核心穴位，缓解便秘和腹泻。
summary_en: A key digestive point — relieves both constipation and diarrhea.
location_zh: 肚脐正旁边两横指（食指和中指并拢的宽度）处。左右各一个。按压时有明显酸胀感。
location_en: Two finger-widths directly to the side of your navel — one point on each side. Press and feel a strong, satisfying ache.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢按住穴位，以中等偏重的力度做顺时针揉动。便秘时顺时针揉，腹泻时逆时针轻揉。
massage_en: Press with your index and middle fingers together using firm pressure. For constipation, knead clockwise. For diarrhea, knead counterclockwise with lighter pressure.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天2-3次。早起和睡前各做一次效果最好。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Most effective first thing in the morning and before bed.
when_zh: 便秘、拉肚子、肚子胀气、肠鸣、经期肚子不舒服时。
when_en: When constipated, having diarrhea, belly is gassy, stomach is gurgling, or you have menstrual belly discomfort.
tips_zh: 配合足三里（ST36）一起按效果显著。便秘时早上起床后喝一杯温水再按更好。
tips_en: Pair with Zusanli (ST36) on your leg for powerful digestive support. For constipation, drink warm water before pressing in the morning.
caution_zh: 饭后至少等1小时。怀孕期间不要按压腹部穴位。急性腹痛请就医。
caution_en: Wait at least 1 hour after eating. Avoid during pregnancy. Seek medical help for sudden, severe pain.

summary_zh: 缓解下腹胀痛和肠胃不适。
summary_en: Relieves lower belly pain and intestinal discomfort.
location_zh: 肚脐正下方约一横指，再往旁边两横指处。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: About one finger-width below your navel, then two finger-widths to the side. Press and feel a dull ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，以中等力度做小圆圈揉动。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip in small circles using moderate pressure.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily.
when_zh: 下腹胀痛、肠胃不舒服、小腹坠胀时。
when_en: When your lower belly feels bloated, heavy, or your gut is uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 配合天枢穴（ST25）一起按，从肚脐旁往下依次按效果好。
tips_en: Combine with Tianshu (ST25) and work downward from navel level through the lower belly points.
caution_zh: 饭后1小时再按。怀孕期间禁止按压。
caution_en: Wait 1 hour after eating. Do not use during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解下腹胀痛和小便不畅。
summary_en: Relieves lower belly bloating and urinary difficulty.
location_zh: 肚脐正下方约两横指，再往旁边两横指处。按压有深层酸胀感。
location_en: About two finger-widths below your navel, then two finger-widths to the side. Press and feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，力度中等偏重，做顺时针揉动。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip using moderate to firm pressure in clockwise circles.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily.
when_zh: 小腹胀痛、小便不利索、腰酸连带小腹不适时。
when_en: When your lower belly is bloated, urination feels incomplete, or lower back pain connects to belly discomfort.
tips_zh: 配合关元穴（CV4）一起按揉，对下腹不适效果好。
tips_en: Combine with Guanyuan (CV4) below your navel for stronger lower belly relief.
caution_zh: 怀孕期间禁止按压。膀胱很胀时先排尿再按。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Empty your bladder before pressing if it feels full.

summary_zh: 缓解小腹胀满、小便不利和经期不适。
summary_en: Relieves lower belly fullness, urinary issues, and menstrual discomfort.
location_zh: 肚脐正下方约三横指，再往旁边两横指处。按压有明显酸胀感向下腹深处扩散。
location_en: About three finger-widths below your navel, then two finger-widths to the side. Press and feel a strong ache spreading deep into the lower belly.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，力度中等，做顺时针揉动。配合呼吸，呼气时加深力度。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip in clockwise circles using moderate pressure. Deepen pressure on exhale, lighten on inhale.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。经期不适时可加做。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily. Add extra sessions during menstrual discomfort.
when_zh: 小便不畅、下腹胀满、身体浮肿、痛经时。
when_en: When urination is difficult, lower belly feels full, body is puffy, or you have period cramps.
tips_zh: 配合三阴交（SP6）一起按，对经期不适和水肿效果好。
tips_en: Pair with Sanyinjiao (SP6) on your inner ankle for menstrual and water retention relief.
caution_zh: 怀孕期间禁止按压。急性泌尿系统疾病请就医。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. See a doctor for acute urinary conditions.

summary_zh: 缓解经期不调、小腹疼痛和疝气不适。
summary_en: Eases irregular periods, lower belly pain, and hernia discomfort.
location_zh: 肚脐正下方约四横指，再往旁边两横指处，大约在耻骨上方一横指的位置。按压有深层酸胀感。
location_en: About four finger-widths below your navel, then two finger-widths to the side — roughly one finger-width above the pubic bone. Press and feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，力度中等，做小圆圈揉动。两侧同时按效果更好。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip using moderate pressure in small circles. Work both sides at the same time for better results.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。经期不适时可增加次数。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily. Increase frequency during menstrual discomfort.
when_zh: 月经不调、痛经、小腹坠胀、疝气不适时。
when_en: During irregular periods, menstrual cramps, lower belly heaviness, or hernia discomfort.
tips_zh: 配合关元穴（CV4）和三阴交（SP6）一起按，对月经问题帮助大。经期时可用热水袋先暖腹再按。
tips_en: Combine with Guanyuan (CV4) and Sanyinjiao (SP6) for menstrual support. Warm your belly with a hot water bottle before pressing during your period.
caution_zh: 怀孕期间禁止按压。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解腹股沟不适和生殖系统问题。
summary_en: Eases groin discomfort and reproductive system issues.
location_zh: 耻骨上缘，肚脐正中线旁开两横指处，大腿根部内侧能摸到脉搏跳动的位置。
location_en: At the top edge of the pubic bone, two finger-widths from center — at the inner groin crease where you can feel a pulse.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻柔按压，避开动脉搏动处，力度要轻，做小幅度揉动。
massage_en: Press gently with your middle fingertip, avoiding the pulsing artery. Use light pressure with small kneading motions.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 腹股沟不适、月经不调、疝气不适时。
when_en: When your groin area is uncomfortable, periods are irregular, or hernia discomfort flares.
tips_zh: 配合归来穴（ST29）一起按揉。注意保暖，避免受凉。
tips_en: Combine with Guilai (ST29). Keep the area warm — avoid cold exposure.
caution_zh: 靠近动脉，力度一定要轻。怀孕期间禁止按压。
caution_en: Near a major artery — always use light pressure. Do not use during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解大腿前侧疼痛和腰膝酸软。
summary_en: Relieves front thigh pain and weak, achy knees and lower back.
location_zh: 大腿前面最上端，站直时大腿根部正前方的凹陷处。坐下屈膝时更容易摸到，按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: At the very top of your front thigh, in the hollow at the thigh crease when standing. Easier to find sitting with knee bent. Press and feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹用力按住穴位，做深层揉动，力度可以稍重。
massage_en: Press firmly with your thumb and knead deeply. You can use stronger pressure here — the thigh muscle is thick.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily.
when_zh: 大腿酸痛、走路无力、腰腿冷痛、久坐后大腿僵硬时。
when_en: When your thigh aches, legs feel weak walking, lower back and legs feel cold-achy, or thighs stiffen after sitting.
tips_zh: 配合伏兔穴（ST32）和足三里（ST36）一起按，从上到下做一套腿部保健。
tips_en: Combine with Futu (ST32) and Zusanli (ST36) — work top to bottom for a full leg care routine.
caution_zh: 大腿有外伤或静脉曲张时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid if you have thigh injuries or varicose veins in the area.

summary_zh: 缓解大腿疼痛和膝盖冷痛。
summary_en: Relieves thigh pain and cold, achy knees.
location_zh: 大腿前面正中，膝盖骨上缘往上约一手掌宽的位置。伸直腿绷紧时大腿前面鼓起的肌肉中点就是。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On the front center of your thigh, about one palm-width above the kneecap. Straighten your leg and tense it — the midpoint of the bulging muscle is the spot. Press for a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用掌根或拇指按住穴位，力度稍重，做深层揉动或上下推按。
massage_en: Use your palm heel or thumb to press firmly. Knead deeply or push up and down along the muscle.
routine_zh: 每次3分钟，每天2次。运动前后都适合做。
routine_en: 3 minutes per session, twice daily. Good both before and after exercise.
when_zh: 大腿酸痛无力、膝盖冷痛、久站后腿累、运动后大腿疲劳时。
when_en: When your thigh is sore or weak, knees feel cold-achy, legs are tired from standing, or thighs are fatigued after exercise.
tips_zh: 可以先热敷大腿再按摩，效果更好。配合梁丘穴（ST34）一起做。
tips_en: Warm your thigh with a hot towel before pressing for better results. Combine with Liangqiu (ST34).
caution_zh: 大腿有外伤或肿胀时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid if you have thigh injuries or swelling.

summary_zh: 缓解膝盖酸冷和大腿疼痛。
summary_en: Relieves cold-achy knees and thigh pain.
location_zh: 膝盖骨上缘往上约三横指，大腿前面外侧。大腿绷紧时能摸到肌肉外侧边缘的位置，按压有酸胀感。
location_en: About three finger-widths above the top of your kneecap, on the outer front of your thigh. Tense your thigh and find the outer edge of the muscle. Press for an ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按住穴位，力度中等偏重，做揉动或点按。
massage_en: Press with your thumb using moderate to firm pressure. Knead or apply rhythmic point pressure.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。膝盖冷痛时加做。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily. Add sessions when knees feel cold and achy.
when_zh: 膝盖冷痛、大腿僵硬、腿脚屈伸不利、天冷时腿不舒服。
when_en: When knees are cold-achy, thighs feel stiff, legs are hard to bend and stretch, or cold weather makes your legs uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 天冷时先热敷膝盖再按摩。配合梁丘穴（ST34）和足三里（ST36）一起按。
tips_en: Warm your knee with a hot compress before pressing in cold weather. Pair with Liangqiu (ST34) and Zusanli (ST36).
caution_zh: 膝关节有急性炎症或肿胀时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid if your knee is acutely inflamed or swollen.

summary_zh: 急性胃痛和膝盖疼痛的快速缓解穴位。
summary_en: A go-to point for quick relief of acute stomach pain and knee pain.
location_zh: 膝盖骨外上方约两横指处。伸直腿用力蹬时，膝盖骨外上角上方会出现一个凹陷，那就是。按压酸胀感明显。
location_en: About two finger-widths above the outer top corner of your kneecap. Straighten your leg hard — a dip appears above the kneecap's outer corner. Press for a strong ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹用力按住穴位，持续按压或做深层揉动，力度可以较重。急性胃痛时持续按压1-2分钟。
massage_en: Press hard with your thumb and hold, or knead deeply. Use firm pressure. For acute stomach pain, hold steady pressure for 1-2 minutes.
routine_zh: 急性发作时随时按，每次2-3分钟。日常保健每天2次。
routine_en: Press immediately during acute episodes, 2-3 minutes each. For daily care, twice daily.
when_zh: 突然胃痛、膝盖肿痛、上下楼梯膝盖痛时。
when_en: When stomach pain hits suddenly, knees swell and ache, or stairs make your knees hurt.
tips_zh: 急性胃痛时同时按合谷穴（LI4）和足三里（ST36），三个穴位一起效果更快。
tips_en: During acute stomach pain, press Hegu (LI4) and Zusanli (ST36) at the same time for faster relief.
caution_zh: 膝关节骨折或严重损伤时不要按压。
caution_en: Do not press if your knee is fractured or seriously injured.

summary_zh: 膝盖保健的核心穴位，缓解各种膝关节不适。
summary_en: A core knee-care point — relieves all kinds of knee joint discomfort.
location_zh: 屈膝时，膝盖骨下缘两侧各有一个凹陷（像两个小酒窝），外侧那个就是。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: Bend your knee — find two dimples below the kneecap on either side of the thick tendon. The outer dimple is the point. Press for a satisfying ache.
massage_zh: 屈膝坐好，用拇指按入凹陷，力度中等偏重，做揉动或点按。可以同时按两侧的凹陷。
massage_en: Sit with knee bent. Press your thumb into the outer dimple with moderate to firm pressure. Knead or apply point pressure. You can press both dimples at once.
routine_zh: 每次3分钟，每天2-3次。膝盖不适时随时可按。
routine_en: 3 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime your knee bothers you.
when_zh: 膝盖疼痛、上下楼膝盖不适、蹲下站起困难、膝盖僵硬时。
when_en: When your knee hurts, stairs bother it, squatting and standing is difficult, or the knee feels stiff.
tips_zh: 配合阳陵泉（GB34）和足三里（ST36）一起按，做一套膝盖保健操。按完轻轻活动膝关节。
tips_en: Combine with Yanglingquan (GB34) and Zusanli (ST36) for a full knee-care routine. Gently bend and stretch your knee afterward.
caution_zh: 膝关节严重肿胀或急性损伤时请就医，不要强力按压。
caution_en: See a doctor for severe knee swelling or acute injury. Do not press forcefully.

summary_zh: 全身保健第一大穴，增强体力、改善消化。
summary_en: The top wellness point on the body — boosts energy and improves digestion.
location_zh: 外膝眼（膝盖骨下外侧凹陷）往下四横指，小腿骨外侧约一横指处。同侧手虎口卡住膝盖外上缘，中指尖所到之处就是。按压酸胀感很强。
location_en: Four finger-widths below the outer knee dimple, about one finger-width outside the shinbone. Shortcut: wrap your hand around your knee with the web between thumb and index on the outer kneecap edge, fingers pointing down — your middle fingertip lands on it. Strong ache when pressed.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹用力按揉，力度可以较重，做顺时针揉动。也可以用掌根上下推按小腿外侧这一区域。
massage_en: Press firmly with your thumb and knead clockwise. You can use strong pressure — the muscle here is thick. Or use your palm heel to rub up and down along the outer shin.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天2-3次。长期坚持效果最佳。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Best results come from making this a daily habit.
when_zh: 疲劳乏力、消化不好、食欲差、免疫力低、膝腿酸软时。日常保健随时可按。
when_en: When tired, digestion is off, appetite is poor, immunity feels low, or legs are weak. Also great as everyday wellness maintenance.
tips_zh: 配合天枢穴（ST25）治消化问题效果显著。每天坚持按揉，相当于给身体"充电"。饭后1小时按最好。
tips_en: Pair with Tianshu (ST25) for powerful digestive support. Daily pressing is like recharging your body's battery. Best 1 hour after meals.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。饭后不要立即按压。
caution_en: Pregnant women should use caution. Don't press right after eating.

summary_zh: 缓解腹痛、腹泻和便秘。
summary_en: Relieves belly pain, diarrhea, and constipation.
location_zh: 外膝眼往下约两个手掌宽（六寸），小腿两骨之间。也就是足三里再往下约三横指的位置。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: About two palm-widths below the outer knee dimple, between the two shinbones — roughly three finger-widths below Zusanli (ST36). Press and feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按揉，力度中等偏重，做揉动或上下推按。
massage_en: Press with your thumb using moderate to firm pressure. Knead in circles or push up and down along the muscle.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily.
when_zh: 腹痛、拉肚子、便秘、肚子咕噜响时。
when_en: When your belly hurts, you have diarrhea or constipation, or your gut is loudly gurgling.
tips_zh: 配合天枢穴（ST25）和足三里（ST36）一起按，对肠道问题效果好。
tips_en: Combine with Tianshu (ST25) and Zusanli (ST36) for comprehensive gut support.
caution_zh: 小腿有外伤时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid if you have injuries on your lower leg.

summary_zh: 缓解小腿抽筋和肩膀疼痛。
summary_en: Relieves leg cramps and shoulder pain.
location_zh: 外膝眼往下约八寸（两个手掌多一点），小腿两骨之间。大约在小腿外侧中段偏下的位置，按压有酸胀感。
location_en: About eight inches below the outer knee dimple, between the two shinbones — roughly in the lower-middle of your outer calf. Press and feel a strong ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹用力按揉，力度可以较重，做深层揉动或持续点按。
massage_en: Press firmly with your thumb and knead deeply. You can use strong, sustained point pressure.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。肩膀痛或腿抽筋时随时做。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily. Press anytime shoulder pain or leg cramps strike.
when_zh: 小腿抽筋、肩膀疼痛活动受限、小腿发冷无力时。
when_en: When your calf cramps, shoulder is painful and stiff, or your lower leg feels cold and weak.
tips_zh: 肩膀痛时一边按条口一边慢慢活动肩膀，效果很明显。配合肩髃穴（LI15）更好。
tips_en: For shoulder pain, slowly rotate your shoulder while pressing this point — the relief is often immediate. Combine with Jianyu (LI15).
caution_zh: 小腿有深静脉血栓时禁止按压。
caution_en: Do not press if you have deep vein thrombosis in your leg.

summary_zh: 缓解下腹疼痛和腹泻。
summary_en: Relieves lower belly pain and diarrhea.
location_zh: 外膝眼往下约九寸，小腿两骨之间。大约在上巨虚（ST37）再往下三横指处，按压有酸胀感。
location_en: About nine inches below the outer knee dimple, between the shinbones — roughly three finger-widths below Shangjuxu (ST37). Press for a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按揉，力度中等偏重，做揉动。
massage_en: Press with your thumb using moderate to firm pressure and knead in circles.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily.
when_zh: 下腹疼痛、拉肚子、小腿酸痛无力时。
when_en: When your lower belly hurts, you have diarrhea, or your calf feels weak and achy.
tips_zh: 配合上巨虚（ST37）和足三里（ST36）从上往下一起按，效果更全面。
tips_en: Work downward from Zusanli (ST36) through Shangjuxu (ST37) to this point for comprehensive leg and gut support.
caution_zh: 小腿有外伤或深静脉血栓时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid if you have lower leg injuries or deep vein thrombosis.

summary_zh: 化解体内多余水湿的关键穴位，缓解痰多和头昏沉。
summary_en: A key point for clearing excess dampness in the body — eases phlegm and heavy-headedness.
location_zh: 外踝尖（脚踝外侧骨头尖端）往上约八寸，小腿外侧。简单找法：外膝眼和外踝尖的中点，距小腿骨约两横指处，肌肉丰满的地方。按压酸胀感明显。
location_en: Midway between the outer knee dimple and the tip of the outer ankle bone, about two finger-widths from the shinbone — on the fleshy part of your outer calf. Press for a strong, satisfying ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹用力按揉，力度较重，做深层揉动。也可以用掌根上下推按整个区域。
massage_en: Press hard with your thumb and knead deeply. You can also rub the whole area up and down with your palm heel. Use firm pressure.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天2-3次。长期坚持效果好。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Consistency over time brings the best results.
when_zh: 痰多咳嗽、头昏沉沉像裹了湿毛巾、身体沉重懒动、胸闷、大便黏腻时。
when_en: When you're coughing up phlegm, head feels foggy and heavy, body feels sluggish, chest is stuffy, or stools are sticky.
tips_zh: 配合阴陵泉（SP9）一起按，一个管"痰"一个管"湿"，对身体沉重无力非常有效。多喝温水帮助代谢。
tips_en: Pair with Yinlingquan (SP9) for a powerful combo — one clears phlegm, the other drains excess fluid. Drink warm water to support the process.
caution_zh: 小腿有外伤或深静脉血栓时禁止按压。
caution_en: Do not press if you have lower leg injuries or deep vein thrombosis.

summary_zh: 缓解脚踝肿痛、头痛和便秘。
summary_en: Relieves ankle swelling, headaches, and constipation.
location_zh: 脚踝前面正中的横纹处，两根大筋之间的凹陷。把脚尖往上勾，脚背上会出现两条筋，中间的凹陷就是。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: In the center front of your ankle crease, between two big tendons. Flex your foot upward — two tendons pop up on top. The dip between them is the point. Press for an ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按入凹陷，力度中等，做小圆圈揉动。可以一边按一边慢慢转动脚踝。
massage_en: Press your thumb into the dip with moderate pressure and make small circles. Slowly rotate your ankle while pressing.
routine_zh: 每次2分钟，每天2次。脚踝不适时随时按。
routine_en: 2 minutes per session, twice daily. Press anytime your ankle feels off.
when_zh: 脚踝肿痛、头痛头晕、便秘、走路多后脚踝不舒服时。
when_en: When your ankle is swollen or sore, you have a headache, constipation, or ankle discomfort after lots of walking.
tips_zh: 脚踝扭伤恢复期配合按揉可以帮助恢复。配合昆仑穴（BL60）一起按效果好。
tips_en: Helpful during ankle sprain recovery. Combine with Kunlun (BL60) behind the ankle for better results.
caution_zh: 脚踝急性扭伤肿胀期（前48小时）不要按，等消肿后再按。
caution_en: Do not press during the first 48 hours of an acute ankle sprain. Wait until swelling subsides.

summary_zh: 缓解脚背肿痛和胃部不适。
summary_en: Relieves foot pain and stomach discomfort.
location_zh: 脚背最高点稍前方，第二脚趾往脚踝方向摸，在脚背中段能摸到脉搏跳动的位置。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On the top of your foot, just past the highest arch. Trace from your second toe toward the ankle — find where you feel a pulse on the mid-foot. Press for an ache.
massage_zh: 避开脉搏跳动的位置，用拇指指腹在旁边按揉，力度轻到中等，做小圆圈揉动。
massage_en: Avoid the pulsing spot. Press with your thumb just beside it using light to moderate pressure in small circles.
routine_zh: 每次2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 脚背肿痛、胃痛胃胀、走路太多脚疲劳时。
when_en: When your foot top is sore and swollen, stomach aches or bloats, or feet are tired from walking.
tips_zh: 配合足三里（ST36）一起按，既能护胃又能护脚。
tips_en: Pair with Zusanli (ST36) to support both your stomach and your feet.
caution_zh: 避开动脉搏动处。脚背有伤口或严重肿胀时不要按。
caution_en: Avoid the artery pulse. Do not press if your foot has open wounds or severe swelling.

summary_zh: 缓解脚面肿痛和面部浮肿。
summary_en: Relieves foot swelling and facial puffiness.
location_zh: 脚背上，第二和第三脚趾缝往脚踝方向约两横指处，两根脚骨之间的凹陷。按压有酸胀感。
