location_en: On the top of your foot, about two finger-widths back from the web between your second and third toes, in the groove between two foot bones. Press for an ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按入骨缝间的凹陷，力度中等，做小圆圈揉动或持续点按。
massage_en: Press your thumb into the groove between the bones with moderate pressure. Make small circles or hold steady point pressure.
routine_zh: 每次2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 脚背肿痛、早起面部浮肿、肚子不舒服时。
when_en: When your foot top is swollen, face is puffy in the morning, or your belly feels off.
tips_zh: 早上起床脸肿时按这个穴位，配合按水分穴（CV9）效果好。
tips_en: Press this point in the morning when your face is puffy. Combine with Shuifen (CV9) for better fluid-draining results.
caution_zh: 脚背有伤口或严重肿胀时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid if you have wounds or severe swelling on your foot.

summary_zh: 清除体内多余热气，缓解牙痛和胃火旺。
summary_en: Clears excess body heat — relieves toothache and overactive stomach fire.
location_zh: 脚背上，第二和第三脚趾缝往脚踝方向约半横指处，趾缝后方的凹陷。按压有明显的刺痛感。
location_en: On your foot top, about half a finger-width back from the web between your second and third toes. Press into the dip just behind the web — you'll feel a sharp, distinct ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指尖用力按住穴位，持续点按或做小幅度揉动。力度可以较重，会有比较强的酸痛感。
massage_en: Press firmly with your thumbnail or thumb tip. Hold strong point pressure or knead in tiny circles. Expect an intense, satisfying ache.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2-3次。牙痛或上火时随时按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime toothache or heat signs flare.
when_zh: 牙疼、口臭、胃口太旺吃太多、脸上长痘、便秘、鼻出血时。
when_en: During toothaches, bad breath, overeating from excessive appetite, facial breakouts, constipation, or nosebleeds.
tips_zh: 牙痛时配合合谷穴（LI4）一起按。上火严重时多按内庭，多喝水。
tips_en: For toothaches, press Hegu (LI4) simultaneously. When heat signs are strong, press this point often and drink plenty of water.
caution_zh: 怀孕期间慎用。体质虚寒怕冷的人不宜长时间重按。
caution_en: Use caution during pregnancy. If you tend to feel cold easily, avoid prolonged strong pressure.

summary_zh: 帮助清醒头脑、缓解面部肿痛和多梦。
summary_en: Clears the mind, eases facial swelling, and reduces excessive dreaming.
location_zh: 第二个脚趾外侧，趾甲根角旁边约一毫米处。就在趾甲外侧下角的旁边，按压有刺痛感。
location_en: On the outer side of your second toe, about one millimeter from the corner of the toenail base. Press the spot right beside the nail's outer lower corner — you'll feel a sharp sting.
massage_zh: 用拇指指甲掐按穴位，或用指尖重点按压。力度较重，短促有力。
massage_en: Pinch the point firmly with your thumbnail, or press with a strong fingertip. Use short, firm pressure bursts.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次。失眠多梦时睡前按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Press before bed if you have restless dreams.
when_zh: 头脑昏沉不清醒、多梦失眠、牙痛、面部肿痛、流鼻血时。
when_en: When your mind feels foggy, you dream too much, can't sleep, have toothaches, facial swelling, or nosebleeds.
tips_zh: 头脑不清醒时配合按涌泉穴（KI1）在脚底，上下呼应，提神效果好。
tips_en: For mental fog, combine with Yongquan (KI1) on the sole of your foot — pressing top and bottom works well together to sharpen alertness.
caution_zh: 此穴刺激较强，每次按压时间不宜过长。怀孕期间慎用。
caution_en: This point produces strong sensation — keep sessions short. Use caution during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解异常出血和腹部不适，也能安神助眠。
summary_en: Helps with abnormal bleeding, digestive upset, and restless sleep.
location_zh: 大脚趾内侧，趾甲根部内侧角旁约2毫米处。按下去会有明显的酸胀感。
location_en: On the inside edge of your big toe, about 2mm from the inner corner of the toenail base. Press and you'll feel a sharp, tingling ache.
massage_zh: 用另一只手的拇指指尖掐按此穴，力度中等偏重，有明显酸胀感即可。也可以用指甲轻掐，每次掐按3-5秒后松开，反复进行。
massage_en: Pinch this point firmly with the thumbnail of your opposite hand. Hold for 3-5 seconds, release, and repeat. The pressure should feel strong but tolerable — a deep ache means you've found it.
routine_zh: 每次按压3-5分钟，每天1-2次，经期前后可适当增加次数。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Increase frequency around your period if needed.
when_zh: 经期量多时、鼻出血反复发作时、夜里多梦睡不好时。
when_en: During heavy periods, recurring nosebleeds, or when you keep having vivid dreams that disrupt sleep.
tips_zh: 配合三阴交（SP6）一起按效果更好。睡前按压有助于安神入眠，配合深呼吸效果更佳。
tips_en: Pair with Sanyinjiao (SP6) for better results. Press before bed while taking slow, deep breaths to calm your mind for sleep.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。此处皮肤薄，力度不要过大以免破皮。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. The skin here is thin — don't press so hard that you break the skin.

summary_zh: 缓解胃胀、胃痛和消化不良，也可用于退热。
summary_en: Eases stomach bloating, stomach pain, and indigestion.
location_zh: 大脚趾内侧，大脚趾根部关节前方凹陷处，皮肤颜色深浅交界的地方。按压会感到酸胀。
location_en: On the inner side of your big toe, in the dip just in front of the big toe joint where the skin color changes from light to dark. Press and you'll feel a tender ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按揉，做小圆圈旋转动作，力度适中，感到酸胀为宜。不要用指甲硬掐。
massage_en: Use your thumb pad to press and make small circular motions. Apply moderate pressure — you should feel a satisfying ache but not sharp pain.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，饭后半小时按效果更好。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Best done 30 minutes after meals.
when_zh: 吃多了感觉胃胀不消化时、胃痛隐隐发作时、吃坏东西拉肚子时。
when_en: When you feel bloated after overeating, have a nagging stomachache, or get diarrhea from bad food.
tips_zh: 配合太白穴（SP3）一起按，帮助消化的效果更明显。按揉时配合顺时针揉腹部效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Taibai (SP3) for stronger digestive relief. Also try gently rubbing your belly clockwise while pressing this point.
caution_zh: 力度不要太重，此处关节附近皮肤较薄。脚部有伤口时避免按压。
caution_en: Use gentle to moderate pressure — the skin near this joint is thin. Avoid if there are wounds on your foot.

summary_zh: 脾经的核心保健穴，擅长改善各种消化问题。
summary_en: A key wellness point for all kinds of digestive issues.
location_zh: 脚内侧，大脚趾根部关节后方凹陷处，皮肤颜色深浅交界线上。用手摸会感到一个明显的小坑，按下去酸胀。
location_en: On the inner edge of your foot, in the dip just behind the big toe joint, along the skin color boundary. Feel for a small hollow — press and you'll notice a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹用力按揉此穴，做顺时针小圆圈动作，力度稍重，以有明显酸胀感为准。也可以用拇指直接按住不动持续施压。
massage_en: Press firmly with your thumb pad and make small clockwise circles. Use moderate to firm pressure — you should feel a strong, spreading ache. You can also just hold steady pressure on the point.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天2-3次，饭前或饭后一小时按最佳。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Best done 1 hour before or after meals.
when_zh: 消化不好经常胀气时、吃完饭肚子不舒服时、便秘或腹泻反复时、浑身沉重没精神时。
when_en: When you often feel gassy, get stomachaches after eating, have recurring constipation or diarrhea, or feel heavy and sluggish all over.
tips_zh: 配合公孙穴（SP4）一起按，对胃肠问题帮助更大。早上起床后空腹按揉，有助于唤醒消化功能。
tips_en: Pair with Gongsun (SP4) for stronger digestive support. Try pressing on an empty stomach in the morning to wake up your digestion.
caution_zh: 按压力度适中即可，不要在刚吃饱时大力按压。
caution_en: Use moderate pressure. Avoid pressing hard right after a big meal.

summary_zh: 既能缓解胃肠不适，又能舒缓胸闷心烦。
summary_en: Relieves stomach and gut discomfort, and calms chest tightness and irritability.
location_zh: 脚内侧，从大脚趾关节沿脚弓往后摸，摸到一块弓形骨头（第一跖骨），骨头后端下缘的凹陷处。按下去有明显酸胀感。
location_en: On the inner arch of your foot — slide your finger back from the big toe joint along the bone until you reach the end of the arch. The point is in the dip at the base of that bone. Press and you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按揉，力度中等偏重，做缓慢的圆圈动作。也可以用拇指持续按压此穴5-10秒后松开，反复交替进行。
massage_en: Press with your thumb pad using firm pressure and make slow circles. Or hold steady pressure for 5-10 seconds, release, and repeat. A deep ache radiating into the arch means you've hit the right spot.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，饭后1小时或感到不适时随时按。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Press whenever you feel discomfort or 1 hour after meals.
when_zh: 饭后胃胀反酸时、心烦胸闷坐不住时、肚子痛拉肚子时、出差旅行水土不服时。
when_en: After meals when you feel acid reflux or bloating, when you're restless with a tight chest, during stomachaches, or when your gut is off from traveling.
tips_zh: 配合内关穴（PC6）一起按，对胃痛和恶心的缓解效果特别好。按压时做几次深呼吸可以增强舒缓感。
tips_en: Combine with Neiguan (PC6) for excellent relief from nausea and stomach pain. Take slow deep breaths while pressing for a stronger calming effect.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。按压力度循序渐进，不要一上来就太重。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Start with light pressure and gradually increase — don't press too hard right away.

summary_zh: 缓解腹胀、便秘等消化问题，也能减轻脚踝肿痛。
summary_en: Eases bloating, constipation, and digestive issues, and soothes ankle swelling.
location_zh: 脚内踝前下方凹陷处。先找到内踝骨最突出的尖端，然后往前下方摸，找到一个明显的凹坑。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: In the dip just in front of and below your inner ankle bone. Find the tip of your inner ankle, then slide your finger forward and down into a noticeable hollow. Press and you'll feel a tender ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按揉此穴，力度轻到中等，做小圆圈动作。此处皮下较薄，不需要用很大力气就能有感觉。
massage_en: Use your thumb pad to press and make small circles with light to moderate pressure. The tissue is thin here, so you don't need much force to feel the ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，晚饭后按揉效果较好。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Works well after dinner.
when_zh: 便秘好几天排不出时、肚子胀气不舒服时、脚踝扭伤恢复期肿胀时。
when_en: When constipation has lasted several days, you feel uncomfortably bloated, or your ankle is swollen during recovery from a sprain.
tips_zh: 配合足三里（ST36）一起按揉，改善消化效果更好。按揉后喝一杯温水有助于肠道蠕动。
tips_en: Pair with Zusanli (ST36) for better digestive results. Drink a glass of warm water after your session to support bowel movement.
caution_zh: 脚踝急性扭伤肿胀明显时不要直接按压此穴。
caution_en: Do not press directly on this point during acute ankle sprains with significant swelling.

summary_zh: 女性保健第一要穴，对消化、睡眠、泌尿问题也很有帮助。
summary_en: A top wellness point for women's health, digestion, sleep, and urinary issues.
location_zh: 小腿内侧，内踝骨尖端往上四横指（把你四根手指并拢，小指下缘贴着内踝尖），食指上缘对应的高度，紧贴小腿骨后边缘。按压会有明显酸胀感。
location_en: On the inner side of your lower leg. Place four fingers together above the inner ankle bone — the point is at the top edge of your index finger, right behind the shin bone. Press and you'll feel a deep, spreading ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹垂直按压在小腿骨后边缘，力度中等偏重，做缓慢的上下推揉动作。感到酸胀并向上扩散说明找对了位置。
massage_en: Press your thumb firmly into the point right behind the shin bone. Use moderate to firm pressure with slow up-and-down strokes. A deep ache that spreads upward confirms you've found the right spot.
routine_zh: 每次按揉5分钟，每天1-2次，睡前按揉助眠，经期前一周开始按效果好。
routine_en: 5 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Press before bed for sleep, or start one week before your period for menstrual support.
when_zh: 经期不规律或痛经时、失眠多梦时、消化不好经常腹胀时、小腿容易浮肿时。
when_en: During irregular or painful periods, when you have trouble sleeping, feel frequently bloated, or notice your lower legs puffing up.
tips_zh: 配合足三里（ST36）一起按揉，消化效果更好；配合神门（HT7）按揉，助眠效果更强。按压时慢慢深呼吸。
tips_en: Pair with Zusanli (ST36) for digestion or Shenmen (HT7) for sleep. Breathe slowly and deeply while pressing for enhanced relaxation.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。经期量大时不要过度刺激此穴。
caution_en: Do NOT use during pregnancy. Avoid overstimulating this point during heavy menstrual flow.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解腹胀肠鸣和小便不畅等问题。
summary_en: Helps relieve abdominal bloating, gurgling stomach, and urinary difficulty.
location_zh: 小腿内侧，内踝骨尖端往上约六横指（大约一个手掌宽多一点），紧贴小腿骨后边缘。按压会有酸胀感。
location_en: On the inner side of your lower leg, about a palm's width plus two finger-widths above the inner ankle bone, right behind the shin bone. Press and you'll feel a dull ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按揉，力度中等，沿小腿骨后缘做上下推揉动作，找到最酸胀的点后持续按压。
massage_en: Use your thumb pad to press along the back edge of the shin bone, sliding up and down to find the most tender spot. Once found, hold firm pressure or make small circles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1次，饭后1-2小时按揉为宜。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session, once daily. Best done 1-2 hours after meals.
when_zh: 肚子经常咕咕叫、腹胀不消化时、小便不太通畅时、小腿酸胀无力时。
when_en: When your stomach keeps gurgling, you feel bloated, have trouble urinating smoothly, or your lower legs feel heavy and weak.
tips_zh: 配合三阴交（SP6）和阴陵泉（SP9）一起从下往上按揉，效果更好。按揉时保持均匀呼吸。
tips_en: Press along the inner leg from SP6 up through this point to SP9 for a complete lower-leg routine. Keep breathing evenly throughout.
caution_zh: 按压力度不要太重，小腿内侧皮肤较敏感。
caution_en: Use moderate pressure — the inner calf skin is sensitive. Ease up if you feel sharp pain.

summary_zh: 缓解痛经和月经不调的要穴，也能帮助止腹痛腹泻。
summary_en: A key point for menstrual cramps and irregular periods, plus belly pain relief.
location_zh: 小腿内侧，先找到膝盖下方内侧的大骨头突起（阴陵泉的位置），从那里往下四横指，紧贴小腿骨后边缘。按压痛经时这里往往特别酸痛。
location_en: On the inner side of your lower leg. Find the bony bump just below the inner knee, then measure four finger-widths straight down, right behind the shin bone. During cramps, this spot is often extra tender when pressed.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹用力按揉此穴，力度可以稍重，做持续的圆圈按揉动作。痛经时可以加大力度，以酸胀感明显为准。
massage_en: Press firmly with your thumb pad and make steady circular motions. You can use stronger pressure during menstrual cramps — a deep, intense ache is normal and means it's working.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，痛经时可随时按揉，平时每天1次即可。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session. During cramps, press as often as needed. Otherwise, once daily is enough.
when_zh: 痛经发作时（急救穴）、月经量少或不规律时、突然腹痛腹泻时。
when_en: When menstrual cramps hit (this is a go-to rescue point), periods are scanty or irregular, or you get sudden stomach pain with diarrhea.
tips_zh: 痛经时配合三阴交（SP6）一起按揉效果翻倍。按揉后在小腹敷热毛巾，舒缓效果更明显。
tips_en: Combine with Sanyinjiao (SP6) during cramps for much stronger relief. Follow up by placing a warm towel on your lower belly.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。经期量多时不宜过度按压此穴。
caution_en: Do NOT use during pregnancy. Avoid heavy pressure during very heavy menstrual flow.

summary_zh: 身体的「祛湿开关」，擅长缓解水肿、腹胀和小便不畅。
summary_en: Your body's "water balance switch" — great for reducing swelling, bloating, and urinary issues.
location_zh: 小腿内侧，用拇指沿小腿骨内侧边缘从下往上推，推到膝盖下方时骨头会向内上方弯曲，手指自然滑入的凹陷处就是此穴。按压会有强烈酸胀感。
location_en: On the inner side of your lower leg. Slide your thumb up along the inner edge of the shin bone toward the knee — when the bone curves inward just below the knee, your finger drops into a hollow. That's the point. Press and you'll feel a strong, deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹用力按压此穴，力度中等偏重，做上下推揉或圆圈按揉动作。此穴感觉较强烈，可以根据自己的承受力调节。
massage_en: Press firmly with your thumb pad and use up-and-down strokes or circular motions. This point tends to be intense — adjust the pressure to your comfort level while keeping it firm enough to feel a deep ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，早晨起床后按效果好。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Morning sessions work best.
when_zh: 腿脚容易浮肿时、身体沉重感觉湿气重时、腹胀消化不好时、小便不顺畅时。
when_en: When your legs swell easily, your body feels heavy and waterlogged, you're bloated with poor digestion, or urination feels incomplete.
tips_zh: 配合足三里（ST36）一起按揉可以同时健脾祛湿。按揉后适量喝温水，帮助身体排出多余水分。
tips_en: Pair with Zusanli (ST36) for a powerful digestion-and-drainage combo. Drink warm water after pressing to help your body flush excess fluid.
caution_zh: 膝关节急性损伤肿胀时避免按压此穴。
caution_en: Avoid pressing this point if your knee is acutely injured or significantly swollen.

summary_zh: 皮肤和月经问题的首选穴位，擅长缓解瘙痒和调理月经。
summary_en: A go-to point for skin itching and menstrual issues.
location_zh: 大腿内侧，膝盖骨内上方约两横指处。用力绷直腿，大腿内侧鼓起的肌肉中间就是。按压会有酸胀感。
location_en: On your inner thigh, about two finger-widths above the top inner corner of the kneecap. Sit down, straighten your leg hard, and feel the muscle that bulges on the inner thigh — the point is in the middle of that bulge. Press and you'll feel a satisfying ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按揉，力度中等偏重，做圆圈动作。也可以用掌根按压此穴区域，范围稍大地揉动，更容易找准位置。
massage_en: Press with your thumb pad and make circles using moderate to firm pressure. You can also use the heel of your palm to cover a wider area — this makes it easier to hit the right spot.
routine_zh: 每次按揉5分钟，每天1-2次，经前一周开始每天按效果好。
routine_en: 5 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Start pressing daily one week before your period for best results.
when_zh: 皮肤瘙痒起疹子时、月经不调或经期量少时、经前综合征烦躁时。
when_en: When your skin itches or breaks out in rashes, your periods are irregular or scanty, or you feel irritable with PMS.
tips_zh: 配合曲池穴（LI11）一起按揉，止痒效果更强。配合三阴交（SP6）对月经调理效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Quchi (LI11) for stronger itch relief. Pair with Sanyinjiao (SP6) for menstrual support.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。皮肤有破溃感染时不要按压。
caution_en: Use with caution during pregnancy. Do not press if the skin at this point is broken or infected.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解小便不畅和大腿内侧不适。
summary_en: Helps relieve urinary difficulty and inner thigh discomfort.
location_zh: 大腿内侧，从膝盖骨内上方往大腿根部方向约三分之一的位置，大腿内侧可以摸到动脉跳动的地方附近。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On the inner thigh, about one-third of the way up from the inner kneecap toward the groin. You may feel an artery pulsing nearby. Press beside (not on) the pulse and you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指或掌根按揉，力度轻到中等，避开动脉跳动的位置，在其外侧按揉。做缓慢的圆圈动作即可。
massage_en: Use your thumb or palm heel to press with light to moderate pressure. Avoid the pulsing artery — press just to the side of it. Make slow, gentle circles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，不需要过于频繁。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, once daily. No need for frequent use.
when_zh: 小便不通畅时、大腿内侧酸痛不适时、久坐后腿部发胀时。
when_en: When urination feels difficult, your inner thighs ache, or your legs feel swollen after sitting for a long time.
tips_zh: 配合阴陵泉（SP9）一起按揉，对缓解下肢不适和小便问题帮助更大。
tips_en: Pair with Yinlingquan (SP9) for better lower-body and urinary relief.
caution_zh: 避开动脉搏动处，不要直接按压血管。孕妇慎用。
caution_en: Do not press directly on the pulsing artery. Use caution during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解小腹疼痛和腹股沟不适。
summary_en: Eases lower abdominal pain and groin discomfort.
location_zh: 大腿根部与腹部交界处（腹股沟），能摸到动脉跳动的位置外侧，大约在耻骨上缘的高度。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: At the crease where your thigh meets your lower belly (the groin fold), just to the outside of where you feel an artery pulsing, level with the top of the pubic bone. Press and you'll feel a dull ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指或食指、中指并拢，在动脉外侧轻柔按揉，力度要轻，做小幅度圆圈动作。此处敏感区域，切勿用力过猛。
massage_en: Use your thumb or two fingers together to gently press and make small circles just outside the artery. Keep the pressure light — this is a sensitive area. A mild ache is sufficient.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，不要按揉过久。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, once daily. Do not overwork this point.
when_zh: 小腹疼痛时、腹股沟（大腿根部）酸胀不适时、久坐后髋部发紧时。
when_en: When you have lower belly pain, your groin area aches, or your hips feel tight after long periods of sitting.
tips_zh: 配合气冲穴（ST30）一起轻柔按揉，对缓解腹股沟不适效果更好。按揉前先热敷此处2分钟。
tips_en: Pair with Qichong (ST30) for better groin relief. Warm the area with a hot towel for 2 minutes before pressing.
caution_zh: 避开动脉搏动处，力度要轻。孕妇禁用。腹股沟有肿块时就医检查，不要自行按压。
caution_en: Avoid the artery. Keep pressure light. Do NOT use during pregnancy. If you feel a lump in the groin, see a doctor instead of pressing.

summary_zh: 缓解下腹疼痛和消化不适。
summary_en: Eases lower abdominal pain and digestive discomfort.
location_zh: 下腹部，肚脐往下约四指宽多一点，再往身体两侧旁开约四指宽处。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On your lower belly, about four finger-widths below and four finger-widths to the side of your navel. Press and you'll feel a soft, deep ache.
massage_zh: 用食指、中指和无名指三指并拢，轻柔地按揉此穴，做顺时针小圆圈动作，力度要轻柔，感到微微酸胀即可。
massage_en: Place three fingers together (index, middle, ring) and press gently with small clockwise circles. Keep the pressure soft — a mild ache is all you need.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，饭后2小时按揉为宜。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, once daily. Best done 2 hours after eating.
when_zh: 下腹隐痛不舒服时、肚子疼伴有腹泻呕吐时、消化不好腹部胀满时。
when_en: When you have a dull ache in your lower belly, stomach pain with diarrhea or vomiting, or bloating from poor digestion.
tips_zh: 配合大横穴（SP15）一起按揉，对腹痛的缓解效果更好。按揉时配合深呼吸，吸气时轻按，呼气时稍加力。
tips_en: Pair with Daheng (SP15) for better belly pain relief. Breathe deeply while pressing — light pressure on the inhale, slightly firmer on the exhale.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。腹部有急性炎症或不明肿块时禁止按压，应就医。
caution_en: Do NOT use during pregnancy. Do not press if you have acute abdominal inflammation or an unexplained lump — see a doctor.

summary_zh: 缓解腹痛和便秘，帮助肠道恢复正常蠕动。
summary_en: Relieves belly pain and constipation, helping restore normal bowel movement.
location_zh: 下腹部，肚脐往下约一指半宽，再往身体两侧旁开约四指宽处。按压有酸胀感，便秘时按压可能更敏感。
location_en: On your lower belly, about one and a half finger-widths below and four finger-widths to the side of your navel. Press and you'll feel an ache — it may be extra tender when you're constipated.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢按揉此穴，力度轻到中等，做顺时针圆圈按揉动作，模拟肠道蠕动方向。
massage_en: Use two fingers (index and middle) to press and make clockwise circles with light to moderate pressure, following the natural direction of bowel movement.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，早晨起床后按揉效果最好。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Morning sessions after waking work best.
when_zh: 便秘排不出来时、腹痛但不是急性剧烈痛时、肚子感觉发紧不舒服时。
when_en: When you're constipated and can't go, have a non-acute bellyache, or your abdomen feels tight and uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 配合天枢穴（ST25）和大横穴（SP15）一起顺时针按揉整个腹部，帮助肠道蠕动效果更好。按揉后喝一杯温水。
tips_en: Combine with Tianshu (ST25) and Daheng (SP15) for a clockwise belly massage routine. Follow up with a glass of warm water.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。急性腹痛、阑尾炎等急腹症时禁止按压，应立即就医。
caution_en: Do NOT use during pregnancy. Do not press during acute severe abdominal pain (e.g., appendicitis) — seek medical attention immediately.

summary_zh: 缓解腹痛、腹泻和便秘的常用穴位，就在肚脐旁边很好找。
summary_en: A handy point right beside the navel for belly pain, diarrhea, and constipation.
location_zh: 腹部，肚脐正旁边，往两侧旁开约四指宽处。从乳头画一条直线往下，与肚脐水平线的交点就是此穴。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On your belly, four finger-widths straight out to the side from your navel. An easy way: draw an imaginary line down from your nipple — where it crosses navel level is the point. Press and you'll feel a deep, soft ache.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢或用掌根按揉此穴，力度中等，做顺时针圆圈按揉动作。双侧同时按揉效果更好。
massage_en: Use two fingers or the heel of your palm to press and make clockwise circles with moderate pressure. Press both sides at the same time for better results.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，饭后1-2小时按揉为宜。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Best done 1-2 hours after meals.
when_zh: 腹痛隐隐不舒服时、便秘或腹泻反复时、吃完饭肚子胀得难受时。
when_en: When you have a lingering bellyache, keep alternating between constipation and diarrhea, or feel painfully bloated after eating.
tips_zh: 配合天枢穴（ST25）和腹结穴（SP14）组成「腹部三穴」一起按揉，效果全面。按揉时深呼吸放松腹部。
tips_en: Combine with Tianshu (ST25) and Fujie (SP14) as a three-point belly routine for comprehensive relief. Relax your belly and breathe deeply while pressing.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。刚吃饱不要马上按压腹部穴位。
caution_en: Do NOT use during pregnancy. Avoid pressing any belly points right after eating.

summary_zh: 缓解上腹部疼痛、消化不良和便秘。
summary_en: Eases upper belly pain, indigestion, and constipation.
location_zh: 上腹部，肚脐往上约三指宽，再往身体两侧旁开约四指宽处。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On your upper belly, about three finger-widths above and four finger-widths to the side of your navel. Press and you'll feel a dull, deep ache.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢，轻柔按揉此穴，做顺时针小圆圈动作，力度轻到中等。不要按得太深，上腹部靠近肋骨下缘要温柔。
massage_en: Press gently with two fingers and make small clockwise circles. Use light to moderate pressure — be gentle near the lower rib area. A mild, spreading ache is the right sensation.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，饭后1-2小时按揉为宜。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, once daily. Best done 1-2 hours after meals.
when_zh: 吃完饭上腹部不舒服时、消化不良胃里堵得慌时、便秘好几天时。
when_en: When your upper belly hurts after eating, your stomach feels stuck from indigestion, or you've been constipated for days.
tips_zh: 配合中脘穴（RN12）一起按揉，消化不良的缓解效果更明显。饭前饭后各按揉一次效果好。
tips_en: Pair with Zhongwan (RN12) for stronger indigestion relief. Try pressing once before and once after meals.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。腹部有急性疼痛或不明原因剧痛时不要按压，应就医。
caution_en: Do NOT use during pregnancy. If you have acute or unexplained severe belly pain, see a doctor instead of pressing.

summary_zh: 缓解胸闷和肋间胀痛。
summary_en: Eases chest stuffiness and rib-area tightness.
location_zh: 胸部侧面，第五根肋骨之间的缝隙（从锁骨往下数到第五个肋间），在胸部正中线往外旁开约六指宽处。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On the side of your chest, in the space between the fifth and sixth ribs, about six finger-widths out from the center of your chest. Press and you'll feel a tender ache between the ribs.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹沿肋骨间隙轻柔按揉，力度要轻，做水平方向的小幅推揉动作。胸部穴位不要用力过大。
massage_en: Use your index or middle finger to press gently along the space between the ribs. Make small horizontal strokes with light pressure. Never press hard on chest points.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，感觉胸闷时随时可以按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, once daily. Press anytime you feel chest stuffiness.
when_zh: 胸口感觉闷闷的时候、肋骨两侧胀痛不舒服时。
when_en: When your chest feels stuffy or tight, or the sides of your ribcage ache.
tips_zh: 配合膻中穴（RN17）一起按揉，对胸闷的缓解效果更好。按揉时做深呼吸，吸气时展开胸腔。
tips_en: Pair with Danzhong (RN17) for better chest relief. Take deep breaths while pressing — expand your ribcage fully on each inhale.
caution_zh: 力度要轻柔，胸部穴位不能大力按压。有肋骨骨折或胸部损伤时禁用。
caution_en: Keep pressure light on all chest points. Do not use if you have a rib fracture or chest injury.

summary_zh: 缓解胸痛、咳嗽和乳房胀痛。
summary_en: Relieves chest pain, cough, and breast tenderness.
location_zh: 胸部侧面，第四根肋骨之间的缝隙（从锁骨往下数到第四个肋间），在胸部正中线往外旁开约六指宽处。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On the side of your chest, in the space between the fourth and fifth ribs, about six finger-widths out from the center of your chest. Press and you'll feel a tender, spreading ache.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹在肋骨间隙轻轻按揉，做小圆圈动作，力度要轻柔。乳房胀痛时在此穴附近轻柔按揉有助于缓解。
massage_en: Use your fingertip to press gently in the rib space with small circular motions. Keep the touch light and soothing. For breast tenderness, gentle massage around this area can help ease the discomfort.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，经前乳房胀痛时可增加次数。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, once daily. Increase frequency if you have pre-menstrual breast tenderness.
when_zh: 咳嗽胸口不舒服时、经前乳房胀痛时、胸部两侧感觉紧绷时。
when_en: When coughing makes your chest ache, you get breast soreness before your period, or your chest sides feel tight.
tips_zh: 配合膻中穴（RN17）一起按揉对缓解胸部不适效果好。咳嗽时配合列缺穴（LU7）一起按揉。
tips_en: Pair with Danzhong (RN17) for chest discomfort. Combine with Lieque (LU7) when coughing.
caution_zh: 力度要轻柔。乳房有肿块时应先就医检查，不要自行按压。
caution_en: Keep pressure gentle. If you notice a breast lump, see a doctor first — do not self-massage the area.

summary_zh: 缓解胸部和肋间胀痛不适。
summary_en: Relieves chest and rib-area tightness and pain.
location_zh: 胸部侧面，第三根肋骨之间的缝隙（从锁骨往下数到第三个肋间），在胸部正中线往外旁开约六指宽处。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On the side of your chest, in the space between the third and fourth ribs, about six finger-widths out from the center of your chest. Press and you'll feel a tender ache.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹在肋骨间隙轻柔按揉，力度要轻，做水平方向的小幅推揉动作。
massage_en: Press gently with your fingertip in the rib space and make small horizontal strokes. Use light pressure — the ribs are close to the surface here.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，胸闷时随时可以按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, once daily. Press anytime you feel chest tightness.
when_zh: 胸口两侧胀痛时、深呼吸时感觉肋间不舒服时、长时间伏案工作后胸部发紧时。
when_en: When the sides of your chest ache, deep breathing feels uncomfortable in your ribs, or your chest is tight after hunching over a desk all day.
tips_zh: 配合食窦穴（SP17）和天溪穴（SP18）从下往上依次按揉，放松整个胸部侧面。按揉时做扩胸深呼吸。
tips_en: Press SP17, SP18, and this point in sequence from bottom to top to relax the whole side of your chest. Take chest-expanding deep breaths while pressing.
caution_zh: 力度要轻柔，不能大力按压胸部穴位。有肋骨损伤时禁用。
caution_en: Always use gentle pressure on chest points. Do not use if you have a rib injury.

summary_zh: 缓解咳嗽气喘和胸部胀满不适。
summary_en: Eases coughing, wheezing, and chest fullness.
location_zh: 胸部侧面，第二根肋骨之间的缝隙（从锁骨往下数到第二个肋间），在胸部正中线往外旁开约六指宽处。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On the side of your upper chest, in the space between the second and third ribs, about six finger-widths out from the center of your chest. Press and you'll feel a tender ache.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹在肋骨间隙轻柔按揉，做小圆圈动作，力度要轻。咳嗽时按揉此穴可帮助缓解胸部不适感。
massage_en: Use your fingertip to press gently in the rib space with small circular motions. Light pressure is enough. Pressing during a coughing fit can help ease chest discomfort.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，咳嗽发作时可随时按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime during a coughing episode.
when_zh: 咳嗽反复不好时、胸口感觉满胀喘不上气时、感冒后咳嗽拖延不愈时。
when_en: When a cough won't quit, your chest feels full and breathing is labored, or a lingering post-cold cough drags on.
tips_zh: 配合肺俞穴（BL13）和列缺穴（LU7）一起按揉，止咳效果更好。按揉时做腹式深呼吸。
tips_en: Combine with Feishu (BL13) and Lieque (LU7) for stronger cough relief. Practice belly breathing while pressing.
caution_zh: 力度要轻柔。咳嗽持续不好应就医，不要仅靠按揉。
caution_en: Use gentle pressure. If your cough persists, see a doctor — don't rely solely on acupoint massage.

summary_zh: 缓解全身酸痛、四肢无力和胸肋胀痛。
summary_en: Relieves body-wide aches, limb weakness, and side-chest tightness.
location_zh: 胸部外侧，腋窝正中线往下，第六根肋骨之间的缝隙处。把手臂抬起来，沿腋窝中间画一条直线往下，数到第六个肋间缝就是此穴。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On the side of your chest, directly below the center of your armpit, in the space between the sixth and seventh ribs. Raise your arm, draw an imaginary line straight down from mid-armpit, and count down to the sixth rib space. Press and you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 抬起手臂，用另一只手的拇指或食指、中指并拢，在肋骨间隙按揉此穴，力度中等，做圆圈或上下推揉动作。
massage_en: Raise the arm on the side you're working on. Use the thumb or two fingers of your opposite hand to press and make circles or up-and-down strokes in the rib space. Use moderate pressure.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1次，身体疲劳时随时可以按。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes per session, once daily. Press anytime you feel fatigued or achy all over.
when_zh: 全身酸痛没力气时、肋骨两侧胀痛不舒服时、运动后肌肉疲劳恢复慢时、长期疲劳感觉身体被掏空时。
when_en: When your whole body aches and feels weak, your ribs hurt on the sides, muscles recover slowly after exercise, or chronic fatigue has you feeling drained.
tips_zh: 配合足三里（ST36）一起按揉，对缓解全身疲劳效果更好。按揉后做几个展臂扩胸的拉伸动作。
tips_en: Pair with Zusanli (ST36) for full-body fatigue relief. After pressing, do a few arm-stretching and chest-opening stretches.
caution_zh: 力度适中即可，胸侧肋间区域不要暴力按压。有肋骨损伤时禁用。
caution_en: Use moderate pressure — never press aggressively between the ribs. Do not use if you have a rib injury.

summary_zh: 缓解心慌胸闷，帮助放松紧绷的肩臂。
summary_en: Eases chest tightness, calms a racing heart, and relieves shoulder-arm tension.
location_zh: 抬起手臂，腋窝正中央，能摸到动脉跳动的地方。按压时会有明显酸胀感，并向手臂内侧放散。
location_en: Raise your arm. Find the center of your armpit where you can feel a pulse. Press just to the inner side of that pulse — you'll feel a deep ache that radiates down your inner arm.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指指腹，避开动脉跳动处，轻轻按揉旁边的位置。力度要轻柔，以感到酸胀为度，不要用力掐按。每次按揉同时做深呼吸。
massage_en: Use the opposite thumb to press gently beside the pulse point — never directly on it. Apply light to moderate pressure in small circular motions. Breathe deeply as you massage. You should feel a dull ache, not sharp pain.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，感到胸闷时随时可按。
routine_en: Massage 1-2 minutes per side, once or twice daily. Use anytime you feel chest tightness.
when_zh: 紧张焦虑时心跳加快、胸口发闷、肩膀僵硬抬不起手臂、天热心烦。
when_en: When anxiety makes your heart race, when your chest feels tight and stuffy, when your shoulders are so stiff you can barely lift your arms, or on hot days when you feel irritable.
tips_zh: 按揉极泉时配合缓慢深呼吸效果更好。可以先按极泉，再按内关（手腕内侧），两个穴位搭配对缓解心慌很有帮助。
tips_en: Pair with slow deep breathing for best results. Follow up by pressing Neiguan (PC6, inner wrist) — the two points work well together for calming a racing heart.
caution_zh: 力度一定要轻，避开动脉跳动处。孕妇慎用。腋下有肿块或淋巴结肿大时不要按。
caution_en: Use only gentle pressure — never press directly on the artery pulse. Avoid during pregnancy. Do not massage if you have lumps or swollen lymph nodes in the armpit.

summary_zh: 缓解上臂内侧疼痛和肋间不适。
summary_en: Relieves inner upper-arm pain and discomfort along the ribs.
location_zh: 弯曲手肘，从肘横纹沿上臂内侧向上量约4横指（3寸），在上臂内侧两块肌肉之间的沟里。按下去会有酸胀感。
location_en: Bend your elbow. From the elbow crease, measure four finger-widths up along the inner arm. Find the groove between the two muscles on the inner side of your upper arm. Press in — you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指指腹按压在沟中，做小幅度的揉按。力度中等，以酸胀舒适为宜。也可以沿着上臂内侧从肘部向上推揉。
massage_en: Use the opposite thumb to press into the groove. Apply moderate pressure with small circular motions. You can also slide your thumb along the inner arm from elbow upward in slow, firm strokes.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，手臂不适时可加按。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per side, once daily. Add an extra session when arm pain flares up.
when_zh: 上臂内侧酸痛、肩膀到手肘一带僵硬、侧胸肋骨处隐隐不适。
when_en: When your inner upper arm aches, when stiffness runs from shoulder to elbow, or when you feel a dull discomfort along the side of your ribcage.
tips_zh: 可以配合少海（HT3，肘内侧）一起按揉，从青灵顺着推到少海，能更好地放松整条手臂内侧。
tips_en: Combine with Shaohai (HT3, inner elbow) by sliding your thumb from HT2 down to HT3. This helps release the entire inner arm.
caution_zh: 此处皮肤较薄，不要用指甲掐按。力度适中即可，不要过重。
caution_en: The skin here is thin — use your thumb pad, never your fingernail. Keep pressure moderate; do not press too hard.

summary_zh: 缓解肘部疼痛和手臂屈伸不利，也能帮助安心定神。
summary_en: Eases elbow pain and stiffness, and helps calm an anxious, restless mind.
location_zh: 手掌朝上弯曲手肘成直角，肘横纹最内侧的尽头处，靠近肘内侧那块突出的骨头。按压时有明显酸胀感。
location_en: Turn your palm up and bend your elbow to a right angle. Find the inner end of the elbow crease, near the bony bump on the inside of your elbow. Press there — you'll feel a distinct sore spot.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指按在肘横纹内侧端的凹陷中，做小圆圈揉按。力度从轻到中，慢慢加力，感到酸胀即可。也可以一边揉一边缓慢屈伸手肘。
massage_en: Place the opposite thumb in the hollow at the inner end of the elbow crease. Press with small circular motions, starting light and gradually increasing to moderate pressure. Slowly bend and straighten your elbow as you massage for a deeper release.
routine_zh: 每次揉按2-3分钟，每天1-2次，建议在伸展手臂后进行。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per side, 1-2 times daily. Best done after gentle arm stretches.
when_zh: 肘关节疼痛或僵硬、长时间用电脑后手臂酸痛、心情烦躁静不下来。
when_en: When your elbow hurts or feels stiff, after long hours at the computer when your arm aches, or when you feel restless and can't settle down.
tips_zh: 配合神门（HT7，手腕内侧）一起按揉，从少海沿手臂内侧推到神门，对安神助眠效果更好。按完后轻轻甩动手臂放松。
tips_en: Follow up with Shenmen (HT7, inner wrist) — slide your thumb from HT3 down the inner forearm to HT7. This combination is especially good for calming the mind. Gently shake out your arm afterward.
caution_zh: 不要猛力按压肘关节内侧骨突。肘部有炎症或肿胀时避免按揉。
caution_en: Do not press hard directly on the bony bump. Avoid massaging if your elbow is inflamed or swollen.

summary_zh: 缓解心慌不安，也能帮助嗓子突然发不出声。
summary_en: Calms heart palpitations and helps when your voice suddenly gives out.
location_zh: 手掌朝上，从手腕横纹向手肘方向量约2横指（1.5寸）。摸到小指侧那根粗筋（弯手腕时更明显），在它靠拇指一侧的边上。按下有酸胀感。
location_en: Palm up, measure about two finger-widths above the wrist crease toward your elbow. Find the thick tendon on the pinky side (flex your wrist to feel it pop up). The point is just on the thumb-side edge of that tendon. Press — you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指指腹，轻轻按压在筋的外侧边缘，做小幅度揉按。力度要轻柔，这里皮下有血管和神经，不能用力按。以感到微微酸胀为度。
massage_en: Use the opposite thumb pad to press gently on the thumb-side edge of the tendon. Make small, slow circular motions with light pressure. This area has blood vessels and nerves beneath the skin, so keep the touch gentle — a mild ache is enough.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，心慌时随时可轻按。
routine_en: Massage 1-2 minutes per side, 1-2 times daily. Press gently anytime you feel your heart flutter.
when_zh: 突然心跳加速紧张不安、嗓子突然哑了说不出话、前臂内侧发紧不舒服。
when_en: When your heart suddenly races with anxiety, when you lose your voice unexpectedly, or when your inner forearm feels tight and uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 按揉时配合缓慢深呼吸，吸气4秒、呼气6秒。可以和通里（HT5）一起按，两个穴位相距约1横指，顺着一起揉效果更好。
tips_en: Breathe slowly as you press — inhale for 4 seconds, exhale for 6. Combine with Tongli (HT5), just one finger-width below. Massaging both in sequence amplifies the calming effect.
caution_zh: 此处不可用力深按，轻柔按揉即可。手腕有损伤或肿胀时不要按。
caution_en: Never press deeply here — light touch only. Avoid if your wrist is injured or swollen.

summary_zh: 帮助说话困难和舌头发僵，也能安定心神。
summary_en: Helps when your tongue feels stiff or speech is difficult, and calms the heart.
location_zh: 手掌朝上，从手腕横纹向手肘方向量约1横指多（1寸）。在小指侧那根粗筋靠拇指一侧的边缘。和灵道（HT4）相距约半横指。按压有酸胀感向手指方向放散。
location_en: Palm up, measure about one finger-width above the wrist crease. Find the thick tendon on the pinky side and locate the point on its thumb-side edge. It's about half a finger-width below HT4. Press — the ache may radiate toward your fingers.
massage_zh: 用对侧拇指指腹轻轻按住穴位，做缓慢的小圆圈揉动。力度要轻，感到酸胀即可停住保持按压几秒再松开，反复几次。不要用力掐按。
massage_en: Use the opposite thumb pad to press gently on the point. Make slow, small circles with light pressure. When you feel the ache, hold the pressure for a few seconds, then release. Repeat several times. Never pinch or press hard.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，说话费力时可随时轻按。
routine_en: Massage 1-2 minutes per side, 1-2 times daily. Press gently whenever speaking feels effortful.
when_zh: 演讲或唱歌后嗓子疲劳、舌头发僵说话不利索、心慌心悸、手腕内侧酸痛。
when_en: After speaking or singing when your voice is fatigued, when your tongue feels stiff and words come out clumsily, during heart palpitations, or when your inner wrist aches.
tips_zh: 嗓子不舒服时，配合廉泉（下巴正下方喉结上方的凹陷）一起按，上下搭配效果更好。按完后喝一杯温水。
tips_en: For voice issues, combine with Lianquan (the hollow above the Adam's apple, under the chin). Working both points together gives better results. Drink warm water afterward.
caution_zh: 此处不可用力深按，轻揉即可。手腕受伤或皮肤破损时避免按揉。
caution_en: Light pressure only — do not press deep. Avoid if your wrist is injured or the skin is broken.

summary_zh: 缓解心慌心痛，帮助减轻夜间盗汗。
summary_en: Eases heart discomfort and palpitations, and helps reduce night sweats.
location_zh: 手掌朝上，从手腕横纹向手肘方向量约半横指（0.5寸）。在小指侧那根粗筋靠拇指一侧的边缘，紧挨手腕横纹上方。按压时酸胀明显。
location_en: Palm up, find the wrist crease on the pinky side. Measure just half a finger-width above it. Locate the thick tendon (flex your wrist to feel it) and press on its thumb-side edge. You'll feel a clear, tender ache.
massage_zh: 用对侧拇指指腹轻按穴位，做缓慢揉按。力度宜轻，这里紧贴血管和神经。按住酸胀点保持5-10秒，松开，再按，反复做。配合均匀呼吸。
massage_en: Press gently with the opposite thumb pad using slow circular motions. Hold each press for 5-10 seconds when you find the tender spot, release, then repeat. Keep your breathing slow and even. This area is close to blood vessels, so use only light pressure.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，睡前按揉效果尤佳。
routine_en: Massage 1-2 minutes per side, 1-2 times daily. Best done before bed to reduce night sweats.
when_zh: 夜里容易出汗醒来、心慌胸口不舒服、紧张焦虑时手心出汗。
when_en: When you wake up drenched in sweat at night, when your chest feels uneasy with palpitations, or when anxiety makes your palms sweaty.
tips_zh: 睡前按揉阴郄，再配合神门（HT7，手腕横纹上），两个穴位一起按对改善睡眠质量特别好。按完后平躺做几次深呼吸。
tips_en: Press Yinxi before bed, then follow with Shenmen (HT7, at the wrist crease). This pair is especially effective for improving sleep quality. Lie down afterward and take several slow, deep breaths.
caution_zh: 轻柔按揉，不可用力深压。手腕有伤或皮肤破损时不要按。
caution_en: Use gentle pressure only — never press deeply. Avoid if your wrist is injured or the skin is broken.

summary_zh: 安神助眠的首选穴位，帮助你睡得更好、心情更平静。
summary_en: The go-to point for better sleep and a calmer mind.
location_zh: 手掌朝上，手腕横纹的最内侧（小指侧），小指下方有一颗圆圆的突起小骨头（豌豆骨），在它旁边靠拇指那侧的凹陷中。按下去有酸胀感，很好找。
location_en: Palm up, look at the wrist crease on the pinky side. Feel for the small round bone that sticks up below your little finger. The point is in the hollow just to the thumb-side of that bone, right on the wrist crease. Press — you'll find a satisfying tender spot.
massage_zh: 用对侧拇指指腹按在凹陷中，做缓慢的小圆圈揉按。力度轻到中等，感到酸胀舒适即可。也可以用拇指持续按住不动，保持10-15秒后松开，反复做5-6次。
massage_en: Place the opposite thumb in the hollow and press with slow circular motions. Use light to moderate pressure — it should feel achey but pleasant. Or simply hold steady pressure for 10-15 seconds, release, and repeat 5-6 times.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天2-3次。睡前15分钟按揉效果最好。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per side, 2-3 times daily. Most effective when done 15 minutes before bed.
when_zh: 晚上翻来覆去睡不着、白天心烦焦虑、记性变差注意力不集中、考试面试前紧张。
when_en: When you toss and turn at night, when daytime anxiety won't let up, when your memory and focus are slipping, or before a stressful exam or interview.
tips_zh: 睡前按完神门，再按内关（手腕内侧正中往上三横指），两个穴位是安神助眠的经典搭配。按的时候闭眼、放慢呼吸，效果翻倍。
tips_en: After pressing Shenmen, add Neiguan (PC6, three finger-widths above the inner wrist center). This classic pairing is powerful for calming the mind. Close your eyes and slow your breathing as you press — it doubles the effect.
caution_zh: 此穴很安全，力度适中即可。孕妇可用但不宜过度刺激。
caution_en: This point is very safe. Use moderate pressure. Pregnant women may use it but should avoid overstimulation.

summary_zh: 缓解心悸胸闷，也能缓解手掌发热和小指不适。
summary_en: Eases palpitations and chest tightness, and soothes hot, uncomfortable palms.
location_zh: 握拳时小指尖碰到手掌的地方就是。位于手掌心偏小指侧，第四和第五根手掌骨之间。松开拳头按压该处，会有明显酸痛感。
location_en: Make a loose fist — the point is where your little fingertip touches your palm. Open your hand and press that spot, between the bones leading to your ring and little fingers. You'll feel a sharp, tender ache.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指指腹用力按压，做小圆圈揉按。手掌肉厚，可以稍微加力，以明显酸痛为度。也可以握一个网球，利用球的压力刺激这个位置。
massage_en: Press firmly with the opposite thumb pad and make small circles. The palm can handle stronger pressure — press until you feel a clear, deep ache. Alternatively, squeeze a tennis ball to stimulate this point naturally.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，心慌时随时可按。
routine_en: Massage 2-3 minutes per hand, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime you feel your heart flutter.
when_zh: 心跳加速感到不安、手掌莫名发烫、小指弯不直或发麻、胸口闷闷的透不过气。
when_en: When your heart races and you feel uneasy, when your palms are inexplicably hot, when your little finger feels numb or stiff, or when your chest feels stuffy and tight.
tips_zh: 左右手都按效果更好。按完少府后再按劳宫（手掌正中央，握拳中指尖处），两个掌心穴位搭配能更好地放松心情。
tips_en: Press both hands for best results. Follow with Laogong (PC8, center of the palm where the middle finger touches when you make a fist). This pair of palm points works well together for relaxation.
caution_zh: 手掌有伤口或皮肤病时不要按。按压力度虽可稍大，但不要引起剧痛。
caution_en: Avoid if you have wounds or skin conditions on the palm. Firm pressure is fine here, but stop if it causes sharp pain.

summary_zh: 急救提神的指尖穴，帮助快速清醒头脑。
summary_en: A fingertip revival point that quickly clears the mind and sharpens focus.
location_zh: 小指指甲根部靠无名指那一侧，指甲角旁边约1毫米处。用另一只手捏住小指甲根部两侧，靠内侧（无名指侧）的那个点就是。捏紧会有刺痛感。
location_en: Look at your little fingernail. Find the base corner on the side closest to the ring finger, about 1mm from the nail edge. Pinch the base of the nail between your opposite thumb and index finger — the point is on the inner side. You'll feel a sharp sting.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指和食指捏住小指指甲根部，拇指在穴位上，用指甲尖端掐按。力度要有刺激感，掐按5秒松开，反复做。也可以快速反复掐按来提神。
massage_en: Pinch the base of your little fingernail between the opposite thumb and index finger, with your thumbnail on the point. Press firmly with your nail tip for 5 seconds, release, and repeat. For a quick wake-up, pinch rapidly several times in a row.
routine_zh: 每次掐按1分钟左右，需要提神时随时可用，不限次数。
routine_en: Pinch for about 1 minute. Use anytime you need to wake up — no limit on frequency.
when_zh: 犯困提不起精神、头脑昏沉注意力涣散、中暑或闷热环境中感觉快晕、考试或开会前需要清醒。
when_en: When drowsiness hits and you can't focus, when your mind feels foggy, when heat makes you feel faint, or when you need to sharpen up before an exam or meeting.
tips_zh: 双手小指都掐效果更好。配合中冲（中指指甲根部）一起掐按，提神醒脑效果更强。掐完后搓热双手盖住眼睛休息片刻。
tips_en: Pinch both little fingers for stronger effect. Combine with Zhongchong (PC9, base of the middle fingernail) for an even more powerful wake-up. Afterward, rub your palms together until warm and cup them over your closed eyes for a moment.
caution_zh: 掐按有刺痛感是正常的，但不要掐破皮肤。指甲周围有伤口时不要按。
caution_en: A sharp sting is normal when pinching, but do not break the skin. Avoid if you have wounds around the fingernail.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛、咽喉不适，也常用于帮助产后妈妈通乳。
summary_en: Eases headaches, sore throat, and supports breast milk flow for new mothers.
location_zh: 在小指指甲根部的外侧角旁。把手翻过来看小指，指甲底边和外侧边交汇的角落，往外约一粒米的距离。按压时会有明显刺痛感。
location_en: On your little finger, right next to the base corner of the nail on the outer side. Look at the spot where the bottom edge and outer edge of the nail meet, then move just a grain of rice outward. Press and you will feel a sharp sting.
massage_zh: 用另一只手的拇指指甲垂直掐按此穴，力度中等偏重，有刺痛感为宜。也可以用指甲尖反复点按，每次掐按3-5秒后松开。
massage_en: Use the thumbnail of your other hand to press firmly straight down on this point. Apply moderate-to-strong pressure until you feel a sharp sting. Press for 3-5 seconds, release, and repeat.
routine_zh: 每次掐按1-2分钟，每天2-3次，饭后1小时为宜。
routine_en: Press for 1-2 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily, ideally an hour after meals.
when_zh: 头痛发作时、咽喉肿痛时、哺乳期奶水不畅时、发烧初期。
when_en: When a headache hits, your throat is sore, you have trouble with breast milk flow, or you feel feverish.
tips_zh: 配合掐按对侧少商穴（拇指指甲旁），对缓解咽喉痛效果更好。掐按时慢慢深呼吸。
tips_en: Combine with pressing Shaoshang (LU11, beside the thumbnail on the opposite hand) for better sore throat relief. Breathe slowly and deeply while pressing.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。此穴刺激较强，不宜用力过猛导致指甲损伤。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Press firmly but do not damage the skin around the nail.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解头痛、眼睛不适和手指肿痛。
summary_en: Helps relieve headaches, eye discomfort, and swollen fingers.
location_zh: 半握拳，小指根部关节前方的横纹尽头，手掌侧面肤色深浅交界处的凹陷里。按下去会有酸胀感。
location_en: Make a loose fist. Find the crease at the base of your little finger on the outer edge of your hand, where darker palm skin meets lighter back-of-hand skin. Press into the small dip there and you will feel a dull ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按揉，做小圆圈动作，力度中等，以酸胀为度。也可以用拇指和食指捏住小指根部两侧来回揉捏。
massage_en: Use your thumb pad to press and make small circles on this point with moderate pressure. You can also pinch both sides of the little finger base between your thumb and index finger and knead gently.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，不拘时间。
routine_en: Massage for 2-3 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily, anytime.
when_zh: 眼睛干涩疲劳时、头痛偏一侧时、小指或手掌外侧胀痛时。
when_en: When your eyes feel tired and dry, you have a one-sided headache, or your little finger and outer hand feel swollen.
tips_zh: 配合按揉后溪穴（SI3），从前谷推向后溪，对缓解手部僵硬效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Houxi (SI3) by sliding your thumb from this point toward SI3 for better hand stiffness relief.
caution_zh: 局部有伤口或红肿时避免按压。力度不宜过大。
caution_en: Avoid if the area has wounds or is red and swollen. Do not press too hard.

summary_zh: 缓解脖子僵硬、腰背痛，久坐办公族的必备穴位。
summary_en: Relieves stiff neck and back pain — a must-know point for desk workers.
location_zh: 半握拳，手掌外侧小指根部关节后方会鼓起一个小肉包，肉包的尖端就是这个穴位，在掌纹尽头、肤色深浅交界处。按压有明显酸胀感。
location_en: Make a loose fist. Behind the little finger knuckle on the outer edge of your hand, a small bump pops up. The tip of that bump, where the palm crease ends and skin color changes, is the point. Press and feel a strong dull ache.
massage_zh: 把手掌外侧搁在桌子边缘，利用手的重量向下压这个穴位，前后滚动刺激。也可以用另一手拇指用力按揉，力度偏重，以酸胀感向手臂方向传导为佳。
massage_en: Rest the outer edge of your hand on a desk edge and let your hand's weight press this point. Roll your hand slightly forward and back. Or use the other thumb to press firmly — aim for a deep ache that travels up your arm.
routine_zh: 每次按压3-5分钟，每天2-3次，久坐每小时按一次最好。
routine_en: Press 3-5 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. If sitting long hours, press once every hour.
when_zh: 脖子僵硬转不动时、伏案太久腰背酸痛时、落枕时、偏头痛发作时。
when_en: When your neck is so stiff you cannot turn it, your back aches from sitting too long, you wake with a crick, or a headache starts.
tips_zh: 同时慢慢转动脖子，边按边转，效果加倍。配合列缺穴（LU7）一起按，对缓解颈椎不适更好。
tips_en: Slowly rotate your neck while pressing for better results. Combine with Lieque (LU7) on your wrist for stronger neck and spine relief.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。按压力度大时注意不要伤到手部皮肤。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. When pressing against a desk edge, do not scrape or bruise the skin.

summary_zh: 缓解手腕疼痛和僵硬，也有助于减轻黄疸和发热。
summary_en: Eases wrist pain and stiffness, and helps with jaundice and fever.
location_zh: 手掌朝下，沿小指一侧向手腕方向摸，在手腕前有一块突起的小骨头，骨头前方的凹陷处，肤色深浅交界的地方。按压会有酸胀感。
location_en: Palm down, slide your finger along the outer edge of your hand toward the wrist. Before the wrist, you will feel a bony bump. The dip just in front of that bump, where skin color changes, is the point. Press and you will feel an ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按压凹陷处，力度中等，做小幅度揉按动作。可以边按边轻轻转动手腕，帮助放松。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad into the dip with moderate force, making small kneading motions. Gently rotate your wrist while pressing to help loosen the joint.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，手腕不适时随时可按。
routine_en: Knead for 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime your wrist feels stiff.
when_zh: 手腕酸痛时、长时间用鼠标后手腕僵硬时、手指活动不灵活时。
when_en: When your wrist aches, feels stiff after long computer use, or your fingers feel clumsy.
tips_zh: 配合阳谷穴（SI5）一起按揉，从腕骨推向阳谷，可以更好地放松手腕。
tips_en: Combine with Yanggu (SI5) by sliding from this point toward SI5 for more thorough wrist relaxation.
caution_zh: 手腕受伤肿胀严重时不要揉按，应就医。
caution_en: If your wrist is badly swollen or injured, see a doctor instead of pressing.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛、头晕和耳鸣，也有助于减轻手腕疼痛。
summary_en: Eases headaches, dizziness, ringing in the ears, and wrist pain.
location_zh: 手腕外侧（小指一侧），手腕背面横纹处，能摸到一个圆圆的骨头突起，骨头突起和旁边小骨头之间的凹陷就是。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: On the outer side of your wrist (little-finger side), at the wrist crease on the back of the hand. Feel for the round bony bump, then find the dip between that bump and the smaller bone beside it. Press and you will feel a dull ache.
massage_zh: 用另一手拇指按入凹陷处，力度中等偏重，持续按压或做小圈揉动。按的时候可以缓慢屈伸手腕来加强刺激。
massage_en: Press your thumb firmly into the dip with moderate-to-strong pressure. Hold steady or make small circles. Slowly flex and extend your wrist while pressing to deepen the effect.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1-2次，头晕耳鸣时随时可按。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Use anytime dizziness or ear ringing occurs.
when_zh: 突然头晕时、耳朵嗡嗡响时、偏头痛时、手腕扭伤恢复期。
when_en: When you suddenly feel dizzy, have ringing in your ears, get a migraine, or are recovering from a wrist sprain.
tips_zh: 头晕耳鸣时配合按压翳风穴（TE17，耳朵后面的凹陷），效果更好。
tips_en: For dizziness or tinnitus, combine with Yifeng (TE17, the dip behind your earlobe) for better results.
caution_zh: 手腕急性扭伤肿胀期应冰敷为主，不宜重按。
caution_en: During acute wrist sprains with swelling, ice first. Do not press hard on a freshly injured wrist.

summary_zh: 专门缓解眼睛疲劳和视力模糊，也帮助放松肩颈腰背。
summary_en: Relieves eye fatigue and blurry vision, and loosens the shoulder, neck, and back.
location_zh: 手掌朝下平放，在手腕小指一侧能摸到一个骨头突起（尺骨小头）。手指按住骨头最高点，然后把手掌翻过来面对自己，手指会自然滑入一条骨缝里，那就是穴位。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: Palm face-down, feel the round bony bump on the little-finger side of your wrist. Put a finger on its highest point, then flip your palm to face your chest — your finger slips into a bone groove. That groove is the point. Press and feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 掌心朝向胸口，用另一手拇指按入骨缝凹陷中，力度中等，持续按压并做小幅度上下拨动。可以同时缓慢转头看远处。
massage_en: With your palm facing your chest, press your other thumb into the groove with moderate pressure. Hold and gently rock up and down within the groove. Slowly turn your head and gaze into the distance at the same time.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天2-3次，用眼过度后立即按。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, 2-3 times daily. Use right after prolonged screen time.
when_zh: 长时间看手机电脑后眼睛酸涩时、视线模糊时、肩颈酸痛时、老年人眼花时。
when_en: After staring at screens and your eyes feel dry, when vision blurs, when your neck and shoulders ache, or when age-related eyestrain kicks in.
tips_zh: 按完后闭目休息1分钟，配合做眼球转动操。和睛明穴（BL1，眼内角）搭配按揉效果更好。
tips_en: After pressing, close your eyes for one minute and roll your eyeballs in circles. Pair with Jingming (BL1, inner eye corner) for better eye relief.
caution_zh: 眼睛有炎症或术后恢复期，请先咨询医生。
caution_en: If you have an eye infection or are recovering from eye surgery, consult your doctor first.

summary_zh: 缓解脖子僵硬、头痛和手肘手臂酸痛。
summary_en: Relieves stiff neck, headaches, and soreness in the elbow and arm.
location_zh: 手腕背面横纹往手肘方向量5寸（大约7横指的距离），在前臂外侧、靠小指那条骨头旁边的肌肉缝里。按压有酸胀感并向手腕方向放射。
location_en: From the wrist crease on the back of your hand, measure about 7 finger-widths toward your elbow, on the outer forearm beside the bone on the little-finger side. Find the gap between the bone and the muscle. Press and you will feel an ache that shoots toward your wrist.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按压在骨头旁的肌肉沟里，力度中等偏重，做垂直于手臂方向的拨动或按揉。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad into the muscle groove beside the bone with firm pressure. Pluck across the muscle perpendicular to your arm, or knead in small circles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，肩颈不适时加按。
routine_en: Massage for 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Add a session when neck or shoulder tension flares.
when_zh: 脖子转不动时、前臂和手肘酸痛时、头痛伴肩膀紧张时。
when_en: When your neck will not turn freely, your forearm or elbow aches, or you have a headache with tight shoulders.
tips_zh: 配合后溪穴（SI3）一起按，先按后溪再按支正，顺着手臂方向推揉效果更佳。
tips_en: Combine with Houxi (SI3) — press SI3 first, then SI7, and slide your thumb along the arm between them for a flowing release.
caution_zh: 前臂有外伤或骨折恢复期，避免重按此区域。
caution_en: Avoid heavy pressure if your forearm has a wound or is recovering from a fracture.

summary_zh: 缓解肘关节疼痛、手臂麻木和颈项僵痛。
summary_en: Eases elbow pain, arm numbness, and stiff neck.
location_zh: 弯曲手肘，在肘尖（手肘最突出的骨头）和内侧骨头突起之间的凹陷里。就是俗称的"麻筋"附近。轻按就会有明显的酸麻感。
location_en: Bend your elbow. Find the dip between the elbow tip (the pointy bone) and the bony bump on the inner side — this is near your "funny bone" spot. Even light pressure produces a clear tingling ache.
massage_zh: 用另一手拇指轻轻按入凹陷处，力度宜轻到中等（此处敏感），做小幅度揉按。切勿猛力敲击，避免刺激到神经。
massage_en: Gently press your thumb into the dip with light-to-moderate pressure — this spot is sensitive. Make small kneading motions. Never tap or slam this area to avoid irritating the nerve.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，手臂酸麻时随时可按。
routine_en: Gently knead for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime your arm feels numb.
when_zh: 手肘痛、打字太久手臂发麻时、颈项僵硬带动手臂不适时。
when_en: When your elbow hurts, your arm goes numb from typing, or neck stiffness spreads discomfort down your arm.
tips_zh: 配合曲池穴（LI11，手肘弯曲横纹尽头）一起按揉，对手肘疼痛缓解更全面。
tips_en: Combine with Quchi (LI11, at the end of the elbow crease) for more complete elbow pain relief.
caution_zh: 此处靠近尺神经，手法务必轻柔，不可用力敲打。
caution_en: This point is near a major nerve. Always use gentle pressure — never strike or pound.

summary_zh: 缓解肩膀后侧疼痛和活动受限。
summary_en: Relieves pain and limited movement in the back of the shoulder.
location_zh: 手臂自然下垂，腋窝后面那条横纹的尽头，往上量一横指的位置。就在肩膀后下方。按压有酸胀感并向肩膀方向放射。
location_en: Let your arm hang naturally. Find the end of the crease at the back of your armpit, then move one finger-width straight up. It is at the lower back of your shoulder. Press and you will feel an ache radiating into the shoulder.
massage_zh: 用对侧手绕过胸前，用中指或食指按压此穴，力度中等，做按揉或持续按压。也可以请人帮忙用拇指按压。
massage_en: Reach across your chest with the opposite hand and press this point with your middle finger, using moderate pressure. Knead or hold steady. You can also ask someone to press with their thumb.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1-2次，肩痛发作时可加按。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Add extra sessions when shoulder pain flares.
when_zh: 肩膀后侧疼痛时、手臂往后伸够不到时、提重物后肩膀酸痛时。
when_en: When the back of your shoulder hurts, you cannot reach behind you, or your shoulder aches after carrying heavy bags.
tips_zh: 按压同时缓慢转动手臂画圈，帮助肩关节活动。配合天宗穴（SI11）效果更好。
tips_en: Slowly rotate your arm in circles while pressing to mobilize the shoulder. Combine with Tianzong (SI11) for better results.
caution_zh: 肩关节脱臼或严重损伤时禁止按揉，应立即就医。
caution_en: Do not massage if your shoulder is dislocated or severely injured. Seek medical help immediately.

summary_zh: 缓解肩膀后上方疼痛和上臂活动不利。
summary_en: Relieves pain in the upper back of the shoulder and restricted arm movement.
location_zh: 手臂自然下垂，腋窝后横纹的尽头直直往上，摸到肩胛骨上面那条横着的骨嵴（肩胛冈），骨嵴下边缘的凹陷就是。按压有深层酸胀感。
location_en: Let your arm hang. From the end of the back armpit crease, go straight up until you feel the bony ridge running across the top of your shoulder blade. The dip just below that ridge is the point. Press and you will feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的中指或食指按压凹陷处，力度中等偏重。也可以靠在墙角，用墙角的棱顶住穴位，身体前后小幅度移动来按摩。
massage_en: Press with the middle finger of your opposite hand, using firm pressure. Or stand with this point against a wall corner and shift your body slightly to let the corner dig in and massage the spot.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1-2次，肩背酸痛时可多按。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Increase frequency when shoulder or upper back soreness hits.
when_zh: 肩膀后上方持续酸痛时、手臂抬不起来时、背部上方僵硬时。
when_en: When the upper back of your shoulder won't stop aching, you can't lift your arm well, or your upper back feels locked up.
tips_zh: 和肩贞穴（SI9）、天宗穴（SI11）三个穴一起按，沿肩胛骨从下往上顺序按效果最佳。
tips_en: Press together with Jianzhen (SI9) and Tianzong (SI11), working from bottom to top along the shoulder blade for the best release.
caution_zh: 肩胛部位有骨折或严重炎症时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid pressing if you have a fracture or severe inflammation in the shoulder blade area.

summary_zh: 肩胛骨区域酸痛的首选穴位，也有助于缓解胸闷。
summary_en: The go-to point for shoulder blade soreness, also helps ease chest tightness.
location_zh: 在肩胛骨的正中央偏下。摸到肩胛骨上面那条横骨嵴，从中点往下约一掌距离，肩胛骨的中心凹陷处。用力按压会有非常明显的酸痛感，很容易找到。
location_en: In the center of your shoulder blade, slightly below middle. Find the bony ridge on top of the blade, go down about a palm-width from its midpoint. Press hard and you will feel an obvious deep ache — very easy to find.
massage_zh: 可以用网球或按摩球放在地上或靠墙，把穴位顶在球上，利用身体重量来按压滚动。也可以请人用拇指用力按揉，力度要偏重，酸痛感明显为佳。
massage_en: Place a tennis ball on the floor or against a wall, position this point on the ball, and use your body weight to press and roll. Or ask someone to press firmly with their thumb. Use strong pressure — a deep ache means you found it.
routine_zh: 每次按压3-5分钟，每天1-2次，久坐后及睡前按最好。
routine_en: Press for 3-5 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Best after long sitting and before bed.
when_zh: 肩胛骨内侧酸痛时、背部僵硬时、胸闷气短时、伏案工作肩背紧绷时。
when_en: When your shoulder blade area aches, your back is stiff, your chest feels tight, or desk work leaves your upper back tense.
tips_zh: 配合秉风穴（SI12，肩胛骨上方）一起按揉效果更好。按完后做几次扩胸运动，伸展背部。
tips_en: Combine with Bingfeng (SI12, above the shoulder blade ridge) for fuller relief. Follow up with a few chest-opening stretches to loosen your back.
caution_zh: 自己不容易按到，用按摩球时注意不要滚到脊椎上。
caution_en: Hard to reach on your own. When using a massage ball, keep it on the shoulder blade — do not roll it onto your spine.

summary_zh: 缓解肩膀上方疼痛和上肢酸麻无力。
summary_en: Eases pain on top of the shoulder and numbness or weakness in the arms.
location_zh: 先找到天宗穴（肩胛骨中央），从天宗直直往上，越过肩胛骨上那条横骨嵴，在骨嵴上方凹窝的正中间。按压有酸胀感向肩膀方向扩散。
location_en: Start at Tianzong (center of shoulder blade), go straight up and over the bony ridge on top of your shoulder blade. The point is in the center of the dip just above that ridge. Press and you will feel an ache spreading toward your shoulder.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的中指按压凹窝中央，力度中等偏重，持续按压或做小圈揉按。也可以用按摩球靠墙来压。
massage_en: Press into the center of the dip with your opposite middle finger, using firm pressure. Hold steady or make small circles. A massage ball against a wall also works well.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1-2次，肩痛严重时可加至3次。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Up to 3 times when shoulder pain is intense.
when_zh: 肩膀上方酸痛时、手臂发麻抬举困难时、提重物后肩部不适时。
when_en: When the top of your shoulder aches, your arm feels numb or heavy to lift, or your shoulder hurts after carrying loads.
tips_zh: 从天宗穴向上推揉到秉风穴，再到肩井穴（GB21），三穴连按放松整个肩背。
tips_en: Slide your pressure from Tianzong (SI11) up through this point to Jianjing (GB21) — three points in a line to release the entire upper back and shoulder.
caution_zh: 肩部急性损伤期先冰敷处理，不要用力揉按。
caution_en: For acute shoulder injuries, apply ice first. Do not massage forcefully.

summary_zh: 缓解肩胛骨内上方的深层酸痛和紧张。
summary_en: Eases deep aching and tension in the upper inner shoulder blade area.
location_zh: 在肩胛骨上那条横骨嵴的内侧端，骨嵴上边缘的凹陷里。大约在脖子后面大骨头（大椎）和肩膀尖端连线的中点附近。按压有深层酸痛感。
location_en: At the inner end of the bony ridge on top of your shoulder blade, in the dip above its edge. It is roughly midway between the big bump at the back of your neck and the tip of your shoulder. Press and you will feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的食指或中指向下按入凹陷，力度中等偏重。也可以用按摩球靠墙，将球定位在肩胛骨内上角处滚压。
massage_en: Press down into the dip with your opposite index or middle finger, using firm pressure. Or use a massage ball against a wall, positioning it at the inner upper corner of your shoulder blade.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1-2次，肩背紧时多按。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press more often when your upper back feels tight.
when_zh: 上背部靠近脊柱一侧持续酸痛时、长时间抬头或低头工作后。
when_en: When the area near your spine at the upper back keeps aching, or after prolonged looking up or down at work.
tips_zh: 和天宗穴（SI11）、秉风穴（SI12）组合按揉，配合深呼吸，全面放松肩胛区。
tips_en: Combine with Tianzong (SI11) and Bingfeng (SI12), breathing deeply throughout, for a full shoulder blade release.
caution_zh: 按压方向应向外向下，避免向胸腔方向深压。
caution_en: Press outward and downward. Do not push deeply inward toward the chest cavity.

summary_zh: 缓解肩背部和颈部的僵硬疼痛。
summary_en: Relieves stiffness and pain in the shoulder, upper back, and neck.
location_zh: 低头时脖子后面最突出的骨头是大椎，大椎下面一节骨头的旁边，向两侧量四横指（约3寸）的地方，大约在肩胛骨内侧缘。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: Bow your head and feel the big bump at the back of your neck (Dazhui). Go one vertebra below it, then measure four finger-widths to the side — you will land near the inner edge of your shoulder blade. Press and you will feel an ache.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的中指按压，力度中等。也可以用两个网球放在袜子里，躺在地上，让两个球分别顶住两侧穴位，利用体重滚压。
massage_en: Press with your opposite middle finger, moderate pressure. Or put two tennis balls in a sock, lie on them so each ball sits on each side of this point, and gently rock your body to roll and press.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1-2次，颈肩僵硬时随时可按。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Use anytime your neck and shoulders feel stiff.
when_zh: 肩背疼痛发硬时、脖子僵硬转动困难时、长时间背包后肩膀酸痛时。
when_en: When your upper back is sore and rigid, your neck is hard to turn, or your shoulders ache after carrying a backpack.
tips_zh: 配合肩中俞（SI15）一起按揉，两穴相距不远，可以用拇指和中指同时按压。
tips_en: Press together with Jianzhongshu (SI15) — the two points are close, so you can press both with your thumb and middle finger at the same time.
caution_zh: 此处不宜向胸腔方向深压，轻柔按揉即可。
caution_en: Do not press deeply inward toward the chest. Keep your pressure gentle and directed outward.

summary_zh: 缓解肩背酸痛，也有助于改善咳嗽和气喘。
summary_en: Eases shoulder and back soreness, and helps with coughing and shortness of breath.
location_zh: 低头时脖子后面最突出的骨头（大椎），在它旁边向两侧量两横指（约2寸）的地方。按压有酸胀感，深按可能引起肩背部酸麻。
location_en: Bow your head and find the biggest bump at the back of your neck (Dazhui). Measure two finger-widths to the side. Press and you will feel an ache; deeper pressure may cause a spreading tingle across your upper back.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的食指和中指并拢按压，力度中等，做上下方向的揉按。也可以把按摩球放在靠椅和后背之间来压。
massage_en: Press with your opposite index and middle fingers together, using moderate pressure, and knead up and down. You can also place a massage ball between your back and a chair to press the point.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，晨起或睡前按最佳。
routine_en: Knead for 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Best in the morning or before bed.
when_zh: 肩膀酸痛僵硬时、咳嗽伴背部紧绷时、久坐办公后上背不适时。
when_en: When your shoulders are sore and stiff, coughing makes your back tight, or your upper back hurts after desk work.
tips_zh: 咳嗽时配合按揉定喘穴（大椎旁开0.5寸）和肺俞穴（BL13），三穴联合使用。
tips_en: For coughs, combine with Dingchuan (half a finger-width beside Dazhui) and Feishu (BL13) for a three-point relief approach.
caution_zh: 此处不宜深压，轻中力度即可，避免向胸腔方向按。
caution_en: Use light-to-moderate pressure only. Do not press deeply toward the chest.

summary_zh: 缓解耳鸣、耳聋、咽喉疼痛和颈部僵硬。
summary_en: Eases ear ringing, hearing loss, sore throat, and stiff neck.
location_zh: 在脖子侧面，与喉结（男性明显的喉部突起）同一高度，脖子侧面那条大肌肉（转头时会鼓起来的肌肉）的后边缘。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On the side of your neck, level with your Adam's apple. Turn your head slightly and feel the big muscle that pops up on the side of your neck — the point is at its back edge. Press and you will feel a dull ache.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢轻轻按压，力度宜轻，做小圈揉按。颈部血管丰富，切勿用力掐捏或猛力按压。
massage_en: Press gently with your index and middle fingers together, making small circles. Use light pressure only. The neck has many blood vessels — never squeeze or press hard.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1-2分钟，每天1次，耳鸣时可加按一次。
routine_en: Gently knead for 1-2 minutes, once daily. Add one session when ear ringing occurs.
when_zh: 耳鸣持续时、嗓子又肿又痛时、脖子一侧僵硬时、突然声音嘶哑时。
when_en: When ear ringing persists, your throat is swollen and sore, one side of your neck is stiff, or you suddenly lose your voice.
tips_zh: 配合翳风穴（TE17，耳垂后凹陷）一起轻揉，对耳鸣和听力下降帮助更大。
tips_en: Combine with gentle pressing on Yifeng (TE17, behind the earlobe) for greater help with tinnitus and hearing issues.
caution_zh: 颈部操作必须轻柔，严禁重力按压或拍打。有颈部血管疾病者禁用。
caution_en: Always be very gentle on the neck. Never press hard or tap. Avoid entirely if you have carotid artery disease.

summary_zh: 缓解咽喉肿痛、耳鸣和颈部不适。
summary_en: Relieves sore throat, ear ringing, and neck discomfort.
location_zh: 在下巴角（下颌骨的拐角处）的后方，脖子侧面大肌肉的前边缘凹陷里。张嘴时能感觉到下巴角后方有个凹陷，按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Behind the angle of your jawbone, in the dip at the front edge of the big neck muscle. Open your mouth and feel for a hollow behind the jaw angle. Press and you will feel a dull ache.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指轻轻按入凹陷中，力度要轻，做小幅度按揉。可以边按边慢慢张嘴闭嘴，增强感觉。
massage_en: Gently press your index or middle finger into the hollow with light pressure, making small kneading motions. Slowly open and close your mouth while pressing to enhance the sensation.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1-2分钟，每天1次，咽喉痛时可加按。
routine_en: Gently knead for 1-2 minutes, once daily. Add a session when your throat hurts.
when_zh: 嗓子疼吞口水都痛时、耳朵嗡嗡响时、脖子侧面肿胀不适时。
when_en: When swallowing hurts, your ears ring, or the side of your neck feels swollen and uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 配合少泽穴（SI1）掐按，一上一下搭配，对咽喉肿痛效果更好。多喝温水配合。
tips_en: Combine with pinching Shaoze (SI1) — one point high, one low — for better sore throat relief. Drink warm water as well.
caution_zh: 颈部操作务必轻柔，不可重按。有颈部肿块者应先就医检查。
caution_en: Always use gentle pressure on the neck. If you have a lump in your neck, see a doctor before pressing.

summary_zh: 缓解面部疼痛、牙痛和面部肌肉抽搐。
summary_en: Relieves facial pain, toothache, and facial muscle twitching.
location_zh: 在颧骨（面颊最高的骨头）的下边缘，与眼睛外角垂直向下的交叉点，能摸到一个小凹陷。按压有酸胀感并可能放射到牙齿或眼周。
location_en: Below your cheekbone, directly under the outer corner of your eye. Feel along the bottom edge of the cheekbone for a small dip. Press and you will feel an ache that may spread to your teeth or around your eye.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹按压凹陷处，力度中等，做小圈揉按或持续按压。脸部皮肤薄，不必用太大力。
massage_en: Press into the dip with your index or middle finger pad, moderate pressure, making small circles or holding steady. Facial skin is thin, so moderate force is enough.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，面痛发作时可立即按。
routine_en: Massage for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press right away when facial pain strikes.
when_zh: 面部一侧疼痛时、牙疼放射到面颊时、眼皮不停跳动时、面部肌肉僵硬时。
when_en: When one side of your face hurts, a toothache radiates to your cheek, your eyelid twitches nonstop, or your facial muscles feel stiff.
tips_zh: 配合合谷穴（LI4，虎口）一起按揉，对面部疼痛和牙痛效果加倍。
tips_en: Combine with Hegu (LI4, in the web between thumb and index finger) for doubled effect on facial pain and toothache.
caution_zh: 面部有伤口、感染或皮肤病时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid pressing if you have facial wounds, infections, or skin conditions.

summary_zh: 缓解耳鸣、听力下降和耳朵闷堵感。
summary_en: Eases ear ringing, hearing decline, and the feeling of blocked ears.
location_zh: 在耳朵前面，张开嘴时耳朵前方会出现一个凹陷，就在耳屏（耳朵前面那个小突起）的正中前方。张嘴按压更容易找到，按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: In front of your ear. Open your mouth and a dip appears just in front of the small flap (tragus) at the front of your ear. The point is right at the center of that dip. Press with your mouth open and you will feel an ache.
massage_zh: 微微张嘴，用食指指腹按压凹陷处，力度轻到中等，做小圈揉按或轻轻按压松开反复操作。可以同时按压双侧。
massage_en: Open your mouth slightly, press your index finger pad into the dip with light-to-moderate pressure, and make small circles or repeatedly press and release. You can press both sides at the same time.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天2次，早晚各一次效果最好。
routine_en: Massage for 2-3 minutes, twice daily — once in the morning and once at night works best.
when_zh: 耳鸣持续时、坐飞机后耳朵闷堵时、听力感觉下降时、牙痛连带耳朵不舒服时。
when_en: When ear ringing persists, your ears feel clogged after a flight, you notice hearing decline, or a toothache makes your ear uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 配合翳风穴（TE17）和听会穴（GB2）三穴一起按揉，围绕耳朵前后形成完整的耳部保健。按完后用手掌捂住耳朵，快速松开，重复几次。
tips_en: Combine with Yifeng (TE17) and Tinghui (GB2) — three points around the ear for complete ear care. After pressing, cup your palms over both ears and quickly release several times.
caution_zh: 耳朵有炎症流脓时不要按压，应就医治疗。按压力度务必轻柔。
caution_en: Do not press if your ear is infected or draining fluid — see a doctor. Always keep pressure gentle.

summary_zh: 缓解眼疲劳和干涩，帮助放松眼周肌肉。
summary_en: Relieves tired, dry eyes and relaxes the muscles around them.
location_zh: 闭上眼睛，在内眼角稍偏上方，鼻梁和眼眶之间有个小凹陷，轻轻一按就能感觉到酸胀。
location_en: Close your eyes. Feel for the small dip between the inner corner of your eye and the bridge of your nose, slightly above the tear duct. A gentle press will produce a distinct ache.
massage_zh: 闭眼后用双手拇指指腹轻轻按住凹陷处，缓慢向鼻梁方向按压，力度一定要轻柔。按住不动5秒再松开，反复进行。
massage_en: Close your eyes. Place both thumbs gently on the points and press slowly inward toward the bridge of your nose. Hold for 5 seconds, release, and repeat. Keep the pressure very light.
routine_zh: 每次轻按1分钟，每天2-3次，用眼过度时随时可按。
routine_en: Gently press for 1 minute, 2-3 times daily. Use anytime your eyes feel strained.
when_zh: 长时间看屏幕后眼睛酸涩时；早晨起来眼睛浮肿时；迎风流泪不舒服时。
when_en: After long screen time when eyes feel dry and tired. When you wake with puffy eyes. When wind makes your eyes water.
tips_zh: 按压时配合闭目养神，按完后慢慢睁眼远眺窗外。可以先搓热双手再按，感觉更舒服。
tips_en: Keep your eyes closed and rest while pressing. Afterward, slowly open your eyes and gaze into the distance. Warming your hands first makes it more soothing.
caution_zh: 此处非常靠近眼球，只能用指腹轻按，绝不能用力或用指甲。眼部有感染时禁用。
caution_en: This point is very close to your eyeball. Use only your fingertip pad with gentle pressure — never your nail. Skip if you have an eye infection.

summary_zh: 缓解眉棱骨胀痛和前额头痛，放松眼周。
summary_en: Eases brow-bone pressure, forehead headaches, and eye tension.
location_zh: 在眉毛内侧的起点处，皱眉时眉头隆起的地方，用手指沿眼眶上缘向内摸会碰到一个小凹陷。按下去酸胀感很明显。
location_en: At the inner tip of your eyebrow. Frown slightly and feel the bump where your brow begins. Trace the upper rim of the eye socket inward to a small notch. Press and you'll feel a strong ache.
massage_zh: 用双手拇指指腹同时按住两侧眉头凹陷处，用力适中，缓慢揉按画小圈。也可以用拇指和食指捏住眉头，轻轻提捏几次。
massage_en: Use both thumbs to press the inner brow dips simultaneously. Make slow, small circles with moderate pressure. You can also pinch each brow head between thumb and index finger and squeeze gently a few times.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天2-3次，头痛时可随时按。
routine_en: Press for 1-2 minutes, 2-3 times daily. Use anytime a headache starts.
when_zh: 前额头痛、眉骨周围胀痛时；用眼过度额头发紧时；鼻塞额头沉重时。
when_en: When you have a forehead headache or brow-bone pressure. When your forehead feels tight from eye strain. When a stuffy nose makes your forehead heavy.
tips_zh: 按完攒竹后，沿眉毛从内向外刮按一遍，整条眉毛都放松了。配合太阳穴一起按效果更好。
tips_en: After pressing, sweep your thumbs along the brow from inner to outer end to relax the whole area. Pair with your temples for stronger headache relief.
caution_zh: 力度不可太重，此处皮肤薄，用力过猛容易瘀青。眼部有红肿时避开。
caution_en: The skin here is thin — use moderate pressure to avoid bruising. Avoid if the area is red or swollen.

summary_zh: 缓解前额头痛和头顶发紧的感觉。
summary_en: Eases forehead headaches and that tight feeling on top of your head.
location_zh: 从攒竹穴（眉头）直直往上，进入发际线约半个拇指宽的地方。用指腹按压会有酸胀感。
location_en: Go straight up from the inner brow tip into the hairline, about half a thumb-width past where hair begins. Press with your fingertip and feel a dull ache.
massage_zh: 用双手中指指腹同时按住两侧穴位，缓慢用力按压后保持3-5秒，松开再按，反复进行。也可以小幅度画圈揉按。
massage_en: Use both middle fingers to press the points simultaneously. Hold firm pressure for 3-5 seconds, release, and repeat. You can also make small circles while pressing.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，头痛发作时可加按。
routine_en: Press for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Add extra sessions when headaches flare.
when_zh: 头痛从额头蔓延到头顶时；头顶发紧像戴了紧箍咒时；鼻塞头昏时。
when_en: When a headache spreads from forehead to crown. When your head feels like it's in a vice. When congestion makes you dizzy.
tips_zh: 按此穴时配合深呼吸，吸气按压，呼气松开。可以和攒竹穴一起从下往上依次按。
tips_en: Sync with breathing — press on inhale, release on exhale. Work upward from BL2 (Cuanzhu) to this point in sequence for better results.
caution_zh: 力度不要过重，发际线附近皮肤较敏感。头部有伤口时避免按压。
caution_en: Use gentle to moderate pressure — the hairline area is sensitive. Avoid if there are wounds on the scalp.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解前额头痛和鼻塞不通。
summary_en: Helps relieve forehead headaches and nasal congestion.
location_zh: 从前额正中发际线往上半个拇指宽，再向外侧（眼睛方向）量约两横指的位置。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Half a thumb-width above the center of your front hairline, then about two finger-widths to the side. Press in and you'll feel a dull ache beneath your fingertip.
massage_zh: 用双手食指或中指同时按住两侧穴位，稍用力按压后小幅度揉动，力度适中。也可以用指腹从中间向两侧推按。
massage_en: Press both sides simultaneously with your index or middle fingers. Apply moderate pressure with small circular motions. You can also sweep outward from the center hairline toward the points.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，鼻塞头痛时增加次数。
routine_en: Press for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Increase frequency during colds.
when_zh: 前额头痛伴鼻塞时；感冒初期鼻子不通气时；头晕不清爽时。
when_en: When you have a forehead headache with congestion. During early cold symptoms with a blocked nose. When your head feels foggy.
tips_zh: 配合按揉迎香穴（鼻翼两侧），通鼻效果更快。按前用热毛巾敷额头1分钟，效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with pressing beside your nostrils (LI20 Yingxiang) for faster congestion relief. A warm towel on the forehead for a minute beforehand enhances the effect.
caution_zh: 力度不宜过大，头部穴位宜轻柔。前额有痤疮或皮肤破损时避开。
caution_en: Keep the pressure gentle — head points respond well to a lighter touch. Avoid if you have acne or broken skin on the forehead.

summary_zh: 缓解头顶痛和头晕，帮助清醒提神。
summary_en: Eases headaches at the top of the head and helps clear dizziness.
location_zh: 从前额正中发际线往上约一个拇指宽，再向外侧量约两横指。在头顶前部，按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: About one thumb-width above your front hairline center, then two finger-widths to the side. It sits on the front of your scalp. Press and feel a tender ache.
massage_zh: 用双手中指指腹同时按住两侧穴位，做节律性按压，按3秒松2秒。也可以用五指分开像梳头一样从前向后反复梳按此区域。
massage_en: Press both sides with your middle fingers. Push down for 3 seconds, release for 2, and repeat rhythmically. You can also spread your fingers and comb through this area from front to back like scratching your scalp.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，午后困倦时加按一次。
routine_en: Press for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Add a session in the afternoon if you feel drowsy.
when_zh: 头顶闷痛、昏沉犯困时；注意力不集中时；头晕不舒服时。
when_en: When the top of your head aches dully. When you can't focus. When dizziness makes you uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 可以用木梳代替手指，沿头部正中两侧从前向后梳按，覆盖面更广。
tips_en: Use a wooden comb instead of fingers — comb from front to back on both sides of the midline for broader coverage.
caution_zh: 力度要轻，头皮薄处不宜过度用力。头部有伤口时不可按压。
caution_en: Use light pressure on the scalp. Do not press on any wounds or sore spots.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解偏头痛和视力模糊的不适感。
summary_en: Helps relieve migraines and blurry-vision discomfort.
location_zh: 从前额发际线正中直上约三横指，再向外侧量两横指的位置，在头顶偏前的区域。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: About three finger-widths above the center hairline, then two finger-widths to the side. It's on the front-top area of your scalp. Press and feel an ache.
massage_zh: 用双手中指指腹按住两侧穴位，缓慢揉按画小圈，力度轻到中等。也可以用指尖轻轻叩击此区域，像敲小鼓一样。
massage_en: Use both middle fingers to press and rub in small circles with light to moderate pressure. Or lightly tap the area with your fingertips in a gentle drumming motion.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: Press for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 偏头痛发作时；看东西模糊、眼花时；鼻塞伴头顶沉重时。
when_en: During a migraine. When your vision feels blurry or unfocused. When congestion makes your head feel heavy.
tips_zh: 配合太阳穴和攒竹穴一起按揉，从前向后依次按，疏通整个头部会更舒服。
tips_en: Combine with temples and BL2 (Cuanzhu). Work front to back across the head for a more thorough tension release.
caution_zh: 头皮敏感处轻按即可。头部外伤或手术后避免按压。
caution_en: Press gently on sensitive scalp areas. Avoid after head injuries or surgery.

summary_zh: 对鼻塞特别有帮助，也能缓解头痛头晕。
summary_en: Especially helpful for stuffy nose, also eases headaches and dizziness.
location_zh: 从前额发际线正中直上约五横指，再向外侧量两横指，在头顶稍偏后的位置。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: About five finger-widths above the center hairline, then two finger-widths to the side. It sits on the top of your head, slightly behind center. Press to feel a tender ache.
massage_zh: 用双手中指指腹同时按住两侧穴位，做持续按压或小幅度揉圈。力度中等，以感到酸胀为度。也可以用指关节轻叩此处。
massage_en: Press both sides simultaneously with your middle fingers. Hold steady pressure or make small circles. Use moderate force — a dull ache is the right feeling. You can also tap gently with your knuckles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天2-3次，鼻塞时可随时加按。
routine_en: Press for 1-2 minutes, 2-3 times daily. Press extra whenever congestion bothers you.
when_zh: 鼻塞不通气时；感冒流鼻涕时；头顶痛伴头晕时。
when_en: When your nose is completely blocked. During a cold with a runny nose. When a headache at the crown comes with dizziness.
tips_zh: 鼻塞时配合按迎香穴（鼻翼两侧）和印堂穴（两眉中间），三穴一起按通鼻效果最佳。
tips_en: For congestion, combine with LI20 (Yingxiang, beside the nostrils) and Yintang (between the brows). These three together work best for clearing the nose.
caution_zh: 力度适中即可，头顶穴位不可过度重按。
caution_en: Use moderate pressure only — avoid pressing too hard on top of the head.

summary_zh: 缓解头晕目眩和耳鸣不适。
summary_en: Eases dizziness, vertigo, and ringing in the ears.
location_zh: 从前额发际线正中直上约七横指，再向外侧量两横指。在头顶偏后方，按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: About seven finger-widths above the center hairline, then two finger-widths to the side, on the rear portion of your scalp. Press to find a tender spot.
massage_zh: 用双手中指指腹按住两侧穴位，做缓慢的揉按动作，力度轻柔。可以双手十指张开，像洗头一样揉按整个头顶后部区域。
massage_en: Press both sides with your middle fingers and rub slowly with gentle pressure. Or spread all ten fingers and massage the entire back-crown area as if shampooing your hair.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，头晕时随时可按。
routine_en: Press for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime dizziness strikes.
when_zh: 起身时突然头晕时；耳鸣嗡嗡响时；鼻塞伴头昏时。
when_en: When you feel dizzy standing up. When your ears buzz or ring. When congestion makes your head feel foggy.
tips_zh: 按揉时闭上眼睛，慢慢深呼吸，有助于缓解眩晕感。配合按风池穴（后脑勺下方）效果更好。
tips_en: Close your eyes and breathe deeply while pressing to ease vertigo. Pair with Fengchi (GB20, at the base of your skull) for stronger relief.
caution_zh: 头晕严重时先坐稳或躺下再按压，不要站着按以免摔倒。
caution_en: If you are very dizzy, sit or lie down first before pressing. Do not stand while treating severe vertigo.

summary_zh: 缓解后脑勺疼痛和颈部僵硬不适。
summary_en: Relieves pain at the back of the head and stiff neck discomfort.
location_zh: 后脑勺最突出的那块骨头（枕骨隆凸）上缘，从正中线向外侧摸约两横指的位置，有一个浅凹陷。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Feel the bony bump at the back of your skull. Move to its upper edge, then slide about two finger-widths to the side. You'll find a shallow dip. Press and feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用双手拇指按住两侧穴位，其余手指抱住头部固定。拇指缓慢用力向内按压并揉动，力度中等偏重。也可以仰躺用后脑勺压在叠好的毛巾上刺激此穴。
massage_en: Cup the back of your head with both hands, thumbs on the points. Press inward with moderate-to-firm pressure and make small circles. Or lie face up and rest the back of your head on a rolled towel placed at this spot.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，起床后颈部僵硬时效果好。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Especially helpful in the morning for a stiff neck.
when_zh: 后脑勺闷痛时；落枕脖子发僵时；看东西模糊伴头痛时。
when_en: When the back of your head aches. When you wake with a stiff neck. When headache comes with blurry vision.
tips_zh: 按揉时慢慢转动脖子，边按边活动更容易松开。配合风池穴（下方凹陷处）一起按效果翻倍。
tips_en: Slowly turn your neck side to side while pressing for faster loosening. Pair with Fengchi (GB20, in the hollow below) for double the effect.
caution_zh: 后脑部位皮肤薄，不要用指甲掐按。颈部有严重疾病者请先就医。
caution_en: The skin here is thin — use your fingertip pad, not nails. See a doctor first if you have a serious neck condition.

summary_zh: 缓解脖子僵硬和后脑勺头痛，颈椎不适的要穴。
summary_en: A key point for stiff neck, back-of-head headaches, and cervical discomfort.
location_zh: 低头时后脑勺下方发际线处，沿正中线向两侧摸约两横指，摸到一根大筋（斜方肌）的外缘凹陷处。按下去酸胀感很强。
