location_en: Lower your chin. At the base of your skull where the hairline starts, feel about two finger-widths out from the midline. Find the hollow at the outer edge of the thick neck muscle. Press for a strong deep ache.
massage_zh: 用双手拇指按住两侧穴位，其余手指托住头部。拇指向上方用力按压，做小幅度揉圈，力度中等偏重。按住不动保持10秒再松开也很有效。
massage_en: Cup your head with both hands, thumbs at the points. Press firmly upward toward the skull and make small circles. Or hold steady deep pressure for 10 seconds, release, and repeat.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天2次，久坐伏案后随时可按。
routine_en: Press 2-3 minutes per session, twice daily. Use anytime after long desk work.
when_zh: 脖子僵硬转不动时；伏案太久后脑勺闷痛时；落枕早上起不来时。
when_en: When your neck is so stiff you can barely turn it. After hours at a desk when the back of your head aches. When you wake with a crick in your neck.
tips_zh: 按完后慢慢做颈部前后左右活动，有助于恢复灵活性。配合风池穴（旁边的凹陷）一起按更舒服。
tips_en: After pressing, gently tilt and rotate your neck in all directions to restore mobility. Combine with Fengchi (GB20, nearby) for greater relief.
caution_zh: 只按肌肉外缘，不要向内深压靠近脊柱的区域。颈椎病严重者请就医。
caution_en: Press the muscle edge only — do not push deeply inward toward the spine. See a doctor for serious cervical spine issues.

summary_zh: 缓解上背部和颈肩交界处的僵硬酸痛。
summary_en: Eases stiffness and soreness where your neck meets your upper back.
location_zh: 低头时脖子后面最突出的骨头是第七颈椎，从它往下摸一节脊椎骨，再向两侧量约两横指的位置。这里在上背部，自己按比较费劲。
location_en: Bow your head and find the most prominent bone at the base of your neck. Go one vertebra down, then two finger-widths to the side. This spot sits on the upper back and is hard to reach alone.
massage_zh: 把网球放在地上，仰躺让穴位压在球上，利用身体重量滚压。也可以请家人用拇指按揉，力度中等偏重。自己够不到时，靠墙夹网球也可以。
massage_en: Lie on your back with a tennis ball under this point and let your body weight do the work — roll gently side to side. Or lean against a wall with the ball at this spot. A partner can also press with their thumb using firm pressure.
routine_zh: 每次滚压或按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，肩颈酸痛时加做一次。
routine_en: Roll or press for 2-3 minutes, once daily. Add a session when shoulders and neck ache.
when_zh: 上背部发僵、脖子和肩膀交界处酸痛时；感冒咳嗽伴背部不适时；长期伏案肩背紧绷时。
when_en: When your upper back stiffens up. When a cold brings coughing with back discomfort. When desk work leaves your shoulders and back tight.
tips_zh: 用网球滚压时可以双手抱胸，这样肩胛骨打开，球更容易压到穴位。滚压后做扩胸伸展更舒服。
tips_en: Cross your arms over your chest while using the tennis ball — this opens the shoulder blades and helps the ball hit the point. Follow with a chest-opening stretch.
caution_zh: 网球滚压时动作要慢，避免压到脊柱正中。背部有损伤时不要使用网球。
caution_en: Roll slowly and avoid pressing directly on the spine. Skip the tennis ball if your back is injured.

summary_zh: 帮助预防和缓解感冒初期的怕冷和鼻塞。
summary_en: Helps prevent colds and eases early symptoms like chills and stuffy nose.
location_zh: 低头找到脖子后面最突出的骨头（第七颈椎），往下摸两节脊椎，再向两侧量约两横指。在上背部肩胛骨之间的区域。
location_en: From the prominent bone at the base of your neck, count two vertebrae down and go two finger-widths to the side. It sits between the shoulder blades on the upper back.
massage_zh: 靠墙站，把网球夹在穴位和墙之间，利用身体前后移动来滚压。也可以请家人用掌根按揉，力度中等。自己不方便时，搓热双手掌快速搓揉后背这个区域也有帮助。
massage_en: Stand against a wall with a tennis ball at this point and move your body to roll it in small circles. A partner can use the heel of their palm to rub firmly. On your own, rub your warm palms briskly over this area.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次。换季容易感冒时坚持每天做。
routine_en: Press or roll for 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Use daily during cold and flu season.
when_zh: 感冒初期打喷嚏、后背发冷时；鼻塞流清涕时；受风后脖子肩背发紧时。
when_en: At the first sneeze of a cold when your back feels chilly. When you have a runny nose with clear mucus. After getting caught in wind or drafts.
tips_zh: 按揉后马上用热毛巾敷在上背部5分钟，驱寒效果更好。配合多喝热水或姜茶。
tips_en: After pressing, drape a warm towel over your upper back for 5 minutes to ward off chills. Follow with hot water or ginger tea.
caution_zh: 靠近脊柱的穴位只能斜着按揉，不可向脊柱方向深压。发高烧时不宜热敷。
caution_en: Press at an angle away from the spine — do not push deeply toward it. Avoid heat packs if you have a high fever.

summary_zh: 对咳嗽气喘和呼吸不畅特别有帮助。
summary_en: Especially helpful for coughs, wheezing, and difficulty breathing.
location_zh: 低头找到脖子最突出的骨头（第七颈椎），往下摸三节脊椎，再向两侧量约两横指。在上背部两肩胛骨之间。
location_en: From the prominent bone at the base of your neck, count three vertebrae down and go two finger-widths to the side. It sits between the shoulder blades on the upper back.
massage_zh: 仰躺在地上，两个网球装进袜子里，间隔约四横指，放在穴位对应的后背位置，利用体重滚压。也可以靠墙用一个网球单侧滚压。请家人帮忙时，用拇指在穴位上画圈按揉。
massage_en: Place two tennis balls in a sock spaced about four finger-widths apart. Lie on them so they press both sides of the spine at this level. Roll gently. Against a wall with one ball also works. A partner can press with thumbs in slow circles.
routine_zh: 每次滚压或按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，咳嗽期间坚持做。
routine_en: Roll or press for 3-5 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Keep it up throughout a coughing spell.
when_zh: 咳嗽老不好时；感觉呼吸浅、吸不到底时；秋冬皮肤干痒时。
when_en: When a cough lingers. When your breathing feels shallow and tight. When dry, itchy skin flares up in autumn or winter.
tips_zh: 按揉时配合深呼吸，吸气时轻按，呼气时加力。按完后做几组深呼吸扩胸运动效果更好。
tips_en: Breathe deeply while pressing — lighter on inhale, firmer on exhale. Finish with a few deep breaths and a chest-opening stretch.
caution_zh: 网球滚压时避开脊柱，只压两侧肌肉。有严重呼吸系统疾病请先就医。
caution_en: Keep the balls on the muscles beside the spine, never on the spine itself. See a doctor for serious respiratory conditions.

summary_zh: 缓解胸闷心悸，帮助放松紧绷的上背部。
summary_en: Eases chest tightness and heart flutters, relaxes the upper back.
location_zh: 低头找到第七颈椎，往下摸四节脊椎，再向两侧量约两横指。在两侧肩胛骨之间的背部。
location_en: From the prominent bone at the base of your neck, count four vertebrae down and go two finger-widths to the side. It sits between the shoulder blades.
massage_zh: 靠墙站立，用网球抵住穴位，缓慢上下滚动。也可以仰躺在网球上，深呼吸配合自然放松。请家人帮忙时用拇指持续按压10秒后松开，反复进行。
massage_en: Lean against a wall with a tennis ball at this point and roll slowly up and down. Lying on the ball and breathing deeply also works. A partner can hold firm thumb pressure for 10 seconds, release, and repeat.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，胸闷时可随时加做。
routine_en: Press or roll for 2-3 minutes, once daily. Add a session whenever chest tightness appears.
when_zh: 胸口发闷、心跳快时；紧张焦虑导致上背部紧绷时；总觉得叹气才舒服时。
when_en: When your chest feels tight and heart pounds. When anxiety tightens your upper back. When you keep sighing for relief.
tips_zh: 按揉时深呼吸特别重要，吸气4秒、呼气6秒，帮助平复心跳。可以配合膻中穴（胸口正中）一起按。
tips_en: Deep breathing is key here — inhale for 4 counts, exhale for 6 to calm your heartbeat. Combine with Danzhong (RN17, center of chest) for added relief.
caution_zh: 心脏有严重疾病者请在医生指导下使用。胸痛剧烈时应立即就医，不要自行按压。
caution_en: Consult a doctor if you have a serious heart condition. Seek emergency care for severe chest pain — do not self-treat.

summary_zh: 帮助安神助眠，缓解心烦失眠和焦虑。
summary_en: Calms the mind, eases insomnia, restlessness, and anxiety.
location_zh: 两侧肩胛骨最下角连线向上摸两节脊椎，脊椎旁开两横指就是。在背部中段偏上位置，自己不容易够到。
location_en: Find the bottom tips of your shoulder blades and draw a line between them. Go two vertebrae up from that line, then two finger-widths to the side. It's on the mid-upper back — hard to reach alone.
massage_zh: 仰躺在网球上，让球正好压在穴位处，配合深呼吸自然放松。也可以靠墙用网球上下缓慢滚动。请家人帮忙用拇指轻柔按揉，力度不用太大，以舒适放松为主。
massage_en: Lie on your back with a tennis ball under this point and breathe deeply to let your body relax onto it. Or roll against a wall. A partner can press gently with thumbs — comfort and relaxation are the goal, not intense pressure.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1次，睡前做效果最好。
routine_en: Press or roll for 3-5 minutes, once daily. Best done before bed.
when_zh: 晚上翻来覆去睡不着时；心烦意乱静不下来时；做梦多、容易惊醒时。
when_en: When you toss and turn at night. When your mind races and won't quiet down. When dreams keep waking you.
tips_zh: 睡前按揉此穴配合听舒缓音乐或做深呼吸练习，有助于更快入睡。可以同时轻按神门穴（手腕内侧）。
tips_en: Press before sleep while listening to calming music or doing breathing exercises. Combine with Shenmen (HT7, inner wrist) for deeper relaxation.
caution_zh: 心脏有严重疾病者请先咨询医生。按揉力度宜轻柔舒适。
caution_en: Consult a doctor if you have a serious heart condition. Keep the pressure gentle and soothing.

summary_zh: 缓解背部中段不适和腹部胀气。
summary_en: Eases mid-back discomfort and abdominal bloating.
location_zh: 两侧肩胛骨最下角连线往上摸一节脊椎，脊椎旁开两横指。在背部中段，自己不容易按到。
location_en: One vertebra above the line connecting the bottom tips of your shoulder blades, then two finger-widths to the side. It's on the mid-back — hard to reach by yourself.
massage_zh: 靠墙站立，用网球抵住穴位来回滚动，控制好力度。也可以仰躺在网球上，利用体重自然按压。请家人用掌根按揉，力度中等。
massage_en: Stand against a wall with a tennis ball at this spot and roll side to side. Lying on the ball works too. A partner can use the heel of their palm with moderate circular pressure.
routine_zh: 每次滚压或按揉2-3分钟，每天1次。
routine_en: Roll or press for 2-3 minutes, once daily.
when_zh: 背部中段酸痛时；吃饱后腹胀打嗝时；胸口闷不舒服时。
when_en: When your mid-back aches. After eating when your belly bloats and you burp. When your chest feels stuffy.
tips_zh: 滚压后顺便活动一下脊柱，做猫牛式或转体动作，可以帮助整个背部放松。
tips_en: After rolling, do a few cat-cow stretches or gentle spinal twists to loosen up your entire back.
caution_zh: 避免网球直接压在脊椎骨上，只按两侧肌肉。
caution_en: Keep the ball on the muscles beside the spine, never directly on the vertebrae.

summary_zh: 缓解打嗝、呃逆，也帮助改善皮肤瘙痒。
summary_en: Relieves hiccups and burping, also helps with itchy skin.
location_zh: 两侧肩胛骨最下角的连线，对应的脊椎骨旁开两横指就是。在背部中段位置，自己按比较困难。
location_en: At the level of the bottom tips of your shoulder blades, two finger-widths to either side of the spine. It's on the mid-back — difficult to press by yourself.
massage_zh: 最方便的方法是仰躺在两个网球上（装进袜子里固定间距），球的位置对准穴位，配合深呼吸放松。也可以靠墙用球滚压，或请家人拇指按揉。
massage_en: The easiest method: put two tennis balls in a sock and lie on them at this level, one ball on each side of the spine. Breathe deeply and relax. Wall-rolling with a single ball or a partner's thumb massage both work too.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1次。打嗝时可临时加按1-2分钟。
routine_en: Press or roll for 3-5 minutes, once daily. Add a quick 1-2 minute session when hiccups strike.
when_zh: 打嗝停不下来时；呃逆频繁时；皮肤莫名瘙痒、容易起疹子时。
when_en: When hiccups won't stop. When burping is frequent. When unexplained itchy skin or rashes appear.
tips_zh: 打嗝时按这个穴位的同时做深呼吸，吸气憋住3秒再慢慢呼出，有助于快速止嗝。
tips_en: During hiccups, press this point while taking a deep breath, holding 3 seconds, then exhaling slowly. This combination often stops hiccups quickly.
caution_zh: 背部操作时避免压到脊柱。出血倾向者按压力度要轻。
caution_en: Avoid the spine when rolling. Use light pressure if you bruise or bleed easily.

summary_zh: 缓解两侧肋骨下方胀痛和情绪烦躁。
summary_en: Eases pain under the ribs and emotional irritability.
location_zh: 从肩胛骨最下角的连线（第七胸椎）再往下摸两节脊椎，脊椎旁开两横指。在背部中下段位置。
location_en: From the bottom tips of your shoulder blades, count two vertebrae down, then go two finger-widths to the side. It's on the mid-to-lower back.
massage_zh: 靠墙用网球抵住穴位缓慢滚动，或仰躺在球上配合深呼吸。请家人帮忙时，用拇指按揉画圈，力度适中，不要太重。
massage_en: Roll a tennis ball at this spot against a wall, or lie on the ball and breathe deeply. A partner can press with thumbs in slow circles using moderate pressure.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，情绪波动大时可加做一次。
routine_en: Press or roll for 2-3 minutes, once daily. Add a session when emotions run high.
when_zh: 两肋胀痛不舒服时；情绪烦躁、容易发脾气时；眼睛干涩疲劳伴肩背酸痛时。
when_en: When the sides of your ribcage ache. When you feel irritable and short-tempered. When tired, dry eyes come with a sore back.
tips_zh: 按揉时配合叹气式呼吸：深吸一口气，然后「哈」地长叹出来，重复5次，有助于释放紧张情绪。
tips_en: While pressing, try sigh-breathing: inhale deeply, then exhale with an audible "haaa" — repeat 5 times to release emotional tension.
caution_zh: 力度不要过重，此处按起来可能比较敏感。有严重肝脏疾病者请先就医。
caution_en: This area can be sensitive — keep pressure moderate. See a doctor if you have a serious liver condition.

summary_zh: 缓解口苦、两肋不适和消化不良。
summary_en: Eases bitter taste in the mouth, rib-side discomfort, and indigestion.
location_zh: 从肩胛骨最下角连线（第七胸椎）往下摸三节脊椎，脊椎旁开两横指。在背部中下段位置。
location_en: From the bottom tips of your shoulder blades, count three vertebrae down, then two finger-widths to the side. It sits on the mid-to-lower back.
massage_zh: 用网球靠墙滚压是最方便的做法，控制好力度，缓慢滚动。也可以仰躺在球上放松。请家人用拇指从上到下沿脊柱两侧依次按揉，连带肝俞一起按。
massage_en: Roll a tennis ball at this spot against a wall — the simplest approach. Or lie on the ball face up and relax. A partner can thumb-press from top to bottom along both sides of the spine, covering BL18 (Ganshu) in the same pass.
routine_zh: 每次滚压2-3分钟，每天1次，饭后1小时做为宜。
routine_en: Roll or press for 2-3 minutes, once daily, ideally an hour after meals.
when_zh: 早起嘴里发苦时；吃油腻食物后消化不良时；右侧肋骨下方胀闷时。
when_en: When you wake with a bitter taste. After greasy food causes indigestion. When the area under your right ribs feels bloated.
tips_zh: 配合按阳陵泉穴（小腿外侧）一起刺激，对肋骨两侧不适的缓解更全面。
tips_en: Combine with Yanglingquan (GB34, outer lower leg) for more thorough relief of rib-side discomfort.
caution_zh: 有胆结石或胆囊炎急性发作时应就医，不要自行按压。
caution_en: See a doctor for gallstone attacks or acute gallbladder inflammation — do not self-treat.

summary_zh: 改善消化不良和腹胀，帮助增进食欲。
summary_en: Improves digestion, reduces bloating, and helps restore appetite.
location_zh: 肚脐正对后背脊柱处（第二腰椎），往上摸三节脊椎，旁开两横指。在后背中下段位置。
location_en: Find the spot on your spine directly behind your navel. Count three vertebrae up from there, then go two finger-widths to the side. It's on the mid-to-lower back.
massage_zh: 靠墙用网球抵住穴位，身体上下微微移动来滚压。也可以趴在床上请家人用拇指按揉，力度适中，揉到有温热感为好。
massage_en: Lean against a wall with a tennis ball at this point and shift your body to roll it. Or lie face down and have a partner press with their thumbs until the area feels warm. Moderate pressure works best.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1次，饭后1小时进行。
routine_en: Press or roll for 3-5 minutes, once daily, ideally an hour after a meal.
when_zh: 吃东西不消化、肚子胀时；食欲差、吃不下饭时；容易拉肚子或大便不成形时。
when_en: When food sits heavy and your belly bloats. When you have no appetite. When your digestion tends toward loose stools.
tips_zh: 按揉后用手掌搓热后背这一带，增强温暖感，对消化的帮助更大。饭后散步10分钟再按效果更好。
tips_en: After pressing, warm the area by rubbing briskly with your palms. A 10-minute walk after eating before your session enhances the effect.
caution_zh: 避免空腹时过度按压。腹部有急性疼痛时应先就医。
caution_en: Avoid heavy pressure on an empty stomach. See a doctor first for acute abdominal pain.

summary_zh: 缓解胃痛胃胀，帮助消化更顺畅。
summary_en: Relieves stomach pain and bloating, helps digestion run smoother.
location_zh: 肚脐正对后背脊柱处（第二腰椎），往上摸两节脊椎，旁开两横指。在后腰偏上的位置。
location_en: Find the spot on your spine directly behind your navel. Count two vertebrae up, then go two finger-widths to the side. It's on the lower-to-mid back.
massage_zh: 靠墙用网球抵住穴位，弯曲膝盖上下移动来滚压，控制力度不要太猛。也可以请家人用拇指按揉，力度中等，揉到穴位处发热。
massage_en: Place a tennis ball at this spot against a wall and bend your knees to roll up and down gently. A partner can use thumb circles with moderate pressure until the area feels warm.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1次，饭后1小时做最合适。
routine_en: Press or roll for 3-5 minutes, once daily. Best done about an hour after eating.
when_zh: 胃痛隐隐不舒服时；吃多了胃胀时；消化不好经常反酸时。
when_en: When a dull stomachache nags at you. After overeating when your belly is distended. When indigestion brings acid reflux.
tips_zh: 可以和脾俞穴（上方一个）一起按，从上到下连续滚压，对消化系统的帮助更全面。
tips_en: Press together with BL20 (Pishu, one level above) — roll from top to bottom for more comprehensive digestive support.
caution_zh: 胃痛剧烈时应先就医。刚吃完饭不要趴着按，等1小时以上。
caution_en: See a doctor for severe stomach pain. Wait at least an hour after eating before lying face down to press.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解腹胀水肿和腰部酸痛。
summary_en: Helps relieve abdominal bloating, water retention, and lower back soreness.
location_zh: 肚脐正对后背脊柱处（第二腰椎），往上摸一节脊椎，旁开两横指。在后腰位置，自己还能勉强够到。
location_en: Find the spot on your spine directly behind your navel. Go one vertebra up, then two finger-widths to the side. It's on the lower back — you can just about reach it yourself.
massage_zh: 双手握拳，用指关节抵住两侧穴位，做上下搓揉动作直到发热。也可以靠墙用网球滚压，或请家人用拇指按揉。
massage_en: Make fists and place your knuckles on both sides of this point. Rub up and down until the area feels warm. Wall-rolling with a tennis ball or a partner's thumb massage also works well.
routine_zh: 每次搓揉或按压3-5分钟，每天1次，腰酸时可加做一次。
routine_en: Rub or press for 3-5 minutes, once daily. Add a session when your lower back aches.
when_zh: 小便不畅、身体浮肿时；肚子胀气、消化不良时；腰部酸痛无力时。
when_en: When urination feels sluggish or you notice puffiness. When bloating and indigestion bother you. When your lower back aches and feels weak.
tips_zh: 搓揉后贴暖宝宝或热水袋热敷10分钟，对腰部酸冷特别有效。可以和肾俞穴（下方）配合一起做。
tips_en: After rubbing, apply a heat pad or hot water bottle for 10 minutes — especially soothing for cold, achy lower backs. Combine with BL23 (Shenshu, just below) for stronger results.
caution_zh: 腰椎有严重问题时请先咨询医生。热敷时避免烫伤，温度适中即可。
caution_en: Consult a doctor if you have serious spinal issues. When applying heat, use moderate warmth to avoid burns.

summary_zh: 缓解腰酸乏力、改善精力不足的后腰要穴。
summary_en: A key lower-back point that eases lumbar soreness and boosts energy.
location_zh: 后腰部，先找到肚脐正后方的脊柱（第2腰椎），从那里向两侧各量两横指宽的位置。左右各一个。
location_en: On your lower back, find the spine directly behind your navel, then move up slightly to the second lumbar vertebra. The point is two finger-widths out to each side.
massage_zh: 双手握拳，用指关节抵住后腰两侧穴位，上下搓揉至皮肤发热。也可以靠墙用两个网球同时按压左右两个穴位。
massage_en: Make fists and use your knuckles to rub up and down on both sides of your lower back until the area feels warm. Or place two tennis balls in a sock, lean against a wall, and roll them over the points.
routine_zh: 每次搓揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，睡前做效果最好。
routine_en: Rub for 3 to 5 minutes, once or twice daily. Best before bed.
when_zh: 腰酸腿软、容易疲劳、夜尿多、手脚发凉、耳鸣时。
when_en: When your lower back aches, you feel chronically tired, need to urinate at night, have cold hands and feet, or notice ringing in your ears.
tips_zh: 搓揉后贴暖宝宝热敷10分钟，温暖感更持久。可搭配按揉太溪穴（内踝后方）。
tips_en: Apply a heat pad for 10 minutes afterward for lasting warmth. Pair with Taixi (behind the inner ankle) for a stronger effect.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。腰部有急性扭伤或皮肤破损时不要搓揉。
caution_en: Use with caution during pregnancy. Avoid if you have an acute back injury or broken skin.

summary_zh: 缓解下腰酸痛和经期腰部不适。
summary_en: Relieves lower back pain and period-related lumbar discomfort.
location_zh: 后腰部，从肾俞往下摸一节脊椎骨（第3腰椎），再向两侧各量两横指宽处。
location_en: On your lower back, one vertebra below Shenshu. Find the third lumbar vertebra and measure two finger-widths out to each side.
massage_zh: 双手搓热后掌心贴在后腰，上下搓揉覆盖此穴位置，直到感觉热透。也可以用网球靠墙滚压。
massage_en: Warm your palms by rubbing them together, then place them on your lower back and rub up and down until the area feels heated through. A tennis ball against a wall also works well.
routine_zh: 每次搓揉3-5分钟，每天1次，经期前几天开始做。
routine_en: Rub for 3 to 5 minutes, once daily. Start a few days before your period if needed.
when_zh: 下腰酸痛、经期腰坠胀、久坐后腰部僵硬时。
when_en: When your lower back is sore, you feel lumbar heaviness during your period, or your back stiffens after sitting too long.
tips_zh: 搭配搓揉肾俞穴，从上到下一起搓效果更好。
tips_en: Rub this point together with Shenshu above it in one continuous up-and-down motion for better relief.
caution_zh: 腰椎有严重问题时请先咨询医生。孕妇慎用。
caution_en: Consult a doctor if you have serious spinal conditions. Use with caution during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 帮助改善便秘腹胀，缓解腰腿酸痛。
summary_en: Helps with constipation, bloating, and lower back or leg soreness.
location_zh: 双手叉腰，拇指按住胯骨最高点，拇指连线与脊柱的交点（第4腰椎）旁开两横指处。
location_en: Place your hands on your hips with thumbs on top of your hip bones. Where the line between your thumbs crosses your spine is the fourth lumbar vertebra — the point is two finger-widths out to each side.
massage_zh: 双手握拳，用指关节按压并上下搓揉此处。也可以靠墙用网球滚压，身体微微下蹲调整网球位置到最酸胀的点。
massage_en: Make fists and rub your knuckles up and down over this area. Or lean against a wall with a tennis ball at this height, bending your knees slightly to roll the ball onto the most tender spot.
routine_zh: 每次搓揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，排便前按效果更好。
routine_en: Rub for 3 to 5 minutes, once or twice daily. Pressing before a bowel movement can help.
when_zh: 便秘腹胀、肚子咕噜响、腰腿酸痛、久坐后下腰发紧时。
when_en: When you are constipated or bloated, your stomach is rumbling, or your lower back and legs feel sore and tight.
tips_zh: 便秘时顺时针揉肚子5分钟后再搓揉大肠俞，效果更明显。
tips_en: For constipation, rub your belly clockwise for 5 minutes first, then work on this point for better results.
caution_zh: 腹部有急性疼痛时先就医，不要自行按揉。
caution_en: Seek medical attention first for acute abdominal pain — do not self-massage.

summary_zh: 缓解腰骶酸痛，帮助改善小便不畅。
summary_en: Eases lower back and sacral soreness, and helps with urinary issues.
location_zh: 后腰最下方，从大肠俞（胯骨连线处）再往下摸一节脊椎骨（第5腰椎），旁开两横指处。
location_en: At the very bottom of your lower back, one vertebra below Dachangshu. Find the fifth lumbar vertebra and measure two finger-widths out to each side.
massage_zh: 双手搓热后贴在腰骶部，用掌根上下推按。也可以仰卧，将两个网球放在腰下方两侧，利用体重按压。
massage_en: Warm your palms and press them against your lower back, pushing up and down with the heel of your hand. Or lie on your back with two tennis balls placed under the lower back on each side, using body weight for pressure.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1次，晚上做效果较好。
routine_en: Press for 3 to 5 minutes, once daily. Evening is ideal.
when_zh: 腰骶酸痛、小便次数多、肚子胀气、久坐后腰发僵时。
when_en: When your sacral area aches, you urinate frequently, feel bloated, or your lower back stiffens from sitting.
tips_zh: 搭配按揉关元穴（肚脐下四横指）前后呼应，效果更全面。
tips_en: Pair with Guanyuan on the front (four finger-widths below the navel) for more complete relief.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。腰骶部有急性损伤时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press if you have an acute sacral injury.

summary_zh: 缓解小腹胀痛和腰骶不适。
summary_en: Relieves lower abdominal discomfort and sacral area soreness.
location_zh: 在臀部上方，骶骨（尾椎上方那块三角形的骨头）上端，第1个骶椎旁开两横指处。大约在腰带下方一点点。
location_en: Just above the buttocks on the sacrum — the triangular bone above your tailbone. Find the first sacral level, about a finger-width below the belt line, two finger-widths out from center.
massage_zh: 俯卧，请人用拇指按压此处，缓慢加力至酸胀。自己做可以仰卧，把网球放在骶骨两侧上端，利用体重按压。
massage_en: Lie face down and have someone press with their thumb, gradually increasing pressure. On your own, lie on your back with a tennis ball under each side of the upper sacrum and let your body weight do the work.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1次，饭后1小时做为宜。
routine_en: Press for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Best done at least one hour after eating.
when_zh: 小腹胀痛、拉肚子、腰骶部酸沉、久坐臀部不舒服时。
when_en: When your lower abdomen feels bloated or crampy, you have diarrhea, or your sacral area aches from long sitting.
tips_zh: 搭配按揉关元穴（肚脐下方）和足三里（膝盖下方），改善消化效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Guanyuan (below the navel) and Zusanli (below the knee) for better digestive relief.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。腹部有急性剧痛时先就医。
caution_en: Use with caution during pregnancy. Seek medical help first for acute abdominal pain.

summary_zh: 帮助改善小便不畅，缓解腰骶酸痛。
summary_en: Helps with urinary issues and relieves sacral and lower back soreness.
location_zh: 在骶骨上，和臀部后上方那个骨头突起（髂后上棘）差不多平齐的位置，脊柱正中旁开两横指处。
location_en: On the sacrum, roughly level with the bony bump you can feel at the top of your buttock (posterior superior iliac spine). Two finger-widths out from the midline.
massage_zh: 仰卧屈膝，将两个网球放在骶骨两侧，缓慢左右摇摆臀部进行滚压。也可以请人用拇指按揉。
massage_en: Lie on your back with knees bent and place two tennis balls under each side of the sacrum. Gently rock your hips side to side. Or have someone press with their thumbs.
routine_zh: 每次滚压或按揉3-5分钟，每天1次。
routine_en: Roll or press for 3 to 5 minutes, once daily.
when_zh: 小便次数多或不顺畅、便秘、腰骶部酸痛沉重时。
when_en: When you urinate too often or with difficulty, feel constipated, or your sacral area feels heavy and achy.
tips_zh: 搭配按揉中极穴（肚脐下四寸）前后配合，改善排尿问题更有效。
tips_en: Pair with Zhongji on the front (about a hand-width below the navel) for more effective urinary relief.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。排尿异常持续不好转请及时就医。
caution_en: Use with caution during pregnancy. See a doctor if urinary problems persist.

summary_zh: 缓解骶骨部位酸痛和消化不适。
summary_en: Eases sacral soreness and digestive discomfort.
location_zh: 在骶骨中部，第3个骶椎旁开两横指处。大约在膀胱俞往下一节的位置。
location_en: On the middle of the sacrum, at the third sacral level, two finger-widths out from center. About one segment below Pangguangshu.
massage_zh: 仰卧屈膝，把网球放在骶骨中部两侧，身体轻轻上下移动进行滚压。也可以请人用拇指指腹按压。
massage_en: Lie on your back with knees bent, place tennis balls under the mid-sacrum on each side, and gently shift your body up and down to roll. A partner can also press with thumb pads.
routine_zh: 每次滚压3-5分钟，每天1次，久坐后做为宜。
routine_en: Roll for 3 to 5 minutes, once daily. Best after prolonged sitting.
when_zh: 骶骨酸痛、肚子胀气不舒服、拉肚子、久坐臀部僵硬时。
when_en: When your sacrum aches, you feel bloated or gassy, have loose stools, or your buttocks are stiff from sitting.
tips_zh: 和膀胱俞一起滚压，把网球从上到下慢慢移动，覆盖整个骶骨区域。
tips_en: Roll from Pangguangshu down through this point in one continuous motion to cover the whole sacral area.
caution_zh: 骶骨有骨折或严重损伤时不要按压。力度不宜过大。
caution_en: Do not press if you have a sacral fracture or serious injury. Keep the pressure moderate.

summary_zh: 缓解骶尾部不适，帮助改善腰骶酸痛。
summary_en: Eases sacral and tailbone discomfort and lower back soreness.
location_zh: 在骶骨下部，第4个骶椎旁开两横指处。大约在骶骨最下端、接近尾骨的位置。
location_en: On the lower sacrum, at the fourth sacral level, two finger-widths from the midline. Near the bottom of the sacrum, close to the tailbone.
massage_zh: 仰卧屈膝，把网球放在骶骨下端两侧，利用体重缓慢按压。也可以请人用拇指按揉，力度以酸胀为度。
massage_en: Lie on your back with knees bent, place tennis balls under the lower sacrum on each side, and use your body weight for slow pressure. A partner pressing with thumbs also works.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1次，睡前做为宜。
routine_en: Press for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Best done before bed.
when_zh: 骶尾部酸痛、久坐后臀部不适、经期腰骶坠胀时。
when_en: When your sacrum or tailbone area aches, you feel buttock discomfort after sitting, or your lower back feels heavy during your period.
tips_zh: 搭配轻柔的骨盆倾斜运动，按压后做几次骨盆前后摆动更放松。
tips_en: Follow up with gentle pelvic tilts — rock your pelvis forward and back a few times for deeper relaxation.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。尾骨有损伤时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press if you have a tailbone injury.

summary_zh: 缓解腰骶酸痛，帮助改善经期不适。
summary_en: Relieves sacral pain and helps ease menstrual discomfort.
location_zh: 在骶骨上，第1个骶后孔的位置。骶骨表面有四对小孔，这是最上面的一对。大约在臀部后上方骨头突起稍内下方。
location_en: On the sacrum, over the first pair of small openings (posterior sacral foramina). These sit just below and inward from the bony bump at the top of your buttock.
massage_zh: 仰卧屈膝，将两个网球放入袜子里，横放在骶骨上端，利用体重滚压。也可以请人用拇指按压骶骨上部两侧的小凹陷。
massage_en: Lie on your back with knees bent, place two tennis balls in a sock across the upper sacrum, and roll gently. A partner can also press their thumbs into the small dips on each side of the upper sacrum.
routine_zh: 每次滚压或按压3-5分钟，每天1次，经期前几天开始做。
routine_en: Roll or press for 3 to 5 minutes, once daily. Start a few days before your period.
when_zh: 腰骶酸痛、经期不舒服、白带异常、腰部发凉时。
when_en: When your sacrum aches, you have menstrual discomfort, unusual discharge, or your lower back feels cold.
tips_zh: 四个髎穴（上次中下）一起滚压，网球从上到下慢慢移动，效果更全面。
tips_en: Roll all four Liao points together by slowly moving the tennis balls from the top to the bottom of the sacrum.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。骶骨区域有急性损伤时不要按压。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press if the sacral area is acutely injured.

summary_zh: 缓解痛经和腰骶部不适的重要穴位。
summary_en: A key point for easing menstrual cramps and sacral discomfort.
location_zh: 在骶骨上，第2个骶后孔的位置。大约在臀部后上方骨头突起和脊柱正中之间。是四个髎穴中最常用的一个。
location_en: On the sacrum, over the second pair of openings. Roughly between the bony bump at the top of your buttock and the midline of your spine. The most commonly used of the four Liao points.
massage_zh: 仰卧屈膝，把网球放在骶骨中上部两侧滚压。或者用拳头指关节搓揉骶骨这个区域，直到发热。请人按压效果最好。
massage_en: Lie on your back with tennis balls under the upper-mid sacrum and roll. Or rub the area with your knuckles until it warms up. Having a partner press with thumbs gives the best result.
routine_zh: 每次按压或搓揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，痛经时可以多做。
routine_en: Press or rub for 3 to 5 minutes, once or twice daily. Do it more often during menstrual cramps.
when_zh: 痛经严重、腰骶酸痛、小便不顺畅、腿脚发麻无力时。
when_en: When you have bad menstrual cramps, sacral pain, difficulty urinating, or numbness and weakness in your legs.
tips_zh: 痛经时先搓热双手，手掌贴在骶骨上热敷1分钟，再用力按压此穴，效果更好。
tips_en: During cramps, warm your palms first and hold them on the sacrum for a minute before pressing this point for stronger relief.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。经期出血量过大时轻按或暂停。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Use light pressure or skip if menstrual bleeding is very heavy.

summary_zh: 帮助改善便秘和经期不适，缓解骶部酸痛。
summary_en: Helps with constipation and menstrual issues, and eases sacral aching.
location_zh: 在骶骨上，第3个骶后孔的位置。在次髎往下约一指宽处。
location_en: On the sacrum, over the third pair of openings, about one finger-width below Ciliao.
massage_zh: 仰卧屈膝，把网球放在骶骨中部偏下两侧滚压。也可以请人用拇指按压，力度中等，按到酸胀即可。
massage_en: Lie on your back with tennis balls under the mid-lower sacrum and roll gently. A partner can press with thumbs using moderate pressure until you feel a deep ache.
routine_zh: 每次按压3-5分钟，每天1次，排便不顺时可多做。
routine_en: Press for 3 to 5 minutes, once daily. Do it more often when constipated.
when_zh: 便秘或拉肚子、经期不规律、白带异常、腰骶酸痛时。
when_en: When you are constipated or have diarrhea, your period is irregular, or your sacrum is aching.
tips_zh: 和上髎、次髎、下髎一起滚压，把整个骶骨都覆盖到效果最好。
tips_en: Roll across all four Liao points together — covering the full sacrum gives the best results.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。腹部急性疼痛时先就医。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. See a doctor first for acute abdominal pain.

summary_zh: 缓解小腹和腰骶部不适，帮助改善排便问题。
summary_en: Eases lower abdominal and sacral discomfort, and helps with bowel issues.
location_zh: 在骶骨上，第4个骶后孔的位置。是四个髎穴中最下面的一个，在中髎往下约一指宽处。
location_en: On the sacrum, over the fourth (lowest) pair of openings, about one finger-width below Zhongliao.
massage_zh: 仰卧屈膝，把网球放在骶骨最下端两侧滚压。也可以请人用拇指由上到下依次按压四个髎穴，最后在此处多按一会。
massage_en: Lie on your back with tennis balls under the lowest part of the sacrum and roll. A partner can press all four Liao points from top to bottom, spending extra time on this lowest one.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1次，排便前做可以帮助排便。
routine_en: Press for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Doing it before a bowel movement may help.
when_zh: 小腹坠胀、便秘或便血、腰骶部酸痛、白带多时。
when_en: When your lower abdomen feels heavy, you are constipated, or your sacral area is achy and sore.
tips_zh: 四个髎穴一组按压完后，用掌心捂住整个骶骨热敷1分钟，感觉更舒服。
tips_en: After pressing all four Liao points, hold your warm palms over the entire sacrum for a minute to seal in the warmth.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。有便血情况请先就医检查。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. See a doctor if you notice blood in your stool.

summary_zh: 缓解尾骨周围不适和久坐引起的肛周问题。
summary_en: Eases tailbone discomfort and sitting-related rectal issues.
location_zh: 在尾骨尖端旁边约半个拇指宽的位置，左右各一个。俯卧时比较容易找到。
location_en: About half a thumb-width to each side of the tailbone tip. Easier to locate when lying face down.
massage_zh: 俯卧或侧卧，用中指指腹轻柔按压尾骨旁边，小幅度揉动。因位置特殊，力度要轻柔，不需要很大力。
massage_en: Lie face down or on your side. Use your middle fingertip to gently press beside the tailbone with small circular motions. Light pressure is enough given the sensitive location.
routine_zh: 每次轻柔按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，便后清洁双手再做。
routine_en: Gently press for 1 to 2 minutes, once daily. Wash hands before and after.
when_zh: 尾骨酸痛、久坐后肛周不舒服、拉肚子、痔疮不适时。
when_en: When your tailbone is sore, you feel rectal discomfort from sitting, have diarrhea, or hemorrhoid issues.
tips_zh: 配合提肛运动效果更好：收紧肛门肌肉5秒后放松，重复10次。
tips_en: Combine with pelvic floor squeezes: tighten for 5 seconds, relax, and repeat 10 times for better results.
caution_zh: 尾骨骨折或局部有伤口时不要按。孕妇慎用。
caution_en: Do not press if you have a tailbone fracture or skin injury. Use with caution during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解臀部和大腿后侧酸痛，改善久坐不适。
summary_en: Relieves buttock and hamstring soreness, especially from prolonged sitting.
location_zh: 在大腿后侧最上方，臀部和大腿交界的那条横纹（臀横纹）正中间。站直摸臀部下缘就能找到。
location_en: At the midpoint of the crease where your buttock meets the back of your thigh (the gluteal fold). Stand up and feel the center of the fold under each buttock.
massage_zh: 坐在硬椅子边缘，把网球放在这个位置下方，利用体重按压并小幅度前后滚动。也可以用拇指用力按压。
massage_en: Sit on the edge of a firm chair with a tennis ball under this crease and rock gently forward and back. You can also press firmly with your thumb while standing.
routine_zh: 每次滚压或按压2-3分钟，每天1次，久坐后做。
routine_en: Roll or press for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Best after long sitting.
when_zh: 久坐后臀部酸痛、大腿后侧发紧、腰痛连着屁股疼、痔疮不适时。
when_en: When your buttocks ache from sitting, your hamstrings feel tight, back pain radiates into your hip, or you have hemorrhoid discomfort.
tips_zh: 搭配拉伸大腿后侧：坐着伸直一条腿，身体前倾够脚尖，效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with a seated hamstring stretch — straighten one leg and lean forward to reach your toes for better release.
caution_zh: 坐骨神经痛急性期轻按或避免。局部有淤青时不要按。
caution_en: Use light pressure or avoid during acute sciatica. Do not press on bruised areas.

summary_zh: 缓解大腿后侧紧绷疼痛和腰痛。
summary_en: Relieves hamstring tightness and lower back pain.
location_zh: 在大腿后侧正中间，臀横纹和膝盖后方横纹连线的中点偏上一点的位置。大约在大腿后面最粗的地方。
location_en: On the back of your thigh, roughly in the middle but slightly above center, between the buttock crease and the back of the knee. Around the thickest part of the hamstring.
massage_zh: 坐在椅子上，把网球放在大腿后侧下方，利用腿的重量按压并前后滚动。也可以用双手拇指叠压按揉。
massage_en: Sit on a chair with a tennis ball under the back of your thigh, using your leg's weight to press and roll forward and back. You can also press with both thumbs stacked together.
routine_zh: 每次滚压或按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，运动后做效果更好。
routine_en: Roll or press for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Best after exercise.
when_zh: 大腿后侧紧绷酸痛、弯腰困难、腰痛连带腿痛时。
when_en: When the back of your thigh is tight and sore, bending forward is hard, or back pain radiates down your leg.
tips_zh: 运动前先滚压此穴放松大腿后侧，可以帮助预防拉伤。
tips_en: Roll this point before exercise to loosen your hamstrings and help prevent strains.
caution_zh: 大腿后侧有拉伤时轻柔处理或避免按压。
caution_en: Use very gentle pressure or avoid if you have a hamstring strain.

summary_zh: 缓解膝盖后方不适和大腿后侧麻木。
summary_en: Eases discomfort behind the knee and thigh numbness.
location_zh: 在膝盖后方（腘窝）上面约一横指宽的位置，偏外侧，大腿后外侧的那根粗筋内侧边缘。
location_en: About one finger-width above the back of your knee crease, on the outer side, along the inner edge of the thick tendon on the back-outer thigh.
massage_zh: 坐着微微弯曲膝盖，用拇指按压膝盖后方偏上外侧的位置，力度中等，缓慢揉按。
massage_en: Sit with your knee slightly bent. Press your thumb into the spot just above and to the outer side of the knee crease. Use moderate pressure and rub slowly.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，腿部不适时可以多做。
routine_en: Press for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Do it more often when your legs bother you.
when_zh: 膝盖后方胀痛、大腿后侧发麻、蹲下站起膝盖不舒服、便秘时。
when_en: When the back of your knee feels swollen or painful, your thigh is numb, squatting bothers your knee, or you are constipated.
tips_zh: 按揉后轻轻伸直和弯曲膝盖几次，帮助放松膝盖后方的肌肉。
tips_en: After pressing, gently straighten and bend your knee a few times to loosen the muscles behind it.
caution_zh: 膝盖后方有肿胀或静脉曲张时避免按压。力度不宜过大。
caution_en: Avoid if there is swelling or varicose veins behind the knee. Keep the pressure moderate.

summary_zh: 缓解膝盖后方不适和腰背酸痛，帮助消肿。
summary_en: Eases knee and lower back pain, and helps reduce swelling.
location_zh: 在膝盖后方横纹上，从正中间向外侧量一横指宽的位置，那根粗筋的内侧。
location_en: On the back of your knee crease, one finger-width to the outer side from center, along the inner edge of the outer tendon.
massage_zh: 坐着把腿稍微弯曲，用拇指按压膝盖后方偏外侧的凹陷处，适度用力揉按。
massage_en: Sit with your leg slightly bent. Press your thumb into the dip on the outer side of the back of your knee crease, using moderate pressure to rub.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，腿部浮肿时可以多做。
routine_en: Press for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Do it more often if your legs are swollen.
when_zh: 膝盖后方痛、小腿抽筋、腿脚浮肿、腰背酸痛时。
when_en: When the back of your knee hurts, your calf cramps, your legs are puffy, or your back aches.
tips_zh: 搭配按揉委中穴（膝盖后方正中），两个穴位一起按效果更全面。
tips_en: Press together with Weizhong (center of the knee crease) for more complete relief.
caution_zh: 膝盖后方有静脉曲张或血管异常时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid if you have varicose veins or vascular issues behind the knee.

summary_zh: 缓解腰背疼痛的膝后重要穴位，古称腰背委中求。
summary_en: The go-to point behind the knee for lower back and spine pain relief.
location_zh: 在膝盖正后方的横纹正中间，弯曲膝盖时能摸到一个明显的凹陷，两根粗筋之间。按下去能感到脉搏跳动。
location_en: Right in the center of the crease behind your knee. Bend your knee and feel for the hollow between two thick tendons. You may notice a pulse under your finger.
massage_zh: 坐着弯曲膝盖，用双手拇指按住膝盖后方正中凹陷处，适度用力按压并缓慢揉动。也可以轻轻拍打此处30-50下。
massage_en: Sit with your knee bent, press both thumbs into the center of the crease behind your knee, and rub slowly with moderate pressure. You can also gently pat the area 30 to 50 times.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，腰痛时随时可以按。
routine_en: Press for 3 to 5 minutes, once or twice daily. Press anytime when your back hurts.
when_zh: 腰背疼痛僵硬、膝盖后方不舒服、小腿抽筋、腿脚发麻无力时。
when_en: When your back is stiff and painful, the area behind your knee is sore, your calf cramps, or your legs feel numb and weak.
tips_zh: 腰痛时先按委中3分钟再站起来活动，会感觉腰部轻松很多。搭配按腰部的肾俞穴效果更佳。
tips_en: When your back hurts, press Weizhong for 3 minutes before standing up — your back will feel noticeably lighter. Combine with Shenshu on the lower back.
caution_zh: 膝盖后方有静脉曲张时不要按压。力度适中，不要过猛。
caution_en: Do not press if you have varicose veins behind the knee. Use moderate, steady pressure — never too forceful.

summary_zh: 缓解肩背僵硬和脖子酸痛。
summary_en: Relieves stiff shoulders, upper back tightness, and neck soreness.
location_zh: 在上背部，低头时脖子后面最突出骨头往下数两节脊椎（第2胸椎），从那里向两侧各量四横指宽的位置，靠近肩胛骨内侧。
location_en: On the upper back, find the prominent bone at the base of your neck when you bow your head, count two vertebrae down, then measure four finger-widths out to each side, near the inner edge of the shoulder blade.
massage_zh: 靠墙站立，将网球放在肩胛骨内上角的位置，利用体重滚压。也可以请人用拇指按压此处。
massage_en: Stand against a wall with a tennis ball at the inner upper corner of your shoulder blade and lean into it to roll. A partner pressing with thumbs is also effective.
routine_zh: 每次滚压或按压3-5分钟，每天1-2次，伏案工作后做。
routine_en: Roll or press for 3 to 5 minutes, once or twice daily. Best after desk work.
when_zh: 肩背僵硬、脖子酸痛转头困难、手臂发麻、伏案太久上背发紧时。
when_en: When your shoulders and upper back are stiff, turning your neck hurts, your arm is numb, or desk work has left your upper back tight.
tips_zh: 按完后做几次耸肩和转头运动，帮助放松肩颈。搭配按揉风池穴（后脑下方）效果更好。
tips_en: After pressing, shrug your shoulders and turn your head a few times to release tension. Pair with Fengchi (at the base of the skull) for better results.
caution_zh: 上背部有急性拉伤时避免用力按压。力度不宜过猛。
caution_en: Avoid forceful pressure if you have an acute upper back strain. Keep it steady and moderate.

summary_zh: 缓解咳嗽气短和上背部紧绷不适。
summary_en: Eases coughing, shortness of breath, and upper back tightness.
location_zh: 在上背部，低头时脖子后面最突出骨头往下数三节脊椎（第3胸椎），从那里向两侧各量四横指宽处，肩胛骨内侧缘。
location_en: On the upper back beside the third thoracic vertebra, four finger-widths from the midline, along the inner edge of the shoulder blade. One vertebra below Fufen.
massage_zh: 靠墙用网球滚压肩胛骨内侧中上部位，找到最酸的点停留按压10秒。也可以请人用拇指按揉。
massage_en: Lean against a wall with a tennis ball along the inner edge of your shoulder blade, find the sorest spot, and hold for 10 seconds. Or have someone press with their thumb.
routine_zh: 每次滚压3-5分钟，每天1次，咳嗽或胸闷时可多做。
routine_en: Roll for 3 to 5 minutes, once daily. Do it more often when coughing or feeling chest tightness.
when_zh: 咳嗽气短、上背部紧绷酸痛、肩背僵硬、深呼吸不畅时。
when_en: When you are coughing, feel short of breath, your upper back is tight and sore, or deep breathing feels restricted.
tips_zh: 按压后做几次深呼吸扩胸运动，双臂向后伸展打开胸腔，感觉会更通畅。
tips_en: After pressing, take several deep breaths with arms stretched back to open up your chest. This amplifies the relief.
caution_zh: 咳嗽持续不好转请就医。背部不宜直刺深按，力度适中即可。
caution_en: See a doctor if your cough persists. Use moderate pressure on the upper back — do not press too deeply.

summary_zh: 缓解疲劳虚弱、改善咳嗽气短的上背部要穴。
summary_en: A vital upper-back point that combats fatigue and eases coughing and breathlessness.
location_zh: 在上背部，低头时脖子后面最突出骨头往下数四节脊椎（第4胸椎），从那里向两侧各量四横指宽处，肩胛骨内侧缘的中间位置。
location_en: On the upper back beside the fourth thoracic vertebra, four finger-widths from the midline, along the middle of the inner edge of the shoulder blade.
massage_zh: 靠墙用网球滚压肩胛骨内侧缘中部，缓慢上下移动找到最酸胀的点。自己够不太到，用网球或请人按压是最好的方式。
massage_en: Lean against a wall with a tennis ball along the middle of your inner shoulder blade edge and roll slowly up and down. This spot is hard to reach by hand — a tennis ball or a partner is the best approach.
routine_zh: 每次滚压3-5分钟，每天1次，感觉疲劳乏力时坚持按。
routine_en: Roll for 3 to 5 minutes, once daily. Keep at it regularly when you feel run down.
when_zh: 身体虚弱疲劳、咳嗽气短、容易出虚汗、记性变差、总觉得没精神时。
when_en: When you feel weak and exhausted, have a lingering cough, sweat easily, notice poor memory, or just feel drained.
tips_zh: 每天坚持按膏肓穴一个月，对改善长期疲劳效果明显。可以搭配按足三里（膝盖下方）一起调理。
tips_en: Press daily for a month to noticeably improve chronic fatigue. Pair with Zusanli (below the knee) for an overall energy boost.
caution_zh: 上背部不宜用力过猛。身体极度虚弱时先休息再按。
caution_en: Do not press too hard on the upper back. Rest first if you are extremely weak before trying massage.

summary_zh: 缓解胸闷心慌和上背部酸痛。
summary_en: Eases chest tightness, heart palpitations, and upper back soreness.
location_zh: 在上背部，低头时脖子后面最突出骨头往下数五节脊椎（第5胸椎），从那里向两侧各量四横指宽处，肩胛骨内侧缘。
location_en: On the upper back beside the fifth thoracic vertebra, four finger-widths from the midline, along the inner edge of the shoulder blade. One vertebra below Gaohuang.
massage_zh: 靠墙用网球滚压肩胛骨内侧中下部，慢慢调整位置找到酸胀点。也可以请人用拇指按揉，力度中等。
massage_en: Lean against a wall with a tennis ball along the mid-lower inner edge of your shoulder blade and adjust until you find the sore spot. A partner pressing with thumbs at moderate pressure also works well.
routine_zh: 每次滚压3-5分钟，每天1次，胸闷或焦虑时随时做。
routine_en: Roll for 3 to 5 minutes, once daily. Press anytime you feel chest tightness or anxiety.
when_zh: 胸闷气短、心慌心跳快、上背部酸痛、情绪紧张焦虑时。
when_en: When your chest feels tight, your heart races, your upper back aches, or you feel tense and anxious.
tips_zh: 按压时配合缓慢深呼吸，吸气4秒、呼气6秒，帮助放松胸腔和情绪。
tips_en: Combine with slow deep breathing — inhale for 4 seconds, exhale for 6 — to relax both your chest and your mind.
caution_zh: 心慌胸痛持续不缓解请立即就医。上背部力度适中即可。
caution_en: Seek immediate medical attention if chest pain or palpitations persist. Use moderate pressure on the upper back.

summary_zh: 缓解咳嗽气喘和肩背酸痛的上背穴位。
summary_en: Eases coughing, wheezing, and upper-back soreness.
location_zh: 在背部，第六胸椎（肩胛骨下角连线再往上约两节）旁开四横指处，脊柱两侧较厚的肌肉上。
location_en: On your upper back, about four finger-widths out from the spine, at the level of the sixth thoracic vertebra — roughly two vertebrae above the line connecting the bottom tips of your shoulder blades.
massage_zh: 此穴在背部自己够不到，可以仰躺将网球放在此处，利用体重缓慢滚压。也可以请人用拇指按揉，力度中等，有酸胀感即可。
massage_en: Lie on your back with a tennis ball placed at this spot and gently roll over it using your body weight. Or ask someone to press with their thumb in slow circles using moderate pressure.
routine_zh: 每次滚压或按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，午后或晚间进行。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily, in the afternoon or evening.
when_zh: 咳嗽不止、呼吸不畅、肩背发紧酸痛、感冒发烧时。
when_en: When you have a persistent cough, tight breathing, stiff upper back, or the onset of a cold with fever.
tips_zh: 配合深呼吸进行按压，吸气时按下、呼气时松开，效果更好。
tips_en: Coordinate with deep breathing — press on the inhale, release on the exhale — for better relief.
caution_zh: 不要用力过猛直接按压脊柱。背部有损伤时避免使用。
caution_en: Do not press directly on the spine or use excessive force. Avoid if the back area is injured.

summary_zh: 缓解打嗝、胸闷和背部僵硬的上背穴位。
summary_en: Relieves hiccups, chest tightness, and mid-back stiffness.
location_zh: 在背部，第七胸椎（低头时脖子后面最突出的那块骨头往下数七节）旁开四横指，肩胛骨下角连线再上约一节处。
location_en: On your back, four finger-widths out from the spine at the level of the seventh thoracic vertebra — roughly one vertebra above the line connecting the bottom corners of your shoulder blades.
massage_zh: 仰躺在网球上滚压此穴位，前后和左右轻微移动，感到酸胀即可。也可以请人用掌根沿脊柱两侧推按。
massage_en: Lie on a tennis ball placed at this point and roll slowly in small movements. Or have someone use the heel of their palm to push along both sides of the spine in this area.
routine_zh: 每次滚压2-3分钟，每天1次，饭后1小时进行为佳。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Best done an hour after eating.
when_zh: 不停打嗝、吃完饭胸口闷堵、背部僵硬不舒服时。
when_en: When hiccups will not stop, your chest feels stuffy after meals, or your mid-back is stiff and uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 打嗝时一边按压一边慢慢喝温水，有助于更快缓解。
tips_en: For hiccups, sip warm water slowly while applying pressure for faster relief.
caution_zh: 饱餐后不要趴下按压，宜仰躺用网球。脊柱病变者慎用。
caution_en: Do not lie face down right after a full meal. Use the tennis ball method lying on your back. Avoid with spinal conditions.

summary_zh: 缓解胁肋胀痛和消化不适的中背穴位。
summary_en: Eases side-rib soreness and digestive discomfort on the mid-back.
location_zh: 在背部，第九胸椎旁开四横指处。大约在肩胛骨下角连线以下两节脊椎的位置，脊柱两侧肌肉上。
location_en: On your mid-back, four finger-widths out from the spine at the level of the ninth thoracic vertebra — about two vertebrae below the bottom tips of your shoulder blades.
massage_zh: 仰躺将网球放在此处，利用身体重量缓慢前后滚压。也可以请人用拇指从脊柱向外侧推按，力度中等。
massage_en: Lie on your back on a tennis ball at this spot and roll gently. Or ask someone to press with their thumb from the spine outward with moderate force.
routine_zh: 每次滚压2-3分钟，每天1次，餐后一小时或睡前。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily, an hour after meals or before bed.
when_zh: 两侧肋骨下方胀痛、拉肚子、消化不好、情绪烦躁时。
when_en: When the area under your ribs feels bloated or sore, you have diarrhea, poor digestion, or feel irritable.
tips_zh: 搭配按揉期门穴（肋骨下缘）效果更好。情绪不好时多做深呼吸。
tips_en: Combine with Qimen (below the ribcage) for better results. Add slow, deep breathing when feeling stressed.
caution_zh: 肋骨骨折或背部受伤时禁用。按压力度不宜过大。
caution_en: Do not use with rib fractures or back injuries. Keep pressure moderate.

summary_zh: 缓解腹泻腹胀和消化不良的中背穴位。
summary_en: Helps with diarrhea, bloating, and indigestion from the mid-back.
location_zh: 在背部，第十胸椎旁开四横指处。大约在肩胛骨下角连线以下三节脊椎的位置。
location_en: On your mid-back, four finger-widths from the spine at the level of the tenth thoracic vertebra — about three vertebrae below the bottom corners of your shoulder blades.
massage_zh: 仰躺在网球上滚压，缓慢调整位置找到酸胀感最明显的点，停留按压。也可以请人用双手拇指同时按揉两侧。
massage_en: Lie on a tennis ball and slowly adjust until you find the most tender spot, then hold. Or ask someone to press both sides simultaneously with their thumbs.
routine_zh: 每次滚压2-3分钟，每天1次，上午或饭后1小时。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily, in the morning or an hour after meals.
when_zh: 肚子咕噜响、拉肚子、消化不好、口渴喝水多时。
when_en: When your stomach gurgles, you have loose stools, poor digestion, or constant thirst.
tips_zh: 消化不好时搭配按揉足三里（膝盖下方），双管齐下效果更好。
tips_en: For digestive issues, combine with Zusanli (below the knee) for stronger results.
caution_zh: 背部皮肤有破损或红肿时不要按压。力度适中即可。
caution_en: Do not press if the skin on your back is broken or inflamed. Use moderate pressure only.

summary_zh: 帮助改善腹胀和消化不良的中背穴位。
summary_en: Improves bloating and indigestion from a mid-back point.
location_zh: 在背部，第十一胸椎旁开四横指处。大约在后腰上方、肋骨最下缘的水平位置。
location_en: On your mid-back, four finger-widths from the spine at the level of the eleventh thoracic vertebra — roughly at the height of your lowest ribs.
massage_zh: 仰躺用网球滚压，小幅度前后移动寻找酸胀点。也可以请人用拇指指腹按揉，力度以舒适的酸胀为宜。
massage_en: Lie on a tennis ball and make small rolling movements to find the tender point. Or have someone press with their thumb pad — aim for a comfortable deep ache.
routine_zh: 每次滚压或按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，饭后1小时。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily, an hour after eating.
when_zh: 腹胀肚子鼓鼓的、恶心想吐、拉肚子、背部酸痛时。
when_en: When your belly feels bloated, you are nauseous, have diarrhea, or your back aches.
tips_zh: 饭后散步10分钟再按揉此穴，对消化帮助更大。
tips_en: Take a 10-minute walk after meals before pressing this point for better digestive support.
caution_zh: 刚吃完饭不要立刻按压。脊柱有问题者轻按或避免。
caution_en: Do not press right after eating. Use very light pressure or skip if you have spinal problems.

summary_zh: 缓解胃痛腹胀和脊背酸痛的中下背穴位。
summary_en: Eases stomach pain, bloating, and mid-back soreness.
location_zh: 在背部，第十二胸椎（最下面一根肋骨对应的脊椎）旁开四横指处，腰部与背部交界区域。
location_en: On your back at the transition between mid-back and lower back, four finger-widths from the spine at the level of the twelfth thoracic vertebra — at the height of your lowest rib.
massage_zh: 仰躺在网球上，将球放在后背与腰部交界处，利用体重缓慢滚压。也可以请人用掌根按揉，力度中等偏重。
massage_en: Lie on a tennis ball at the spot where your mid-back meets your lower back and roll gently. Or ask someone to press with the heel of their palm using moderate-firm pressure.
routine_zh: 每次滚压2-3分钟，每天1次，饭后1小时为宜。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily, ideally an hour after meals.
when_zh: 胃痛、腹胀、小孩吃多了不消化、后背酸痛时。
when_en: When you have stomach pain, feel bloated, experience indigestion, or your back aches.
tips_zh: 胃不舒服时搭配按揉中脘穴（肚脐上方），前后呼应效果更好。
tips_en: For stomach trouble, combine with Zhongwan (above the navel) to address the issue from both front and back.
caution_zh: 胃痛剧烈时请就医，不要仅靠按揉。背部受伤时避免。
caution_en: See a doctor for severe stomach pain — do not rely on massage alone. Avoid if your back is injured.

summary_zh: 缓解腹痛便秘和腰部不适的上腰穴位。
summary_en: Helps relieve abdominal pain, constipation, and lower-back discomfort.
location_zh: 在腰部，第一腰椎旁开四横指处。大约在最下面一根肋骨下方一寸（一个拇指宽），脊柱外侧肌肉上。
location_en: On your lower back, four finger-widths from the spine at the first lumbar vertebra — about one thumb-width below your lowest rib, on the thick muscle beside the spine.
massage_zh: 仰躺将网球放在此处缓慢滚压，也可以双手握拳用指关节上下搓揉腰部两侧，搓到发热为佳。
massage_en: Lie on a tennis ball at this spot and roll gently. Or make fists and rub your knuckles up and down on both sides of your lower back until the area feels warm.
routine_zh: 每次按揉或搓热3-5分钟，每天1次，晚间为佳。
routine_en: 3 to 5 minutes per session, once daily, preferably in the evening.
when_zh: 肚子痛、便秘好几天没上厕所、腰部酸胀不适时。
when_en: When you have belly pain, have not had a bowel movement in days, or your lower back feels achy and tight.
tips_zh: 便秘时搭配顺时针揉肚子（以肚脐为中心），内外配合更有效。
tips_en: For constipation, also rub your abdomen clockwise around the navel. Working both front and back is more effective.
caution_zh: 腰椎间盘突出急性期避免用力按压。孕妇禁用。
caution_en: Avoid forceful pressure during acute disc herniation. Do not use during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 改善腰酸乏力、增强活力的腰部重要穴位。
summary_en: A key lumbar point that eases back fatigue and boosts vitality.
location_zh: 在腰部，第二腰椎旁开四横指处。双手叉腰，拇指按在胯骨最高点，从那里往上约一寸，脊柱外侧就是此穴。
location_en: On your lower back, four finger-widths from the spine at the second lumbar vertebra. Place hands on hips, thumbs on hip bones — the point is about one thumb-width above that level, beside the spine.
massage_zh: 双手握拳放在腰部两侧，用指关节上下搓揉此穴，搓到腰部发热。也可以用掌心按住后腰快速上下摩擦。
massage_en: Place your fists on both sides of your lower back and rub your knuckles up and down over this area until it feels warm. You can also press your palms flat and rub briskly.
routine_zh: 每次搓揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，早晚各一次最佳。
routine_en: 3 to 5 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Morning and evening is ideal.
when_zh: 腰酸腿软、精力不足、长时间站坐后腰部僵硬、小便不畅时。
when_en: When your lower back aches, you feel low on energy, your back stiffens after sitting or standing, or you have urinary difficulty.
tips_zh: 搓完腰部后再按揉太溪穴（内踝后方），上下搭配效果更好。
tips_en: After warming your lower back, press Taixi (behind the inner ankle) for a complementary top-and-bottom boost.
caution_zh: 腰椎严重疾病者请先咨询医生。经期女性力度宜轻。
caution_en: Consult a doctor first if you have serious spinal conditions. Use lighter pressure during menstruation.

summary_zh: 缓解小便不畅、腹胀便秘和腰骶酸痛。
summary_en: Helps with urinary difficulty, bloating, constipation, and sacral soreness.
location_zh: 在臀部上方，骶骨（尾椎上方的三角形扁骨）第二个孔的水平线上，脊柱正中旁开四横指处。大约在臀部最上方的位置。
location_en: On your upper buttock area, four finger-widths out from the midline of the sacrum, level with the second sacral opening — roughly at the very top of the buttock.
massage_zh: 仰躺将网球放在臀部上方此处，利用身体重量滚压。也可以用拇指按揉或者双手握拳敲打此区域。
massage_en: Lie on your back with a tennis ball under your upper buttock at this point and roll gently. Or use your thumb to press, or tap the area with loose fists.
routine_zh: 每次滚压或按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，下午或晚间。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily, in the afternoon or evening.
when_zh: 小便不顺畅、腹胀便秘、久坐后腰骶部酸痛时。
when_en: When urination feels incomplete, you are constipated or bloated, or your lower back and sacrum ache after sitting.
tips_zh: 搭配按揉中极穴（肚脐下方四横指），对改善小便不畅更有帮助。
tips_en: Combine with Zhongji (four finger-widths below the navel) for better urinary support.
caution_zh: 骶骨区域有损伤或炎症时避免按压。孕妇禁用。
caution_en: Avoid if the sacral area is injured or inflamed. Do not use during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解腰腿痛和坐骨不适的臀部重要穴位。
summary_en: A key buttock point that eases lower-back and leg pain.
location_zh: 在臀部，尾骨旁开四横指处。摸到尾骨尖端后，水平往外量四横指，在臀部肌肉深处。按下去会有明显的酸胀感，可能向腿部传导。
location_en: On your buttock, four finger-widths out from the tip of the tailbone. Press into the deep buttock muscle — you will feel a strong ache that may travel down your leg.
massage_zh: 仰躺在网球上，把球放在臀部此处，利用体重缓慢滚压，找到最酸胀的点后停留按压30秒。也可以侧躺用拇指用力按揉。
massage_en: Lie on a tennis ball placed under this spot. Roll slowly to find the sorest point, then hold for 30 seconds. You can also lie on your side and press with your thumb using firm pressure.
routine_zh: 每次滚压3-5分钟，每天1次，久坐后或运动前后。
routine_en: 3 to 5 minutes per session, once daily. Great after sitting or before and after exercise.
when_zh: 腰腿痛、久坐后臀部僵硬、走路时腿发麻、便秘痔疮不适时。
when_en: When your lower back or legs hurt, your buttocks are stiff from sitting, your legs tingle while walking, or you have hemorrhoid discomfort.
tips_zh: 搭配按揉环跳穴（臀部外侧），两个穴位一起按对腰腿痛效果更全面。
tips_en: Combine with Huantiao (outer buttock) for more complete lower-back and leg pain relief.
caution_zh: 坐骨神经痛严重时请就医。孕妇禁用。
caution_en: See a doctor for severe sciatica. Do not use during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解小腿酸痛和腰背不适的膝后穴位。
summary_en: Eases calf soreness and lower-back pain below the knee crease.
location_zh: 在小腿后面，膝盖后方横纹往下三横指，小腿肚两块肌肉之间的凹陷处。按下去有明显酸胀感。
location_en: On the back of your lower leg, three finger-widths below the knee crease, in the groove between the two calf muscles. Press and you will feel a clear ache.
massage_zh: 坐着翘腿，用双手拇指叠放按压此穴，力度中等偏重，缓慢揉按。也可以用拇指从膝后向下推按到小腿中段。
massage_en: Sit and cross one leg over the other. Stack both thumbs and press this point with moderate-firm pressure, kneading slowly. You can also slide your thumb down from behind the knee.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每侧各一次，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per leg, once or twice daily.
when_zh: 小腿酸痛、腰背不舒服、长时间走路后腿累、腿部抽筋时。
when_en: When your calves ache, your lower back hurts, your legs are tired from walking, or you get leg cramps.
tips_zh: 按完此穴后从上往下推按整条小腿后侧，帮助放松整个小腿肌肉。
tips_en: After pressing this point, stroke down the entire back of your calf to relax the whole muscle group.
caution_zh: 膝后有静脉曲张时避免按压。力度不宜过猛。
caution_en: Avoid if you have varicose veins behind the knee. Do not use excessive force.

summary_zh: 缓解小腿抽筋和腿部疲劳的小腿肚穴位。
summary_en: Relieves calf cramps and leg fatigue in the belly of the calf.
location_zh: 在小腿后面正中，膝盖后方横纹往下约七横指（大约小腿后面中段偏上），小腿肚最鼓的地方，两块肌肉之间。
location_en: On the back of your calf, midway between the knee crease and the midpoint of the calf, right in the thickest part of the calf muscle between the two muscle bellies.
massage_zh: 坐着把脚搁在对侧膝盖上，用拇指按揉小腿肚最鼓的地方，力度中等，有酸胀感即可。也可以用掌心揉捏整个小腿肚。
massage_en: Sit and rest your ankle on the opposite knee. Press your thumb into the thickest part of the calf and knead with moderate pressure. You can also squeeze the whole calf with your palm.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每侧各一次，每天1次。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per leg, once daily.
when_zh: 小腿抽筋、久站久走后腿部沉重、腰背酸痛、痔疮不适时。
when_en: When your calf cramps, your legs feel heavy after standing or walking, your back aches, or you have hemorrhoid discomfort.
tips_zh: 抽筋时先轻轻拉伸小腿，然后再按揉此穴，缓解更快。
tips_en: If cramping, gently stretch the calf first, then massage this point for faster relief.
caution_zh: 小腿有血栓风险时禁止按揉。急性拉伤时避免按压。
caution_en: Do not massage if you suspect a blood clot. Avoid during acute muscle strain.

summary_zh: 缓解小腿抽筋和痔疮不适的经典小腿穴位。
summary_en: A classic calf point for cramps, leg fatigue, and hemorrhoid relief.
location_zh: 在小腿后面，踮脚时小腿肚肌肉下方会出现一个人字形凹陷，凹陷的尖端就是此穴。或者膝盖后方横纹到外踝尖连线的正中点。
location_en: On the back of your calf. Stand on tiptoe — a V-shaped groove appears below the calf muscle. The point is at the tip of that V. Or find the midpoint between the knee crease and the outer ankle bone.
massage_zh: 坐着用拇指用力按压凹陷处，力度偏重，有强烈酸胀感为佳。也可以翘腿后用对侧膝盖顶压此穴。按揉时缓慢做圆圈动作。
massage_en: Sit and press firmly into the groove with your thumb — you should feel a strong, deep ache. Or cross your legs and use the opposite knee to press into the point. Make slow circles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每侧各一次，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 3 to 5 minutes per leg, once or twice daily.
when_zh: 小腿抽筋、久站后腿酸胀、便秘、痔疮不适、脚踝扭伤恢复期。
when_en: When your calf cramps, legs feel swollen after standing, you are constipated, have hemorrhoids, or are recovering from an ankle sprain.
tips_zh: 运动后按揉此穴配合拉伸小腿，可以有效预防抽筋和肌肉酸痛。
tips_en: Press this point after exercise along with calf stretches to prevent cramps and soreness.
caution_zh: 小腿肿胀疑似血栓时禁止按揉，请立即就医。
caution_en: Do not massage if your calf is swollen and you suspect a blood clot — seek medical help immediately.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛鼻塞和小腿疲劳的外侧小腿穴位。
summary_en: Eases headaches, nasal congestion, and outer-calf fatigue.
location_zh: 在小腿外后方，承山穴（小腿肚人字凹陷处）再往下一横指偏外侧，小腿外侧肌肉与跟腱交界的位置。
location_en: On the outer back of your lower leg, one finger-width below and to the outside of Chengshan, where the outer calf muscle meets the Achilles tendon area.
massage_zh: 坐着用拇指按揉此穴，力度中等，做小圆圈揉动。也可以从承山穴沿小腿外侧向下推按到此穴。
massage_en: Sit and press with your thumb using moderate pressure in small circles. You can also slide your thumb down from Chengshan along the outer calf to this point.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每侧各一次，每天1次。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per leg, once daily.
when_zh: 头痛、鼻塞流涕、腰痛、小腿外侧酸胀、走路腿没力气时。
when_en: When you have a headache, stuffy nose, lower-back pain, outer calf soreness, or your legs feel weak while walking.
tips_zh: 感冒鼻塞时搭配按揉迎香穴（鼻翼旁），上下搭配通鼻更快。
tips_en: For a stuffy nose, combine with Yingxiang (beside the nostril) to clear congestion from both ends.
caution_zh: 小腿有静脉曲张时轻按或避免。急性扭伤时不要按。
caution_en: Use light pressure or skip if you have varicose veins. Avoid during acute sprains.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛和脚踝肿痛的外踝上方穴位。
summary_en: Relieves headaches and ankle swelling above the outer ankle.
location_zh: 在小腿外后方，外踝尖直上四横指，跟腱外侧和腓骨之间的凹陷处。
location_en: On the outer back of your lower leg, four finger-widths straight up from the tip of the outer ankle bone, in the groove between the Achilles tendon and the fibula bone.
massage_zh: 坐着用拇指按住凹陷处，向骨面方向适度按压，缓慢揉动。力度中等，有酸胀感即可。
massage_en: Sit and press your thumb into the groove toward the bone. Use moderate pressure and knead slowly until you feel a dull ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每侧各一次，每天1次。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per leg, once daily.
when_zh: 头痛、腰骶酸痛、脚踝扭伤恢复期肿胀、小腿外侧不舒服时。
when_en: When you have a headache, sacral pain, lingering ankle swelling from a past sprain, or outer calf discomfort.
tips_zh: 脚踝恢复期搭配按揉昆仑穴（外踝后方），帮助消肿更有效。
tips_en: During ankle recovery, combine with Kunlun (behind the outer ankle) for better swelling reduction.
caution_zh: 脚踝急性扭伤肿胀期不要按，等急性期过后再开始。
caution_en: Do not press during the acute swelling phase of an ankle sprain. Wait until the initial swelling subsides.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛、脖子僵硬和脚踝疼痛的外踝要穴。
summary_en: A key outer-ankle point for headaches, stiff neck, and ankle pain.
location_zh: 在外踝骨尖端和脚后跟那根粗筋（跟腱）之间的凹陷处，大约在两者正中间。按下去有明显酸胀感。
location_en: In the dip between the tip of your outer ankle bone and the Achilles tendon, roughly midway between the two. Press and you will feel a clear ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指和食指分别放在内外踝后方，拇指按压此穴做小圆圈揉动，力度中等偏重。也可以单独用拇指按揉。
massage_en: Place your thumb on this point and index finger behind the inner ankle. Press with moderate-firm thumb pressure in small circles. You can also use your thumb alone.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每侧各一次，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per ankle, once or twice daily.
when_zh: 头痛、脖子僵硬、脚后跟痛、脚踝扭伤恢复期、腰背酸痛时。
when_en: When you have a headache, stiff neck, heel pain, are recovering from an ankle sprain, or your back aches.
tips_zh: 头痛时同时按揉两侧昆仑穴，配合太阳穴按揉效果更好。
tips_en: For headaches, press both Kunlun points at the same time. Add temple massage for stronger relief.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。脚踝急性扭伤红肿期不要按揉。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Avoid during acute ankle sprains with redness and swelling.

summary_zh: 缓解脚后跟痛和足踝不适的跟骨外侧穴位。
summary_en: Eases heel pain and ankle discomfort on the outer heel.
location_zh: 在脚后跟外侧，从昆仑穴（外踝后方凹陷）直接往下，跟骨外侧面上，皮肤颜色深浅交界的地方。
location_en: On the outer side of your heel, directly below Kunlun, on the side of the heel bone where the skin color changes from sole to ankle skin.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按住跟骨外侧面，向骨面方向用力按压，做小幅度揉动。力度中等，以酸胀为度。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad against the outer heel bone surface, pushing toward the bone with moderate pressure. Make small kneading movements until you feel a dull ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每侧各一次，每天1次。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per heel, once daily.
when_zh: 脚后跟疼痛、久站后脚跟酸、脚踝不稳容易扭到、腰部酸痛时。
when_en: When your heel hurts, aches after long standing, your ankle feels unstable, or your lower back is sore.
tips_zh: 脚后跟痛时搭配按揉太溪穴（内踝后方），内外配合效果更好。
tips_en: For heel pain, combine with Taixi (behind the inner ankle) to work both sides of the heel.
caution_zh: 跟骨骨折或严重足底筋膜炎时请就医，不要自行按揉。
caution_en: See a doctor for heel fractures or severe plantar fasciitis — do not self-massage.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛失眠、改善脚踝灵活性的外踝下穴位。
summary_en: Helps with headaches, insomnia, and ankle mobility below the outer ankle.
location_zh: 在外踝骨尖端正下方的凹陷处。用手摸到外踝最突出的点，直接往下滑，手指会落入一个小窝。
location_en: In the dip directly below the tip of your outer ankle bone. Slide your finger straight down from the most prominent point of the outer ankle until it drops into a small hollow.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按住凹陷处，力度中等，缓慢做小圆圈揉动。这个穴位不需要太大力就有感觉。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad into the hollow with moderate pressure and make slow, small circles. This point responds well to gentle pressure — no need to push hard.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每侧各一次，每天1-2次，睡前为佳。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per ankle, once or twice daily. Best done before bed.
when_zh: 头痛头晕、晚上睡不着、白天总犯困、腰腿痛、脚踝活动不灵活时。
when_en: When you have headaches, dizziness, insomnia, daytime drowsiness, leg pain, or stiff ankles.
tips_zh: 失眠时搭配按揉照海穴（内踝下方），一外一内配合安神效果更好。
tips_en: For insomnia, pair with Zhaohai (below the inner ankle) — pressing both inner and outer ankle points calms the mind more effectively.
caution_zh: 脚踝急性扭伤时避免按压。力度不宜过重。
caution_en: Avoid during acute ankle sprains. Keep pressure moderate.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛和足踝肿痛的足背外侧穴位。
summary_en: Eases headaches and outer foot or ankle pain.
location_zh: 在脚背外侧，外踝前方往下摸到一块突起的骨头（第五跖骨粗隆），骨头后方的凹陷处。
location_en: On the outer edge of your foot, feel for the bony bump below and in front of the outer ankle (fifth metatarsal tuberosity). The point is in the dip just behind that bump.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按住凹陷处，向骨面方向适度按压，做小幅度揉动。力度中等偏轻。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad into the dip toward the bone with moderate-light pressure and make small rubbing movements.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每侧各一次，每天1次。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes per foot, once daily.
when_zh: 头痛、脚外侧肿痛、走路脚踝不舒服、小腿外侧酸痛时。
when_en: When you have a headache, the outer edge of your foot is sore, your ankle hurts while walking, or your outer calf aches.
tips_zh: 脚外侧不适时沿足背外缘从此穴推按到束骨穴，效果更全面。
tips_en: For outer foot discomfort, slide your thumb from this point forward to Shugu along the outer foot edge for broader relief.
caution_zh: 脚部骨折或严重扭伤时不要按揉。痛风发作时避免。
caution_en: Do not press if you have a foot fracture or severe sprain. Avoid during gout flares.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛、颈项僵硬和足外侧痛的足部穴位。
summary_en: Relieves headaches, stiff neck, and outer foot pain.
location_zh: 在脚外侧，沿小脚趾一侧往脚跟方向摸，第五跖骨中段外侧有一块明显突起的骨头，骨头前下方凹陷处，肤色深浅交界处。
location_en: On the outer edge of your foot, slide along the little-toe side toward the heel. Find the prominent bony bump at the midshaft of the fifth metatarsal — the point is in the dip just in front of and below this bump, where the skin color changes.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按在骨头前下方的凹陷处，向骨面适度按压，做小圆圈揉动。力度中等。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad into the dip in front of the bony bump, pushing toward the bone with moderate pressure. Make small circles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每侧各一次，每天1次。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per foot, once daily.
when_zh: 头痛、脖子僵硬转不动、腰腿酸痛、脚外侧不舒服时。
when_en: When you have a headache, your neck is stiff, your back and legs ache, or the outer edge of your foot hurts.
tips_zh: 颈项僵硬时搭配按揉后溪穴（手掌外侧），手脚配合效果更好。
tips_en: For a stiff neck, combine with Houxi (outer edge of the hand) for a stronger hand-and-foot approach.
caution_zh: 脚部有骨折或严重肿胀时不要按揉。力度适中即可。
caution_en: Do not press if your foot is fractured or severely swollen. Keep pressure moderate.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛眩晕和颈项僵痛的小脚趾侧穴位。
summary_en: Eases headaches, dizziness, and neck stiffness near the little toe.
location_zh: 在脚外侧，小脚趾根部关节后方，肤色深浅交界处的凹陷中。轻握脚趾时关节后方会更明显。
location_en: On the outer side of your foot, just behind the base joint of the little toe, where the skin color changes. Curl your toes slightly to make the joint more prominent.
massage_zh: 用拇指指尖按住关节后方凹陷处，适度用力按压揉动。也可以用拇指和食指捏住小脚趾根部两侧来回揉捏。
massage_en: Press your thumb tip into the dip behind the joint with moderate pressure and knead. You can also pinch both sides of the little toe base between your thumb and index finger.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每侧各一次，每天1次。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes per foot, once daily.
when_zh: 头痛头晕、脖子发僵、腰腿酸痛、眼睛不舒服时。
when_en: When you have a headache, dizziness, stiff neck, achy legs, or eye discomfort.
tips_zh: 头痛时搭配按揉太阳穴和风池穴（后脑勺下方），效果更全面。
tips_en: For headaches, combine with temple massage and Fengchi (below the base of the skull) for broader relief.
caution_zh: 小脚趾关节红肿或痛风发作时不要按。力度不宜过重。
caution_en: Avoid if the little toe joint is red, swollen, or during a gout flare. Keep pressure moderate.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛颈僵和鼻出血的小脚趾旁穴位。
summary_en: Helps with headaches, stiff neck, and nosebleeds near the little toe.
location_zh: 在小脚趾根部关节前方，肤色深浅交界处的凹陷中。和束骨穴相邻，一前一后分列小脚趾关节两侧。
location_en: On the outer side of your foot, just in front of the base joint of the little toe, where the skin color changes. It sits right next to Shugu — one in front and one behind the same joint.
massage_zh: 用拇指指尖按住关节前方凹陷处，力度中等偏轻，缓慢按揉。也可以沿小脚趾关节两侧来回推按。
massage_en: Press your thumb tip into the dip in front of the joint with moderate-light pressure and rub slowly. You can also slide back and forth along both sides of the little toe joint.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每侧各一次，每天1次。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes per foot, once daily.
when_zh: 头痛、脖子僵硬疼痛、鼻子出血、精神紧张焦虑时。
when_en: When you have a headache, your neck is stiff and painful, you get a nosebleed, or you feel anxious.
tips_zh: 可以把束骨和足通谷一起按，用拇指沿小脚趾关节前后来回推按。
tips_en: Press Shugu and Zutonggu together by sliding your thumb back and forth across both sides of the little toe joint.
caution_zh: 小脚趾关节有红肿或受伤时不要按。按力宜轻。
caution_en: Avoid if the little toe joint is injured, red, or swollen. Use gentle pressure.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛鼻塞和眼睛不适的小脚趾末端穴位。
summary_en: Relieves headaches, nasal congestion, and eye discomfort at the little toe tip.
location_zh: 在小脚趾指甲根部的外侧角旁，指甲外侧边缘和下缘交汇处往外约一粒米的距离。
location_en: On your little toe, right next to the outer corner of the toenail base. Find where the outer edge and bottom edge of the nail meet, then move just a grain of rice outward.
massage_zh: 用拇指指甲或指尖垂直掐按此穴，力度中等偏重，有刺痛感为宜。每次掐按3-5秒后松开，反复进行。
massage_en: Use your thumbnail or fingertip to press straight down on this point with moderate-firm pressure until you feel a sharp sting. Hold for 3-5 seconds, release, and repeat.
routine_zh: 每次掐按1-2分钟，每天1-2次，不拘时间。
routine_en: Press for 1-2 minutes, once or twice daily, anytime.
when_zh: 头痛、鼻塞流涕、眼睛痛、脑袋昏沉不清醒时。
when_en: When you have a headache, stuffy or runny nose, eye pain, or feel mentally foggy.
tips_zh: 鼻塞时搭配掐按迎香穴（鼻翼两旁），上下配合通鼻效果更快。
tips_en: For nasal congestion, combine with pressing Yingxiang (beside the nostrils) for faster relief working both ends.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。掐按力度适中，避免损伤脚趾皮肤。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Press firmly but carefully to avoid breaking the skin on the toe.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛失眠、提神醒脑的足底要穴。
summary_en: A key point on the sole that eases headaches, insomnia, and mental fatigue.
location_zh: 在脚底前部，弯曲脚趾时脚心出现的最深凹陷处，大约在脚底从趾根到脚跟连线的前三分之一处。按下去会有明显酸胀感。
location_en: On the sole of your foot, curl your toes and find the deepest crease in the front third of your sole. Press in — you will feel a distinct tender spot.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹用力按揉，力度以感到酸胀为宜。可以做小圆圈揉动，也可以上下推按。冬天可以用掌心搓热脚底。
massage_en: Press firmly with your thumb pad and make small circles. You should feel a deep, satisfying ache. In cold weather, you can also rub the sole briskly with your palm to warm it up.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，睡前按效果最好。
routine_en: 3 to 5 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Best done before bed.
when_zh: 头痛头晕、晚上睡不着、精神疲惫、脚底发烫不舒服时。
when_en: When you have a headache, feel dizzy, can not fall asleep, are mentally drained, or your feet feel uncomfortably hot.
tips_zh: 睡前泡脚后再按涌泉效果更佳。搭配按揉太溪穴（内踝后方），助眠效果更好。
tips_en: Soak your feet in warm water first for better results. Combine with Taixi (behind the inner ankle) for deeper relaxation and better sleep.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。脚底有伤口或皮肤病时不要按。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press if there are wounds or skin conditions on the sole.

summary_zh: 缓解咽喉不适和足内侧疼痛的足弓穴位。
summary_en: Relieves sore throat and inner foot pain near the arch.
location_zh: 在脚内侧，足弓最高点下方，皮肤颜色深浅交界的地方。用手摸会感到一块突起的骨头，穴位就在骨头下缘的凹陷处。
location_en: On the inner side of your foot, below the highest point of the arch where the skin changes color. Feel for the bony bump — the point is in the dip just below it.
massage_zh: 用拇指指尖按住凹陷处，稍用力向骨头方向按压，做小幅度揉动。力度中等，有酸胀感即可。
massage_en: Place your thumb tip in the dip and press toward the bone with moderate pressure. Make small rubbing movements until you feel a mild ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，早晚均可。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once or twice daily, morning or evening.
when_zh: 嗓子干痛、脚内侧肿痛、夜里出汗多、口渴喝水多时。
when_en: When you have a dry sore throat, inner foot swelling, night sweats, or are constantly thirsty.
tips_zh: 嗓子痛时搭配按揉太溪穴和照海穴效果更好。多喝温水配合按揉。
tips_en: For sore throats, combine with Taixi and Zhaohai points. Drink warm water afterward for better effect.
caution_zh: 按压力度不宜过大，局部有红肿时避免按揉。
caution_en: Do not press too hard. Avoid if the area is red or swollen.

summary_zh: 补充精力、改善腰酸耳鸣的内踝核心穴位。
summary_en: A vital inner-ankle point that boosts energy and helps with lower-back soreness and tinnitus.
location_zh: 在内踝骨（脚踝内侧突起的圆骨）和后面那根粗筋（跟腱）之间的凹陷处，大约在两者的正中间。按下去能摸到脉搏跳动。
location_en: In the dip between the inner ankle bone and the thick tendon at the back of your ankle, roughly midway. Press in and you may feel a pulse under your finger.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按住凹陷处，缓慢用力按压并小幅度揉动。力度由轻到重，以酸胀但不刺痛为准。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad into the dip and slowly increase pressure while making small circles. Aim for a deep ache — not sharp pain.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，晚上按效果更好。
routine_en: 3 to 5 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Evening is the best time.
when_zh: 腰酸腿软、耳朵嗡嗡响、晚上睡不好、精力不足、脚踝痛时。
when_en: When your lower back aches, you have ringing in your ears, poor sleep, low energy, or ankle pain.
tips_zh: 搭配按揉涌泉穴（脚底）效果更佳。可以先泡脚让脚踝放松后再按。
tips_en: Pair with Yongquan on the sole for a stronger boost. Soaking feet in warm water first helps you find the point more easily.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。局部有伤口或肿胀时不要按。
caution_en: Use with caution during pregnancy. Avoid if the ankle area is injured or swollen.

summary_zh: 缓解脚跟痛和腰背不适的后跟穴位。
summary_en: Eases heel pain and lower-back discomfort near the back of the ankle.
location_zh: 在内踝骨后下方，脚后跟骨头上缘、跟腱前方的凹陷处。从太溪穴往下滑约半个拇指宽就能摸到一个小窝。
location_en: Below and behind the inner ankle bone, in a small dip at the top edge of the heel bone, just in front of the Achilles tendon. Slide down from Taixi about half a thumb-width.
massage_zh: 用拇指指尖按住凹陷处，适度用力按揉，做小圆圈运动。力度中等偏轻，避免按到跟腱。
massage_en: Press your thumb tip into the dip with moderate-light pressure and make small circles. Avoid pressing directly on the Achilles tendon.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，久站久走后按。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Ideal after long standing or walking.
when_zh: 脚后跟疼、久站腰酸、提不起精神、总想躺着时。
when_en: When your heels hurt, your back aches from standing too long, or you feel unusually sluggish and just want to lie down.
tips_zh: 脚跟痛时搭配按涌泉穴和太溪穴一起按，效果更全面。
tips_en: For heel pain, combine with Yongquan and Taixi for a more complete routine.
caution_zh: 跟腱有伤时避免按揉。力度不宜过大。
caution_en: Avoid if the Achilles tendon is injured. Keep pressure gentle.

summary_zh: 缓解经期不适和小便不畅的足跟内侧穴位。
summary_en: Helps with menstrual discomfort and urinary issues on the inner heel.
location_zh: 在内踝骨和脚跟之间，从太溪穴（内踝后方凹陷）直接往下一拇指宽，脚跟骨内侧的凹陷处。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: One thumb-width directly below Taixi, in a dip on the inner side of the heel bone, between the inner ankle and the heel. You will feel a tender ache when you press.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按住凹陷处，向骨面方向用力按压，缓慢揉动。力度中等，经期时可稍轻一些。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad into the dip toward the bone and rub slowly. Use moderate pressure — lighter during your period.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，经期前几天开始按。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Start a few days before your period.
when_zh: 月经不规律、经期肚子痛、小便不通畅、眼睛看东西模糊时。
when_en: When your period is irregular, you have menstrual cramps, difficulty urinating, or blurry vision from fatigue.
tips_zh: 经期不适时搭配按三阴交（小腿内侧）和气海（肚脐下方）效果更好。
tips_en: For menstrual issues, combine with Sanyinjiao (inner calf) and Qihai (below the navel) for better relief.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。经期出血量大时轻按或暂停。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Use very light pressure or skip if menstrual flow is heavy.

summary_zh: 缓解咽喉干痛和失眠的内踝下方穴位。
summary_en: Soothes a dry sore throat and helps with insomnia, located below the inner ankle.
location_zh: 在内踝骨正下方一拇指宽的位置，内踝骨下缘的凹陷处。用手从内踝尖往下推，手指自然滑入一个小窝就是。
location_en: One thumb-width directly below the tip of the inner ankle bone, in the dip under the bone's lower edge. Slide your finger down from the ankle tip until it drops into a hollow.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹轻柔按压凹陷处，做缓慢的小圆圈揉动。力度偏轻柔，不需要很大力就有感觉。
massage_en: Gently press your thumb pad into the hollow and make slow, small circles. This point responds to light pressure — no need to push hard.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，睡前按最佳。
routine_en: 3 to 5 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Most effective before bed.
when_zh: 嗓子干痛、失眠多梦、眼睛干涩发红、月经不调时。
when_en: When your throat is dry and sore, you have trouble sleeping, your eyes are dry and red, or your cycle is off.
tips_zh: 咽喉痛时搭配列缺穴（手腕上方）一起按，效果更显著。睡前配合深呼吸按揉助眠。
tips_en: For sore throats, pair with Lieque on the wrist. Before bed, combine with slow deep breathing for better sleep.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。局部皮肤破损时不要按。
caution_en: Use with caution during pregnancy. Do not press on broken skin.

summary_zh: 调节出汗和减轻腿部浮肿的小腿内侧穴位。
summary_en: Regulates sweating and reduces leg swelling on the inner calf.
location_zh: 在小腿内侧，从内踝骨尖往上量两横指（食指和中指并拢的宽度），跟腱前缘的位置。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: On the inner calf, two finger-widths above the inner ankle bone tip, just in front of the Achilles tendon. You will feel a tender ache when pressing.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹沿着跟腱前缘按揉，力度中等，做上下推揉或小圆圈揉动。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad along the front edge of the tendon and rub up and down or in small circles with moderate pressure.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，下午或傍晚按。
routine_en: 3 to 5 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Afternoon or early evening works best.
when_zh: 出汗太多或太少、腿脚浮肿、拉肚子、腿发沉无力时。
when_en: When you sweat too much or too little, your legs are puffy, you have diarrhea, or your legs feel heavy and weak.
tips_zh: 腿部浮肿时搭配按揉阴陵泉（膝盖下方内侧）效果更好。按后喝一杯温水促进代谢。
tips_en: For puffy legs, combine with Yinlingquan (inner knee). Drink warm water afterward to support fluid balance.
caution_zh: 局部有静脉曲张时避免直接按压。
caution_en: Avoid pressing directly on varicose veins.

summary_zh: 缓解月经不调和腹泻便秘的小腿内侧穴位。
summary_en: Helps with irregular periods and digestive issues on the inner calf.
location_zh: 在小腿内侧，内踝骨尖往上两横指，小腿骨（胫骨）内侧后缘的凹陷处。在复溜穴稍前方，靠近骨头边缘。
location_en: On the inner calf, two finger-widths above the inner ankle bone tip, in the dip behind the inner edge of the shin bone. It is slightly forward from Fuliu, near the bone edge.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按住骨头后缘的凹陷，适中力度按揉，做小幅度的上下推动。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad into the dip behind the shin bone and rub with moderate pressure, using small up-and-down strokes.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，经期前后可增加频率。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Increase frequency around your period.
when_zh: 月经不准时、小腹不舒服、便秘或拉肚子交替出现时。
when_en: When your period is unpredictable, your lower belly feels off, or you alternate between constipation and loose stools.
tips_zh: 月经不调时搭配三阴交穴一起按效果更佳。保持小腿温暖有助于穴位起效。
tips_en: For irregular periods, pair with Sanyinjiao. Keeping your lower legs warm helps this point work better.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。局部皮肤有伤时避免按揉。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Avoid if the skin in this area is broken.

summary_zh: 缓解小腿疼痛和恶心不适的小腿内侧穴位。
summary_en: Eases calf pain and nausea on the inner lower leg.
location_zh: 在小腿内侧，从内踝骨尖往上量约五横指（一手掌宽），小腿肚肌肉和跟腱之间的位置。按下去小腿会有酸胀感。
location_en: On the inner calf, about a palm-width (five finger-widths) above the inner ankle tip, between the calf muscle and the Achilles tendon. Pressing here produces a deep ache in the calf.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按住穴位，中等力度向肌肉深处按压并揉动。也可以用掌根沿小腿内侧上下推揉。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad into the point with moderate depth and rub. You can also use your palm heel to stroke up and down the inner calf.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1次，小腿酸痛时随时按。
routine_en: 3 to 5 minutes per session, once daily. Press anytime your calves feel sore.
when_zh: 小腿酸痛抽筋、恶心想吐、情绪烦躁不安时。
when_en: When your calves cramp or ache, you feel nauseous, or you are restless and irritable.
tips_zh: 小腿痛时搭配承山穴（小腿后侧中间）一起按，缓解效果更好。按前可以先热敷小腿。
tips_en: For calf pain, combine with Chengshan (mid-back of the calf). Apply a warm towel to the calf first for better results.
caution_zh: 小腿有深静脉血栓风险时禁止按揉。力度不要过猛。
caution_en: Do not massage if there is a risk of deep vein thrombosis. Avoid excessive force.

summary_zh: 缓解膝盖内侧痛和泌尿不适的膝窝穴位。
summary_en: Relieves inner knee pain and urinary discomfort behind the knee.
location_zh: 弯曲膝盖成直角，在膝盖后方内侧，膝窝横纹的内侧端，能摸到两根筋，穴位在两筋之间。按下去明显酸胀。
location_en: Bend your knee to 90 degrees. Feel the inner end of the crease behind your knee — find two tendons and press between them. You will feel a clear tender ache.
massage_zh: 膝盖弯曲放松，用拇指指腹按住两筋之间的凹陷，中等力度按揉。也可以用四指并拢轻轻揉按膝窝内侧。
massage_en: With your knee bent and relaxed, press your thumb pad between the two tendons with moderate pressure and rub. Or use four fingers together to gently knead the inner knee crease.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，久坐后按效果好。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Especially helpful after prolonged sitting.
when_zh: 膝盖内侧酸痛、小便不畅、腰酸腿软、久坐膝盖僵硬时。
when_en: When the inner side of your knee aches, urination feels incomplete, your lower back is sore, or your knees feel stiff from sitting.
tips_zh: 膝盖不适时搭配按揉阴陵泉和血海穴效果更全面。按完可以轻轻活动膝关节。
tips_en: For knee trouble, combine with Yinlingquan and Xuehai. Gently move your knee joint after massaging.
caution_zh: 膝盖后方有肿胀或受伤时不要按。力度要轻柔。
caution_en: Do not press if the back of your knee is swollen or injured. Use gentle pressure only.

summary_zh: 缓解小腹胀痛和泌尿不适的下腹穴位。
summary_en: Eases lower abdominal bloating and urinary discomfort in the lower belly.
location_zh: 在小腹最下方，肚脐正下方约一手掌（五横指）的距离，再往旁边半个拇指宽的位置。靠近耻骨上缘，按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: At the very bottom of the belly, about a palm-width below the navel, then half a thumb-width to the side. Near the top edge of the pubic bone. Pressing yields a deep ache.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松腹部，用中指或食指指腹轻柔按压，做缓慢的小圆圈揉动。力度要轻，这个区域比较敏感。
massage_en: Lie on your back with your belly relaxed. Use your middle or index fingertip to gently press and make slow small circles. Keep the pressure light — this is a sensitive area.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，早晨起床前按。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Best done in the morning before getting up.
when_zh: 小腹胀痛、小便不顺畅、尿频尿急时。
when_en: When your lower belly feels bloated and achy, or you have urinary urgency or difficulty.
tips_zh: 搭配按揉关元穴（肚脐下三寸）和气海穴效果更好。按前先搓热双手暖腹。
