tips_en: Combine with Guanyuan and Qihai (both below the navel). Warm your hands by rubbing them together before pressing on the belly.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。饭后一小时内不要按腹部穴位。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Avoid pressing abdominal points within one hour after eating.

summary_zh: 改善生殖系统不适的下腹穴位。
summary_en: Supports reproductive health in the lower abdomen.
location_zh: 在小腹部，肚脐正下方四横指的距离，再往旁边半个拇指宽。比横骨穴高约一横指。按下去有深层酸胀感。
location_en: On the lower belly, four finger-widths below the navel and half a thumb-width to the side. About one finger-width above Henggu. Pressing produces a deep ache.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松，用食指或中指指腹轻轻按压并揉动，力度要柔和，配合腹式呼吸慢慢按揉。
massage_en: Lie on your back, relax your belly, and gently press with your index or middle finger while breathing slowly into your abdomen. Keep the pressure soft.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，睡前按为宜。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Best before bed.
when_zh: 生殖系统不舒服、白带异常、小腹冷痛时。
when_en: When you experience reproductive discomfort, unusual discharge, or cold aching in the lower belly.
tips_zh: 小腹冷痛时先用热水袋暖腹再按揉。搭配关元穴一起按效果更好。
tips_en: If your lower belly feels cold, warm it with a hot water bottle first. Combine with Guanyuan for stronger relief.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。月经量大时暂停按揉。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Pause if menstrual flow is heavy.

summary_zh: 调理月经、缓解小腹腰背痛的下腹穴位。
summary_en: Helps regulate periods and ease lower belly and back pain.
location_zh: 在小腹部，肚脐正下方三横指的距离，再往旁边半个拇指宽。和关元穴差不多高，偏外侧一点。按压有酸胀感。
location_en: On the lower belly, three finger-widths below the navel and half a thumb-width to the side. Nearly level with Guanyuan but slightly lateral. Tender when pressed.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松腹部，用中指指腹轻柔按揉，做缓慢圆圈运动。力度轻到中等，配合深呼吸。
massage_en: Lie down with your belly relaxed. Use your middle fingertip to press gently and make slow circles. Light to moderate pressure, paired with deep breathing.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，经期前一周开始按。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Start one week before your expected period.
when_zh: 月经不调、白带多、备孕调理、小腹连着腰背一起酸痛时。
when_en: When your cycle is irregular, you have increased discharge, are preparing for conception, or lower belly pain radiates to your back.
tips_zh: 搭配按揉关元穴和三阴交穴，调理月经效果更佳。可以在腹部敷热毛巾后再按。
tips_en: Pair with Guanyuan and Sanyinjiao for cycle regulation. Apply a warm towel to your belly first for a better experience.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。腹部有炎症或急性疼痛时不要按。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Avoid if you have abdominal inflammation or acute pain.

summary_zh: 缓解腹胀水肿和月经不调的脐下穴位。
summary_en: Relieves bloating, water retention, and menstrual irregularity below the navel.
location_zh: 在小腹部，肚脐正下方两横指的距离，再往旁边半个拇指宽。按下去有轻微酸胀感。
location_en: On the lower belly, two finger-widths below the navel and half a thumb-width to the side. A mild tender ache when pressed.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松，用食指和中指并拢按压穴位，轻柔地做顺时针方向的圆圈揉动。
massage_en: Lie on your back, press with your index and middle fingers together, and rub gently in clockwise circles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，饭后一小时以上再按。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Wait at least one hour after meals.
when_zh: 肚子胀气、身体浮肿、月经不规律、腹痛拉肚子时。
when_en: When you feel bloated, your body retains water, your period is irregular, or you have belly pain with diarrhea.
tips_zh: 腹胀时搭配天枢穴（肚脐旁两寸）一起按效果更好。按完顺时针揉肚子帮助消化。
tips_en: For bloating, combine with Tianshu (beside the navel). Follow up by rubbing your belly clockwise to aid digestion.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。腹部刚做过手术时不要按。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Avoid after recent abdominal surgery.

summary_zh: 缓解便秘腹痛和月经不调的脐下穴位。
summary_en: Helps with constipation, belly pain, and irregular periods just below the navel.
location_zh: 在小腹部，肚脐正下方一横指的距离，再往旁边半个拇指宽。紧挨肚脐下方，按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: On the lower belly, one finger-width below the navel and half a thumb-width to the side. Just below the navel — tender when pressed.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松，用中指指腹轻柔按压，缓慢揉动。可以配合另一只手轻轻覆盖在上面增加温度。
massage_en: Lie down relaxed, press gently with your middle finger, and rub slowly. You can place your other hand on top for added warmth.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，晨起或睡前按。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Morning or bedtime.
when_zh: 便秘排不出、小腹隐隐作痛、月经推迟或提前时。
when_en: When you are constipated, have a dull ache in your lower belly, or your period comes early or late.
tips_zh: 便秘时搭配天枢穴和大横穴一起按，促进肠道蠕动。多喝温水配合。
tips_en: For constipation, combine with Tianshu and Daheng. Drink warm water alongside the massage to encourage bowel movement.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。急性腹痛原因不明时不要自行按揉。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Avoid self-massage if you have unexplained acute abdominal pain.

summary_zh: 缓解肚脐周围腹痛和便秘的穴位。
summary_en: Eases belly pain and constipation right beside the navel.
location_zh: 在腹部，肚脐正旁边半个拇指宽的位置。左右各一个。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: On the belly, half a thumb-width to either side of the navel. There is one on each side. Pressing produces a mild ache.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松，用双手中指分别按住肚脐两侧的穴位，轻柔同时按揉，做小圆圈运动。
massage_en: Lie on your back and use both middle fingers to press the points on each side of the navel simultaneously. Rub gently in small circles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，早晨起床时按。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Best in the morning upon waking.
when_zh: 肚脐周围胀痛、便秘不通、腹部发凉、月经痛时。
when_en: When you have pain or bloating around the navel, constipation, a cold feeling in the belly, or menstrual cramps.
tips_zh: 搭配顺时针揉腹和按天枢穴，改善便秘效果明显。可以先用热毛巾暖腹。
tips_en: Combine with clockwise belly rubbing and Tianshu for constipation. Warm your belly with a hot towel first.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。饭后一小时内勿按。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Wait at least one hour after eating.

summary_zh: 缓解上腹胀痛、腹泻和便秘的腹部穴位。
summary_en: Relieves upper belly pain, diarrhea, and constipation.
location_zh: 在上腹部，肚脐正上方两横指的距离，再往旁边半个拇指宽。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: On the upper belly, two finger-widths above the navel and half a thumb-width to the side. Tender when pressed.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松腹部，用食指或中指指腹轻柔按压，做缓慢的顺时针小圆圈揉动。力度轻柔。
massage_en: Lie on your back with a relaxed belly. Press gently with your index or middle finger and make slow clockwise circles. Keep it light.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，两餐之间按。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Best between meals.
when_zh: 肚子胀痛、拉肚子、便秘、消化不好有积食感时。
when_en: When your belly hurts and feels bloated, you have diarrhea, constipation, or a lingering sense of undigested food.
tips_zh: 消化不好时搭配按中脘穴（肚脐上四寸）和足三里穴效果更好。饭后散步也有帮助。
tips_en: For digestion, pair with Zhongwan (above the navel) and Zusanli. A short walk after meals also helps.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。饭后一小时内不要按。腹部有急性病变时禁用。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy or within one hour of eating. Avoid with acute abdominal conditions.

summary_zh: 缓解腹痛便秘的上腹穴位，也有助于调理生育功能。
summary_en: Eases belly pain and constipation, and supports reproductive wellness.
location_zh: 在上腹部，肚脐正上方三横指的距离，再往旁边半个拇指宽。按压有酸胀感，可能向腹部深处传导。
location_en: On the upper belly, three finger-widths above the navel and half a thumb-width to the side. Pressing may produce an ache that radiates deeper into the belly.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松，用中指指腹轻柔按压并揉动，力度从轻到中，配合呼气时加力、吸气时放松。
massage_en: Lie on your back, press gently with your middle finger, and rub. Increase pressure as you exhale, ease off as you inhale.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，下午或傍晚按。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Afternoon or early evening.
when_zh: 腹部闷痛、便秘多日、备孕调理时。
when_en: When your belly feels stuffy and achy, you have been constipated for days, or you are preparing for conception.
tips_zh: 便秘时搭配天枢穴和大肠俞穴效果更好。平时多吃蔬果、多喝水配合。
tips_en: For constipation, combine with Tianshu and Dachangshu. Eat more fiber and stay hydrated alongside the massage.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。上腹部有急性疼痛时不要自行按揉。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Avoid self-massage with acute upper abdominal pain.

summary_zh: 缓解腹胀肠鸣和消化不适的上腹穴位。
summary_en: Relieves upper belly bloating, gurgling, and digestive discomfort.
location_zh: 在上腹部，肚脐正上方四横指的距离，再往旁边半个拇指宽。大约在肚脐和胸骨下端的中间位置偏下。
location_en: On the upper belly, four finger-widths above the navel and half a thumb-width to the side. Roughly midway between the navel and the bottom of the breastbone, slightly lower.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松，用食指和中指并拢，轻柔按压并做顺时针小圆圈揉动。力度轻柔，不要用力过猛。
massage_en: Lie on your back, press gently with your index and middle fingers together, and rub in small clockwise circles. Keep it gentle.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，饭后1-2小时按。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Best 1 to 2 hours after meals.
when_zh: 肚子胀气、肠子咕噜咕噜响、腹痛不舒服时。
when_en: When your belly feels gassy, your stomach gurgles loudly, or you have a general abdominal discomfort.
tips_zh: 腹胀时搭配按中脘穴和足三里穴效果更好。饭后慢走十分钟也很有帮助。
tips_en: For bloating, pair with Zhongwan and Zusanli. A ten-minute slow walk after meals also helps.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。饭后一小时内勿按。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Wait at least one hour after eating.

summary_zh: 缓解腹胀呕吐和消化不良的上腹穴位。
summary_en: Eases bloating, nausea, and indigestion in the upper belly.
location_zh: 在上腹部，肚脐正上方五横指（约一手掌宽）的距离，再往旁边半个拇指宽。靠近胃的位置。
location_en: On the upper belly, a palm-width (five finger-widths) above the navel and half a thumb-width to the side. Near the stomach area.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松，用中指指腹轻按穴位，缓慢揉动。力度偏轻，胃部区域不宜用力过大。
massage_en: Lie on your back and gently press with your middle finger, rubbing slowly. Keep the pressure light — the stomach area is sensitive.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，两餐之间按为宜。
routine_en: 2 to 3 minutes per session, once daily. Best between meals.
when_zh: 吃多了肚子胀、恶心想吐、消化不良有积食感时。
when_en: When you have eaten too much and feel bloated, nauseous, or like food is sitting in your stomach.
tips_zh: 恶心时搭配按内关穴（手腕内侧上两寸）止吐效果更好。喝一杯温热的姜茶也有帮助。
tips_en: For nausea, combine with Neiguan on the inner wrist. Sipping warm ginger tea also helps settle the stomach.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。饭后一小时内不按。胃部有严重疾病时就医。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Wait one hour after eating. See a doctor for serious stomach conditions.

summary_zh: 缓解上腹胀痛、恶心呕吐的胃脘旁穴位。
summary_en: Relieves upper stomach pain, bloating, nausea, and vomiting.
location_zh: 在上腹部，肚脐正上方六横指的距离，再往旁边半个拇指宽。大约在胸骨最下端（剑突）下方一点点旁边。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: On the upper belly, six finger-widths above the navel and half a thumb-width to the side. Roughly just below the bottom tip of the breastbone, to the side. Tender on pressure.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松，用中指指腹轻轻按压穴位，缓慢揉动。这个位置靠近胃，力度一定要轻柔。
massage_en: Lie on your back and press gently with your middle finger, rubbing slowly. This is close to the stomach, so always use light, careful pressure.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，两餐之间按。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes per session, once daily. Between meals.
when_zh: 胃胀痛不消化、恶心呕吐、吃完东西不舒服、拉肚子时。
when_en: When your stomach aches and feels bloated, you are nauseous or vomiting, feel unwell after eating, or have diarrhea.
tips_zh: 胃不舒服时搭配中脘穴和内关穴一起按效果更好。少食多餐、细嚼慢咽配合调理。
tips_en: For stomach trouble, combine with Zhongwan and Neiguan. Eating smaller meals and chewing slowly also supports recovery.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。饭后一小时内不按。持续呕吐请及时就医。
caution_en: Do not use during pregnancy. Wait one hour after meals. Seek medical care for persistent vomiting.

summary_zh: 缓解胸闷咳嗽和呼吸不畅的胸部穴位。
summary_en: Eases chest tightness, coughing, and shortness of breath.
location_zh: 在胸部，沿着胸骨（胸口正中的骨头）往旁边量约两横指宽，在第5根肋骨下方的缝隙里。大约在乳头下方一个肋骨间隙的位置。
location_en: On the chest, about two finger-widths out from the center of the breastbone, in the space below the fifth rib. Roughly one rib-space below the nipple level.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹轻轻按压肋骨间隙，做小圆圈揉动。胸部穴位力度一定要轻，感到微微酸胀即可。
massage_en: Use your index or middle fingertip to gently press into the space between the ribs and make small circles. Chest points require light pressure — stop at a mild ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，感到胸闷时随时按。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Press anytime you feel chest tightness.
when_zh: 胸口憋闷、咳嗽气喘、深呼吸困难、恶心想吐时。
when_en: When your chest feels tight, you are coughing or wheezing, have trouble taking a deep breath, or feel nauseous.
tips_zh: 胸闷时搭配按膻中穴（两乳头连线中点）和内关穴，舒胸效果更好。配合深呼吸练习。
tips_en: For chest tightness, combine with Danzhong (center of the chest) and Neiguan. Practice slow deep breathing alongside.
caution_zh: 力度必须轻柔。胸部有外伤或骨折时禁用。
caution_en: Always use gentle pressure. Do not use if you have chest injuries or rib fractures.

summary_zh: 缓解咳嗽胸闷和乳房胀痛的胸部穴位。
summary_en: Relieves coughing, chest tightness, and breast tenderness.
location_zh: 在胸部，沿胸骨往旁边量约两横指宽，在第4根肋骨下方的缝隙里。大约在乳头同一水平线上，靠近胸骨的位置。
location_en: On the chest, about two finger-widths from the breastbone center, in the space below the fourth rib. Roughly at nipple level, closer to the breastbone.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹轻按肋间缝隙，做小幅度圆圈揉动。力度要轻，有微微酸感就够了。
massage_en: Gently press your fingertip into the space between the ribs and make small circles. A faint ache is enough — do not push hard.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，咳嗽严重时可增加次数。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes per session, once daily. Increase frequency if coughing is persistent.
when_zh: 咳嗽频繁、胸口发闷发胀、乳房胀痛（经前）、恶心时。
when_en: When you cough frequently, your chest feels full and tight, you have pre-period breast tenderness, or feel nauseous.
tips_zh: 经前乳房胀痛时搭配按期门穴（肋骨旁）和太冲穴（脚背）效果更好。
tips_en: For pre-period breast soreness, combine with Qimen (beside the ribs) and Taichong (top of the foot).
caution_zh: 力度必须轻柔。乳房有肿块等异常请及时就医，不要自行按揉。
caution_en: Use gentle pressure only. If you notice any breast lumps, see a doctor — do not self-massage.

summary_zh: 缓解咳嗽气喘和胸胁胀满的胸部穴位。
summary_en: Eases coughing, wheezing, and a feeling of fullness in the chest.
location_zh: 在胸部，沿胸骨往旁边量约两横指宽，在第3根肋骨下方的缝隙里。大约在乳头上方一个肋骨间隙。
location_en: On the chest, about two finger-widths from the breastbone center, in the space below the third rib. Roughly one rib-space above nipple level.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹轻按肋间缝隙，力度要轻柔，做缓慢的小圆圈揉动。感到微微酸胀即可。
massage_en: Gently press your fingertip between the ribs and make slow, small circles. Light pressure only — a mild ache is the right level.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，呼吸不畅时随时可按。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes per session, once daily. Press anytime breathing feels labored.
when_zh: 咳嗽气喘、胸口闷胀、呼吸不顺畅、乳房胀痛时。
when_en: When you are coughing or wheezing, your chest feels stuffy, breathing is strained, or you have breast tenderness.
tips_zh: 咳嗽时搭配按天突穴（喉咙下方凹陷）和肺俞穴（背部）效果更好。
tips_en: For coughing, combine with Tiantu (hollow at the base of the throat) and Feishu (upper back).
caution_zh: 力度必须轻柔。胸部有外伤时禁用。
caution_en: Always use gentle pressure. Do not use if you have chest injuries.

summary_zh: 缓解胸闷气短和咳嗽的上胸穴位。
summary_en: Relieves chest tightness, shortness of breath, and coughing in the upper chest.
location_zh: 在胸部上方，沿胸骨往旁边量约两横指宽，在第2根肋骨下方的缝隙里。大约在锁骨下方两个肋骨间隙。
location_en: On the upper chest, about two finger-widths from the breastbone center, in the space below the second rib. Roughly two rib-spaces below the collarbone.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹轻按肋间缝隙，做缓慢的小圆圈揉动。力度轻柔，上胸部皮肤较薄，不需要大力。
massage_en: Press gently between the ribs with your fingertip and make slow small circles. The skin here is thin, so light touch is sufficient.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，早晨做深呼吸时配合按。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes per session, once daily. Pair with morning deep-breathing exercises.
when_zh: 胸闷气短、咳嗽不停、感觉胸口堵着不舒服、恶心时。
when_en: When you feel short of breath, cough persistently, have a stuffy feeling in the chest, or are nauseous.
tips_zh: 搭配按膻中穴和天突穴，打开胸腔呼吸更顺畅。早晨在窗前做几次深呼吸同时按揉。
tips_en: Combine with Danzhong and Tiantu to open up the chest. Try pressing while doing deep breaths by an open window in the morning.
caution_zh: 力度必须轻柔。有肋骨损伤或胸部手术史时慎用。
caution_en: Always use light pressure. Use with caution if you have rib injuries or a history of chest surgery.

summary_zh: 缓解咳嗽胸闷的锁骨下方穴位。
summary_en: Eases coughing and chest tightness below the collarbone.
location_zh: 在胸部上方，沿胸骨往旁边量约两横指宽，在第1根肋骨下方的缝隙里。就在锁骨下方一个肋骨间隙的位置。
location_en: On the upper chest, about two finger-widths from the breastbone center, in the space below the first rib. One rib-space directly below the collarbone.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹轻轻按压肋间缝隙，做小圆圈揉动。力度一定要轻，这里皮肤薄、位置较浅。
massage_en: Gently press your fingertip into the rib space and make small circles. Very light pressure — this area is close to the surface.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，咳嗽或胸闷时随时按。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes per session, once daily. Press whenever you cough or feel chest congestion.
when_zh: 咳嗽频繁、胸口闷胀不适、呼吸费力时。
when_en: When you cough frequently, your chest feels congested, or breathing requires extra effort.
tips_zh: 搭配按天突穴和膻中穴一起用，缓解胸闷咳嗽效果更佳。多喝温水润喉。
tips_en: Combine with Tiantu and Danzhong for better relief from chest tightness and coughing. Sip warm water to soothe your throat.
caution_zh: 力度必须轻柔。胸部有伤或肋骨骨折时禁用。
caution_en: Always use gentle pressure. Do not use if you have chest injuries or rib fractures.

summary_zh: 缓解咳嗽气喘和胸痛的锁骨下穴位。
summary_en: Relieves coughing, asthma, and chest pain just below the collarbone.
location_zh: 在胸部最上方，锁骨下缘的凹陷处，离胸口正中线约两横指宽。用手沿锁骨下缘往中间摸，找到一个明显的小凹陷就是。
location_en: At the top of the chest, in the hollow just under the collarbone, about two finger-widths from the center. Trace along the underside of your collarbone toward the middle until you feel a clear dip.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹按住锁骨下方的凹陷，轻柔按压并做小圆圈揉动。力度轻到中等，有酸胀感即可。
massage_en: Press your fingertip into the hollow under the collarbone and make small circles with light to moderate pressure. Stop at a mild, satisfying ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，早晨深呼吸时配合按。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Best paired with morning deep breathing.
when_zh: 咳嗽久治不好、胸口闷痛、呼吸困难、恶心想吐时。
when_en: When you have a lingering cough, chest pain and tightness, difficulty breathing, or nausea.
tips_zh: 搭配按天突穴和定喘穴（颈后）一起按，止咳平喘效果更好。可以用精油辅助按揉。
tips_en: Combine with Tiantu and Dingchuan (back of the neck) for better cough and wheeze relief. A drop of eucalyptus oil on your finger can enhance the experience.
caution_zh: 力度必须轻柔。锁骨有骨折或外伤时禁用。持续胸痛请就医。
caution_en: Always use gentle pressure. Do not use with collarbone fractures or injuries. Seek medical care for persistent chest pain.

summary_zh: 缓解胸闷气短，帮助改善呼吸不畅的感觉。
summary_en: Eases chest tightness and helps you breathe more freely.
location_zh: 乳头外侧约一横指，平第四根肋骨的间隙处。
location_en: About one thumb-width outside your nipple, in the space between the fourth and fifth ribs.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻轻按压，力度以微微酸胀为宜，做小幅度的画圈动作。注意这个位置比较敏感，不要用力过猛。
massage_en: Place your middle finger on the point and press gently with a small circular motion. Use light pressure — this area is sensitive. You should feel a mild, comfortable ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，呼吸不畅时随时可按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Press anytime you feel chest tightness.
when_zh: 胸口发闷、呼吸不顺畅、情绪压抑感到憋闷时。
when_en: When your chest feels tight, breathing feels shallow, or emotions feel stuck and heavy.
tips_zh: 配合深呼吸效果更好。按完后轻轻拍打胸口几下，帮助气息流通。
tips_en: Combine with slow deep breathing for better results. Gently tap your chest a few times afterward to promote circulation.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。局部有伤口或皮肤病时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press if there are wounds or skin conditions in the area.

summary_zh: 缓解手臂疼痛和胸口不适，帮助上肢放松。
summary_en: Relieves arm pain and chest discomfort, helping your upper body relax.
location_zh: 手臂自然下垂时，腋窝前方皱纹下约两横指，上臂内侧靠近骨头边缘处。
location_en: Let your arm hang naturally. Find the front crease of your armpit, then measure two finger-widths down along the inner side of your upper arm, near the bone.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指按住穴位，沿着手臂方向上下推揉，力度中等，以感到酸胀为度。
massage_en: Use your opposite thumb to press the point. Slide up and down along the arm with moderate pressure. You should feel a deep, satisfying ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，手臂酸痛时可加按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Add extra sessions when your arm is sore.
when_zh: 手臂酸痛无力、长时间用电脑后上臂不适、胸口闷痛时。
when_en: When your arm aches from overuse, after long computer sessions, or when you feel a dull ache in your chest.
tips_zh: 按揉前先甩甩手臂活动一下，配合PC6内关一起按效果更好。
tips_en: Shake out your arms before massaging. For better results, also press PC6 (Neiguan) on your inner wrist.
caution_zh: 按压力度不宜过重，避免压迫到腋下血管和神经。
caution_en: Do not press too hard. Avoid heavy pressure near the armpit where blood vessels and nerves run.

summary_zh: 缓解胃部不适和手肘疼痛，对中暑也有帮助。
summary_en: Eases stomach discomfort and elbow pain, and helps with heat-related symptoms.
location_zh: 微微弯曲手肘，在肘弯横纹上，能摸到一根粗大的筋，筋的内侧（靠小指一侧）凹陷处。
location_en: Slightly bend your elbow. Feel for the thick tendon at the center of your elbow crease. The point is in the dip just to the inner side (pinky side) of that tendon.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按压凹陷处，垂直向下用力，力度中等偏轻，按住后可以小幅度揉动。避免过度用力。
massage_en: Press your thumb straight down into the dip beside the tendon. Use moderate-to-light pressure and make small, gentle circles. Do not press too hard on this sensitive area.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，胃不舒服时可随时按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, once daily. Press anytime you feel stomach discomfort.
when_zh: 胃痛恶心、天热中暑头晕、手肘疼痛僵硬时。
when_en: When you feel nauseous, have stomach pain, feel dizzy from heat, or your elbow is stiff and sore.
tips_zh: 胃不舒服时配合PC6内关一起按，效果更明显。按完后喝一杯温水。
tips_en: For stomach issues, combine with PC6 (Neiguan). Drink a glass of warm water after your session.
caution_zh: 肘部有损伤或肿胀时避免按压。不要用力掐捏。
caution_en: Avoid if your elbow is injured or swollen. Do not pinch or use excessive force.

summary_zh: 缓解心慌不安和胸口疼痛，帮助安定情绪。
summary_en: Calms a racing heart and chest pain, helping you feel emotionally steady.
location_zh: 手心朝上，手腕横纹和肘横纹的中点处再往手腕方向移一横指，前臂内侧两根大筋之间。
location_en: Palm up, find the midpoint between your wrist crease and elbow crease. Move one finger-width toward the wrist. The point is between the two big tendons on your inner forearm.
massage_zh: 用对侧手拇指按压两筋之间，力度中等，按住后做缓慢的揉按动作。感到酸胀即可，不必追求疼痛感。
massage_en: Use your opposite thumb to press between the two tendons. Apply moderate pressure and knead slowly. Aim for a comfortable ache, not pain.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，心慌时可立即按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Press immediately when you feel your heart racing.
when_zh: 突然感到心慌、胸口隐隐作痛、情绪激动心跳加快时。
when_en: When your heart suddenly races, you feel a dull ache in your chest, or emotional stress speeds up your heartbeat.
tips_zh: 配合缓慢深呼吸，吸气4秒呼气6秒。同时按PC6内关效果更佳。
tips_en: Pair with slow breathing (inhale 4 seconds, exhale 6 seconds). Combining with PC6 (Neiguan) enhances the calming effect.
caution_zh: 如果胸痛剧烈或持续不缓解，请立即就医，不要自行按压。
caution_en: If chest pain is severe or persistent, seek medical attention immediately. Do not rely on massage alone.

summary_zh: 缓解心烦焦虑和胃部不适，帮助稳定情绪。
summary_en: Eases anxiety, irritability, and stomach upset, helping to stabilize your mood.
location_zh: 手心朝上，从手腕横纹向手肘方向量四横指宽，前臂内侧两根大筋之间。
location_en: Palm facing up, measure four finger-widths above your wrist crease. The point is between the two prominent tendons on your inner forearm.
massage_zh: 用拇指按在两筋之间，垂直按压后缓慢揉动，力度中等。也可以用拇指沿两筋之间来回推按。
massage_en: Press your thumb between the two tendons and push straight down, then slowly knead. Moderate pressure. You can also slide your thumb back and forth between the tendons.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，焦虑不安时随时可按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, once or twice daily. Press anytime you feel anxious or restless.
when_zh: 心情烦躁、焦虑不安、胃痛恶心、情绪波动大的时候。
when_en: When you feel irritable, anxious, nauseated, or experiencing big mood swings throughout the day.
tips_zh: 心情烦躁时先按PC5再按PC6，然后做几次深呼吸，效果更好。
tips_en: When feeling irritable, press PC5 first, then PC6, followed by several deep breaths for a stronger calming effect.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。按压力度不宜过重，以免损伤前臂肌腱。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press too hard to prevent strain on the forearm tendons.

summary_zh: 缓解恶心、心慌和焦虑，是最常用的安神止呕穴位。
summary_en: Relieves nausea, calms a racing heart, and eases anxiety.
location_zh: 手心朝上，从手腕横纹向手肘方向量两横指宽，前臂内侧两根大筋之间。
location_en: Palm facing up, measure two finger-widths above your wrist crease. The point is between the two tendons you can feel on your inner forearm.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指按在两筋之间，垂直按压，力度中等，按住后做小幅度揉圈。感到酸胀感向手掌方向传导最好。
massage_en: Press your opposite thumb straight down between the two tendons. Use moderate pressure and make small circles. Ideally you will feel a spreading ache toward your palm.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天2-3次，恶心或心慌时随时可按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, two to three times daily. Press anytime you feel nauseous or anxious.
when_zh: 晕车晕船、恶心想吐、心慌紧张、失眠焦虑、考试面试前紧张时。
when_en: Motion sickness, nausea, pre-exam or interview nerves, insomnia, anxiety, or whenever your heart races from stress.
tips_zh: 晕车前10分钟开始按压效果最好。睡前按揉配合腹式呼吸有助入睡。
tips_en: Start pressing 10 minutes before travel to prevent motion sickness. Before bed, combine with belly breathing to promote sleep.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。低血压者按压时间不宜过长。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. If you have low blood pressure, limit sessions to 1-2 minutes.

summary_zh: 缓解手腕疼痛和心烦失眠，帮助安心宁神。
summary_en: Eases wrist pain and restless sleep, helping to calm your mind at night.
location_zh: 手心朝上，微微弯曲手腕，手腕横纹正中央，两根大筋之间的凹陷处。
location_en: Palm facing up, slightly bend your wrist. Find the center of your wrist crease — the point is in the dip between the two tendons.
massage_zh: 用对侧拇指按压凹陷处，垂直用力，力度偏轻到中等，按住后缓慢揉动。也可以两手腕交叉互相按压此穴。
massage_en: Press your opposite thumb into the dip between the tendons. Use light-to-moderate pressure and knead slowly. You can also cross your wrists and press both points at once.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天2次，睡前按揉效果最好。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, twice daily. Most effective when done before bedtime.
when_zh: 手腕酸痛、用电脑后手腕不适、睡前心烦难以入睡时。
when_en: When your wrist aches from typing, after long computer sessions, or when you feel restless and cannot fall asleep.
tips_zh: 睡前配合PC6内关一起按揉，再做几次深呼吸，有助于快速入睡。
tips_en: Before bed, press both PC7 and PC6 together, then take several slow deep breaths to help you fall asleep faster.
caution_zh: 手腕有骨折或严重扭伤时避免按压。力度要轻柔。
caution_en: Avoid if your wrist is fractured or severely sprained. Always use gentle pressure at this point.

summary_zh: 清除口腔异味，缓解手心出汗和心烦燥热。
summary_en: Freshens your breath, reduces sweaty palms, and cools down feelings of inner heat.
location_zh: 半握拳，食指、中指、无名指和小指轻压掌心，中指和无名指指尖之间所对的位置。
location_en: Make a loose fist with your four fingers curling into your palm. The point is where the tips of your middle and ring fingers touch your palm.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指顶住掌心此处，用力按压并做旋转揉动，力度可以稍重。也可以用笔帽等硬物辅助按压。
massage_en: Use your opposite thumb to press firmly into the palm at this point. Rotate and knead with strong pressure. You can also use the cap of a pen for more focused pressure.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天2-3次，紧张手心冒汗时随时可按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes per session, two to three times daily. Press anytime your palms get sweaty from nerves.
when_zh: 口气不清新、手心容易出汗、心烦燥热、紧张需要冷静时。
when_en: When you notice bad breath, sweaty palms, inner restlessness, or need to calm down quickly before a stressful moment.
tips_zh: 紧张出汗时两手交替互按劳宫穴，配合缓慢呼吸效果显著。
tips_en: Alternate pressing both palms when nervous. Combine with slow breathing for a noticeable calming effect.
caution_zh: 手掌有伤口或水泡时避免按压。孕妇慎用。
caution_en: Avoid if you have open wounds or blisters on your palm. Not recommended during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 快速提神醒脑，缓解头晕和中暑不适。
summary_en: Quickly revives alertness and relieves dizziness or heat-related discomfort.
location_zh: 中指指尖的最高点，指甲尖端下方约一粒米的距离处。
location_en: At the very tip of your middle finger, just below the highest point of the fingernail, about a grain of rice away from the nail edge.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指和食指夹住中指指尖，拇指在指腹、食指在指甲侧，用力掐按5-10秒后松开，反复数次。
massage_en: Pinch the tip of your middle finger between your opposite thumb and index finger. Squeeze firmly for 5-10 seconds, release, and repeat several times.
routine_zh: 每次掐按1-2分钟，需要提神时随时可用，不限次数。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes per session, anytime you need a mental boost. No limit on daily frequency.
when_zh: 犯困打瞌睡、头晕目眩、天热中暑、精神不振需要提神时。
when_en: When you feel drowsy, dizzy, overheated in summer, or mentally foggy and need a quick pick-me-up.
tips_zh: 开会犯困时可以悄悄掐按，配合十指交叉用力握紧再松开效果更好。
tips_en: Discreetly pinch during meetings when drowsy. For a stronger effect, interlace your fingers, squeeze tightly, then release.
caution_zh: 指尖有伤口时避免掐按。力度适当，不要掐破皮肤。
caution_en: Avoid if you have cuts on your fingertip. Use firm but controlled pressure — do not break the skin.

summary_zh: 缓解咽喉不适和头部闷热感的指尖小穴。
summary_en: A fingertip point that eases sore throat and head stuffiness.
location_zh: 无名指指甲根部靠小指一侧，指甲角旁约一粒米的距离。
location_en: On the ring finger, at the base of the nail on the pinky side, about a grain of rice away from the nail corner.
massage_zh: 用另一只手的拇指指甲掐按此穴，力度稍重，有刺痛感即可。每次掐按5秒后松开，反复10次。
massage_en: Pinch this point firmly with the thumbnail of your other hand. Press for 5 seconds, release, and repeat 10 times. You should feel a sharp but tolerable sting.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天2-3次，觉得不舒服时随时可按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes each time, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime you feel unwell.
when_zh: 嗓子发干发痛、天气闷热头昏、中暑感觉不适时。
when_en: When your throat feels dry or sore, during hot stuffy weather, or when you feel overheated and lightheaded.
tips_zh: 配合少商穴（大拇指指甲旁）一起掐按，缓解咽喉不适效果更好。多喝温水。
tips_en: Combine with Shaoshang (beside the thumbnail) for better throat relief. Drink warm water afterward.
caution_zh: 掐按力度不宜过猛，孕妇慎用。皮肤破损处不要按压。
caution_en: Do not press too aggressively. Avoid if pregnant. Do not press on broken or wounded skin.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解耳鸣和咽喉肿痛的手背穴位。
summary_en: A hand point that helps relieve ear ringing and sore throat.
location_zh: 手背朝上，无名指和小指之间的指蹼边缘，两指分开时能摸到的凹陷处。
location_en: On the back of your hand, in the web between the ring finger and pinky. Spread your fingers to find the depression at the edge of the webbing.
massage_zh: 用另一只手的拇指按在穴位上，食指托住手心，捏揉此处。力度中等，以酸胀感为宜，持续按揉。
massage_en: Place your opposite thumb on the point with your index finger supporting underneath. Squeeze and knead with moderate pressure until you feel a dull ache.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次，早晚各一次。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes each time, twice daily, morning and evening.
when_zh: 耳朵嗡嗡响、嗓子红肿疼痛、头痛眼睛发红时。
when_en: When you have ringing in the ears, a red swollen throat, headache, or red irritated eyes.
tips_zh: 配合外关穴（手腕背面上方两横指处）一起按揉，效果更佳。按后轻轻活动手指。
tips_en: Pair with Waiguan (two finger-widths above the wrist crease on the back of the forearm) for better results. Gently wiggle your fingers afterward.
caution_zh: 手部有伤口或红肿发炎时避免按压。力度不要过大。
caution_en: Avoid pressing if the hand area is wounded, red, or inflamed. Do not use excessive force.

summary_zh: 缓解耳鸣、头痛和手指僵硬的手背要穴。
summary_en: A key hand point for ear ringing, headaches, and stiff fingers.
location_zh: 握拳手背朝上，无名指和小指掌骨之间，指关节后方的凹陷处。
location_en: Make a fist with the back of your hand facing up. Find the depression between the ring and pinky finger bones, just behind the knuckles.
massage_zh: 用另一只手的拇指尖用力按压此穴，同时缓慢弯曲伸展无名指和小指。按压时保持深呼吸，按5秒松3秒。
massage_en: Press firmly with the tip of your opposite thumb while slowly bending and straightening your ring and pinky fingers. Hold 5 seconds, release 3 seconds. Breathe deeply.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天2-3次，手指僵硬时随时可按。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes each time, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime fingers feel stiff.
when_zh: 耳鸣听力下降、手指僵硬不灵活、肩背酸痛、头痛时。
when_en: When you have ear ringing, reduced hearing, stiff fingers, shoulder and back soreness, or headaches.
tips_zh: 配合外关穴一起按揉效果更好。按完后活动手腕和手指关节，做几次握拳松开的动作。
tips_en: Combine with Waiguan for enhanced effect. After massaging, rotate your wrist and open and close your fist several times.
caution_zh: 手背肿胀或受伤时不要按压。孕妇避免用力刺激此穴。
caution_en: Do not press if the back of the hand is swollen or injured. Pregnant women should avoid strong stimulation.

summary_zh: 暖手助循环、缓解手腕疼痛的穴位。
summary_en: A wrist point that warms cold hands and eases wrist pain.
location_zh: 手腕背面横纹的中央，沿无名指骨头往手腕方向摸，到横纹处能感觉到的凹陷。
location_en: On the back of your wrist, at the center of the wrist crease. Trace from the ring finger knuckle toward your wrist to find the depression at the crease.
massage_zh: 用另一只手的拇指轻柔按压此穴，做小圆圈揉动。力度要轻，不宜重按，以温热感向手掌扩散为佳。
massage_en: Gently press with your opposite thumb and make small circular motions. Use light pressure — the goal is to feel warmth spreading into your hand, not pain.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天3次，手凉时随时可揉。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes each time, 3 times daily. Rub anytime your hands feel cold.
when_zh: 手脚冰凉、手腕酸痛、长时间用电脑手腕不舒服时。
when_en: When your hands and feet are cold, your wrist aches, or after long computer use causes wrist discomfort.
tips_zh: 双手互相按揉阳池穴效果更好。冬天可先搓热双手再按压。配合合谷穴使用。
tips_en: Massage both wrists for better effect. In cold weather, rub your hands warm first. Pair with Hegu (between thumb and index finger).
caution_zh: 手腕扭伤急性期不要按压。力度一定要轻柔，此穴不宜重按。
caution_en: Do not press during acute wrist sprains. Always use gentle pressure — this point should not be pressed hard.

summary_zh: 缓解感冒头痛、耳鸣和手臂不适的常用穴。
summary_en: A go-to point for colds, headaches, ear ringing, and arm discomfort.
location_zh: 手腕背面横纹正中往手肘方向两横指宽，前臂两根骨头之间的中点。
location_en: On the back of your forearm, two finger-widths above the center of the wrist crease, right between the two forearm bones.
massage_zh: 用拇指按压穴位，力度中等偏重，以酸胀感沿前臂扩散为佳。可以一边按压一边缓慢转动手腕。每次按5秒松3秒。
massage_en: Press with your thumb using moderate to firm pressure. You should feel a spreading ache along the forearm. Slowly rotate your wrist while pressing. Hold 5 seconds, release 3 seconds.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天2-3次。感冒初起时可多按几次。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes each time, 2-3 times daily. Press more often at the first sign of a cold.
when_zh: 感冒初起、头痛、耳鸣、肩膀手臂酸痛、肋骨两侧不适时。
when_en: At the onset of a cold, during headaches, ear ringing, sore shoulders and arms, or discomfort along the ribs.
tips_zh: 和内关穴（手腕内侧同样位置）同时按压，前后夹住前臂，效果更好。也可配合合谷穴。
tips_en: Press together with Neiguan (same position on the inner wrist) by pinching both sides of the forearm. Also pairs well with Hegu.
caution_zh: 前臂骨折或严重扭伤时禁止按压。孕妇不宜强力刺激。
caution_en: Do not press if the forearm is fractured or severely sprained. Pregnant women should avoid strong stimulation.

summary_zh: 促进排便、缓解便秘和肋间不适的前臂穴。
summary_en: A forearm point that promotes bowel movement and eases rib-area discomfort.
location_zh: 手腕背面横纹正中往手肘方向四横指宽，前臂两根骨头之间。
location_en: On the back of your forearm, four finger-widths above the center of the wrist crease, between the two forearm bones.
massage_zh: 用拇指垂直按压此穴，力度由轻到重，以酸胀感明显为度。按压的同时做深呼吸，配合腹式呼吸效果更好。
massage_en: Press vertically with your thumb, gradually increasing pressure until you feel a clear deep ache. Breathe deeply with belly breathing while pressing for best results.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天早晨起床后和晚上睡前各一次。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes each time, once after waking and once before bed.
when_zh: 便秘排便困难、肋骨两侧胀痛、恶心想吐时。
when_en: When constipated, when the sides of your ribcage feel tight or achy, or when feeling nauseous.
tips_zh: 便秘时配合天枢穴（肚脐两侧三横指）一起按揉。早晨空腹喝一杯温水后再按效果更好。
tips_en: For constipation, combine with Tianshu (three finger-widths beside the navel). Drink a glass of warm water on an empty stomach before pressing.
caution_zh: 腹部急性疼痛或不明原因腹痛时请先就医，不要自行按压。
caution_en: Seek medical attention first for acute or unexplained abdominal pain. Do not self-massage in these cases.

summary_zh: 缓解耳鸣和前臂疼痛的穴位。
summary_en: A point that eases ear ringing and forearm pain.
location_zh: 手腕背面横纹往手肘方向四横指宽，靠小指一侧那根骨头的内侧边缘。
location_en: Four finger-widths above the wrist crease on the back of the forearm, along the inner edge of the bone on the pinky side.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按压骨头边缘的凹陷处，做上下滑动按揉。力度中等，以酸胀为度。
massage_en: Press with your thumb pad along the bone edge and slide up and down while kneading. Use moderate pressure until you feel a deep ache.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次，耳鸣发作时可加按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes each time, twice daily. Add extra sessions when ear ringing flares up.
when_zh: 耳鸣、听力下降、前臂酸痛无力时。
when_en: When you experience ringing in the ears, reduced hearing, or forearm soreness and weakness.
tips_zh: 配合中渚穴和翳风穴一起按揉，对缓解耳鸣效果更好。按完后轻拉耳垂数次。
tips_en: Combine with Zhongzhu (hand) and Yifeng (behind earlobe) for better ear ringing relief. Gently tug your earlobes a few times afterward.
caution_zh: 前臂受伤或骨折时禁止按压。不要直接按在骨头上。
caution_en: Do not press if the forearm is injured or fractured. Avoid pressing directly on the bone.

summary_zh: 缓解牙痛和手臂疼痛的前臂穴位。
summary_en: A forearm point that helps relieve toothache and arm pain.
location_zh: 手腕背面横纹正中往手肘方向约五横指宽，前臂两根骨头之间。
location_en: About five finger-widths above the center of the wrist crease on the back of the forearm, between the two forearm bones.
massage_zh: 用拇指按压穴位，做圆圈状揉动，力度中等偏重。牙痛时可持续按压不松手，直到疼痛减轻。
massage_en: Press with your thumb and knead in circles using moderate to firm pressure. For toothache, hold steady pressure without releasing until the pain subsides.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次。牙痛时可随时加按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes each time, twice daily. Add sessions anytime during a toothache.
when_zh: 牙痛、嗓子突然说不出话、前臂和手臂酸痛时。
when_en: When you have a toothache, sudden voice loss, or aching in your forearm and upper arm.
tips_zh: 牙痛时配合合谷穴（虎口处）一起按揉效果更好。按后可用温盐水漱口。
tips_en: For toothache, combine with Hegu (in the web between thumb and index finger). Rinse with warm salt water afterward.
caution_zh: 牙痛持续不缓解请及时看牙医。前臂肿胀时不要按压。
caution_en: See a dentist if toothache persists. Do not press if the forearm is swollen.

summary_zh: 缓解咽喉肿痛和前臂不适的穴位。
summary_en: A point that eases sore throat and forearm discomfort.
location_zh: 前臂背面，肘尖往手腕方向约五横指宽处，两根骨头之间的中点。
location_en: On the back of the forearm, about five finger-widths below the elbow tip, in the middle between the two forearm bones.
massage_zh: 用拇指按压两骨之间的肌肉，力度中等，做上下方向的推揉。可以同时轻轻转动前臂。
massage_en: Press between the two bones with your thumb using moderate pressure and knead up and down. Gently rotate your forearm while pressing.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2次，嗓子不舒服时可加按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes each time, twice daily. Add sessions when your throat feels off.
when_zh: 嗓子肿痛、牙痛、声音嘶哑说不出话、手臂酸痛时。
when_en: When your throat is swollen and sore, during toothache, when your voice is hoarse, or when your arm aches.
tips_zh: 嗓子不舒服时配合少商穴（大拇指指甲旁）一起按揉。多喝温水帮助缓解。
tips_en: For throat discomfort, combine with Shaoshang (beside the thumbnail). Drink plenty of warm water to help soothe.
caution_zh: 前臂有外伤或严重肿胀时不要按压。
caution_en: Do not press if the forearm is wounded or severely swollen.

summary_zh: 缓解肘部疼痛和偏头痛的肘后穴位。
summary_en: An elbow point that eases elbow pain and migraines.
location_zh: 弯曲手肘成直角，肘尖（肘部最突出的骨头）往上一横指宽的凹陷处。
location_en: Bend your elbow at a right angle. Find the bony tip of the elbow, then move one finger-width upward into the depression.
massage_zh: 弯曲手肘，用另一只手的拇指按入凹陷处，做圆圈揉动。力度中等，以酸胀感为宜。也可以伸直手臂再弯曲，反复活动。
massage_en: Bend your elbow, press your opposite thumb into the depression, and knead in circles with moderate pressure. You can also repeatedly straighten and bend the arm while pressing.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天2次。肘部不适时随时可按。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes each time, twice daily. Press anytime the elbow feels uncomfortable.
when_zh: 肘部疼痛、偏头痛、肩膀手臂酸痛、肋骨两侧不舒服时。
when_en: When you have elbow pain, migraines, sore shoulders and arms, or discomfort along the sides of the ribcage.
tips_zh: 配合曲池穴（弯肘时肘横纹外端）一起按揉，对肘部问题效果更好。按后轻轻甩臂放松。
tips_en: Combine with Quchi (at the outer end of the elbow crease) for elbow issues. Gently shake out your arm afterward to relax.
caution_zh: 肘关节急性损伤或骨折时禁止按压。
caution_en: Do not press during acute elbow injuries or fractures.

summary_zh: 缓解肩臂疼痛和头痛的上臂穴位。
summary_en: An upper arm point that relieves shoulder-arm pain and headaches.
location_zh: 肘尖（肘部最突出的骨头）往肩膀方向两横指宽处，上臂后侧。
location_en: On the back of your upper arm, two finger-widths above the elbow tip toward the shoulder.
massage_zh: 用另一只手的拇指和其余四指环抱上臂，拇指按压穴位做圆圈揉动。力度中等，以局部酸胀为度。
massage_en: Wrap your opposite hand around the upper arm, press your thumb on the point, and knead in circles. Use moderate pressure until you feel a local deep ache.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes each time, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 肩膀和手臂疼痛、头痛、眼睛胀痛、肋部不适时。
when_en: When your shoulder and arm ache, during headaches, eye soreness, or discomfort in the rib area.
tips_zh: 配合天井穴和肩髎穴一起按揉，从肘到肩顺序按效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Tianjing (elbow) and Jianliao (shoulder). Massage in sequence from elbow to shoulder for best results.
caution_zh: 上臂有外伤或严重肿胀时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid pressing if the upper arm is injured or severely swollen.

summary_zh: 缓解颈项僵硬和上臂疼痛的穴位。
summary_en: A point that eases stiff neck and upper arm pain.
location_zh: 上臂后侧，肘尖往肩膀方向约手掌宽的距离，上臂中段偏下的位置。
location_en: On the back of the upper arm, about a palm-width above the elbow tip, in the lower-middle area of the upper arm.
massage_zh: 用另一只手握住上臂，拇指按压穴位，做上下推揉动作。力度稍重，以深层酸胀感为宜。
massage_en: Grip the upper arm with your opposite hand and press with your thumb, kneading up and down. Use slightly firm pressure to reach a deep ache.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes each time, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 脖子僵硬转动困难、头痛、牙痛、上臂酸痛时。
when_en: When your neck is stiff and hard to turn, during headaches, toothaches, or upper arm soreness.
tips_zh: 颈部僵硬时配合风池穴（后脑勺发际线凹陷处）一起按揉。按后轻轻转动脖子放松。
tips_en: For neck stiffness, combine with Fengchi (in the hollows at the base of the skull). Gently rotate your neck afterward to relax.
caution_zh: 上臂受伤或骨折时不要按压。
caution_en: Do not press if the upper arm is injured or fractured.

summary_zh: 缓解肩膀和上臂活动不便的穴位。
summary_en: A point that helps when your shoulder and upper arm feel restricted.
location_zh: 肩膀最高点（肩峰）往下约四横指宽，上臂外侧靠后的肌肉下缘。
location_en: About four finger-widths below the tip of the shoulder, on the outer-back side of the upper arm, at the lower edge of the shoulder muscle.
massage_zh: 用另一只手的拇指按压此穴，其余手指扶住上臂前侧。做圆圈揉动，力度中等偏重，以酸胀向肩膀扩散为佳。
massage_en: Press with your opposite thumb while your other fingers support the front of the arm. Knead in circles with moderate to firm pressure until the ache spreads toward the shoulder.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes each time, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 上臂抬不起来、肩膀僵硬疼痛、手臂无力时。
when_en: When you cannot lift your arm easily, your shoulder is stiff and painful, or your arm feels weak.
tips_zh: 配合肩髎穴（肩膀后侧凹陷处）一起按揉。按完后做几次手臂画圈的动作帮助放松。
tips_en: Combine with Jianliao (shoulder depression). After massaging, swing your arm in circles to loosen up.
caution_zh: 肩关节严重损伤或脱臼时禁止按压。
caution_en: Do not press during severe shoulder injuries or dislocations.

summary_zh: 缓解肩膀疼痛和活动受限的重要肩部穴位。
summary_en: A key shoulder point for pain and limited arm movement.
location_zh: 手臂用力外展平举，肩膀最高处后侧会出现一个凹陷，就是这个穴位。
location_en: Raise your arm straight out to the side. Feel for the depression that appears behind the tip of the shoulder — that is the point.
massage_zh: 用另一只手的中指或拇指按入肩部凹陷，做圆圈揉动。力度由轻到重，以酸胀感明显为度。可一边按揉一边缓慢活动手臂。
massage_en: Press into the shoulder depression with your opposite middle finger or thumb and knead in circles. Gradually increase pressure until you feel a clear ache. Slowly move your arm while pressing.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天2-3次。肩膀僵痛时多按几次。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes each time, 2-3 times daily. Increase frequency when the shoulder is stiff and painful.
when_zh: 肩膀疼痛抬不起来、肩周不适、长时间伏案肩膀僵硬时。
when_en: When your shoulder hurts and you cannot raise your arm, or after long desk work leaves your shoulders stiff.
tips_zh: 配合肩井穴（肩膀最高处中点）和曲池穴一起按揉。按完做几个耸肩和画圈动作。
tips_en: Combine with Jianjing (midpoint of the shoulder top) and Quchi (elbow crease). Shrug and circle your shoulders afterward.
caution_zh: 肩关节急性损伤、脱臼或骨折时禁止按压。
caution_en: Do not press during acute shoulder injuries, dislocations, or fractures.

summary_zh: 缓解肩背僵痛和脖子转动困难的穴位。
summary_en: A point that eases shoulder-back stiffness and neck turning difficulty.
location_zh: 肩膀后上方，肩井穴（肩膀最高处中点）和肩胛骨内上角连线的中间位置。
location_en: On the upper back behind the shoulder, midway between the highest point of the shoulder and the upper inner corner of the shoulder blade.
massage_zh: 用对侧手绕过头顶或从前方够到穴位，用中指按压做圆圈揉动。如果够不到，可以用网球靠墙滚压。
massage_en: Reach over with your opposite hand to press with your middle finger and knead in circles. If hard to reach, lean against a wall with a tennis ball placed on the point.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes each time, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 肩背僵硬疼痛、脖子僵硬转动困难、长时间低头后不适时。
when_en: When your upper back and shoulders are stiff and painful, your neck is hard to turn, or after prolonged looking down.
tips_zh: 配合肩井穴和风池穴一起按揉。按完后做几次头部左右转动和耸肩动作。
tips_en: Combine with Jianjing (shoulder top) and Fengchi (base of skull). After massaging, turn your head side to side and shrug a few times.
caution_zh: 肩背部有外伤或急性拉伤时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid pressing if the upper back or shoulder area is wounded or acutely strained.

summary_zh: 缓解头晕、耳鸣和颈侧僵痛的颈部穴位。
summary_en: A neck point that eases dizziness, ear ringing, and neck stiffness.
location_zh: 脖子侧面，下巴角（下颌骨转角处）的后方，脖子侧面大筋的后缘凹陷中。
location_en: On the side of the neck, behind the jaw angle, in the depression behind the large neck muscle you feel when turning your head.
massage_zh: 用拇指或中指轻柔按压此穴，做小幅度圆圈揉动。力度一定要轻，以微微酸胀为度。不要用力掐按。
massage_en: Gently press with your thumb or middle finger and make small circles. Keep the pressure light — you should feel only a mild ache. Never press hard on the neck.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次，力度要轻。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes each time, 1-2 times daily. Always use gentle pressure.
when_zh: 头晕目眩、耳朵嗡嗡响、嗓子肿痛、脖子侧面僵硬疼痛时。
when_en: When feeling dizzy, having ringing ears, a swollen sore throat, or stiffness and pain on the side of your neck.
tips_zh: 配合风池穴和翳风穴一起轻柔按揉。按完后缓慢转动头部放松颈部。
tips_en: Combine with Fengchi (base of skull) and Yifeng (behind earlobe) using gentle pressure. Slowly rotate your head afterward to relax.
caution_zh: 颈部有血管搏动处不要按压。力度必须轻柔，颈部不可重按。孕妇避免。
caution_en: Do not press where you feel a pulse on the neck. Always use light pressure — never press the neck hard. Avoid during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 缓解耳鸣、面部不适和打嗝的耳后常用穴。
summary_en: A popular point behind the ear for ear ringing, facial discomfort, and hiccups.
location_zh: 耳垂后面，耳垂和脖子之间的凹陷处。把耳垂往后按，耳垂边缘碰到的地方就是。
location_en: Behind the earlobe, in the depression between the earlobe and the neck. Press the earlobe backward — the spot it touches is the point.
massage_zh: 用中指或食指指腹按压凹陷处，做轻柔的圆圈揉动。力度适中，以酸胀感向耳朵内部扩散为佳。
massage_en: Press into the depression with the pad of your middle or index finger. Knead gently in circles with moderate pressure until you feel the ache spreading into the ear.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2-3次。耳鸣时可随时按揉。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes each time, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime ear ringing occurs.
when_zh: 耳鸣听力下降、面部抽搐、牙痛、打嗝不止、脸颊肿痛时。
when_en: When you have ear ringing, hearing loss, facial twitching, toothache, persistent hiccups, or swollen cheeks.
tips_zh: 配合听宫穴（耳朵前方凹陷）和中渚穴一起按揉，对耳鸣效果更好。打嗝时可持续按压。
tips_en: Combine with Tinggong (in front of the ear) and Zhongzhu (hand) for better ear ringing relief. For hiccups, hold steady pressure.
caution_zh: 耳朵正在发炎流脓时避免按压周围。力度不要过重。
caution_en: Avoid pressing near the ear if there is active infection or discharge. Do not use excessive force.

summary_zh: 缓解耳鸣和头痛的耳后穴位。
summary_en: A point behind the ear that eases ear ringing and headaches.
location_zh: 耳朵后面，耳垂后方骨头凸起（乳突）的中央位置，沿耳廓后方弧线的下三分之一处。
location_en: Behind the ear, on the center of the bony bump (the hard area behind the ear), at the lower third of the curved line running behind the ear.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹轻柔按压此处，做小圆圈揉动。力度要轻，以微微酸胀为宜。
massage_en: Gently press with your index or middle finger pad and make small circles. Keep the pressure light — a mild ache is sufficient.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes each time, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 耳鸣、听力下降、头痛、头部紧绷不适时。
when_en: When you experience ear ringing, reduced hearing, headaches, or tightness around the head.
tips_zh: 配合翳风穴和角孙穴一起按揉，沿耳后做弧线按摩效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Yifeng (behind earlobe) and Jiaosun (above the ear). Massage along the curve behind the ear for best results.
caution_zh: 耳后皮肤有伤口或感染时不要按压。力度必须轻柔。
caution_en: Do not press if the skin behind the ear is wounded or infected. Always use gentle pressure.

summary_zh: 缓解耳鸣和头痛的耳上方穴位。
summary_en: A point above the ear that eases ear ringing and headaches.
location_zh: 耳朵后上方，沿耳廓后方弧线的上三分之一处，耳尖后方的骨面上。
location_en: Behind and above the ear, at the upper third of the curved line running behind the ear, on the bone surface behind the ear tip.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹轻轻按揉此处，做小圆圈揉动。力度要轻柔，头皮处不宜用力过大。
massage_en: Lightly press and knead with your index or middle finger pad in small circles. Keep pressure gentle — the scalp area should not be pressed too hard.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes each time, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 耳鸣、头痛、头部紧绷、耳朵听不清时。
when_en: When you have ear ringing, headaches, head tightness, or difficulty hearing clearly.
tips_zh: 配合瘛脉穴和翳风穴，沿耳后从下往上依次按揉，效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Qimai and Yifeng. Massage behind the ear from bottom to top in sequence for better results.
caution_zh: 头部有外伤时避免按压。力度务必轻柔。
caution_en: Avoid pressing if the head area is injured. Always use very gentle pressure.

summary_zh: 缓解偏头痛、牙痛和眼睛不适的耳上穴位。
summary_en: A point above the ear for migraines, toothache, and eye discomfort.
location_zh: 把耳朵向前折叠，耳尖正对着头上发际线的位置就是这个穴位。
location_en: Fold your ear forward. The point is on the hairline directly above the ear tip.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹按压发际线处的穴位，做圆圈揉动。力度轻到中等，以局部酸胀为度。
massage_en: Press on the hairline point with your index or middle finger pad and knead in circles. Use light to moderate pressure until you feel a local ache.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天1-2次。偏头痛时可随时按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes each time, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime during a migraine.
when_zh: 偏头痛、牙痛、脸颊肿胀、脖子僵硬、眼睛模糊不适时。
when_en: During migraines, toothaches, cheek swelling, neck stiffness, or blurry uncomfortable eyes.
tips_zh: 偏头痛时配合太阳穴（眼角和眉梢之间凹陷处）一起按揉。可以用双手同时按两侧。
tips_en: For migraines, combine with Taiyang (temple, between the eye corner and eyebrow tip). Press both sides simultaneously with both hands.
caution_zh: 头部有外伤或手术伤口时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid pressing if the head area has wounds or surgical incisions.

summary_zh: 缓解耳鸣、耳聋和牙痛的耳前重要穴位。
summary_en: A key point in front of the ear for ear ringing, hearing loss, and toothache.
location_zh: 微微张开嘴巴，耳朵前方上部会出现一个凹陷，用手指按压能感觉到明显的窝。
location_en: Slightly open your mouth. Feel for the depression that appears in front of the upper part of your ear — you will find a clear hollow.
massage_zh: 微微张嘴，用食指或中指指腹按压凹陷处，做轻柔的圆圈揉动。可以配合张嘴闭嘴的动作，交替进行。
massage_en: Open your mouth slightly. Press into the hollow with your index or middle finger pad and knead gently in circles. Alternate between opening and closing your mouth while pressing.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天2-3次。耳朵不适时随时可按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes each time, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime your ears feel uncomfortable.
when_zh: 耳鸣、听力下降、牙痛、脸颊疼痛肿胀时。
when_en: When you have ear ringing, hearing difficulty, toothache, or painful swollen cheeks.
tips_zh: 配合听宫穴（耳朵正前方凹陷）和翳风穴一起按揉，三个穴位围绕耳朵效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Tinggong (directly in front of the ear) and Yifeng (behind the earlobe) — three points around the ear work well together.
caution_zh: 耳朵正在发炎或流脓时请先就医。按压时嘴巴要微张，不要闭嘴用力按。
caution_en: See a doctor first if the ear is actively inflamed or discharging. Keep your mouth slightly open while pressing — do not press with a closed jaw.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛、耳鸣和下巴紧绷的太阳穴旁穴位。
summary_en: A point near the temple that eases headaches, ear ringing, and jaw tightness.
location_zh: 鬓发（鬓角头发）后缘，耳朵根部前方的位置。可以摸到一根血管在跳动，穴位在它后面。
location_en: At the rear edge of the sideburn hair, in front of the ear root. You may feel a pulsing vessel — the point is just behind it.
massage_zh: 避开跳动的血管，用食指或中指指腹在血管后方轻柔按揉，做小圆圈动作。力度一定要轻。
massage_en: Avoid the pulsing vessel. Press gently with your index or middle finger pad just behind it and make small circles. Keep the pressure very light.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes each time, 1-2 times daily.
when_zh: 头痛、耳鸣、下巴打不开（牙关紧）、面部不适时。
when_en: During headaches, ear ringing, jaw tightness (difficulty opening the mouth), or facial discomfort.
tips_zh: 配合太阳穴和耳门穴一起轻柔按揉。下巴紧绷时可以一边按揉一边慢慢张嘴闭嘴。
tips_en: Combine with Taiyang (temple) and Ermen (in front of the ear). For jaw tightness, slowly open and close your mouth while pressing.
caution_zh: 此处有血管，绝对不要用力按压。能感觉到跳动的地方要避开。
caution_en: A blood vessel runs through this area — never press hard. Avoid the exact spot where you feel pulsing.

summary_zh: 缓解眼部疲劳、眼皮跳和偏头痛的眉尾穴位。
summary_en: An eyebrow-tip point for eye fatigue, eyelid twitching, and migraines.
location_zh: 眉毛外端（眉梢）的凹陷处，沿眉毛摸到最末端稍微往里的地方就是。
location_en: In the depression at the outer end of the eyebrow. Trace your eyebrow to its tip and feel for the small hollow just inside the end.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹轻轻按压眉梢凹陷，做小圆圈揉动。力度一定要轻柔，眼周皮肤薄且敏感。
massage_en: Gently press the hollow at the eyebrow tip with your index or middle finger pad and knead in tiny circles. Use very light pressure — the skin around the eyes is thin and sensitive.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天2-3次。用眼过度时随时可按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes each time, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime after heavy eye use.
when_zh: 眼睛疲劳酸涩、眼皮跳个不停、偏头痛、头晕时。
when_en: When your eyes are tired and dry, your eyelid keeps twitching, or during migraines and dizziness.
tips_zh: 配合攒竹穴（眉头凹陷处）和太阳穴一起按揉，从眉头沿眉毛按到眉梢再到太阳穴，舒缓眼部疲劳。
tips_en: Combine with Zanzhu (inner eyebrow hollow) and Taiyang (temple). Massage from the inner eyebrow along to the tip, then to the temple, for full eye relief.
caution_zh: 眼部有炎症或刚做过眼部手术时不要按压。此穴不宜艾灸，仅适合按揉。
caution_en: Do not press if you have an eye infection or recent eye surgery. This point is for massage only — do not apply heat.

summary_zh: 缓解眼睛疲劳酸涩，也能帮助减轻太阳穴附近的头痛。
summary_en: Relieves tired, achy eyes and eases headaches near the temples.
location_zh: 眼角外侧（靠近太阳穴那边），用手指沿眼眶骨的外缘向外摸，离眼角大约半个指尖宽的地方有一个小凹陷。按下去有轻微酸胀感。
location_en: At the outer corner of your eye, slide your fingertip along the bony rim toward your temple. About half a fingertip-width out, you'll find a small dip in the bone. Press gently and you'll feel a mild ache.
massage_zh: 用双手中指指腹同时轻轻按住两侧穴位，做小幅度画圈揉动。力度一定要轻柔，眼周皮肤薄，感觉微微酸胀即可。
massage_en: Place both middle fingertips on each side simultaneously. Make tiny, gentle circles with light pressure. The skin here is delicate — a soft ache is all you need.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1分钟，每天2-3次，用眼过度时随时可按。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1 minute, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime after heavy screen use.
when_zh: 长时间看屏幕眼睛酸涩时；太阳穴附近隐隐作痛时；眼睛干涩想揉眼时。
when_en: After long screen sessions when your eyes feel dry and strained. When a dull ache creeps around your temples. When you catch yourself wanting to rub your eyes.
tips_zh: 闭上眼睛按效果更好。可以配合太阳穴一起轻揉，从眼角到太阳穴依次按过去。
tips_en: Close your eyes while pressing for a deeper effect. Follow up by rubbing your temples in sequence from eye corner outward.
caution_zh: 眼周皮肤很薄，只能轻柔按揉，不可用力按压。眼部有炎症时不要按。
caution_en: Use only very gentle pressure — the skin around the eye is fragile. Skip if you have any eye infection or inflammation.

summary_zh: 缓解耳鸣耳闷，也能帮助放松下巴紧张。
summary_en: Eases ringing in the ears and jaw tension.
location_zh: 张开嘴，在耳朵前面（耳屏的前下方）会出现一个凹陷，用手指按进去能感觉到明显的坑。闭上嘴凹陷就会变浅。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Open your mouth and feel just in front of your ear, slightly below the little flap (tragus). A dip appears when your jaw opens. Press into it — you'll feel a clear ache. The dip disappears when you close your mouth.
massage_zh: 微微张嘴，用食指或中指指腹按住凹陷处，做轻柔的按压和小圈揉动。力度适中，有酸胀感即可。可以边按边慢慢开合嘴巴。
massage_en: Open your mouth slightly. Press your index or middle fingertip into the dip and rub in small circles with moderate pressure. Try slowly opening and closing your jaw while pressing.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天2次，耳鸣发作时随时可按。
routine_en: Press 1-2 minutes per session, twice daily. Press anytime during episodes of ear ringing.
when_zh: 耳朵嗡嗡响或闷堵感时；下巴咬合紧张、磨牙后不适时；坐飞机后耳朵不舒服时。
when_en: When your ears ring or feel blocked. After teeth grinding or jaw clenching. When your ears feel plugged after a flight.
tips_zh: 按的时候嘴巴微微张开效果最好。可以配合听宫穴（正上方）一起按，上下交替。
tips_en: Keep your mouth slightly open while pressing for the best effect. Pair with the point just above (SI19 Tinggong) for stronger relief.
caution_zh: 力度不要太大，这里靠近耳道和颞下颌关节。耳朵发炎流脓时不要按。
caution_en: Press gently — this area is close to your ear canal and jaw joint. Avoid if you have an ear infection with discharge.

summary_zh: 缓解太阳穴区域头痛和下巴紧张不适。
summary_en: Relieves headaches near the temples and eases jaw stiffness.
location_zh: 在颧骨弓（耳朵前面那根凸起的骨头弧线）的最上缘中央，有一个小凹陷。用手指沿颧弓上缘摸，中间位置按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Feel the bony arch in front of your ear (cheekbone arch). Run your finger along its upper edge to the center. There's a small notch — press into it and you'll feel a deep ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住凹陷处，做小圈揉动或持续按压。力度中等，不要太重，酸胀为度。可以双手同时按两侧。
massage_en: Press your middle fingertip into the notch and rub in small circles, or hold steady pressure. Use both hands to press both sides at once. Moderate pressure is enough.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，头痛时可随时按。
routine_en: Press 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime during a headache.
when_zh: 太阳穴附近头痛时；嘴巴张不大、下巴关节卡住时；面部偏头痛发作时。
when_en: When headaches settle near your temples. When your jaw feels locked or won't open fully. During facial pain or migraine episodes.
tips_zh: 配合下关穴（颧弓下缘同一位置）一起按，上下夹住颧弓骨，效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with the point just below the cheekbone arch (ST7 Xiaguan) — pressing above and below together works well.
caution_zh: 力度适中即可，不要用力敲击或重按。颞下颌关节有急性炎症时慎用。
caution_en: Use moderate pressure only — no tapping or heavy force. Use caution if your jaw joint is acutely inflamed.

summary_zh: 缓解偏头痛和太阳穴发胀的不适感。
summary_en: Eases migraine pain and throbbing pressure at the temples.
location_zh: 在太阳穴上方的发际线附近，从额角发际到耳朵上方弧形连线的上四分之一处。用指尖沿发际摸，按到酸胀的点就是。
location_en: Near the hairline above your temple. Imagine a curve from your front hairline corner down to just above your ear — the point is one-quarter of the way from the front. Press along the hairline until you find a tender spot.
massage_zh: 用中指或食指指腹按住穴位，做轻柔的画圈揉动。头皮下面就是骨头，不需要太大力度，轻轻揉即可。
massage_en: Press with your middle or index fingertip and rub in gentle circles. The bone is just beneath the skin, so light pressure is sufficient.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，偏头痛时可随时按。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press whenever a migraine flares up.
when_zh: 太阳穴区域胀痛时；偏头痛发作时；眼睛外侧酸胀伴头痛时。
when_en: When your temples feel swollen and achy. During migraine episodes. When eye strain triggers a headache spreading to the side of your head.
tips_zh: 配合率谷穴（耳尖上方）和太阳穴一起按，沿头侧从前往后依次揉过去效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with GB8 (Shuaigu) above your ear and the temple area. Work from front to back along the side of your head.
caution_zh: 此处头皮薄，轻柔按揉即可，不要用指甲抠或重力按压。
caution_en: The scalp here is thin. Use gentle fingertip pressure only — no digging with nails.

summary_zh: 缓解偏头痛，也能帮助减轻牙痛和眼胀。
summary_en: Eases migraine pain and helps with toothaches and eye pressure.
location_zh: 在太阳穴到耳朵上方的弧形连线中点处，大约在发际线附近。用指尖按压这个区域，找到最酸胀的点就是。
location_en: Halfway along the curved line from your temple hairline corner down to just above your ear. Press along this arc near the hairline until you find the most tender point.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻轻按住穴位，做小幅度的揉圈。力度要轻，头部骨头就在皮肤下方，感觉微微酸胀就够了。
massage_en: Press your middle fingertip gently on the point and make small circles. Keep pressure light — bone is right beneath the surface. A mild ache is enough.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，头痛发作时可随时按。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime during headache episodes.
when_zh: 偏头痛发作时；上排牙齿隐隐作痛时；眼睛胀痛伴头侧不适时。
when_en: When a migraine strikes. When your upper teeth ache faintly. When eye pressure comes with pain at the side of your head.
tips_zh: 可以和颔厌、悬厘一起沿发际弧线依次按揉，把整条线都放松。
tips_en: Press in sequence along the hairline arc with GB4 (Hanyan) and GB6 (Xuanli) to relax the entire zone.
caution_zh: 轻柔按揉，不要用力敲打头部。头部外伤未愈时不要按。
caution_en: Gentle pressure only — don't tap or pound the head. Avoid if you have an unhealed head injury.

summary_zh: 缓解头侧胀痛和眼睛疲劳。
summary_en: Relieves pain on the side of the head and tired eyes.
location_zh: 在太阳穴到耳朵上方的弧形连线的下四分之一处，接近耳朵上方的发际附近。按下去有轻微酸感。
location_en: Three-quarters of the way from your temple hairline down toward the top of your ear, near the hairline. Press until you find a subtly tender spot.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹轻轻按住穴位，做小幅度揉圈。力度要轻柔，微微酸胀就好。可以双手同时按两侧。
massage_en: Use your index or middle fingertip to press gently and rub in tiny circles. Both sides at once is ideal. Light pressure is all you need.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1分钟，每天1-2次，头痛时可增加次数。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1 minute, 1-2 times daily. Increase frequency during headaches.
when_zh: 头侧隐隐作痛时；眼睛酸胀伴太阳穴不适时；精神紧张头皮发紧时。
when_en: When the side of your head aches faintly. When eye strain pairs with temple discomfort. When stress makes your scalp feel tight.
tips_zh: 从颔厌到悬颅再到悬厘，依次沿发际线揉过来，整条放松效果最好。
tips_en: Work along the hairline from GB4 through GB5 to GB6 in order for a full release of the temporal zone.
caution_zh: 此处骨头浅，只需轻揉，不可重压。
caution_en: Bone is close to the surface — light rubbing only, no heavy pressing.

summary_zh: 缓解偏头痛、面颊胀痛和牙齿不适。
summary_en: Eases migraine, cheek swelling, and tooth discomfort.
location_zh: 在耳朵前方鬓角区域，鬓角发际后缘和耳尖水平线的交叉点。用手指在耳朵前上方的发际处按压，找到酸胀点就是。
location_en: At the sideburn area in front of your ear. Find where the back edge of your sideburn hairline meets a horizontal line from your ear tip. Press into the hairline there and feel for a tender spot.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹按住穴位，轻柔地画圈揉动。力度不要大，感觉轻微酸胀即可。
massage_en: Press with your fingertip and rub in gentle circles. Keep pressure light — a mild ache is all you need.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，下巴不适或头痛时加按。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Add sessions when jaw pain or headaches arise.
when_zh: 偏头痛发作时；脸颊肿胀不适时；牙齿阵阵作痛、嘴张不开时。
when_en: During migraine flare-ups. When your cheek feels puffy or sore. When your teeth ache and your jaw feels stiff.
tips_zh: 牙痛时配合合谷穴（虎口处）一起按，双管齐下效果明显。
tips_en: For toothache, pair with LI4 (Hegu) in the thumb web for a noticeably stronger effect.
caution_zh: 此处靠近太阳穴，轻柔按揉即可，不要重按。
caution_en: Close to the temple — keep it gentle. No firm pressing here.

summary_zh: 缓解偏头痛和宿醉头痛，也能帮助止晕止吐。
summary_en: Relieves migraine and hangover headaches, also helps with dizziness and nausea.
location_zh: 把耳朵向上折，找到耳尖，从耳尖直直往上摸进头发里，大约两横指的距离就到了。按下去酸胀感明显。
location_en: Fold your ear forward to find the tip. Go straight up from the ear tip into the hairline about two finger-widths. Press firmly and you'll feel a clear, deep ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，做按压加揉圈的动作。力度中等，酸胀感明显即可。可以两手同时按两侧。
massage_en: Press your middle fingertip on the point and combine steady pressure with small circles. Use both hands to press both sides at once. Moderate pressure works well.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天2次，头痛或头晕时随时可按。
routine_en: Press 1-2 minutes per session, twice daily. Press anytime for headache or dizziness relief.
when_zh: 偏头痛或宿醉头痛时；头晕想吐时；喝酒后头胀不舒服时。
when_en: When migraine or hangover headaches hit. When you feel dizzy and nauseous. When your head throbs after drinking.
tips_zh: 宿醉头痛时两侧同时按，配合多喝温水效果更好。偏头痛配合太阳穴一起揉。
tips_en: For hangovers, press both sides while drinking plenty of warm water. For migraines, combine with temple massage.
caution_zh: 力度适中就好，此处头皮下面就是颅骨，不需要用很大力。
caution_en: Moderate pressure is enough — the skull is right beneath the scalp. No need for heavy force.

summary_zh: 缓解耳后头痛和牙龈胀痛，也能帮助安神定志。
summary_en: Eases headaches behind the ear, swollen gums, and helps calm an anxious mind.
location_zh: 在耳朵后缘的正上方，从耳根往上摸进发际大约两横指的距离就到了。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Directly above the back edge of your ear. Go straight up from the ear base into the hairline about two finger-widths. Press and you'll find a tender ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，做小幅度揉圈。力度轻到中等，感觉酸胀即可。可以双手同时按两侧。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip and make small circles. Light to moderate pressure is enough. Press both sides simultaneously for best results.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1分钟，每天1-2次，头痛或焦虑时可加按。
routine_en: Press for 1 minute, 1-2 times daily. Add extra sessions during headaches or anxious moments.
when_zh: 耳朵后面头痛时；牙龈肿胀疼痛时；心烦意乱睡不着时。
when_en: When pain settles behind your ear. When your gums are swollen and sore. When you feel restless and can't wind down.
tips_zh: 配合风池穴（后脑勺下方）一起按，从上到下顺着按下来效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with GB20 (Fengchi) at the base of the skull — press from top to bottom for a fuller release.
caution_zh: 轻柔按揉即可，不要用力抠或敲打。
caution_en: Gentle rubbing only — no scratching or tapping.

summary_zh: 缓解耳后头痛和耳鸣，也能帮助放松颈部。
summary_en: Relieves headaches behind the ear, tinnitus, and neck tension.
location_zh: 在耳朵后面，耳后那个凸起骨头（乳突）的后上方。从天冲穴到完骨穴的弧线上三分之一处。用手指在耳后上方摸索，找到酸胀点就是。
location_en: Behind your ear, above and behind the bony bump (mastoid). Feel around the area above and behind that bump — about one-third of the way down from the top of the curve behind your ear. Press until you find a tender spot.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，做轻柔揉圈。耳后区域皮肤薄，力度要轻，微微酸胀就好。
massage_en: Press your middle fingertip on the point and rub in small, gentle circles. Keep pressure light — the skin behind the ear is thin. A mild ache is sufficient.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1分钟，每天1-2次，耳鸣时可随时按。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1 minute, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime during tinnitus episodes.
when_zh: 耳朵后面头痛时；耳鸣或听力模糊时；脖子后面僵硬不舒服时。
when_en: When you get headaches behind your ear. When your ears ring or hearing feels muffled. When the back of your neck feels stiff.
tips_zh: 配合完骨穴（耳后乳突下方）和天冲穴一起沿弧线按揉，整个耳后都放松。
tips_en: Press in sequence along the curve behind your ear with GB9 (Tianchong) and GB12 (Wangu) for full relief.
caution_zh: 此处靠近耳后，力度要轻。耳部有感染时不要按。
caution_en: This is close to the ear — keep it gentle. Skip if you have any ear infection.

summary_zh: 缓解后脑和耳后区域的头痛，也能放松僵硬的脖子。
summary_en: Eases headaches behind the ears and loosens a stiff neck.
location_zh: 在耳朵后面，耳后凸骨（乳突）的后上方，从天冲到完骨弧线的下三分之一处。在浮白穴稍下方，按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Behind your ear, above and behind the bony bump. It sits about two-thirds of the way down the curve from the top of the ear to the bump behind it. Press gently to find a tender ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻轻按住穴位，做小幅度揉圈。力度轻柔，耳后区域不需要重按，感觉微微酸胀即可。
massage_en: Press gently with your middle fingertip and make small circles. Light pressure is enough for this area — just find a mild ache.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1分钟，每天1-2次，后脑头痛时可加按。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1 minute, 1-2 times daily. Increase during headaches at the back of the head.
when_zh: 后脑勺和耳后区域头痛时；脖子后面僵硬酸痛时；颈项强直转头困难时。
when_en: When the back of your head or the area behind your ears aches. When your neck is stiff and turning feels hard.
tips_zh: 配合风池穴和完骨穴一起按，沿后脑到脖子的线路依次揉下来效果好。
tips_en: Combine with GB12 (Wangu) and GB20 (Fengchi). Press in a line from behind the ear down to the base of the skull.
caution_zh: 轻柔按揉即可，此处皮肤薄且靠近耳部，不要重按。
caution_en: Light rubbing only — the skin is thin and close to the ear. No heavy pressure.

summary_zh: 缓解后脑头痛和脖子僵硬，也能帮助改善失眠。
summary_en: Relieves headaches at the back of the head, stiff neck, and helps with sleep.
location_zh: 在耳朵后面那个凸起的骨头（乳突）的正下方，有一个明显的凹陷。用手指从耳后骨头往下摸，摸到骨头下缘的凹坑就是。按下去酸胀感很明显。
location_en: Find the bony bump behind your ear (mastoid). Slide your finger to its lower edge and drop into the hollow just below. Press in firmly and you'll feel a strong, satisfying ache.
massage_zh: 用拇指或中指指腹按住凹陷，做稍有力度的按压和揉圈。力度可以中等偏重，此处肌肉有厚度，按到酸胀即可。
massage_en: Press your thumb or middle finger into the hollow. Use moderate-to-firm pressure with circular rubbing. This area has more muscle, so a deeper press feels good.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2分钟，每天2次，睡前按一次有助于放松入睡。
routine_en: Press for 2 minutes, twice daily. A session before bed can help you wind down for sleep.
when_zh: 后脑勺头痛时；脖子僵硬转不动时；晚上翻来覆去睡不着时；牙齿疼痛时。
when_en: When the back of your head aches. When your neck is locked up. When you can't fall asleep. When your teeth hurt.
tips_zh: 失眠时配合风池穴一起按，先完骨再风池，按完后闭眼做几次深呼吸。
tips_en: For insomnia, pair with GB20 (Fengchi) — press Wangu first, then Fengchi. Close your eyes and take several deep breaths afterward.
caution_zh: 力度适中即可，不要向内深压。耳后有疖肿或皮肤问题时不要按。
caution_en: Moderate pressure only — don't push straight inward too deeply. Avoid if you have skin issues or boils behind the ear.

summary_zh: 缓解前额头痛和焦虑紧张，帮助安定心神。
summary_en: Eases forehead headaches and anxious tension, helping you feel grounded.
location_zh: 从前额发际线往上半个拇指宽度，再从头顶正中线向旁边量四横指（约3寸）处。大约在额头发际的外侧区域。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Half a thumb-width above your front hairline, about four finger-widths to the side of the center of your head. It's in the outer part of the frontal hairline. Press and you'll feel a mild ache.
massage_zh: 用食指或中指指腹按住穴位，做小幅度揉圈。力度轻柔，头皮薄的地方不需要重按。可以两手同时按两侧。
massage_en: Press with your fingertip and rub in tiny circles. Light pressure is enough on the scalp. Use both hands to press both sides simultaneously.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，焦虑时随时可按。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime you feel anxious.
when_zh: 前额头痛时；焦虑紧张、思绪纷乱时；头晕目眩时；入睡前心神不宁时。
when_en: When your forehead aches. When anxiety scatters your thoughts. When dizziness hits. When your mind races at bedtime.
tips_zh: 焦虑时配合深呼吸一起做，按揉时闭眼，吸气四秒呼气六秒，效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with slow breathing — close your eyes, inhale for 4 seconds, exhale for 6. The combination is deeply calming.
caution_zh: 轻柔按揉即可，此处头皮薄，不要用力压。
caution_en: Light pressure only — the scalp is thin here. No hard pressing.

summary_zh: 缓解前额头痛和眼睛酸胀，也能减轻眉棱骨痛。
summary_en: Eases forehead headaches, tired eyes, and brow-bone pressure.
location_zh: 正视前方，在眉毛中点的正上方一横指处（约1寸）。平视时从瞳孔直直往上到额头，超过眉毛一横指就到了。按下去有酸胀感。
location_en: Look straight ahead. Go one thumb-width directly above the center of your eyebrow, straight up from your pupil. Press the forehead there and you'll feel a clear ache.
massage_zh: 用双手中指指腹同时按住两侧穴位，做轻柔的揉圈或按压。力度适中，感觉酸胀但不痛。可以从眉毛中间往上推按到穴位。
massage_en: Place both middle fingertips above your eyebrow centers. Rub gently in small circles or hold steady pressure. You can also slide upward from mid-brow to the point.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天2-3次，用眼过度时随时可按。
routine_en: Press 1-2 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime after heavy screen time.
when_zh: 前额发紧头痛时；长时间看屏幕眼睛酸涩时；眉骨附近胀痛时；眼皮沉重抬不起时。
when_en: When your forehead feels tight and achy. After long screen sessions with strained eyes. When your brow bone throbs. When your eyelids feel heavy.
tips_zh: 配合攒竹穴（眉头）和鱼腰（眉毛中间）一起按，沿眉毛从内到外再往上到阳白，效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with BL2 (Zanzhu) at the inner brow and the mid-brow area. Work from inner brow outward, then up to this point.
caution_zh: 力度适中，此处额骨浅，不需要太大力就能有感觉。
caution_en: Moderate pressure is enough — the bone is shallow here and responds easily.

summary_zh: 缓解前额头痛和鼻塞，也能帮助减轻流泪和眼胀。
summary_en: Eases forehead headaches, nasal congestion, and watery or achy eyes.
location_zh: 从前额发际线正上方半个拇指宽的地方，在瞳孔正上方。正视前方时，从瞳孔垂直往上到发际线再多半指就到了。按下去有酸感。
location_en: Half a thumb-width above your front hairline, directly above your pupil when looking straight ahead. Press and you'll feel a mild soreness.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，做小幅度揉圈。力度轻柔，微微酸胀即可。双手同时按两侧效果更好。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip and rub in small circles. Light pressure, both sides at once. A gentle ache is all you need.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，鼻塞时可增加次数。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press more often when congested.
when_zh: 前额头痛时；鼻子不通气、流鼻涕时；眼睛酸胀流泪时；头顶发沉昏沉时。
when_en: When your forehead aches. When your nose is stuffed up. When your eyes water and feel strained. When your head feels heavy and foggy.
tips_zh: 鼻塞时配合迎香穴（鼻翼两侧）一起按，通鼻效果更快。
tips_en: For congestion, combine with LI20 (Yingxiang) beside the nostrils for faster sinus relief.
caution_zh: 轻柔按揉，此处头皮薄，不需要用力。
caution_en: Light rubbing only — the scalp here is thin and doesn't need firm pressure.

summary_zh: 缓解眼睛疲劳酸胀和前额头痛，帮助眼睛明亮。
summary_en: Relieves eye fatigue and forehead headaches, helping your vision feel clearer.
location_zh: 从前额发际线往上大约两横指（约1.5寸），在瞳孔正上方。在头临泣穴再往上一横指左右的位置。按下去有微微酸感。
location_en: About two finger-widths above your front hairline, directly above your pupil. It's roughly one finger-width above GB15. Press and you'll feel a subtle ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，做轻柔的揉圈动作。力度要轻，感觉微微酸胀就好。双手同时按两侧更方便。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip and rub in gentle circles. Light pressure is enough. Use both hands for both sides at once.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1分钟，每天1-2次，用眼过度时可加按。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1 minute, 1-2 times daily. Add sessions after intense screen work.
when_zh: 眼睛酸涩看东西模糊时；前额连着头顶发沉时；长时间阅读或看屏幕后。
when_en: When your eyes feel strained and vision blurs. When heaviness spreads from forehead to the top of your head. After long reading or screen sessions.
tips_zh: 可以从阳白、头临泣到目窗依次往上按揉，沿头顶方向把前额的紧张一路松开。
tips_en: Press in order from GB14 (Yangbai) to GB15 to GB16, working upward from the forehead to release tension step by step.
caution_zh: 轻柔按揉，不需要用力。按的时候保持呼吸均匀。
caution_en: Keep it gentle and breathe steadily while pressing. No firm force needed.

summary_zh: 缓解头顶和头侧胀痛，也能帮助减轻牙齿不适。
summary_en: Eases pain at the top and sides of the head, and helps with toothache.
location_zh: 从前额发际线往上大约三横指半（约2.5寸），在瞳孔正上方。大约在头顶前部的位置。按下去有轻微酸胀。
location_en: About three and a half finger-widths above your front hairline, directly above your pupil. It's on the front part of the top of your head. Press for a mild ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按住穴位，做小幅度揉圈。头顶的皮肤紧贴骨头，不需要太大力，轻轻揉就好。
massage_en: Press your middle fingertip on the point and make tiny circles. The scalp is tight against bone here, so light rubbing is enough.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1分钟，每天1-2次，头痛时可增加次数。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1 minute, 1-2 times daily. Increase during headache episodes.
when_zh: 头顶或头侧胀痛时；上排牙齿隐痛时；头晕目眩时。
when_en: When the top or side of your head aches. When your upper teeth throb faintly. When dizziness hits.
tips_zh: 可以用五指张开从前额梳到头顶，依次按过阳白、头临泣、目窗到正营，像梳头一样放松。
tips_en: Spread your fingers and comb from forehead to crown, pressing GB14 through GB17 in sequence — like a relaxing scalp massage.
caution_zh: 头顶皮肤薄，轻揉即可，不要用指甲或硬物刮按。
caution_en: The scalp is thin here. Rub gently with fingertips — no nails or hard objects.

summary_zh: 缓解头顶头痛和鼻塞，也能帮助减轻头晕。
summary_en: Relieves headaches at the crown, nasal congestion, and dizziness.
location_zh: 从前额发际线往上大约五横指（约4寸），在瞳孔正上方。在头顶偏前的位置，正营穴再往后约两横指。按下去有轻微酸感。
location_en: About five finger-widths above your front hairline, directly above your pupil. It's on the crown area, roughly two finger-widths behind GB17. Press for a subtle ache.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻轻按住穴位，做小幅度揉圈。头顶力度要轻，微微酸胀就够了。双手同时按两侧。
massage_en: Press gently with your middle fingertip and rub in tiny circles. Very light pressure at the crown is enough. Press both sides at once.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1分钟，每天1-2次，鼻塞头痛时可加按。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1 minute, 1-2 times daily. Add sessions during congestion or headaches.
when_zh: 头顶闷痛时；鼻子堵塞不通气时；头晕目眩站不稳时；流鼻血时按压有帮助。
when_en: When the top of your head aches dully. When your nose is completely blocked. When dizziness makes you unsteady. May also help during nosebleeds.
tips_zh: 鼻塞时配合迎香穴和印堂穴一起按，三个穴位配合通鼻效果更好。
tips_en: For stuffy nose, combine with LI20 (Yingxiang) beside the nostrils and Yintang between the brows for stronger relief.
caution_zh: 轻揉即可，头顶不宜重按。有头部外伤时避开此处。
caution_en: Light rubbing only at the crown. Avoid this point if you have a head injury.

summary_zh: 缓解后脑头痛和颈部僵硬，也能帮助减轻头晕。
summary_en: Eases headaches at the back of the head, neck stiffness, and dizziness.
location_zh: 在后脑勺，风池穴的正上方，与后脑中央那个凸起（枕外隆凸）的上缘在同一水平线上。用手指在后脑勺上部左右两侧摸索，找到酸胀点即是。
location_en: At the back of your head, directly above GB20 (Fengchi), level with the upper edge of the bony bump at the center of the back of your skull. Feel around and press until you find a tender spot.
massage_zh: 用中指或拇指指腹按住穴位，做小幅度揉圈。力度中等，感觉酸胀即可。双手同时按两侧更方便。
massage_en: Press with your middle finger or thumb and rub in small circles. Moderate pressure — find a satisfying ache. Both sides at once works well.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，头痛时可随时按。
routine_en: Press 1-2 minutes per session, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime for headache relief.
when_zh: 后脑勺发沉头痛时；头晕目眩时；颈项强直不舒服时；眼睛酸痛连着后脑不适时。
when_en: When the back of your head feels heavy and achy. When dizziness strikes. When your neck feels rigid. When eye pain connects to discomfort at the back of your head.
tips_zh: 配合风池穴一起按，从脑空顺着往下揉到风池，一条线松下来效果很好。
tips_en: Pair with GB20 (Fengchi) — rub downward from this point to Fengchi for a connected release along the back of the skull.
caution_zh: 力度适中，后脑勺区域不要用力敲击或重压。
caution_en: Use moderate pressure — no tapping or heavy force on the back of the skull.

summary_zh: 缓解头痛、脖子僵硬和感冒症状的明星穴位。
summary_en: A superstar point for headaches, stiff neck, and early cold symptoms.
location_zh: 后脑勺下方，脖子和头连接的地方。低头时后脑勺正中能摸到一个凸起，凸起的两侧各有一条大筋，大筋外侧的凹陷处就是。用拇指按进去会有很强的酸胀感。
location_en: At the base of your skull where your neck meets your head. Tilt your chin down. Feel the bump at the center of the back of your skull, then slide outward past the thick muscle on each side. Press into the hollows — you'll feel a deep, strong ache.
massage_zh: 双手抱住后脑，用两个拇指同时按进两侧凹陷里，向头顶方向稍微用力，做按压加揉圈的动作。力度中等偏重，酸胀感会很明显，非常舒服。
massage_en: Cradle the back of your head with both hands. Press both thumbs into the hollows, angling slightly upward toward the crown. Combine firm pressure with circular rubbing. It should feel intensely satisfying.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天2-3次，头痛或脖子不舒服时随时可按。
routine_en: Press 2-3 minutes per session, 2-3 times daily. Press anytime for headache or neck discomfort.
when_zh: 各种头痛发作时；脖子僵硬酸痛时；感冒初期怕冷头昏时；长时间低头看手机后；失眠时。
when_en: During any type of headache. When your neck is stiff and sore. At the first sign of a cold. After long phone scrolling. When you can't sleep.
tips_zh: 按揉时闭上眼睛，配合慢呼吸效果翻倍。按完之后慢慢转动脖子，你会发现灵活很多。
tips_en: Close your eyes and breathe slowly while pressing — the effect doubles. After pressing, gently rotate your neck. You'll notice it moves much more freely.
caution_zh: 按压方向朝头顶方向，不要直接向前深压（前方是重要结构）。力度虽可以较重但要渐进。
caution_en: Angle your pressure upward toward the crown, not straight forward. Increase pressure gradually — don't start with full force.

summary_zh: 肩膀酸痛僵硬的首选穴位，也能缓解紧张性头痛。
summary_en: The top point for stiff, aching shoulders, and a great headache reliever.
location_zh: 在肩膀最高点，低头时后脖子最凸的那个骨头（大椎）和肩膀尖端连线的正中间。用对侧手搭肩，中指自然落下的位置就差不多是。按下去酸胀感非常明显。
location_en: At the highest point of your shoulder, midway between the big bump at the base of your neck and the tip of your shoulder. Reach across and rest your opposite hand on your shoulder — your middle finger lands near the spot. You'll feel a strong, deep ache.
massage_zh: 用对侧手的拇指、食指和中指一起捏住肩膀肌肉，像揉面团一样反复提捏。也可以用中指指腹直接按揉。力度可以稍重，这里肌肉很厚，酸胀感会很强。
massage_en: Reach across with the opposite hand and squeeze the shoulder muscle between your thumb and fingers, kneading like dough. Or press directly with your middle finger. Use firm pressure — the muscle here is thick and responds well to deep work.
routine_zh: 每次按揉或提捏2-3分钟，每天2-3次，肩膀不舒服时随时可做。
routine_en: Knead or press for 2-3 minutes, 2-3 times daily. Do it anytime your shoulders feel tight.
when_zh: 肩膀酸痛僵硬时；久坐办公后颈肩不适时；紧张性头痛从脖子蔓延到头顶时；落枕时。
when_en: When your shoulders are stiff and aching. After long desk work with neck and shoulder tension. When a tension headache creeps from your neck up. When you wake with a crick in your neck.
tips_zh: 按揉的同时慢慢转动脖子和耸肩，能帮助肌肉更快放松。配合风池穴一起按效果更好。
tips_en: Slowly roll your neck and shrug your shoulders while pressing to help the muscle release faster. Pair with GB20 (Fengchi) for a stronger effect.
caution_zh: 孕妇不要按此穴。按揉力度虽可较重，但要避免用尖锐物品刺激。不要在骨头上直接重按。
caution_en: Avoid this point during pregnancy. Press firmly on the muscle, but not on bone. Don't use sharp objects.

summary_zh: 缓解胸侧和腋下胀痛，也能帮助减轻上臂不适。
summary_en: Relieves pain along the side of the chest and under the arm.
location_zh: 在胸部外侧，腋窝正下方，大约在第四根肋骨之间的缝隙处。把手臂抬起，在腋窝中线往下摸约三横指，按到酸胀的位置就是。
location_en: On the outer side of your chest, directly below the center of your armpit, in the space between the fourth ribs. Raise your arm and press about three finger-widths below the armpit center until you find a tender spot.
massage_zh: 抬起同侧手臂，用对侧手的食指和中指并拢按住穴位，做轻柔的揉圈。力度适中偏轻，胸侧肋骨之间不要用力太大。
massage_en: Raise the arm on the same side. Press with the opposite hand's index and middle fingers together, rubbing in gentle circles. Use light to moderate pressure — the ribs are close beneath.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，胸侧不适时可随时按。
routine_en: Rub gently for 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime you feel side-chest discomfort.
when_zh: 胸侧或腋下胀痛不适时；深呼吸时侧面有牵扯痛时；上臂内侧酸痛时。
when_en: When the side of your chest or armpit area feels sore and tight. When deep breathing pulls at your side. When the inner upper arm aches.
tips_zh: 按揉时配合深呼吸，吸气时轻按，呼气时稍加力，能帮助胸廓更好地打开。
