tips_en: Breathe deeply while pressing — lighter on inhale, firmer on exhale. This helps open up the rib cage.
caution_zh: 此处肋骨浅，只能轻柔按揉，不要用力戳按。腋下有淋巴结肿大时不要按。
caution_en: Ribs are close to the surface — gentle pressure only. Skip if you have swollen lymph nodes under your arm.

summary_zh: 胸侧的穴位，适合缓解胸闷和叹气不畅。
summary_en: A side-chest point that eases chest tightness and shortness of breath.
location_zh: 在胸部外侧，腋窝下方约一个手掌的位置，第4根肋骨的间隙中。
location_en: On the outer side of your chest, about one palm below the armpit, in the space between the fourth and fifth ribs.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢，轻轻按压肋骨间隙，力度以有酸胀感为宜，做缓慢的小圈揉动。注意力度要轻。
massage_en: Place your index and middle fingers together on the rib space. Press gently and make slow small circles. Keep the pressure light — you should feel a mild ache, not pain.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，胸闷时随时可按。
routine_en: Massage for 1 to 2 minutes, once daily. Press anytime you feel chest tightness.
when_zh: 胸口发闷、总想深呼吸或叹气时、焦虑紧张时。
when_en: When your chest feels stuffy, when you keep sighing or craving deep breaths, or during anxiety.
tips_zh: 按揉时配合深呼吸，吸气时按压，呼气时松开，能帮助放松胸部。
tips_en: Breathe deeply while pressing — press on the inhale, release on the exhale. This helps the chest muscles relax.
caution_zh: 肋骨区域力度一定要轻。胸部有伤或术后不要按压。
caution_en: Always use gentle pressure on the rib area. Avoid if you have a chest injury or recent surgery.

summary_zh: 肋骨下缘的穴位，有助于缓解恶心和胁肋胀痛。
summary_en: A point under the ribcage that helps with nausea and side-rib bloating.
location_zh: 在胸部，从乳头直直往下摸，到肋骨弓的上缘，第7和第8根肋骨之间的位置。
location_en: On your chest, trace straight down from the nipple to the lower edge of the ribcage. The point is between the seventh and eighth ribs where they meet.
massage_zh: 用拇指或食指指腹沿肋骨间隙轻柔按压，找到酸胀点后保持按压并缓慢揉动，配合深呼吸。
massage_en: Press gently along the rib space with your thumb or index finger. Once you find a tender spot, hold steady pressure and knead slowly while breathing deeply.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1次，饭后一小时再按。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes each time, once daily. Wait at least one hour after eating.
when_zh: 吃完饭觉得肚子胀、恶心想吐、两侧肋骨下面发胀时。
when_en: When you feel bloated after eating, nauseous, or have a heavy feeling under your ribs on both sides.
tips_zh: 和期门穴（LR14，肋骨下缘更靠中间）配合按揉，缓解腹胀效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with Qimen (LR14, closer to center on the rib margin) for stronger relief from abdominal bloating.
caution_zh: 肋骨处力度要轻。饭后不要立刻按。孕妇慎用。
caution_en: Use light pressure on the ribs. Do not press right after a meal. Avoid during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 腰侧的穴位，适合缓解腰酸和腹胀。
summary_en: A side-waist point that eases lower back soreness and belly bloating.
location_zh: 在上腹部侧面，最下面那根能摸到的短肋骨（第12肋）的下缘尖端处。
location_en: On the side of your upper abdomen, at the tip of the lowest rib you can feel (the twelfth, or floating rib). Run your fingers along the side to find its free end.
massage_zh: 用拇指按在浮肋尖端下方，向内稍微施压，以酸胀为度，缓慢揉按。也可以双手叉腰用拇指同时按两侧。
massage_en: Press your thumb just below the tip of the floating rib, angling slightly inward. Use moderate pressure until you feel a deep ache. You can do both sides at once with hands on your waist.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，腰酸时随时可按。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Press anytime your lower back feels sore.
when_zh: 腰两侧酸痛、腹胀不消化、小便不太通畅时。
when_en: When your lower back aches on the sides, your belly feels bloated, or urination feels sluggish.
tips_zh: 双手叉腰，拇指放在穴位上，配合扭腰动作一起按揉效果更好。
tips_en: Place both thumbs on the points with hands on your waist, then gently twist your torso side to side while pressing.
caution_zh: 肾脏区域不要用力敲击或重按。腹部疼痛原因不明时请就医。
caution_en: Do not pound or press hard on the kidney area. See a doctor for unexplained abdominal pain.

summary_zh: 腰侧与肚脐平齐的穴位，帮助缓解腰痛和腹部不适。
summary_en: A side-waist point at navel level that helps ease back pain and belly discomfort.
location_zh: 在腰侧，肚脐正对的水平线上，与腋窝中线交叉的点。简单说就是腰两侧与肚脐同高的位置。
location_en: On the side of your waist, at the same height as your navel. Find the point where a horizontal line from your navel meets the midline of your side.
massage_zh: 双手叉腰，拇指放在腰侧穴位上，用指腹按压并做小圈揉动，也可以两手同时向后推揉。
massage_en: Place both hands on your waist with thumbs on the points. Press with your thumb pads and make small circles, or push and knead backward along the waistline.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，早晚各一次。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once or twice daily, morning and evening.
when_zh: 腰部酸沉、月经期间腰部不舒服、小腹冷或胀时。
when_en: When your waist feels achy and heavy, during menstrual back discomfort, or when your lower belly is cold or bloated.
tips_zh: 沿腰部环绕一圈推揉，从带脉穴出发向后推到后腰，能放松整个腰带区域。
tips_en: From this point, knead in a circle around your waistline toward the back. This relaxes the entire belt area around your torso.
caution_zh: 孕妇不要按压此穴。腰部受伤或有炎症时避免。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not massage if the waist area is injured or inflamed.

summary_zh: 小腹侧面的穴位，适合缓解腹痛和腰部酸痛。
summary_en: A lower-side belly point that helps relieve abdominal pain and hip soreness.
location_zh: 在下腹部侧面，肚脐往下约四横指宽，再向外到骨盆前面那块突出的骨头内侧。
location_en: On the side of your lower abdomen, about four finger-widths below the navel, then out to the inner side of the bony bump at the front of your pelvis.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢，轻轻按压骨头内侧的软组织处，力度不宜过重，以温和酸胀为宜。
massage_en: Press gently with your index and middle fingers on the soft tissue just inside the pelvic bone. Use mild pressure — aim for a warm, dull ache rather than sharp pain.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，腹痛时可适当增加。
routine_en: Massage for 1 to 2 minutes, once daily. Increase frequency during abdominal discomfort.
when_zh: 小腹两侧胀痛、腰胯酸痛、月经期间不舒服时。
when_en: When your lower belly aches on the sides, your hip area is sore, or during menstrual discomfort.
tips_zh: 配合带脉穴（GB26）从腰侧到下腹依次按揉，效果更好。
tips_en: Combine with Daimai (GB26) by massaging downward from the waist to the lower belly for a fuller routine.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁止按压。腹部有不明肿块时请先就医。
caution_en: Do not press during pregnancy. See a doctor if you notice any unexplained lumps in the abdomen.

summary_zh: 骨盆前侧的穴位，帮助缓解消化不良和腰腿酸痛。
summary_en: A front-pelvis point that helps with poor digestion and achy hips.
location_zh: 在下腹部，骨盆前面那块突出的骨头（髂前上棘）的内下方约半横指处。
location_en: On your lower abdomen, about half a finger-width below and inward from the bony bump at the front of your pelvis (the hip bone point).
massage_zh: 用拇指轻柔按压骨头内下方的软组织，力度要轻，缓慢揉动，有微微酸感即可。
massage_en: Gently press your thumb into the soft tissue just inside and below the pelvic bone. Use light pressure and knead slowly until you feel a mild ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，饭后一小时再按。
routine_en: Massage for 1 to 2 minutes, once daily. Wait at least one hour after meals.
when_zh: 胃口不好、恶心犯困、腰和大腿连接处酸痛时。
when_en: When you have poor appetite, feel nauseous or sluggish, or your hip-thigh junction aches.
tips_zh: 配合五枢穴（GB27）一起按揉，沿骨盆前缘从上到下顺序操作。
tips_en: Pair with Wushu (GB27) by massaging along the front edge of the pelvis from top to bottom.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁止按压。局部有伤口或炎症时避免。
caution_en: Do not press during pregnancy. Avoid if there is a wound or inflammation in the area.

summary_zh: 臀部外侧的穴位，特别适合缓解髋关节和腰部酸痛。
summary_en: An outer-hip point that is great for relieving hip joint and lower back soreness.
location_zh: 在臀部外侧，找到骨盆前面突出的骨头和大腿外侧最突出的骨头，两者连线的中点就是这个穴位。
location_en: On the outer side of your hip. Find the bony bump at the front of your pelvis and the bony bump on the outer thigh — the point is halfway between them.
massage_zh: 用拇指或掌根按压穴位，力度可以稍重，做深层揉按。也可以侧躺时用网球放在穴位下方滚压。
massage_en: Press with your thumb or the heel of your palm using firm pressure and knead deeply. You can also lie on your side with a tennis ball under this point and roll gently.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，久坐后效果尤佳。
routine_en: Massage for 3 to 5 minutes, once or twice daily. Especially helpful after long sitting.
when_zh: 久坐后髋部僵硬、走路多了腰胯酸痛、腰腿连接处不舒服时。
when_en: When your hip feels stiff from sitting, when walking leaves your hip area sore, or when your lower back-to-leg junction aches.
tips_zh: 配合环跳穴（GB30）一起按揉，从前到后放松整个髋部外侧。
tips_en: Combine with Huantiao (GB30) by massaging from front to back to release the entire outer hip area.
caution_zh: 髋关节受伤或术后请遵医嘱。不要在骨头上用力敲击。
caution_en: Follow medical advice if the hip joint is injured or post-surgery. Do not pound directly on the bone.

summary_zh: 臀部深处的大穴，对坐骨和腰腿疼痛特别有帮助。
summary_en: A major deep-hip point that is especially helpful for sciatica and leg pain.
location_zh: 在臀部，大腿根外侧最突出的骨头与尾骨之间，靠近外侧三分之一的位置。侧卧时在臀部最厚的肌肉处。
location_en: On your buttock, about one-third of the way from the bony bump on the outer thigh toward the tailbone. When lying on your side, it is in the thickest part of the gluteal muscle.
massage_zh: 侧卧上腿弯曲，用拇指或肘尖按压臀部深层肌肉，力度可以较重。也可以仰卧把网球放在臀部下方滚压。
massage_en: Lie on your side with the top leg bent. Press deeply into the buttock with your thumb or elbow. Alternatively, lie on your back with a tennis ball under the point and roll slowly.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，久坐后一定要按。
routine_en: Massage for 3 to 5 minutes, once or twice daily. Make it a habit after prolonged sitting.
when_zh: 臀部和大腿后侧发麻酸痛、久坐后站起来不舒服、走路多了腰腿累时。
when_en: When your buttock or back of the thigh feels numb or achy, when standing up after sitting hurts, or when walking tires your legs.
tips_zh: 和居髎穴（GB29）、委中穴（BL40，膝盖后方中间）配合，从臀部到腿部依次按揉效果更佳。
tips_en: Pair with Juliao (GB29) and Weizhong (BL40, center of the back of the knee) to massage from hip to leg for fuller relief.
caution_zh: 髋关节疾病或腰椎间盘突出严重时请就医，不要自行大力按压。
caution_en: See a doctor for serious hip joint issues or disc problems. Do not self-massage with heavy force in these cases.

summary_zh: 大腿外侧的穴位，帮助缓解腿部酸痛和皮肤痒。
summary_en: An outer-thigh point that relieves leg soreness and itchy skin.
location_zh: 站直双手自然下垂，中指指尖碰到大腿外侧的位置就是这个穴位。大概在大腿外侧正中间偏上。
location_en: Stand straight with your arms hanging naturally at your sides. Where your middle fingertip touches your outer thigh — that is the point.
massage_zh: 用拇指或掌根按压大腿外侧，找到酸胀最明显的点后深按并缓慢揉动。也可以用拳头沿大腿外侧上下敲打。
massage_en: Press your thumb or palm heel into the outer thigh, find the most tender spot, and knead deeply. You can also tap along the outer thigh with a loose fist.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1次，运动后效果更好。
routine_en: Massage for 3 to 5 minutes, once daily. Especially effective after exercise.
when_zh: 大腿外侧发紧酸痛、皮肤痒反复发作、腿部乏力沉重时。
when_en: When your outer thigh feels tight or sore, when itchy skin flares up, or when your legs feel heavy and weak.
tips_zh: 沿大腿外侧从髋部到膝盖方向依次拍打按揉，可以同时覆盖多个穴位。
tips_en: Tap and knead along the entire outer thigh from hip to knee to cover multiple points in one session.
caution_zh: 大腿有静脉曲张时轻柔操作。皮肤有伤口或皮疹时避免。
caution_en: Use gentle pressure if you have varicose veins. Avoid if there are wounds or rashes on the skin.

summary_zh: 大腿外侧偏下的穴位，适合缓解腿部麻木和无力感。
summary_en: A lower outer-thigh point that eases leg numbness and weakness.
location_zh: 在大腿外侧，膝盖后面横纹往上约七寸，大约在大腿外侧中下段的位置。
location_en: On the outer side of your thigh, about one-third of the way up from the back of the knee toward the hip, on the mid-lower portion of the outer thigh.
massage_zh: 用拇指或掌根在大腿外侧深按，找到酸胀感最强的位置，保持按压并上下推揉。
massage_en: Press deeply into the outer thigh with your thumb or palm heel. Find the most tender spot and hold firm pressure while sliding up and down slowly.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，久坐后按效果好。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Best done after prolonged sitting.
when_zh: 腿部发麻没力气、久坐后大腿外侧不舒服、走路多了腿发沉时。
when_en: When your legs feel numb or weak, when the outer thigh aches after sitting, or when walking makes your legs heavy.
tips_zh: 和风市穴（GB31）一起，沿大腿外侧从上到下推揉，放松整条肌肉。
tips_en: Combine with Fengshi (GB31) by massaging down the outer thigh from top to bottom to release the whole muscle.
caution_zh: 大腿深静脉血栓风险人群不要用力按压，请先咨询医生。
caution_en: Do not press firmly if you are at risk for deep vein thrombosis. Consult a doctor first.

summary_zh: 膝盖外侧的穴位，帮助缓解膝盖疼痛和僵硬。
summary_en: An outer-knee point that helps ease knee pain and stiffness.
location_zh: 在膝盖外侧，大腿骨外侧突出骨头的上方凹陷处。坐下弯膝，在膝盖外侧上方能摸到一个明显的凹窝。
location_en: On the outer side of your knee. Sit and bend your knee — feel for a clear dip just above the bony bump on the outer side of your knee.
massage_zh: 用拇指按在凹陷处，向内稍加力，以酸胀为宜。可以一边按一边缓慢屈伸膝盖，帮助放松。
massage_en: Press your thumb into the dip with moderate inward pressure until you feel a dull ache. Slowly bend and straighten your knee while pressing to enhance the release.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，上下楼梯前后按。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once or twice daily. Great before and after climbing stairs.
when_zh: 膝盖外侧疼痛、上下楼梯膝盖不舒服、小腿发麻时。
when_en: When the outer side of your knee hurts, when stairs bother your knees, or when your lower leg feels numb.
tips_zh: 配合阳陵泉（GB34，膝盖外侧下方）一起按揉，从上到下覆盖膝盖外侧。
tips_en: Pair with Yanglingquan (GB34, just below the outer knee) to cover the full outer knee area from top to bottom.
caution_zh: 膝关节严重肿胀或受伤时不要按压，请先就医检查。
caution_en: Do not massage if the knee is severely swollen or injured. See a doctor first.

summary_zh: 膝盖外侧下方的重要穴位，是放松肌肉和筋腱的首选穴。
summary_en: A key point below the outer knee, the top choice for muscle relaxation.
location_zh: 在小腿外侧，膝盖下方外侧能摸到一个圆圆的小骨头（腓骨头），穴位在小骨头前下方的凹陷中。
location_en: On the outer side of your lower leg. Feel for the small round bone just below and outside the knee (fibula head) — the point is in the dip just in front of and below it.
massage_zh: 用拇指按在骨头前下方的凹陷处，力度中等偏重，以明显酸胀为宜。按压的同时活动脚踝画圈，能增强效果。
massage_en: Press your thumb into the dip in front of and below the small bone with moderate to firm pressure. Rotate your ankle in circles while pressing for a stronger effect.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，运动前后都适合按。
routine_en: Massage for 3 to 5 minutes, once or twice daily. Helpful both before and after exercise.
when_zh: 肌肉紧张抽筋、膝盖外侧疼痛、肩颈僵硬、肋骨两侧胀痛时。
when_en: When muscles are tight or cramping, the outer knee hurts, your neck and shoulders are stiff, or your rib sides ache.
tips_zh: 这是全身筋腱的「总管」穴位，任何肌肉紧张都可以先按这里。配合足三里（ST36）效果更佳。
tips_en: This is the master point for all tendons — press it first for any muscle tightness. Pair with Zusanli (ST36) for even better results.
caution_zh: 膝盖急性扭伤肿胀时避免按压。骨折恢复期遵医嘱。
caution_en: Avoid during acute knee sprains with swelling. Follow medical advice during fracture recovery.

summary_zh: 小腿外侧的穴位，帮助缓解小腿酸痛和胸闷不畅。
summary_en: An outer-calf point that eases leg soreness and chest stuffiness.
location_zh: 在小腿外侧，外脚踝骨尖端往上约七寸（小腿中段偏上），小腿骨（腓骨）后面的边缘。
location_en: On the outer side of your lower leg, about seven cun (mid-upper calf) above the tip of the outer ankle bone, along the back edge of the outer leg bone.
massage_zh: 用拇指按压腓骨后缘，找到酸胀感最明显的位置，保持按压并沿骨头边缘上下推揉。
massage_en: Press your thumb along the back edge of the outer leg bone. Find the most tender spot, hold the pressure, and slide up and down along the bone edge.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，走路多了之后按。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Best done after a day with lots of walking.
when_zh: 小腿外侧酸痛、胸口闷堵不舒服、情绪烦躁不安时。
when_en: When your outer calf aches, your chest feels stuffy and blocked, or you feel restless and irritable.
tips_zh: 沿小腿外侧从阳陵泉（GB34）向下推揉到脚踝，整条放松效果更好。
tips_en: Slide your thumb from Yanglingquan (GB34) down to the ankle along the outer calf for a full-leg release.
caution_zh: 小腿有静脉曲张时避免用力按压。皮肤有伤口时不要按。
caution_en: Avoid firm pressure if you have varicose veins. Do not press on broken skin.

summary_zh: 小腿外侧的穴位，适合缓解小腿紧绷和胸胁不适。
summary_en: An outer-calf point that relieves tight calves and side-chest discomfort.
location_zh: 在小腿外侧，外脚踝骨尖端往上约七寸（小腿中段偏上），小腿骨（腓骨）前面的边缘。
location_en: On the outer side of your lower leg, about seven cun above the tip of the outer ankle bone (mid-upper calf), along the front edge of the outer leg bone.
massage_zh: 用拇指沿腓骨前缘按压，找到最敏感的点后持续按揉，力度中等，以酸胀为宜。
massage_en: Press your thumb along the front edge of the outer leg bone. Once you find the most sensitive spot, hold and knead with moderate pressure until you feel a spreading ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，运动后效果更好。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Especially effective after exercise.
when_zh: 小腿外侧紧绷不舒服、肋骨两侧发胀、运动后小腿酸痛时。
when_en: When your outer calf feels tight, when your rib area feels bloated, or when your calf is sore after exercise.
tips_zh: 和阳交穴（GB35）位置接近，可以用拇指沿腓骨前后缘同时覆盖两个穴位。
tips_en: This point is close to Yangjiao (GB35). You can cover both by kneading along the front and back edges of the outer leg bone.
caution_zh: 小腿肿胀原因不明时请就医。有静脉曲张时轻柔操作。
caution_en: See a doctor for unexplained calf swelling. Use gentle pressure if you have varicose veins.

summary_zh: 小腿外侧的穴位，对眼睛疲劳和视力模糊特别有帮助。
summary_en: An outer-calf point that is especially helpful for tired eyes and blurry vision.
location_zh: 在小腿外侧，外脚踝骨尖端往上约五寸（大约手掌宽度），小腿骨（腓骨）前面的边缘。
location_en: On the outer side of your lower leg, about five cun (one palm-width) above the tip of the outer ankle bone, along the front edge of the outer leg bone.
massage_zh: 用拇指按压腓骨前缘，力度中等偏重，有明显酸胀感后保持按压并缓慢揉动。按完后闭眼休息一会儿。
massage_en: Press firmly with your thumb along the front edge of the outer leg bone. Hold until you feel a strong ache, then knead slowly. Close your eyes and rest for a moment afterward.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，用眼过度后一定要按。
routine_en: Massage for 3 to 5 minutes, once or twice daily. Always press after heavy screen time.
when_zh: 长时间看手机或电脑后眼睛酸涩、视线模糊、眼睛干涩不舒服时。
when_en: After long screen time when your eyes feel strained, when vision gets blurry, or when your eyes are dry and uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 按完光明穴后再揉太阳穴和眼眶周围，从腿到头一套操作，护眼效果显著。
tips_en: After pressing Guangming, massage your temples and around the eye sockets. This leg-to-head routine gives your eyes a thorough reset.
caution_zh: 视力突然下降或眼睛剧痛请立即就医，不要自行按摩代替治疗。
caution_en: Seek immediate medical care for sudden vision loss or severe eye pain. Massage is not a substitute for treatment.

summary_zh: 小腿外侧偏下的穴位，帮助缓解嗓子痛和腿部不适。
summary_en: A lower outer-calf point that helps with sore throat and leg discomfort.
location_zh: 在小腿外侧，外脚踝骨尖端往上约四横指宽，小腿骨（腓骨）前面的边缘。
location_en: On the outer side of your lower leg, about four finger-widths above the tip of the outer ankle bone, along the front edge of the outer leg bone.
massage_zh: 用拇指按在腓骨前缘，找到酸痛点后按压并缓慢揉动。力度以能忍受的酸胀为度。
massage_en: Press your thumb along the front edge of the leg bone, find the sore spot, and knead slowly. The pressure should produce a tolerable deep ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，嗓子不舒服时可多按。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Increase frequency when your throat is bothering you.
when_zh: 嗓子肿痛、腋下不舒服、小腿外侧酸痛无力时。
when_en: When your throat is sore and swollen, when your armpit area feels uncomfortable, or when the outer calf aches.
tips_zh: 嗓子不舒服时配合少商穴（大拇指指甲旁）一起掐按，上下配合效果好。
tips_en: For sore throat, pair with Shaoshang (beside the thumbnail) for a top-and-bottom combination that works well together.
caution_zh: 嗓子痛持续不好转请就医。小腿有外伤时避免按压。
caution_en: See a doctor if sore throat does not improve. Avoid pressing on an injured calf.

summary_zh: 脚踝上方的穴位，缓解脖子僵硬和腿部酸痛的好帮手。
summary_en: A point above the ankle that is great for stiff necks and achy legs.
location_zh: 在小腿外侧，外脚踝骨尖端往上约四横指宽，小腿骨（腓骨）前面的边缘。
location_en: On the outer side of your lower leg, about four finger-widths above the tip of the outer ankle bone, along the front edge of the outer leg bone.
massage_zh: 用拇指按在腓骨前缘的凹陷处，垂直向内按压，力度以酸胀感明显为宜，保持按压并小幅度揉动。
massage_en: Press your thumb straight inward at the dip along the front edge of the leg bone. Use firm pressure until you feel a clear deep ache, and make small kneading motions.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，脖子僵硬时随时可按。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once or twice daily. Press anytime your neck feels stiff.
when_zh: 脖子僵硬转头不方便、小腿酸痛无力、走路多了脚踝不舒服时。
when_en: When your neck is stiff and hard to turn, when your calves feel weak and sore, or when walking makes your ankles uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 脖子不舒服时，一边按悬钟穴一边缓慢转动脖子，远端取穴效果出人意料地好。
tips_en: For a stiff neck, press this point while slowly rotating your head. Pressing a distant point like this works surprisingly well.
caution_zh: 脚踝扭伤急性期不要按压附近区域。骨折恢复期遵医嘱。
caution_en: Do not press near the ankle during an acute sprain. Follow medical advice during fracture recovery.

summary_zh: 脚踝外侧前方的穴位，缓解脚踝疼痛和眼睛不适。
summary_en: A point in front of the outer ankle that eases ankle pain and eye discomfort.
location_zh: 在脚踝外侧，外踝骨的前面偏下方，脚背用力翘起时可以看到一根筋，穴位在筋的外侧凹陷处。
location_en: In front of and slightly below the outer ankle bone. Flex your foot upward to reveal a tendon — the point is in the dip on the outer side of that tendon.
massage_zh: 用拇指按在凹陷处，力度中等，以酸胀为宜。按压的同时缓慢活动脚踝画圈，帮助放松。
massage_en: Press your thumb into the dip with moderate pressure until you feel a dull ache. Slowly rotate your ankle in circles while pressing to deepen the release.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，走路或运动后按。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Best done after walking or exercise.
when_zh: 脚踝外侧疼痛、走路多了脚踝不舒服、眼睛发干视物模糊时。
when_en: When the outer ankle hurts, when walking makes your ankle uncomfortable, or when your eyes feel dry and vision is blurry.
tips_zh: 配合光明穴（GB37）一起按揉，从小腿到脚踝顺序操作，缓解眼睛疲劳效果好。
tips_en: Pair with Guangming (GB37) by working from the calf down to the ankle for a solid eye-fatigue routine.
caution_zh: 脚踝扭伤红肿发热时不要按压，等急性期过后再开始。
caution_en: Do not press if the ankle is sprained, red, swollen, or hot. Wait until the acute phase has passed.

summary_zh: 脚背上的重要穴位，特别适合缓解偏头痛和眼睛胀痛。
summary_en: A key foot point that is especially good for migraines and eye pressure.
location_zh: 在脚背上，第4和第5个脚趾的骨头根部交汇处，往脚趾方向摸到的凹陷中，偏外侧。
location_en: On the top of your foot, where the bones of the fourth and fifth toes meet near their base. Slide your finger toward the toes from the junction to find the dip on the outer side.
massage_zh: 用拇指指尖按在凹陷处，垂直向下按压，力度以明显酸胀为度。按5秒松3秒，反复按压。
massage_en: Press your thumb tip straight down into the dip with firm pressure. Hold for 5 seconds, release for 3, and repeat. You should feel a strong, spreading ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，头痛发作时随时可按。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once or twice daily. Press anytime a headache strikes.
when_zh: 偏头痛发作、眼睛胀痛、月经前后头疼、脚背疼痛时。
when_en: During migraines, when your eyes feel pressured, during menstrual headaches, or when the top of your foot aches.
tips_zh: 和外关穴（TE5，手腕背面上方两横指）配合按揉，是缓解偏头痛的经典组合。
tips_en: Pair with Waiguan (TE5, two finger-widths above the wrist crease on the back of the forearm) — a classic combo for migraine relief.
caution_zh: 孕妇不宜按压此穴。脚背肿胀或受伤时避免。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press if the top of the foot is swollen or injured.

summary_zh: 脚背上的穴位，帮助缓解眼睛红肿和脚背胀痛。
summary_en: A foot point that helps relieve red swollen eyes and top-of-foot pain.
location_zh: 在脚背上，第4和第5个脚趾的骨头之间，靠近第4个脚趾根部关节的后方凹陷中。
location_en: On the top of your foot, between the bones of the fourth and fifth toes, in the dip just behind the base joint of the fourth toe.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按在两根骨头之间的凹陷处，轻柔按压并小幅度揉动，力度不宜过重。
massage_en: Press your thumb pad into the dip between the two bones. Use gentle pressure and make small kneading motions. Keep the force light.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，眼睛不舒服时可多按。
routine_en: Massage for 1 to 2 minutes, once daily. Press more often when your eyes feel uncomfortable.
when_zh: 眼睛红肿疼痛、脚背发胀不舒服、腋下胀痛时。
when_en: When your eyes are red and painful, when the top of your foot feels puffy, or when your armpit area aches.
tips_zh: 配合足临泣（GB41）一起按揉，从脚背骨缝间依次操作，效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with Zulinqi (GB41) by massaging along the grooves between the foot bones in sequence for a fuller effect.
caution_zh: 脚背有伤口或肿胀时避免按压。力度保持轻柔。
caution_en: Avoid if there are wounds or swelling on the top of the foot. Always keep pressure gentle.

summary_zh: 脚趾缝间的穴位，适合快速缓解头痛和耳鸣。
summary_en: A toe-web point for quick relief from headaches and ear ringing.
location_zh: 在脚背上，第4和第5个脚趾之间，两趾连接处的趾蹼边缘，靠近皮肤颜色交界的位置。
location_en: On the top of your foot, in the web between the fourth and fifth toes, right at the edge where the skin connects between the toes.
massage_zh: 用拇指和食指捏住趾蹼处，一边捏一边轻轻揉动，力度以有明显酸痛感为宜。
massage_en: Pinch the web between the fourth and fifth toes with your thumb and index finger. Squeeze and knead gently until you feel a clear, sharp ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，头痛时立刻可按。
routine_en: Massage for 1 to 2 minutes, once or twice daily. Press immediately when a headache hits.
when_zh: 头痛头晕、耳朵嗡嗡响、眼睛红肿疼痛、脚趾不舒服时。
when_en: When you have a headache or dizziness, ringing in the ears, red painful eyes, or sore toes.
tips_zh: 和太冲穴（LR3，大脚趾和二趾之间脚背上）配合，两个趾缝穴位一起按效果明显。
tips_en: Pair with Taichong (LR3, on the foot between the big and second toes) — pressing both toe-web points together gives noticeable relief.
caution_zh: 脚趾有伤口或真菌感染时避免按揉。不要用力过猛。
caution_en: Avoid if there are wounds or fungal infection between the toes. Do not squeeze too hard.

summary_zh: 第四脚趾尖端的穴位，帮助快速缓解头痛和耳鸣。
summary_en: A point at the tip of the fourth toe for fast headache and ear-ringing relief.
location_zh: 在第4个脚趾外侧，趾甲根部角落旁边，靠近趾甲边缘约一粒米的距离。
location_en: On the outer side of your fourth toe, right next to the corner of the toenail base, about a grain of rice away from the nail edge.
massage_zh: 用另一只手的拇指指甲掐按此穴，力度稍重，有刺痛感即可。掐5秒松开，反复10次。
massage_en: Pinch this point firmly with the thumbnail of your other hand. Press for 5 seconds, release, and repeat 10 times. A sharp sting is normal.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次，头痛急性发作时随时掐按。
routine_en: 1 to 2 minutes each time, once or twice daily. Pinch anytime a headache flares up.
when_zh: 头痛剧烈、耳朵嗡嗡响、眼睛红肿疼痛、肋骨两侧不舒服时。
when_en: During a severe headache, ringing ears, red painful eyes, or discomfort along the sides of the ribs.
tips_zh: 配合侠溪穴（GB43）从趾缝到趾尖依次掐按，沿脚趾末端快速缓解头部不适。
tips_en: Pair with Xiaxi (GB43) by pressing from the toe web to the toe tip for quick head-area relief along the foot.
caution_zh: 掐按力度不要过猛，避免掐破皮肤。脚趾有伤口时不要按。
caution_en: Do not pinch too aggressively — avoid breaking the skin. Skip if the toe has a wound.

summary_zh: 大脚趾旁的穴位，有助于缓解小腹不适和紧张情绪。
summary_en: A point near the big toe that helps ease lower belly discomfort and tension.
location_zh: 在大脚趾外侧，趾甲根部角落旁边，靠近趾甲边缘的位置。
location_en: On the outer side of your big toe, right next to the corner of the toenail base.
massage_zh: 用拇指指甲轻轻掐按此穴，力度以微微酸痛为宜，每次掐按后稍停再重复，交替按压两脚。
massage_en: Use your thumbnail to press firmly on this point. Apply steady pressure until you feel a mild ache, hold for 3 seconds, release, and repeat. Do both feet.
routine_zh: 每次按压1-2分钟，每天1-2次，早晚均可。
routine_en: Press for 1 to 2 minutes per foot, once or twice daily, morning or evening.
when_zh: 小腹胀闷不舒服时、情绪烦躁低落时、头脑昏沉不清醒时。
when_en: When you feel bloated in the lower belly, emotionally irritable, or mentally foggy and need a quick reset.
tips_zh: 可以配合太冲穴（LR3）一起按揉，从脚趾到脚背依次按摩效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with Taichong (LR3) for better results. Massage from the toe upward along the foot for a fuller effect.
caution_zh: 孕妇避免按压此穴。局部有伤口或感染时不要按。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press if there is a wound or infection on the toe.

summary_zh: 脚趾缝间的穴位，适合在上火、眼红或烦躁时按揉。
summary_en: A point between your toes that helps with red eyes, irritability, and overheating.
location_zh: 在脚背上，大脚趾和第二脚趾之间，两趾连接处的趾蹼边缘。
location_en: On the top of your foot, in the web between your big toe and second toe, right at the edge where the skin connects.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按压趾缝处，稍微用力向脚背方向推按，感到酸胀即可，可以小幅度揉动。
massage_en: Press your thumb into the web between the toes, pushing slightly toward the top of the foot. Apply moderate pressure and make small circular motions until you feel a deep ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，睡前效果较好。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Best done before bed.
when_zh: 眼睛干涩发红时、脾气大容易发火时、晚上翻来覆去睡不着时。
when_en: When your eyes feel dry or red, when you are quick to anger, or when you toss and turn at night.
tips_zh: 搭配太冲穴（LR3）效果更佳，先按行间再按太冲，从趾缝向脚背推揉。
tips_en: Combine with Taichong (LR3) for stronger relief. Press LR2 first, then move up to LR3 along the foot.
caution_zh: 脚部有伤口、水泡或真菌感染时避免按揉。
caution_en: Avoid if you have wounds, blisters, or fungal infection on the foot.

summary_zh: 脚背上最常用的减压穴位，帮你在生气或头痛时快速放松。
summary_en: The most popular stress-relief point on the foot, great for calming anger and easing headaches.
location_zh: 在脚背上，大脚趾和第二脚趾的趾缝往脚背方向推约两指宽，两根骨头交汇前的凹陷处。
location_en: On the top of your foot, slide your finger from the web between the big toe and second toe toward the ankle about two finger-widths until you feel a dip between two bones.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹垂直按压凹陷处，力度稍重，按到有明显酸胀感，然后保持按压并缓慢揉动。
massage_en: Press your thumb straight down into the dip with firm pressure until you feel a strong, spreading ache. Hold and slowly knead in small circles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，生气或头痛时随时可按。
routine_en: Knead for 3 to 5 minutes, once or twice daily. Press anytime you feel angry or get a headache.
when_zh: 生气发火时、头痛头晕时、压力大焦虑时、眼睛不舒服时。
when_en: When you are angry, have a headache or dizziness, feel stressed or anxious, or your eyes are uncomfortable.
tips_zh: 和合谷穴（LI4，虎口处）一起按叫「四关穴」，对头痛和情绪问题效果显著。
tips_en: Press together with Hegu (LI4, in the web of your hand) — this classic pairing is especially effective for headaches and emotional tension.
caution_zh: 孕妇不宜用力按压。脚背肿胀或受伤时避免。
caution_en: Avoid strong pressure during pregnancy. Skip if the top of the foot is swollen or injured.

summary_zh: 脚踝内侧前方的穴位，适合缓解踝关节不适和小腹紧张。
summary_en: A point near the inner ankle that helps ease ankle stiffness and lower belly tightness.
location_zh: 在脚踝内侧骨头的前下方，脚背用力翘起时可以看到一根大筋，穴位在大筋的内侧凹陷处。
location_en: In front of and slightly below the inner ankle bone. Flex your foot upward to reveal a large tendon — the point is in the dip on the inner side of that tendon.
massage_zh: 用拇指按住凹陷处，向内踝方向轻轻施压，保持酸胀感的力度，缓慢画小圈按揉。
massage_en: Press your thumb into the dip and angle the pressure slightly toward the inner ankle bone. Maintain a comfortable ache and rub in slow, small circles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，久坐后按效果更好。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Especially helpful after long periods of sitting.
when_zh: 久坐后脚踝僵硬时、走路多脚踝不舒服时、小腹发紧时。
when_en: When your ankle feels stiff after sitting, when your feet ache from walking, or when your lower belly feels tight.
tips_zh: 可以配合太冲穴（LR3）从脚背到脚踝依次按揉，疏通整条经络。
tips_en: Combine with Taichong (LR3) by massaging from the top of the foot up to the ankle for a fuller routine.
caution_zh: 脚踝扭伤急性期（红肿发热时）不要按揉。
caution_en: Do not massage during the acute phase of an ankle sprain (when it is red, swollen, or hot).

summary_zh: 小腿内侧的穴位，常用于缓解小腿酸胀和下腹不适。
summary_en: A point on the inner shin that helps relieve leg soreness and lower abdominal discomfort.
location_zh: 在小腿内侧，内踝骨尖端往上约一个手掌宽（5寸），小腿骨内侧面的正中间。
location_en: On the inner side of your lower leg, about one palm-width (5 cun) above the tip of the inner ankle bone, in the middle of the shinbone's inner surface.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹沿小腿骨内侧面上下推揉，找到最酸胀的点后重点按压，力度适中。
massage_en: Slide your thumb along the inner surface of the shinbone to find the most tender spot. Press firmly on that spot and knead up and down with moderate pressure.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，可在洗澡后进行。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. A good time is right after a warm shower.
when_zh: 小腿酸胀无力时、久站后腿部疲劳时、下腹有闷胀感时。
when_en: When your lower legs feel heavy or tired, after standing for a long time, or when your lower abdomen feels bloated.
tips_zh: 沿小腿内侧从蠡沟向上推揉到膝盖，可以同时覆盖中都穴（LR6），效果更好。
tips_en: Slide your thumb upward from LR5 toward the knee to also cover Zhongdu (LR6) for a more thorough leg massage.
caution_zh: 小腿有静脉曲张时避免用力按压，轻柔触碰即可。
caution_en: Avoid firm pressure if you have varicose veins on the lower leg. Use only gentle touch.

summary_zh: 小腿内侧偏上的穴位，适合缓解腹痛和腿部不适。
summary_en: A point on the inner shin that helps ease belly pain and leg discomfort.
location_zh: 在小腿内侧，内踝骨尖端往上约七寸（膝盖到内踝中点再往下一点），小腿骨内侧面正中。
location_en: On the inner side of your lower leg, about 7 cun above the inner ankle bone tip. Find the midpoint between your knee and ankle, then move slightly downward — the point is on the shinbone's inner surface.
massage_zh: 用拇指按压小腿骨内侧面，找到酸痛最明显的位置，持续按压并小幅度揉动。
massage_en: Press your thumb against the inner surface of the shinbone, locate the most tender spot, and hold steady pressure while making small kneading motions.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1次，经期不适时可增加次数。
routine_en: Press for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Increase to twice daily during menstrual discomfort.
when_zh: 腹部痉挛疼痛时、经期不舒服时、小腿内侧酸痛时。
when_en: When you have belly cramps, during menstrual discomfort, or when the inner side of your lower leg aches.
tips_zh: 可以和三阴交（SP6）配合按揉，两个穴位都在小腿内侧，方便一起操作。
tips_en: Pair with Sanyinjiao (SP6) — both are on the inner leg, making it easy to massage them together in one session.
caution_zh: 孕妇避免按压此穴。小腿有静脉曲张时轻柔操作。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Use gentle pressure if you have varicose veins on the lower leg.

summary_zh: 膝盖内侧下方的穴位，专门用于缓解膝关节疼痛和僵硬。
summary_en: A point below the inner knee that specifically helps ease knee pain and stiffness.
location_zh: 在膝盖内侧，膝盖下方能摸到一块突出的骨头，穴位在这块骨头的后下方凹陷处。
location_en: On the inner side of your knee, find the bony bump just below the kneecap on the inner side. The point is in the dip just behind and below that bump.
massage_zh: 坐下屈膝，用拇指按住膝盖内侧下方的凹陷，稳定按压并缓慢揉动，不要在骨头上直接搓。
massage_en: Sit with your knee bent. Press your thumb into the dip below the inner knee bump. Hold steady pressure and rub slowly. Avoid pressing directly on bone.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，上下楼梯前后按。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once or twice daily. Helpful before and after climbing stairs.
when_zh: 上下楼梯膝盖痛时、天气变化膝盖不舒服时、久坐站起时膝盖僵硬。
when_en: When your knees hurt on stairs, when weather changes make your knees ache, or when your knees feel stiff after sitting.
tips_zh: 配合阳陵泉（GB34，膝盖外侧）一起按揉，内外兼顾，膝关节保养效果更全面。
tips_en: Pair with Yanglingquan (GB34, on the outer knee) to cover both sides of the knee for a more complete routine.
caution_zh: 膝关节急性损伤（红肿发热）时不要按揉，等消肿后再按。
caution_en: Do not massage during acute knee injury (redness, swelling, heat). Wait until swelling subsides.

summary_zh: 膝盖内侧弯曲处的穴位，对膝盖保养和下腹不适都有帮助。
summary_en: A point at the inner knee crease that supports knee health and eases belly discomfort.
location_zh: 弯曲膝盖，在膝盖内侧的最高骨头后边缘，膝弯横纹的内侧尽头，两根筋的前方凹陷中。
location_en: Bend your knee. Find the bony bump on the inner side of the knee. The point is right behind that bump, at the inner end of the knee crease, in a dip in front of two tendons.
massage_zh: 屈膝坐好，用拇指按在膝盖内侧褶皱尽头的凹陷中，稳定用力按压，感到深层酸胀后保持并揉动。
massage_en: Sit with your knee bent. Press your thumb into the dip at the inner end of the knee crease. Apply firm, steady pressure until you feel a deep ache, then hold and knead gently.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1次，睡前按揉效果好。
routine_en: Massage for 3 to 5 minutes, once daily. Best done before bedtime.
when_zh: 膝盖酸软无力时、经期小腹不适时、大腿内侧紧绷时。
when_en: When your knee feels weak, during menstrual lower belly discomfort, or when the inner thigh feels tight.
tips_zh: 和阴陵泉（SP9，膝盖内侧下方）一起按揉，两个穴位相邻，可以连贯推揉。
tips_en: Pair with Yinlingquan (SP9, just below the inner knee). These two are close together and can be massaged in one continuous motion.
caution_zh: 膝关节急性肿胀时不要按。孕妇避免用力按压。
caution_en: Avoid during acute knee swelling. Pregnant women should not apply strong pressure.

summary_zh: 大腿内侧的穴位，有助于缓解大腿紧张和腰腹不适。
summary_en: A point on the inner thigh that relieves thigh tightness and lower back discomfort.
location_zh: 在大腿内侧，膝盖骨上缘往上约四指宽，大腿内侧两条肌肉之间的缝隙中。
location_en: On the inner side of your thigh, about four finger-widths above the top edge of the kneecap. Find the groove between two muscles on the inner thigh.
massage_zh: 坐下放松腿部，用拇指或掌根按压大腿内侧的肌肉缝隙，缓慢加力直到酸胀，保持按压并揉动。
massage_en: Sit and relax your leg. Use your thumb or the heel of your palm to press into the groove between the inner thigh muscles. Slowly increase pressure until you feel an ache, then hold and knead.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，久坐后按效果更好。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once daily. Especially helpful after prolonged sitting.
when_zh: 久坐后大腿内侧紧绷时、腰部酸痛连带小腹时、膝盖不舒服时。
when_en: When your inner thighs feel tight from sitting, when lower back pain spreads to your belly, or when your knees bother you.
tips_zh: 沿大腿内侧从膝盖向上推揉，依次覆盖曲泉（LR8）和阴包（LR9），放松整条大腿内侧。
tips_en: Slide your thumb along the inner thigh from the knee upward to cover both Ququan (LR8) and Yinbao (LR9) in one stroke.
caution_zh: 大腿内侧有淤青或受伤时不要按揉。孕妇慎用。
caution_en: Avoid if the inner thigh is bruised or injured. Use caution during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 大腿根部内侧的穴位，有助于缓解腹股沟区域的紧张和不适。
summary_en: A point on the upper inner thigh that eases groin tension and discomfort.
location_zh: 在大腿根部内侧，腹股沟中间位置往下约三寸，可以感受到动脉跳动的地方附近。
location_en: On the inner side of your upper thigh, about three thumb-widths below the midpoint of the groin crease. You may feel a pulse nearby.
massage_zh: 坐下双腿微张，用掌根或四指并拢轻柔按压大腿根部内侧，不要用力过猛，缓慢揉动即可。
massage_en: Sit with legs slightly apart. Use the heel of your palm or four fingers together to gently press the upper inner thigh. Keep pressure light and rub slowly.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1-2分钟，每天1次，动作要轻柔。
routine_en: Gently rub for 1 to 2 minutes, once daily. Always use light, careful pressure.
when_zh: 大腿根部紧绷不舒服时、久坐后腹股沟区域发闷时、小腹胀痛时。
when_en: When your upper inner thigh feels tight, when the groin area feels stuffy after sitting, or when your lower belly aches.
tips_zh: 可以从大腿内侧中段沿经络向上推揉至大腿根部，整体放松大腿内侧。
tips_en: Combine with a long stroke along the inner thigh from mid-thigh upward to the groin to release the whole area.
caution_zh: 此处靠近动脉，力度一定要轻。孕妇禁用。局部有淋巴结肿大时不要按。
caution_en: This area is near an artery — always use light pressure. Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press if lymph nodes are swollen.

summary_zh: 大腿根部内侧的穴位，有助于缓解腹股沟紧张和下腹不适。
summary_en: A point at the upper inner thigh that eases groin tension and belly discomfort.
location_zh: 在大腿根部内侧，腹股沟中间位置往下约两寸，比足五里（LR10）稍高一点。
location_en: On the inner side of your upper thigh, about two thumb-widths below the midpoint of the groin crease, slightly higher than Zuwuli (LR10).
massage_zh: 坐下双腿微张，用掌根轻轻按压大腿根部内侧，力度要轻，感到温热即可，不要深压。
massage_en: Sit with legs slightly open. Use the heel of your palm to gently press the upper inner thigh. Keep pressure light — aim for a warm sensation, not deep pressure.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1-2分钟，每天1次，动作轻柔缓慢。
routine_en: Gently rub for 1 to 2 minutes, once daily. Use slow, soft movements.
when_zh: 大腿根部不舒服时、下腹闷胀时、经期小腹不适时。
when_en: When the upper inner thigh feels uncomfortable, when the lower belly feels bloated, or during menstrual discomfort.
tips_zh: 可以和足五里（LR10）一起，用掌根沿大腿内侧上段轻轻推揉。
tips_en: Massage together with Zuwuli (LR10) by gently sliding your palm along the upper inner thigh in one motion.
caution_zh: 此区域敏感，力度一定要轻。孕妇禁用。局部有肿块时不要按。
caution_en: This is a sensitive area — always use gentle pressure. Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press if there are lumps.

summary_zh: 腹股沟处的穴位，有助于缓解腹股沟和小腹的紧张不适。
summary_en: A point in the groin crease that relieves tension in the groin and lower belly.
location_zh: 在腹股沟处，大腿和躯干连接的褶皱线上，身体正中线往外约两个半拇指宽。
location_en: In the groin crease where the thigh meets the torso, about two and a half thumb-widths out from the body's center line.
massage_zh: 仰卧放松，用指腹极轻地按压腹股沟处，避开能感受到脉搏跳动的地方，轻柔画圈按揉。
massage_en: Lie on your back and relax. Use your fingertips to press very gently in the groin crease. Avoid the spot where you feel a pulse. Rub in soft, small circles.
routine_zh: 每次轻揉1分钟，每天1次，力度宜轻不宜重。
routine_en: Gently rub for about 1 minute, once daily. Always err on the side of lighter pressure.
when_zh: 腹股沟区域紧绷不适时、小腹疼痛时、久坐后大腿根部发紧时。
when_en: When the groin area feels tight, when you have lower belly pain, or when your upper thighs feel stiff after sitting.
tips_zh: 可以先热敷腹股沟区域再轻揉，放松效果更好。
tips_en: Apply a warm towel to the groin area before massaging for better relaxation.
caution_zh: 此处有大动脉，务必避开脉搏跳动处，力度极轻。孕妇禁用。
caution_en: A major artery runs nearby — never press where you feel a pulse. Use very light pressure only. Avoid during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 肋骨下方侧腹的穴位，帮助缓解腹胀、胁肋不适和消化不良。
summary_en: A point below the side ribs that helps ease bloating, side pain, and indigestion.
location_zh: 在身体侧面，把手臂自然垂下，肘尖对着的位置附近，最下面那根能活动的肋骨（浮肋）尖端下方。
location_en: On the side of your body, near where your elbow points when your arm hangs naturally. Find the tip of the lowest rib that moves when you breathe — the point is just below its tip.
massage_zh: 双手叉腰，用拇指从背后绕到侧腹，按压浮肋尖端下方，稳定用力后缓慢揉动，以酸胀为度。
massage_en: Place your hands on your waist with thumbs wrapping around to the side. Press below the tip of the floating rib with your thumb. Apply steady pressure and knead slowly until you feel a comfortable ache.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，饭后1小时按效果好。
routine_en: Massage for 3 to 5 minutes, once or twice daily. Best done about 1 hour after a meal.
when_zh: 吃完饭腹胀不消化时、侧腹闷痛时、整体感觉疲倦没精神时。
when_en: When you feel bloated after eating, when your side aches, or when you feel generally fatigued and low-energy.
tips_zh: 配合期门穴（LR14）一起按揉，从胸肋到侧腹依次推揉，效果更全面。
tips_en: Pair with Qimen (LR14) by massaging from the chest down to the side ribs in sequence for a more complete routine.
caution_zh: 肋骨骨折或局部受伤时禁止按揉。按压力度不要过重。
caution_en: Do not massage if you have a rib fracture or local injury. Avoid excessive pressure.

summary_zh: 胸部下方肋骨间的穴位，帮助缓解胸闷、叹气和肋骨区域不适。
summary_en: A point between the lower ribs that helps relieve chest tightness and rib-area discomfort.
location_zh: 在胸部，乳头正下方，往下数两根肋骨的间隙中（第六、第七根肋骨之间）。
location_en: On the chest, directly below the nipple, in the space between the sixth and seventh ribs — about two rib-spaces down from the nipple level.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢，轻轻按压肋骨间隙，力度以舒适为宜，缓慢画圈按揉，配合深呼吸。
massage_en: Place your index and middle fingers together on the rib space. Press gently until comfortable, rub in slow circles, and breathe deeply at the same time.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，感到胸闷时随时可按。
routine_en: Massage for 2 to 3 minutes, once or twice daily. Press anytime you feel chest tightness.
when_zh: 胸口发闷时、老想叹气时、肋骨两侧胀痛时、情绪郁闷压抑时。
when_en: When your chest feels stuffy, when you keep sighing, when the sides of your ribs ache, or when you feel emotionally down.
tips_zh: 配合章门穴（LR13）从上往下依次按揉，再做几次深呼吸，放松胸腹效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with Zhangmen (LR13) by massaging downward from chest to side ribs, then take several deep breaths for enhanced relaxation.
caution_zh: 胸部有外伤或术后恢复期不要按。女性注意避开乳腺组织。
caution_en: Avoid if you have a chest injury or are recovering from surgery. Women should avoid pressing on breast tissue.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解久坐引起的尾骨和肛周不适。
summary_en: Helps relieve tailbone and rectal discomfort from prolonged sitting.
location_zh: 尾骨尖端与肛门之间的中点处，俯卧时臀部微微抬起更容易找到。
location_en: Midway between the tip of your tailbone and your anus. Easier to locate when lying face down with hips slightly raised.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻柔地按压此处，力度以感到微微酸胀为宜，顺时针方向小幅度揉按。因位置特殊，建议如厕后清洁双手再操作。
massage_en: Use your middle fingertip to press gently on this point, applying moderate pressure in small clockwise circles. Keep the pressure comfortable, not painful. Wash hands before and after.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1-2次，晨起或睡前进行。
routine_en: Press for 1-2 minutes, once or twice daily, in the morning or before bed.
when_zh: 久坐后尾骨酸痛、排便不畅、痔疮不适时。
when_en: After long periods of sitting, when experiencing tailbone soreness, difficulty with bowel movements, or hemorrhoid discomfort.
tips_zh: 配合提肛运动效果更好：吸气时收紧肛门肌肉，呼气时放松，重复10次。
tips_en: Combine with Kegel-like exercises: tighten pelvic floor muscles on inhale, relax on exhale, repeat 10 times for better results.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。皮肤有破损或感染时不要按压。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press if the skin is broken or infected.

summary_zh: 缓解腰部和臀部的酸痛不适。
summary_en: Relieves soreness in the lower back and buttock area.
location_zh: 臀裂最上端的小凹陷处，沿脊柱正中线，尾骨上方可以摸到一个小窝。
location_en: At the small dip right above the top of your buttock crease, on the midline of your spine. Feel for a small hollow just above the tailbone.
massage_zh: 双手叠放，用掌根按压这个凹陷处，缓慢用力向下按压后保持5秒，再缓缓松开，反复进行。也可用网球抵墙滚压。
massage_en: Place one palm over the other and use the heel of your hand to press into this hollow. Hold for 5 seconds, release slowly, and repeat. You can also lean against a tennis ball placed at this spot against a wall.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1次，久坐后进行为宜。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, once daily, ideally after prolonged sitting.
when_zh: 久坐后腰骶酸痛、臀部僵硬、经期腰部不适时。
when_en: After long sitting, when your lower back feels stiff, buttocks are tight, or during period-related lower back discomfort.
tips_zh: 配合轻柔的猫牛式伸展，先按揉此穴再做伸展，效果加倍。
tips_en: Pair with gentle cat-cow stretches. Massage the point first, then stretch for better results.
caution_zh: 腰椎有严重疾病者请先咨询医生。局部皮肤破损时避免按压。
caution_en: Consult a doctor first if you have serious spinal conditions. Avoid pressing on broken skin.

summary_zh: 缓解下腰部酸痛，改善腰部活动不灵活。
summary_en: Eases lower back pain and improves flexibility in the lumbar area.
location_zh: 双手叉腰，拇指按住胯骨最高点（髂嵴），两拇指连线与脊柱交点的凹陷处。
location_en: Place your hands on your hips with thumbs on the top of your hip bones. The point is in the dip on your spine where an imaginary line between your thumbs crosses your midline.
massage_zh: 双手握拳，用指关节沿脊柱两侧上下搓揉此处，直到感觉温热。也可以用掌根按压凹陷处并缓慢画圈。
massage_en: Make fists and use your knuckles to rub up and down along both sides of this spot until the area feels warm. You can also press with the heel of your palm and make slow circles.
routine_zh: 每次搓揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，运动前后做效果更好。
routine_en: Rub for 2-3 minutes, once or twice daily. Best done before and after exercise.
when_zh: 弯腰困难、下腰发凉酸痛、长时间站立后腰部不适时。
when_en: When bending is difficult, your lower back feels cold or achy, or after standing for long periods.
tips_zh: 搓揉后用热毛巾敷在腰部5分钟，有助于放松腰部肌肉。
tips_en: After rubbing, apply a warm towel to your lower back for 5 minutes to help relax the muscles.
caution_zh: 腰椎间盘突出急性期避免用力按压。孕妇慎用。
caution_en: Avoid forceful pressure during acute disc herniation. Use caution during pregnancy.

summary_zh: 帮助温暖腰部，缓解腰部怕冷和疲劳感。
summary_en: Warms the lower back and relieves cold sensations and fatigue in the lumbar area.
location_zh: 肚脐正对面的后背脊柱上，站直后从肚脐水平绕到后背正中线的凹陷处。
location_en: On your spine, directly behind your navel. Stand up straight, imagine a line from your belly button going straight through to your back — the dip on your spine at that level is the point.
massage_zh: 双手搓热后掌心贴在此处，上下搓揉至皮肤发热。也可以双手握拳，用指关节轻叩此处30-50次。
massage_en: Warm your palms by rubbing them together, then place them on this spot and rub up and down until the skin feels warm. Alternatively, make fists and gently tap 30-50 times with your knuckles.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1次，睡前做效果最好。
routine_en: Massage for 3-5 minutes, once daily. Best done before bed.
when_zh: 腰部怕冷、容易疲劳乏力、清晨腰部僵硬时。
when_en: When your lower back feels cold, you feel generally fatigued, or your back is stiff in the morning.
tips_zh: 搓揉后贴暖宝宝或用热水袋热敷10分钟，可以增强温暖感。
tips_en: After massaging, apply a heat pad or hot water bottle for 10 minutes to enhance the warming effect.
caution_zh: 皮肤发红发炎时不要搓揉。发烧时不宜热敷。
caution_en: Do not rub if skin is red or inflamed. Avoid heat application when you have a fever.

summary_zh: 缓解腰背酸痛和腹部胀满不适。
summary_en: Eases back soreness and abdominal bloating discomfort.
location_zh: 在命门穴上方约两指宽处，脊柱正中线上的凹陷中，大约在后背中下部位。
location_en: About two finger-widths above the Mingmen point (behind the navel), in the dip on your spine midline, in the mid-lower back area.
massage_zh: 此处自己较难触及，可用网球放在地上仰卧，将球对准此穴位置，利用身体重量缓慢左右滚动按压。
massage_en: This spot is hard to reach by hand. Lie on your back on a tennis ball placed at this point. Use your body weight to slowly roll side to side for a gentle massage.
routine_zh: 每次滚压2-3分钟，每天1次，饭后1小时再做。
routine_en: Roll for 2-3 minutes, once daily. Wait at least 1 hour after eating.
when_zh: 饭后腹部胀满、腰背酸痛、消化不畅时。
when_en: After meals when feeling bloated, when your back aches, or when digestion feels sluggish.
tips_zh: 按压后顺时针揉腹部2分钟，腹胀时双管齐下效果更好。
tips_en: After pressing this point, rub your belly clockwise for 2 minutes. This combo works well for bloating.
caution_zh: 脊柱骨折或严重骨质疏松者禁用。饱食后立即按压可能不适。
caution_en: Do not use if you have spinal fractures or severe osteoporosis. Avoid pressing right after a heavy meal.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解中背部紧张和消化不适。
summary_en: Helps relieve mid-back tension and digestive discomfort.
location_zh: 后背正中线上，大约在后背中部，肚脐水平线以上约一手掌宽的脊柱凹陷处。
location_en: On the midline of your back, roughly one palm-width above navel level. Feel for a dip between the vertebrae in your mid-back.
massage_zh: 自己较难触及，可靠墙站立，将网球放在此穴位置，靠墙上下滚动。也可请人用拇指按压并缓慢揉动。
massage_en: Hard to reach alone. Stand against a wall with a tennis ball placed at this point and roll up and down. Or ask someone to press with their thumb and make slow circular movements.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1次，可在感觉消化不适时进行。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, once daily, or whenever you feel digestive discomfort.
when_zh: 中背部僵硬酸痛、消化不畅、饭后腹胀时。
when_en: When your mid-back is stiff or achy, digestion feels off, or you feel bloated after eating.
tips_zh: 配合深呼吸按压效果更好：按压时深吸气，松开时慢慢呼气。
tips_en: Combine with deep breathing: inhale deeply while pressing, exhale slowly while releasing.
caution_zh: 脊柱有严重疾病者请先咨询医生。不要用力捶打脊柱。
caution_en: Consult a doctor first if you have serious spinal conditions. Never pound forcefully on the spine.

summary_zh: 缓解中背部酸痛和胃部不适。
summary_en: Relieves mid-back soreness and stomach discomfort.
location_zh: 脊中穴上方约一指宽处，脊柱正中线上，后背中部略偏上的凹陷中。
location_en: About one finger-width above the Jizhong point, on the spine midline, in a dip in the upper mid-back area.
massage_zh: 自己不易触及。可用网球靠墙滚压，或请人用拇指指腹按压凹陷处，力度适中，持续按压后缓慢松开。
massage_en: Difficult to reach alone. Use a tennis ball against a wall or ask someone to press with their thumb pad at moderate pressure. Hold, then release slowly.
routine_zh: 每次按压2分钟，每天1次，感到胃部不适时可随时进行。
routine_en: Press for 2 minutes, once daily, or anytime you feel stomach discomfort.
when_zh: 胃胀恶心、中背部僵硬、弯腰后背部不适时。
when_en: When you feel nauseous or bloated, your mid-back is stiff, or your back hurts after bending.
tips_zh: 按揉后喝一杯温水，帮助胃部舒缓。避免冷饮。
tips_en: Drink a cup of warm water after massage to soothe your stomach. Avoid cold drinks.
caution_zh: 脊柱损伤或手术后未康复者禁用。不要过度用力。
caution_en: Do not use after spinal injury or surgery without medical clearance. Avoid excessive force.

summary_zh: 帮助放松背部紧绷的肌肉，缓解脊背僵硬。
summary_en: Helps relax tight back muscles and relieve spinal stiffness.
location_zh: 后背正中线上，大约在两侧肩胛骨下角连线以下约两指宽处的脊柱凹陷。
location_en: On the spine midline, about two finger-widths below the line connecting the bottom tips of your shoulder blades.
massage_zh: 自己较难触及。仰卧在网球上，将球对准此处，双膝弯曲脚踩地面，利用身体重量缓慢滚动按压1-2分钟。
massage_en: Hard to reach by hand. Lie on a tennis ball placed at this point, bend your knees with feet flat on the floor, and slowly roll your body weight over the ball for 1-2 minutes.
routine_zh: 每次滚压2-3分钟，每天1次，运动后做效果更佳。
routine_en: Roll for 2-3 minutes, once daily. Best done after exercise.
when_zh: 后背肌肉紧绷、脊背发硬弯腰困难、长期伏案后背部僵硬时。
when_en: When your back muscles feel tight, your spine is stiff and bending is hard, or after long hours at a desk.
tips_zh: 滚压后做简单的背部伸展：双手抱膝卷成球状，前后轻轻滚动。
tips_en: After rolling, do a simple stretch: hug your knees to your chest and gently rock back and forth.
caution_zh: 急性背部拉伤时不要按压。脊柱疾病患者请先咨询医生。
caution_en: Do not press during an acute back strain. Consult a doctor if you have spinal conditions.

summary_zh: 缓解上背部沉重感和胸闷不适。
summary_en: Relieves heaviness in the upper back and chest tightness.
location_zh: 自然垂臂站立，两侧肩胛骨最下端连线与脊柱的交点凹陷处。
location_en: Stand with arms relaxed at your sides. The point is in the dip on your spine at the level where the bottom tips of your shoulder blades meet the midline.
massage_zh: 靠墙站立，将网球放在此处，缓慢上下移动身体进行滚压。或请人用拇指按压3-5秒后松开，反复进行。
massage_en: Stand against a wall with a tennis ball at this spot and slowly move up and down. Or ask someone to press with their thumb for 3-5 seconds, release, and repeat.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1次，午后或感到胸闷时进行。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, once daily, in the afternoon or when chest feels tight.
when_zh: 上背部沉重酸痛、胸闷气短、天气潮湿时身体沉重不爽时。
when_en: When your upper back feels heavy, your chest feels tight, or humid weather makes your body feel sluggish.
tips_zh: 按压后挺胸扩展双臂，做几次深呼吸，帮助打开胸腔。
tips_en: After pressing, open your chest by spreading your arms wide and take several deep breaths.
caution_zh: 脊柱骨折或严重骨病者禁用。不要直接用力捶打。
caution_en: Do not use with spinal fractures or severe bone disease. Never pound directly on the spine.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解背部紧张和呼吸不畅。
summary_en: Helps ease back tension and improve breathing comfort.
location_zh: 至阳穴上方约一指宽处，脊柱正中线上，两肩胛骨之间稍偏下的凹陷中。
location_en: About one finger-width above Zhiyang, on the spine midline, in a dip slightly below the middle of your shoulder blades.
massage_zh: 自己难以触及。靠墙用网球滚压，或请人用拇指按压，力度以感到酸胀但不疼痛为准，持续按压后缓慢揉动。
massage_en: Difficult to reach alone. Roll against a wall with a tennis ball, or ask someone to press with their thumb — firm enough to feel a deep ache, but not painful. Hold and then rub slowly.
routine_zh: 每次按压2分钟，每天1次，咳嗽或胸闷时可随时进行。
routine_en: Press for 2 minutes, once daily, or anytime when coughing or feeling chest tightness.
when_zh: 咳嗽不畅、背部紧绷、呼吸感觉受限时。
when_en: When you have a lingering cough, your back feels tight, or breathing feels restricted.
tips_zh: 按压后做几次腹式深呼吸：用鼻子慢慢吸气让腹部鼓起，用嘴慢慢呼出。
tips_en: After pressing, practice belly breathing: slowly inhale through your nose to expand your belly, slowly exhale through your mouth.
caution_zh: 高烧不退时请就医，不要仅靠按摩。脊柱疾病者先咨询医生。
caution_en: Seek medical help for persistent high fever; do not rely on massage alone. Consult a doctor for spinal conditions.

summary_zh: 帮助安定心神，缓解紧张和心慌不安。
summary_en: Helps calm the mind and relieve nervousness and heart palpitations.
location_zh: 两侧肩胛骨中间偏上的位置，脊柱正中线上的凹陷处，大约在肩胛骨内缘中点的水平高度。
location_en: On the spine midline between your shoulder blades, roughly at the level of the middle of the inner edges of your shoulder blades.
massage_zh: 自己不易触及。请人用拇指轻柔按压此处，配合缓慢深呼吸，按压3-5秒后松开，反复10次。也可靠墙用网球滚压。
massage_en: Hard to reach alone. Ask someone to gently press with their thumb while you breathe slowly. Press for 3-5 seconds, release, and repeat 10 times. A tennis ball against a wall also works.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1次，睡前或感到焦虑时进行。
routine_en: Massage for 2-3 minutes, once daily. Best before bed or when feeling anxious.
when_zh: 心情紧张焦虑、心跳加速感到不安、睡前心神不宁时。
when_en: When feeling anxious, your heart races, or your mind is restless before bed.
tips_zh: 按压时闭眼做5次深呼吸，配合轻柔的背景音乐，放松效果更好。
tips_en: Close your eyes and take 5 deep breaths while pressing. Soft background music enhances the calming effect.
caution_zh: 心脏疾病患者请先咨询医生。持续心悸应就医检查。
caution_en: Consult a doctor if you have heart conditions. Seek medical attention for persistent palpitations.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解上背部疲劳，改善呼吸顺畅度。
summary_en: Relieves upper back fatigue and helps improve breathing smoothness.
location_zh: 低头时颈后最突出的骨头往下数第三个脊椎骨，其下方的凹陷处，脊柱正中线上。
location_en: Bow your head and find the most prominent bone at the base of your neck. Count down three vertebrae from there. The point is in the dip below that third vertebra on the midline.
massage_zh: 请人用拇指按压此凹陷，力度中等，持续按压5秒后松开，反复8-10次。也可用网球靠墙滚压此处。
massage_en: Ask someone to press this dip with their thumb at moderate pressure, hold for 5 seconds, release, and repeat 8-10 times. A tennis ball against a wall also works well.
routine_zh: 每次按压2-3分钟，每天1次，下午疲劳时做效果好。
routine_en: Press for 2-3 minutes, once daily. Best in the afternoon when fatigue sets in.
when_zh: 上背部酸累、咳嗽气短、孩子经常哭闹不安时（可轻柔按揉）。
when_en: When your upper back is tired, you have a cough or shortness of breath. Also used gently for fussy children.
tips_zh: 按压后做扩胸运动：双手在背后交叉，慢慢向后伸展，打开胸腔。
tips_en: After pressing, clasp your hands behind your back and gently stretch backward to open your chest.
caution_zh: 婴幼儿按揉力度要极轻。脊柱受伤者先咨询医生。
caution_en: Use very light pressure on infants and toddlers. Consult a doctor if you have a spinal injury.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解颈背交界处的紧张和发热不适。
summary_en: Relieves tension at the neck-back junction and helps with feverish discomfort.
location_zh: 低头时颈后最突出骨头往下一个脊椎骨的下方凹陷处，脊柱正中线上。
location_en: Bow your head and find the most prominent bone at the base of your neck. Move down one vertebra. The point is in the dip just below it on the midline.
massage_zh: 用中指或食指按压此凹陷处，力度中等，按压5秒后松开，重复8-10次。也可用指腹小幅度揉动。
massage_en: Press this dip with your middle or index finger at moderate pressure. Hold for 5 seconds, release, and repeat 8-10 times. You can also rub in small circles with your fingertip.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2分钟，每天1次，午后或傍晚进行。
routine_en: Massage for 2 minutes, once daily, in the afternoon or early evening.
when_zh: 感冒初起发热怕冷、颈背交界处僵硬酸痛时。
when_en: At the onset of a cold with chills, or when the junction of your neck and upper back feels stiff and sore.
tips_zh: 感冒时配合按揉大椎穴（此穴上方一个），效果更好。多喝温水。
tips_en: When you have a cold, also massage the Dazhui point (one vertebra above). Drink plenty of warm water.
caution_zh: 高烧不退应及时就医。皮肤有破损时不要按压。
caution_en: Seek medical help for persistent high fever. Do not press on broken skin.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解感冒初期不适和颈部僵硬。
summary_en: Helps relieve early cold symptoms and neck stiffness.
location_zh: 低头时颈后最突出的那块骨头的正下方凹陷处。左右摇头时这块骨头会随之转动，容易确认。
location_en: Bow your head and feel for the most prominent bone at the base of your neck. The point is in the dip just below it. Confirm by turning your head side to side — this bone moves with your head.
massage_zh: 用中指和食指并拢，按压此凹陷处，力度中等偏重，按压后缓慢揉动。也可用掌根搓揉此处直至发热。
massage_en: Press with your middle and index fingers together at moderate-to-firm pressure, then rub slowly. You can also use the heel of your palm to rub briskly until the area feels warm.
routine_zh: 每次按揉3-5分钟，每天1-2次，感冒初期可增加频次。
routine_en: Massage for 3-5 minutes, once or twice daily. Increase frequency at the start of a cold.
when_zh: 感冒初期打喷嚏流鼻涕、颈部僵硬酸痛、怕冷发热时。
when_en: When a cold is starting with sneezing and runny nose, your neck feels stiff, or you have chills and mild fever.
tips_zh: 搓热此穴后立即围上围巾保暖，配合喝一杯姜茶效果更佳。
tips_en: After warming this point by rubbing, wrap a scarf around your neck immediately. Pair with a cup of ginger tea for best results.
caution_zh: 皮肤有破损或过敏时避免搓揉。高烧应及时就医。
caution_en: Avoid rubbing on broken or allergic skin. Seek medical care for high fever.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解颈后僵硬和头部沉重感。
summary_en: Helps relieve neck stiffness and a heavy feeling in the head.
location_zh: 后脑勺下方，后发际正中往上约半个拇指宽的凹陷处。低头时更容易摸到。
location_en: Below the back of your skull, about half a thumb-width above the center of your rear hairline. Easier to find when you bow your head slightly.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹轻柔按压此凹陷处，力度一定要轻，按压3秒后松开，反复8-10次。切勿用力深按。
massage_en: Use your thumb pad to gently press this hollow. Keep pressure light. Press for 3 seconds, release, and repeat 8-10 times. Do not press deeply or forcefully.
routine_zh: 每次轻按1-2分钟，每天1次，头痛或颈部僵硬时进行。
routine_en: Gently press for 1-2 minutes, once daily, when you have a headache or stiff neck.
when_zh: 颈后僵硬、头部沉重昏沉、声音沙哑说话费力时。
when_en: When the back of your neck is stiff, your head feels heavy and foggy, or your voice is hoarse.
tips_zh: 按压后缓慢转动头部，左右各5次，帮助放松颈部肌肉。
tips_en: After pressing, slowly turn your head left and right, 5 times each side, to help loosen neck muscles.
caution_zh: 此穴靠近脑干，力度必须轻柔。颈椎病患者请先咨询医生。
caution_en: This point is near the brainstem — pressure must be very gentle. Consult a doctor if you have cervical spine issues.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解头痛、头晕和颈部不适。
summary_en: Helps relieve headaches, dizziness, and neck discomfort.
location_zh: 后脑勺下方，后发际正中直上约一横指（拇指宽），能摸到一个明显的凹陷。
location_en: Below the back of your skull, about one thumb-width above the center of your rear hairline. You can feel a noticeable dip there.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹轻柔按压这个凹陷，力度要轻，缓慢画小圈按揉。按压时微微仰头可以帮助放松肌肉。
massage_en: Gently press this hollow with your thumb pad and rub in small slow circles. Tilt your head back slightly while pressing to help relax the muscles. Keep pressure light.
routine_zh: 每次轻按1-2分钟，每天1次，头痛或头晕时可随时进行。
routine_en: Gently press for 1-2 minutes, once daily, or anytime when you have a headache or feel dizzy.
when_zh: 头痛头晕、吹风后头部不适、颈部酸痛僵硬时。
when_en: When you have a headache or dizziness, discomfort after wind exposure, or a stiff and sore neck.
tips_zh: 天冷风大时注意保护后脑勺，出门戴帽子或围巾覆盖此处。
tips_en: In cold, windy weather, protect the back of your head by wearing a hat or scarf that covers this area.
caution_zh: 此穴靠近脑干，只能轻按，绝不可用力。头部有外伤时禁用。
caution_en: Near the brainstem — only light pressure allowed, never press hard. Do not use if you have a head injury.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解后脑勺疼痛和颈项紧张。
summary_en: Helps relieve pain at the back of the head and neck tension.
location_zh: 后脑勺中央，能摸到一块向外隆起的骨头（枕骨隆凸），其上缘的凹陷处。
location_en: At the center of the back of your head, feel for a bony bump (the external occipital protuberance). The point is in the dip at the upper edge of this bump.
massage_zh: 用拇指指腹按压此凹陷处，力度轻到中等，按压3-5秒松开，反复8次。也可用指腹轻柔揉动。
massage_en: Press this dip with your thumb pad at light-to-moderate pressure. Hold for 3-5 seconds, release, and repeat 8 times. You can also rub gently with your fingertip.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，后脑疼痛时可随时进行。
routine_en: Massage for 1-2 minutes, once daily, or anytime the back of your head aches.
when_zh: 后脑勺胀痛、颈项僵硬、视物模糊眼睛疲劳时。
when_en: When the back of your head feels swollen or achy, your neck is stiff, or your eyes are tired with blurry vision.
tips_zh: 按揉后用双手十指梳头，从前额梳到后脑，重复10次，帮助头部放松。
tips_en: After massaging, comb through your hair with all ten fingers from forehead to the back of your head, 10 times, to help the head relax.
caution_zh: 头部有外伤或手术史者请先咨询医生。力度要轻柔。
caution_en: Consult a doctor if you have had a head injury or surgery. Keep pressure gentle.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解头痛和后脑部的紧张感。
summary_en: Helps relieve headaches and tension at the back of the head.
location_zh: 后脑勺上方，后发际正中直上约四横指处，头顶后部的中线上可摸到一个浅凹。
location_en: On the back of your head, about four finger-widths straight up from the center of your rear hairline, on the midline. Feel for a slight dip.
massage_zh: 用中指或拇指指腹按压此处，力度轻柔，按压后小幅度揉动，每次按压3-5秒后松开。
massage_en: Press with your middle finger or thumb pad at gentle pressure. Rub in small movements. Hold each press for 3-5 seconds, then release.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，头痛时可随时按揉。
routine_en: Massage for 1-2 minutes, once daily, or anytime you have a headache.
when_zh: 后脑勺疼痛、头部紧绷感、颈项僵硬不灵活时。
when_en: When the back of your head hurts, your head feels tight, or your neck is stiff and hard to move.
tips_zh: 同时按揉风池穴（后脑勺下方两侧凹陷处），头痛缓解效果更好。
tips_en: Also massage the Fengchi points (the dips on both sides below the back of your skull) for better headache relief.
caution_zh: 头部有外伤时不要按压。持续剧烈头痛应就医。
caution_en: Do not press if you have a head injury. Seek medical help for persistent severe headaches.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解头顶后部的疼痛和头晕。
summary_en: Helps relieve pain at the back of the crown and dizziness.
location_zh: 头顶偏后方，后发际正中直上约五指半宽处，在头部中线上。百会穴后方约一指半处。
location_en: On the back part of the top of your head, about one and a half finger-widths behind the Baihui point (the crown), on the midline.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻柔按压此处，按压3-5秒后松开，反复8-10次。也可用指腹轻轻叩击此处。
massage_en: Gently press with your middle fingertip for 3-5 seconds, release, and repeat 8-10 times. You can also lightly tap this area with your fingertips.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，头痛或头晕时可随时进行。
routine_en: Massage for 1-2 minutes, once daily, or anytime you have a headache or feel dizzy.
when_zh: 头顶后部隐痛、头晕目眩、长时间用脑后头部不适时。
when_en: When the back of your crown aches, you feel dizzy, or your head hurts after long mental work.
tips_zh: 按揉后用十指指腹轻叩整个头顶30秒，促进头部放松和清醒。
tips_en: After pressing, gently tap the entire crown of your head with all ten fingertips for 30 seconds to refresh your mind.
caution_zh: 头部有外伤或手术后未愈合者禁用。力度要轻。
caution_en: Do not use if you have an unhealed head injury or recent head surgery. Keep pressure light.

summary_zh: 帮助提神醒脑、缓解头痛头晕和改善睡眠。
summary_en: Helps clear the mind, relieve headaches and dizziness, and improve sleep.
location_zh: 头顶正中央。将两只耳朵尖端向上连线，与头部前后中线的交叉点就是此穴。
location_en: At the very top center of your head. Fold both ears forward and imagine a line connecting the ear tips over the top of your head — where that line crosses your midline is the point.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按压头顶正中，力度中等，按压5秒后松开，反复10次。也可用五指并拢轻叩头顶30秒。
massage_en: Press the center of your crown with your middle fingertip at moderate pressure. Hold for 5 seconds, release, and repeat 10 times. You can also tap your crown lightly with all five fingertips for 30 seconds.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，清晨和午后各一次效果最佳。
routine_en: Massage for 2-3 minutes, once or twice daily. Best in the morning and early afternoon.
when_zh: 头痛头晕、精神不振犯困、失眠多梦、注意力不集中时。
when_en: When you have headaches or dizziness, feel drowsy or unfocused, or have trouble sleeping.
tips_zh: 用梳子背面（非齿侧）轻叩头顶和周围，从前到后梳理，既按摩穴位又促进头部放松。
tips_en: Use the flat side of a comb to gently tap the crown and surrounding area, stroking from front to back, for both massage and relaxation.
caution_zh: 婴幼儿囟门未闭合时禁用。头部有外伤时不要按压。
caution_en: Do not use on infants whose fontanelle has not closed. Avoid pressing on head injuries.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解前额和头顶部位的疼痛。
summary_en: Helps relieve pain in the forehead and top of the head.
location_zh: 头顶前部，前发际正中直上约三指半宽处，百会穴前方约一指半处，头部中线上。
location_en: On the front part of the top of your head, about one and a half finger-widths in front of the Baihui point (crown), on the midline.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按压此处，力度轻柔，按压3-5秒后松开，反复8-10次。也可用指尖轻叩此区域。
massage_en: Press gently with your middle fingertip for 3-5 seconds, release, and repeat 8-10 times. You can also lightly tap this area with your fingertips.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，头痛或面部肿胀时进行。
routine_en: Massage for 1-2 minutes, once daily, when you have a headache or facial puffiness.
when_zh: 前额疼痛、头顶胀痛、面部浮肿、鼻塞时。
when_en: When your forehead hurts, the top of your head aches, your face feels puffy, or your nose is congested.
tips_zh: 配合按揉印堂穴（两眉之间），前额头痛缓解效果更好。
tips_en: Also massage the Yintang point (between your eyebrows) for better relief of forehead headaches.
caution_zh: 婴幼儿囟门未闭合时禁用。力度不宜过重。
caution_en: Do not use on infants whose fontanelle has not closed. Avoid using excessive pressure.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解头痛和鼻部不适。
summary_en: Helps relieve headaches and nasal discomfort.
location_zh: 头部前方，前发际正中直上约两横指处，头部中线上。
location_en: On the front of your head, about two finger-widths straight up from the center of your front hairline, on the midline.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻柔按压此处，按压3秒后松开，反复8-10次。也可以用指腹轻柔画圈揉动。
massage_en: Gently press with your middle fingertip for 3 seconds, release, and repeat 8-10 times. You can also rub in soft circles with your fingertip.
routine_zh: 每次按揉1-2分钟，每天1次，鼻塞或头痛时可随时进行。
routine_en: Massage for 1-2 minutes, once daily, or anytime when you have nasal congestion or a headache.
when_zh: 头痛、鼻塞流涕、头晕目眩时。
when_en: When you have a headache, stuffy or runny nose, or feel dizzy.
tips_zh: 鼻塞时同时按揉迎香穴（鼻翼两侧），双管齐下通鼻效果更好。
tips_en: For congestion, also press the Yingxiang points (beside your nostrils) for better nose-clearing results.
caution_zh: 婴幼儿囟门未闭合时严禁按压。成人力度也需轻柔。
caution_en: Strictly forbidden on infants with open fontanelles. Adults should also use only gentle pressure.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解鼻塞和前额头痛。
summary_en: Helps relieve nasal congestion and forehead headaches.
location_zh: 前发际正中直上约一横指处，头部中线上的浅凹陷中。
location_en: About one finger-width straight up from the center of your front hairline, on the midline. Feel for a slight dip.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按压此凹陷，力度中等，按压3-5秒后松开，反复10次。也可用指尖从此处向前发际方向推揉。
massage_en: Press this dip with your middle fingertip at moderate pressure. Hold for 3-5 seconds, release, and repeat 10 times. You can also stroke from this point down toward your hairline.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2分钟，每天1-2次，鼻塞时可增加频次。
routine_en: Massage for 2 minutes, once or twice daily. Increase frequency when your nose is congested.
when_zh: 鼻塞不通气、流鼻涕、前额头痛、眼睛酸涩时。
when_en: When your nose is blocked, you have a runny nose, forehead headache, or sore tired eyes.
tips_zh: 按揉后用温热毛巾敷在鼻梁上1-2分钟，帮助通鼻。
tips_en: After massaging, place a warm towel over your nose bridge for 1-2 minutes to help clear your nasal passages.
caution_zh: 鼻出血时不要按压此穴。头部有伤口时避免操作。
caution_en: Do not press during a nosebleed. Avoid if there are wounds on your head.

summary_zh: 帮助安神定志，缓解失眠和前额不适。
summary_en: Helps calm the mind, ease insomnia, and relieve forehead discomfort.
location_zh: 前发际正中直上约半个拇指宽处，头部中线上。上星穴与前发际中点之间。
location_en: About half a thumb-width straight up from the center of your front hairline, on the midline. Halfway between your hairline and the Shangxing point.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻柔按压此处，缓慢画圈揉动，配合深呼吸，每次按压5秒后松开。
massage_en: Gently press with your middle fingertip and rub in slow circles. Combine with deep breathing. Hold each press for 5 seconds, then release.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2分钟，每天1次，睡前半小时进行效果最佳。
routine_en: Massage for 2 minutes, once daily. Best done 30 minutes before bed.
when_zh: 失眠入睡困难、头脑混沌不清醒、前额胀痛、鼻塞时。
when_en: When you have trouble falling asleep, your mind feels foggy, your forehead aches, or your nose is stuffy.
tips_zh: 睡前按揉此穴后再按揉安眠穴（耳后凹陷处），帮助快速入睡。
tips_en: Before bed, massage this point first, then the Anmian point (in the hollow behind your ear) to help you fall asleep faster.
caution_zh: 前额有伤口或皮肤病时避免按压。
caution_en: Avoid pressing if there are wounds or skin conditions on your forehead.

summary_zh: 帮助快速通鼻和提神醒脑。
summary_en: Helps quickly clear the nose and sharpen alertness.
location_zh: 鼻尖正中央，就是鼻子最尖端的那个点。
location_en: Right at the tip of your nose, the very center point.
massage_zh: 用食指指腹轻轻按压鼻尖，力度要轻，按压3秒后松开，反复5-8次。也可用拇指和食指轻捏鼻尖揉动。
massage_en: Lightly press the tip of your nose with your index fingertip. Hold for 3 seconds, release, and repeat 5-8 times. You can also gently pinch and rub your nose tip between thumb and index finger.
routine_zh: 每次轻按1分钟，鼻塞或犯困时随时可做。
routine_en: Gently press for 1 minute anytime your nose is congested or you feel drowsy.
when_zh: 鼻塞不通、头脑昏沉犯困、突然感到头晕时。
when_en: When your nose is blocked, you feel drowsy and foggy, or you suddenly feel dizzy.
tips_zh: 配合深呼吸，按压时用嘴吸气，松开后尝试用鼻呼气，反复练习。
tips_en: Combine with breathing exercises: inhale through your mouth while pressing, then try to exhale through your nose when you release.
caution_zh: 鼻部有伤口、酒糟鼻发作期或鼻出血时不要按压。
caution_en: Do not press if you have nose wounds, active rosacea, or a nosebleed.

summary_zh: 帮助快速提神醒脑，是经典的急救清醒穴位。
summary_en: A classic revival point that helps quickly restore alertness and clear-headedness.
location_zh: 人中沟（鼻子和上嘴唇之间的竖沟）的上三分之一处，靠近鼻子的一端。
location_en: In the groove between your nose and upper lip (the philtrum), at the upper one-third, closer to the nose.
massage_zh: 用拇指指甲尖端垂直掐按此处，力度稍重，以产生明显酸胀感为宜。掐按3-5秒后松开，可反复2-3次。
massage_en: Use your thumbnail to press firmly straight into this spot. The pressure should create a noticeable aching sensation. Press for 3-5 seconds, release, and repeat 2-3 times.
routine_zh: 仅在需要时使用，每次掐按不超过1分钟。不需要每天常规做。
routine_en: Use only when needed, for no more than 1 minute each time. No daily routine required.
when_zh: 突然头晕眼黑、犯困打瞌睡、中暑不适、精神恍惚时。
when_en: When you suddenly feel faint, are drowsy and nodding off, feel overheated, or your mind goes blank.
tips_zh: 犯困时按此穴后喝杯冷水，再到通风处呼吸新鲜空气，效果更好。
tips_en: After pressing when drowsy, drink a glass of cool water and move to a well-ventilated area for fresh air.
caution_zh: 面部皮肤破损或有疱疹时不要按压。力度不宜过猛以免掐伤皮肤。
caution_en: Do not press on broken skin or active cold sores. Avoid pressing so hard that you bruise the skin.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解嘴唇干裂和口腔不适。
summary_en: Helps relieve dry cracked lips and oral discomfort.
location_zh: 上嘴唇正中央的唇珠上，就是上唇最突出的那个小尖点。
location_en: At the center of your upper lip, right on the cupid's bow — the small peak at the top of your upper lip.
massage_zh: 用食指指腹轻轻按压上唇中央，力度极轻，按压2-3秒后松开，反复5-8次。也可以轻柔揉动。
massage_en: Lightly press the center of your upper lip with your index fingertip. Hold for 2-3 seconds, release, and repeat 5-8 times. You can also rub very gently.
routine_zh: 每次轻按1分钟，嘴唇干燥或牙痛时可随时进行。
routine_en: Gently press for 1 minute anytime your lips feel dry or you have a toothache.
when_zh: 嘴唇干裂脱皮、牙龈肿痛、口腔异味时。
when_en: When your lips are cracked and peeling, gums are swollen and sore, or you have bad breath.
tips_zh: 按揉后涂抹润唇膏，多喝温水，保持口腔清洁。
tips_en: After pressing, apply lip balm, drink warm water, and maintain good oral hygiene.
caution_zh: 嘴唇有疱疹、溃疡或破损时不要按压。
caution_en: Do not press if you have cold sores, ulcers, or broken skin on your lips.

summary_zh: 帮助缓解牙龈不适和鼻部问题。
summary_en: Helps relieve gum discomfort and nasal problems.
location_zh: 翻开上嘴唇，上唇系带（连接上唇和牙龈的那条薄膜）与上门牙牙龈交接的地方。
location_en: Flip up your upper lip. The point is where the thin strip of tissue connecting your upper lip to your gum (the frenulum) meets the gum above your front teeth.
massage_zh: 洗净双手后，用食指指腹轻轻按压上唇系带与牙龈交汇处，力度极轻，按压2-3秒后松开，反复5次。
massage_en: Wash your hands first. Gently press the area where the upper lip frenulum meets the gum with your index fingertip. Use very light pressure. Hold for 2-3 seconds, release, repeat 5 times.
routine_zh: 每次轻按1分钟，牙龈不适时可进行，不需每天常规做。
routine_en: Gently press for 1 minute when gums are uncomfortable. No daily routine required.
when_zh: 牙龈红肿不适、鼻塞不通、口腔异味时。
when_en: When your gums are red and swollen, your nose is congested, or you have persistent bad breath.
tips_zh: 按压后用淡盐水漱口，帮助清洁口腔和缓解牙龈不适。
tips_en: After pressing, rinse your mouth with mild salt water to help clean your mouth and soothe your gums.
caution_zh: 口腔有溃疡或伤口时不要按压。手指必须清洁。
caution_en: Do not press if you have mouth ulcers or wounds. Make sure your fingers are clean.

summary_zh: 帮助安神助眠、缓解头痛和鼻塞。
summary_en: Helps calm the mind, improve sleep, relieve headaches, and clear nasal congestion.
location_zh: 两条眉毛内侧端连线的正中点，就是两眉之间的凹陷处。
location_en: Right between your eyebrows, at the midpoint of the line connecting the inner ends of your two eyebrows. Feel for a slight dip.
massage_zh: 用中指或拇指指腹按压两眉之间，力度中等，缓慢画圈揉动。也可以用拇指和食指交替从眉心向上推抹。
massage_en: Press between your eyebrows with your middle finger or thumb at moderate pressure. Rub in slow circles. You can also alternate thumb and index finger to stroke upward from this point.
routine_zh: 每次按揉2-3分钟，每天1-2次，睡前做效果最佳。
routine_en: Massage for 2-3 minutes, once or twice daily. Best done before bed.
when_zh: 失眠难入睡、头痛头晕、鼻塞不通、焦虑紧张时。
when_en: When you cannot fall asleep, have a headache or dizziness, a stuffy nose, or feel anxious and tense.
tips_zh: 睡前按揉此穴时配合薰衣草精油（稀释后涂抹），放松助眠效果更好。
tips_en: Apply diluted lavender essential oil to this area before bed while massaging for enhanced relaxation and sleep.
caution_zh: 皮肤有痤疮或破损时避免按压。精油需稀释后使用，避免刺激皮肤。
caution_en: Avoid pressing on acne or broken skin. Always dilute essential oils before applying to prevent skin irritation.

summary_zh: 调理盆底、改善私密区域不适的要穴。
summary_en: A key point for pelvic floor health and comfort.
location_zh: 坐位时身体最低点，肛门与生殖器之间的正中位置。
location_en: At the midpoint between the anus and the genitals, the lowest point when sitting.
massage_zh: 坐在网球或按摩球上，让球抵住会阴区域，轻柔地前后移动身体，借助体重进行温和按压。
massage_en: Sit on a tennis ball or massage ball positioned at this area. Gently rock your body forward and back, using your body weight for mild pressure.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1次，晨起或睡前进行。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes, once daily, morning or bedtime.
when_zh: 久坐不适、盆底松弛感、产后恢复期。
when_en: After prolonged sitting, pelvic floor weakness, or during postpartum recovery.
tips_zh: 配合提肛运动（凯格尔运动）效果更好，按摩后喝一杯温水帮助循环。
tips_en: Combine with Kegel exercises for better results. Drink warm water afterward to support circulation.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。月经期间避免按压。局部有伤口或感染时禁用。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press during menstruation. Stop if there are local wounds or infections.

summary_zh: 缓解小腹不适、改善泌尿问题的穴位。
summary_en: Relieves lower belly discomfort and urinary issues.
location_zh: 小腹最下方，摸到耻骨（小腹底部的硬骨）上缘正中处。
location_en: At the top edge of the pubic bone, on the midline of the lower belly. Feel for the hard bone at the very bottom of your abdomen.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹放在耻骨上缘正中，轻柔向下按压，保持稳定压力，缓慢画小圈按揉。
massage_en: Place your middle fingertip on the midline just above the pubic bone. Press gently downward and massage in small circles with steady pressure.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天1-2次，饭后1小时进行。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily, at least one hour after meals.
when_zh: 小便不畅、小腹胀满、经期前后小腹不适。
when_en: Difficulty urinating, bloated lower belly, or menstrual discomfort in the lower abdomen.
tips_zh: 可配合关元穴一起按揉，按摩前先排空膀胱，搭配热敷效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with Guanyuan (RN4). Empty your bladder before massaging. A warm compress beforehand enhances the effect.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。膀胱充盈时不要按压。局部皮肤破损时避免。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press with a full bladder. Skip if the skin is broken.

summary_zh: 专调泌尿和生殖系统不适的下腹要穴。
summary_en: A lower belly point for urinary and reproductive comfort.
location_zh: 肚脐正下方，量四个拇指宽的距离（约4寸），在小腹正中线上。
location_en: On the midline of the lower belly, about four thumb-widths straight down from the navel.
massage_zh: 仰卧屈膝放松腹部，用食指和中指并拢按在穴位上，缓慢向下按压并揉动，力度以有酸胀感为宜。
massage_en: Lie on your back with knees bent to relax the belly. Press with your index and middle fingers together, pushing gently inward while rubbing. Aim for a mild ache.
routine_zh: 每次3分钟，每天1-2次，早晚均可。
routine_en: 3 minutes, 1-2 times daily, morning or evening.
when_zh: 尿频尿急、经期不适、小腹冷痛、产后恢复。
when_en: Frequent or urgent urination, menstrual discomfort, cold sensation in the lower belly, or postpartum recovery.
tips_zh: 与关元穴上下配合按揉效果佳，按前先排尿，冬天可先热敷再按摩。
tips_en: Works well paired with Guanyuan (RN4). Empty your bladder first. In cold weather, apply a warm towel before massaging.
caution_zh: 孕妇禁用。膀胱充盈时不可按压。腹部手术后恢复期慎用。
caution_en: Avoid during pregnancy. Do not press with a full bladder. Use caution after abdominal surgery.

summary_zh: 补充能量、温暖身体的核心保健穴位。
summary_en: A core wellness point that warms the body and restores energy.
location_zh: 肚脐正下方，四横指（食指到小指并拢）的距离，小腹正中线上。
location_en: On the midline of the lower belly, four finger-widths (index to pinky held together) straight down from the navel.
massage_zh: 双手掌叠放在穴位上，先顺时针揉36圈，再逆时针揉36圈，动作缓慢柔和，让热感渗透到腹部深处。
massage_en: Stack both palms over the point. Rub clockwise 36 times, then counterclockwise 36 times, slowly and gently until warmth penetrates deep into the belly.
routine_zh: 每次5分钟，每天1-2次，早起和睡前最佳。
routine_en: 5 minutes, 1-2 times daily, best in the morning and before bed.
when_zh: 容易疲劳、手脚冰冷、经期痛、食欲不振、体质虚弱。
when_en: Fatigue, cold hands and feet, menstrual pain, poor appetite, or general weakness.
tips_zh: 搭配气海穴按摩效果加倍，也可用暖水袋热敷此处，冬季保健尤佳。
tips_en: Pair with Qihai (RN6) for enhanced effect. A hot water bottle on this area works well, especially in winter.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。饱食后不宜立即按压。急性腹痛时避免。
caution_en: Use caution during pregnancy. Avoid right after a full meal. Do not press during acute abdominal pain.

summary_zh: 帮助排水消胀、调理小腹的穴位。
summary_en: Helps reduce bloating and regulate the lower belly.
location_zh: 肚脐正下方两个拇指宽（约2寸），小腹正中线上。
location_en: On the midline of the lower belly, about two thumb-widths straight down from the navel.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢，放在穴位上缓慢按压，保持3秒后松开，反复按压，配合深呼吸。
massage_en: Press with your index and middle fingers together. Hold for 3 seconds, release, and repeat. Breathe deeply with each press.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天1次，饭后1小时进行。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes, once daily, at least one hour after meals.
when_zh: 腹部胀满、水肿、小便不畅、经期腹部不适。
when_en: Abdominal bloating, water retention, difficulty urinating, or menstrual belly discomfort.
tips_zh: 配合气海穴一起按揉，饮食清淡配合效果更好，可搭配热敷。
tips_en: Pair with Qihai (RN6). Light meals complement the effect. A warm compress beforehand helps.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。腹部有炎症或剧痛时禁用。
caution_en: Use caution during pregnancy. Avoid if there is abdominal inflammation or sharp pain.

summary_zh: 提升元气、缓解疲劳的经典养生穴位。
summary_en: A classic wellness point that boosts vitality and fights fatigue.
location_zh: 肚脐正下方约两横指（约1.5寸），小腹正中线上。
location_en: On the midline of the lower belly, about one and a half thumb-widths straight down from the navel.
massage_zh: 双手搓热后叠放在穴位上，用掌心的温度温暖此处，然后缓慢顺时针揉按，力度适中，感到温热为宜。
massage_en: Rub your palms together to warm them. Stack both hands over the point and let the warmth soak in, then massage in slow clockwise circles with moderate pressure.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天1-2次，晨起空腹时最佳。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes, 1-2 times daily, best on an empty stomach in the morning.
when_zh: 体力不足、精神疲惫、手脚冰凉、消化不良、经期虚弱。
when_en: Low energy, mental exhaustion, cold extremities, indigestion, or feeling weak during your period.
tips_zh: 与关元穴配合使用效果翻倍，可搭配艾灸贴或暖宝宝温敷。
tips_en: Pair with Guanyuan (RN4) for double the benefit. A warming patch or hot water bottle on the area works great.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。皮肤破损处避免。饱食后不宜按压。
caution_en: Use caution during pregnancy. Avoid on broken skin. Do not press right after a large meal.

summary_zh: 调理小腹胀痛和水肿的腹部穴位。
summary_en: Eases lower belly pain, bloating, and water retention.
location_zh: 肚脐正下方一个拇指宽（约1寸），小腹正中线上。
