location_en: On the midline of the lower belly, about one thumb-width straight down from the navel.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按在穴位上，缓慢按压并小幅度揉动，配合腹式深呼吸，吸气时按压、呼气时放松。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip and rub in small motions. Coordinate with deep belly breathing: press on the inhale, release on the exhale.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天1次，睡前进行。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes, once daily, before bedtime.
when_zh: 小腹胀痛、身体浮肿、经期不规律、消化不畅。
when_en: Lower belly pain or bloating, body puffiness, irregular periods, or sluggish digestion.
tips_zh: 配合水分穴（RN9）上下一起按揉，多喝温水帮助排水。
tips_en: Pair with Shuifen (RN9) by massaging both in sequence. Drink warm water to support fluid balance.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。急性腹痛时不要按压。
caution_en: Use caution during pregnancy. Do not press during acute abdominal pain.

summary_zh: 温暖腹部、改善消化的天然保健点。
summary_en: Warms the belly and improves digestion naturally.
location_zh: 就是你的肚脐正中央。
location_en: Right at the center of your navel.
massage_zh: 双手搓热后，一手掌心贴住肚脐，顺时针缓慢揉腹，不要用力按压肚脐内部，只做表面的温和揉动。
massage_en: Warm your palms by rubbing them together. Place one palm over your navel and rub gently in clockwise circles. Do not press into the navel itself, just massage the surface.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天1-2次，晨起或睡前。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes, 1-2 times daily, morning or before bed.
when_zh: 肚子着凉、腹泻、腹胀肠鸣、消化不良、身体虚冷。
when_en: Chilled belly, diarrhea, rumbling stomach, indigestion, or feeling cold all over.
tips_zh: 用暖水袋或热毛巾敷肚脐效果很好，睡觉时注意肚脐保暖。
tips_en: A hot water bottle or warm towel over the navel works wonderfully. Keep your belly covered while sleeping.
caution_zh: 不要用力按压肚脐深处。肚脐有伤口或感染时禁用。
caution_en: Never press deep into the navel. Avoid if there is any wound or infection at the navel.

summary_zh: 帮助身体排水消肿、缓解腹胀的穴位。
summary_en: Helps the body manage water balance and reduce belly bloating.
location_zh: 肚脐正上方一个拇指宽（约1寸），腹部正中线上。
location_en: On the midline of the belly, about one thumb-width straight up from the navel.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢按在穴位上，缓慢按压后松开，反复进行，同时配合深呼吸。
massage_en: Press with your index and middle fingers together. Push gently inward, hold briefly, release, and repeat while breathing deeply.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天1-2次，餐后1小时进行。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes, 1-2 times daily, one hour after meals.
when_zh: 腹部积水感、浮肿、小便不顺、腹胀腹痛。
when_en: Feeling waterlogged, puffiness, difficulty urinating, or belly bloating and pain.
tips_zh: 配合阴交穴（RN7）按揉，少吃生冷食物，适当运动帮助排水。
tips_en: Pair with Yinjiao (RN7). Reduce cold and raw foods. Light exercise helps your body manage fluids.
caution_zh: 孕妇慎用。饱食后不要按压。急性腹痛时避免。
caution_en: Use caution during pregnancy. Avoid right after eating. Do not press during acute abdominal pain.

summary_zh: 促进消化吸收、缓解胃部不适的穴位。
summary_en: Supports digestion and eases stomach discomfort.
location_zh: 肚脐正上方两横指（约2寸），腹部正中线上。
location_en: On the midline of the belly, about two finger-widths straight up from the navel.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指按在穴位上，顺时针方向缓慢揉按，力度中等，以感到微微酸胀为宜。
massage_en: Press with your index and middle fingers and rub in slow clockwise circles. Use moderate pressure until you feel a mild ache.
routine_zh: 每次3分钟，每天1-2次，饭后1小时进行。
routine_en: 3 minutes, 1-2 times daily, one hour after meals.
when_zh: 吃饭后胃胀、消化慢、食欲差、胃痛隐隐。
when_en: Post-meal bloating, slow digestion, poor appetite, or a dull stomachache.
tips_zh: 与中脘穴（RN12）一起按揉效果更佳，饮食规律、细嚼慢咽配合使用。
tips_en: Pair with Zhongwan (RN12) for better results. Eat regular meals and chew thoroughly.
caution_zh: 饱食后不要大力按压。急性胃痛或呕吐时避免。
caution_en: Do not press hard after a full meal. Avoid during acute stomach pain or vomiting.

summary_zh: 强健脾胃、改善消化功能的腹部穴位。
summary_en: Strengthens digestion and calms a troubled stomach.
location_zh: 肚脐正上方三横指（约3寸），腹部正中线上。
location_en: On the midline of the belly, about three finger-widths straight up from the navel.
massage_zh: 用拇指或中指指腹按压穴位，缓慢揉动，力度由轻到重，持续按揉至局部温热。
massage_en: Press with your thumb or middle finger. Rub slowly, gradually increasing pressure until the area feels warm.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天1次，两餐之间进行。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes, once daily, between meals.
when_zh: 胃口差、消化不良、肚子咕咕响、胃部隐痛。
when_en: Poor appetite, indigestion, stomach rumbling, or a dull ache in the stomach area.
tips_zh: 配合中脘穴（RN12）和下脘穴（RN10）三穴连按效果好。
tips_en: Press in sequence with Zhongwan (RN12) and Xiawan (RN10) for the best digestive support.
caution_zh: 饱食后避免按压。胃部有严重疼痛时停止。
caution_en: Avoid right after eating. Stop if you have severe stomach pain.

summary_zh: 最重要的养胃穴位，消化不好就找它。
summary_en: The most important stomach point — go-to for any digestive issue.
location_zh: 肚脐与胸骨下端连线的正中点，大约在肚脐上方四横指处。
location_en: Midway between the navel and the bottom of the breastbone, roughly four finger-widths above the navel on the midline.
massage_zh: 双手叠放在中脘穴上，先顺时针揉按2分钟，再逆时针揉按2分钟，力度适中，感觉温热舒适即可。
massage_en: Stack both palms over the point. Rub clockwise for 2 minutes, then counterclockwise for 2 minutes, using moderate pressure until the area feels warm and comfortable.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天1-2次，饭后1小时最佳。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes, 1-2 times daily, ideally one hour after meals.
when_zh: 胃痛胃胀、恶心反酸、消化不良、食欲不振、便秘或腹泻。
when_en: Stomachache, bloating, nausea, acid reflux, indigestion, poor appetite, constipation, or diarrhea.
tips_zh: 配合足三里穴（ST36）效果翻倍，养成饭后散步的习惯更有帮助。
tips_en: Pair with Zusanli (ST36) for double the benefit. A gentle walk after meals also helps.
caution_zh: 饱食后不宜大力按压。孕妇慎用。胃出血等急症时禁用。
caution_en: Do not press hard after a full meal. Use caution during pregnancy. Avoid during stomach bleeding or emergencies.

summary_zh: 缓解胃上部不适和恶心呕吐的穴位。
summary_en: Eases upper stomach discomfort, nausea, and vomiting.
location_zh: 肚脐正上方五横指（约5寸），腹部正中线上，大约在胸骨下端往下四横指处。
location_en: On the midline, about five finger-widths above the navel, or four finger-widths below the bottom of the breastbone.
massage_zh: 用食指和中指并拢按压穴位，轻柔向下按压后缓慢揉动，感到恶心时可稍加力度点按。
massage_en: Press with your index and middle fingers together. Push gently inward and rub slowly. When nauseous, try slightly firmer tapping presses.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天1次，两餐之间进行。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes, once daily, between meals.
when_zh: 胃胀想吐、打嗝反酸、吃不下饭、上腹闷胀。
when_en: Nausea, acid reflux, hiccups, loss of appetite, or tightness in the upper belly.
tips_zh: 配合中脘穴（RN12）从上往下依次按揉，饭前喝杯温水帮助消化。
tips_en: Massage downward from this point to Zhongwan (RN12) in sequence. A cup of warm water before meals aids digestion.
caution_zh: 饱食后不要按压。持续呕吐或呕血时立即就医。
caution_en: Avoid after a full meal. Seek medical help immediately for persistent vomiting or vomiting blood.

summary_zh: 缓解心慌胸闷、安定情绪的上腹穴位。
summary_en: Calms a racing heart, eases chest tightness, and settles emotions.
location_zh: 胸骨下端（心窝处）往下约两横指，腹部正中线上。
location_en: On the midline, about two finger-widths below the bottom tip of the breastbone, in the soft area of the upper belly.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻轻按压穴位，缓慢揉动，注意力度要轻柔，配合缓慢深呼吸，感到放松为宜。
massage_en: Press gently with your middle fingertip and rub slowly. Keep the pressure light. Pair with slow, deep breaths until you feel calm.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天1次，情绪紧张时随时可按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes, once daily. Press anytime you feel anxious or tense.
when_zh: 心慌心跳快、胸口发闷、情绪焦虑烦躁、紧张不安。
when_en: Rapid heartbeat, chest tightness, anxiety, irritability, or nervousness.
tips_zh: 配合膻中穴（RN17）一起按揉，听舒缓音乐、做深呼吸效果更好。
tips_en: Pair with Danzhong (RN17). Listening to calming music and deep breathing enhance the effect.
caution_zh: 力度必须轻柔，此处靠近内脏。胸痛严重时请就医。
caution_en: Use only light pressure — organs are close beneath. Seek medical help for severe chest pain.

summary_zh: 舒缓胸闷气短和上腹不适的穴位。
summary_en: Soothes chest tightness, shortness of breath, and upper belly discomfort.
location_zh: 胸骨下端尖头（剑突）往下一横指处，心窝正下方。
location_en: About one finger-width below the pointed tip at the bottom of the breastbone, just below the pit of the stomach.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻按穴位，缓慢揉按，力度一定要轻，避免用力戳按，配合深呼吸放松。
massage_en: Press lightly with your middle fingertip and rub gently. Never push hard here. Breathe deeply and relax as you massage.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1次，饭后避免立即按压。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes, once daily. Avoid pressing right after eating.
when_zh: 胸闷气短、上腹胀满不舒服、打嗝不止、情绪烦闷。
when_en: Chest tightness, shortness of breath, upper belly fullness, persistent hiccups, or emotional distress.
tips_zh: 配合巨阙穴（RN14）一起按揉，保持心情舒畅、避免生闷气。
tips_en: Pair with Juque (RN14). Stay emotionally relaxed and avoid bottling up frustration.
caution_zh: 力度必须轻柔。饱食后禁止按压。局部疼痛剧烈时就医。
caution_en: Use only light pressure. Never press after a full meal. See a doctor for severe local pain.

summary_zh: 缓解胸口闷胀和吞咽不畅的穴位。
summary_en: Eases chest fullness and difficulty swallowing.
location_zh: 胸骨下端的正中位置，两侧肋弓交汇处的胸骨上。
location_en: On the breastbone at its lower end, where the rib arches meet in the center of the chest.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按在胸骨上，轻柔按压并上下推揉，不要用力过大，配合自然呼吸。
massage_en: Place your middle fingertip on the breastbone at this point. Press gently and slide up and down while breathing naturally. Keep the pressure light.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1次，饭后1小时进行。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes, once daily, one hour after meals.
when_zh: 胸口闷胀、吃东西往下咽不舒服、恶心想吐。
when_en: Chest fullness, discomfort when swallowing food, or nausea.
tips_zh: 配合膻中穴（RN17）一起按揉，饭后慢走帮助消化。
tips_en: Pair with Danzhong (RN17). A slow walk after meals supports digestion.
caution_zh: 力度轻柔，不要大力敲击胸骨。吞咽困难持续时请就医。
caution_en: Use gentle pressure only — do not pound the breastbone. See a doctor if swallowing difficulty persists.

summary_zh: 打开胸口、顺畅呼吸的最常用胸部穴位。
summary_en: The most popular chest point for opening the chest and easing breathing.
location_zh: 两个乳头连线的正中点，胸骨上。男性很容易找到；女性可从锁骨往下摸四根肋骨的位置，在胸骨正中取穴。
location_en: On the breastbone at the midpoint between the two nipples. Women can count down four ribs from the collarbone and find the center of the breastbone at that level.
massage_zh: 用拇指或中指按在穴位上，向胸骨方向按压，然后缓慢揉动。也可用掌根上下推擦胸骨，直到胸口发热。
massage_en: Press into the breastbone with your thumb or middle finger and rub slowly. You can also use the heel of your palm to rub up and down along the breastbone until it feels warm.
routine_zh: 每次3-5分钟，每天1-2次，早起或情绪低落时。
routine_en: 3-5 minutes, 1-2 times daily, in the morning or when feeling emotionally low.
when_zh: 胸闷气短、心情郁闷、咳嗽气喘、哺乳期奶少。
when_en: Chest tightness, shortness of breath, low mood, coughing, wheezing, or low milk supply during breastfeeding.
tips_zh: 配合深呼吸效果加倍。可搭配太冲穴（LR3）疏解情绪，感冒咳嗽时配合天突穴（RN22）。
tips_en: Deep breathing doubles the effect. Pair with Taichong (LR3) for emotional relief. For cough, combine with Tiantu (RN22).
caution_zh: 胸骨骨折或胸部手术后禁用。力度适中即可。
caution_en: Avoid after breastbone fracture or chest surgery. Use moderate pressure only.

summary_zh: 缓解胸闷咳嗽、帮助顺畅呼吸的穴位。
summary_en: Relieves chest tightness and coughing, and helps breathing.
location_zh: 膻中穴上方一个肋间距，大约在胸骨正中偏上的位置。
location_en: On the breastbone, one rib space above the midpoint between the nipples, in the upper-center area of the chest.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按在胸骨上，轻柔按压并缓慢揉动，配合深呼吸，吸气时按压、呼气时放松。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip on the breastbone. Rub gently and slowly. Press on the inhale, release on the exhale.
routine_zh: 每次2-3分钟，每天1次，咳嗽发作时可随时按。
routine_en: 2-3 minutes, once daily. Press anytime during a coughing episode.
when_zh: 胸闷不舒服、咳嗽有痰、气短、胸口疼痛。
when_en: Chest discomfort, cough with phlegm, shortness of breath, or chest pain.
tips_zh: 配合膻中穴（RN17）从下往上依次按揉，多喝温水化痰。
tips_en: Massage upward from Danzhong (RN17) to this point in sequence. Drink warm water to thin mucus.
caution_zh: 胸骨骨折后禁用。力度轻柔，不可大力敲击。
caution_en: Avoid after breastbone fracture. Use gentle pressure — do not pound.

summary_zh: 缓解上胸部闷痛和呼吸不畅的穴位。
summary_en: Eases upper chest tightness and breathing difficulty.
location_zh: 胸骨正中线上，锁骨下方数第二个肋间隙的位置，约在胸骨中上段。
location_en: On the breastbone at the level of the second rib space below the collarbone, in the upper-middle area of the chest.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹按压胸骨上的穴位，轻柔揉按，可配合另一手轻拍胸口辅助放松。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip on the breastbone and rub gently. You can lightly tap the chest with your other hand to help relax.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1次，感到胸闷时随时可按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes, once daily. Press anytime you feel chest tightness.
when_zh: 上胸闷痛、呼吸不畅、咳嗽气喘。
when_en: Upper chest tightness or pain, labored breathing, coughing, or wheezing.
tips_zh: 从膻中穴（RN17）向上依次按到紫宫穴，开窗通风配合深呼吸。
tips_en: Massage upward from Danzhong (RN17) to this point. Open a window for fresh air and take deep breaths.
caution_zh: 胸部手术后或骨折时禁用。按压力度要轻柔。
caution_en: Avoid after chest surgery or fracture. Keep pressure gentle.

summary_zh: 缓解咳嗽气喘和上胸不适的穴位。
summary_en: Relieves coughing, wheezing, and upper chest discomfort.
location_zh: 胸骨正中线上，锁骨下方第一个肋间隙的位置，接近胸骨上端。
location_en: On the breastbone at the first rib space below the collarbone, near the top of the breastbone.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻按胸骨上的穴位，缓慢揉按，也可用掌根从上往下推擦胸骨。
massage_en: Press lightly with your middle fingertip on the breastbone and rub slowly. You can also use the heel of your palm to stroke downward along the breastbone.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1次，咳嗽气喘发作时可按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes, once daily. Press during coughing or wheezing episodes.
when_zh: 咳嗽不止、气喘胸闷、上胸疼痛不适。
when_en: Persistent cough, wheezing, chest tightness, or upper chest pain.
tips_zh: 配合天突穴（RN22）一起按揉，保持空气湿润有助缓解咳嗽。
tips_en: Pair with Tiantu (RN22). Using a humidifier helps relieve coughing.
caution_zh: 力度轻柔，不可大力按压胸骨。严重气喘请立即就医。
caution_en: Use gentle pressure only. Seek immediate medical help for severe wheezing or breathing difficulty.

summary_zh: 缓解咳嗽咽痛和胸口不适的上胸穴位。
summary_en: Eases coughing, sore throat, and chest discomfort.
location_zh: 胸骨上端，喉咙下方的凹窝（天突穴）往下约一横指，胸骨正中线上。
location_en: On the breastbone, about one finger-width below the hollow at the base of the throat, on the midline.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻按胸骨上缘的穴位，缓慢按揉，力度轻柔，感到微微酸胀即可。
massage_en: Press with your middle fingertip near the top of the breastbone. Rub gently until you feel a mild ache. Keep the pressure light.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1次，喉咙不舒服时可随时按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes, once daily. Press anytime your throat feels uncomfortable.
when_zh: 咳嗽痰多、喉咙痛痒、胸口闷、呼吸不顺。
when_en: Cough with phlegm, sore or itchy throat, chest fullness, or labored breathing.
tips_zh: 配合天突穴（RN22）一起按揉，多喝温水润喉。
tips_en: Pair with Tiantu (RN22). Sip warm water to soothe the throat.
caution_zh: 力度轻柔。甲状腺区域有问题者慎用。
caution_en: Use gentle pressure. Use caution if you have thyroid conditions.

summary_zh: 止咳平喘、缓解咽喉不适的喉部要穴。
summary_en: The go-to throat point for coughing, wheezing, and sore throat.
location_zh: 喉咙正下方，两根锁骨之间的凹窝正中央。低头时手指很容易摸到这个窝。
location_en: In the center of the hollow between the two collarbones, right below the throat. Tilt your chin down and the notch is easy to feel.
massage_zh: 用中指指腹轻轻按在凹窝中央，向下方（朝胸骨方向）轻按，不要向喉咙深处按压。轻揉1-2分钟，力度一定要轻。
massage_en: Place your middle fingertip in the center of the notch. Press gently downward toward the breastbone — never push inward toward the throat. Rub lightly for 1-2 minutes.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次，咳嗽发作时可随时按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime a cough flares up.
when_zh: 咳嗽不止、喉咙痛痒、声音嘶哑、气喘胸闷、吞咽不畅。
when_en: Persistent cough, sore or itchy throat, hoarse voice, wheezing, chest tightness, or difficulty swallowing.
tips_zh: 配合膻中穴（RN17）和合谷穴（LI4）效果更好，喝蜂蜜水润喉。
tips_en: Pair with Danzhong (RN17) and Hegu (LI4). Honey water soothes the throat.
caution_zh: 力度必须轻柔，绝不可向喉咙深处按压。严重呼吸困难请立即就医。
caution_en: Use very gentle pressure only — never press deep into the throat. Seek immediate medical help for severe breathing difficulty.

summary_zh: 缓解咽喉不适、改善吞咽和说话的穴位。
summary_en: Eases throat discomfort and helps with swallowing and speech.
location_zh: 下巴正下方，喉结上方，仰头时能摸到舌骨上缘的一个凹陷处。
location_en: Below the chin on the midline, above the Adam's apple. Tilt your head back and feel for a small dip above the throat bump.
massage_zh: 微微仰头，用拇指指腹从下巴向喉咙方向轻推按压，找到凹陷处后轻揉，不要用力过猛。
massage_en: Tilt your head back slightly. Press with your thumb from under the chin toward the throat until you find the dip. Rub gently — do not press hard.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1次，喉咙不舒服时可随时按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes, once daily. Press anytime your throat feels off.
when_zh: 喉咙痛、吞咽困难、说话费力声音哑、口水多。
when_en: Sore throat, difficulty swallowing, strained or hoarse voice, or excess saliva.
tips_zh: 配合天突穴（RN22）一起按揉，少吃辛辣刺激食物，多喝温水。
tips_en: Pair with Tiantu (RN22). Avoid spicy foods and drink plenty of warm water.
caution_zh: 力度轻柔，避免压迫气管。颈部有肿物或严重疼痛时就医。
caution_en: Use light pressure to avoid pressing on the windpipe. See a doctor for neck lumps or severe throat pain.

summary_zh: 缓解面部不适和口周问题的面部穴位。
summary_en: A facial point that eases mouth and chin area discomfort.
location_zh: 下嘴唇正下方的凹陷处，下巴与下唇之间那条沟的正中点。
location_en: In the dip centered below the lower lip, right in the middle of the groove between the lip and the chin.
massage_zh: 用拇指或食指指腹按在凹陷处，轻柔按压并小幅度揉动，力度适中，持续按揉至局部微热。
massage_en: Press with your thumb or index finger in the dip. Rub gently in small circles with moderate pressure until the area feels slightly warm.
routine_zh: 每次1-2分钟，每天1-2次，随时可按。
routine_en: 1-2 minutes, 1-2 times daily. Press anytime.
when_zh: 嘴歪面痛、牙龈肿痛、流口水、下巴紧张酸痛。
when_en: Facial pain, toothache or sore gums, drooling, or jaw tension and soreness.
tips_zh: 配合合谷穴（LI4）缓解牙痛效果好，平时注意面部保暖防风。
tips_en: Pair with Hegu (LI4) for toothache relief. Keep your face warm and shielded from cold wind.
caution_zh: 面部皮肤破损或有炎症时避免。力度不可过重。
caution_en: Avoid if facial skin is broken or inflamed. Do not use excessive pressure.
